jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: JOB TITLE: **AI Engineer** Location: Solon, Ohio (Remote up to 2 days per week) Main responsibilities: * Provide dedicated technical execution capacity for the Filling, Can and Plastic business's artificial intelligence (AI) program, turning proven concepts into deployed solutions with measurable business results. * Structure data and build, configure, test and implement AI solutions together with business Process Owners, who keep ownership of the business problem, process definition, user validation and adoption. Reporting to: * Business Line: Filling, Can and Plastic * AI Program Lead Main missions: * Structure, clean and prepare business data for AI use, including technical documents, engineering drawings, product information, historical email, customer relationship management and document management records. * Select the right model, platform and approach for each use case across leading AI ecosystems (such as Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and OpenAI ChatGPT), balancing capability, cost, security and ease of adoption. * Build and configure AI solutions such as knowledge assistants, AI agents, document and quote generation, and workflow automation. * Work with Process Owners to translate mapped current and future processes into practical technical solutions with clear acceptance criteria. * Coordinate development and testing: prepare test cases, evaluate outputs for accuracy with business users, and iterate before release. * Implement solutions with the Process Owner, including controlled data sources, user access, user guidance and handover for ongoing use. * Deliver a portfolio of initiatives across the commercial\-to\-engineering workflow, including product configuration, Bill of Materials generation, proposal and quote automation, sales and customer knowledge, field service intelligence and spare parts quoting. * Connect individual solutions into a shared data and AI foundation so they can work together over time. * Support content improvement and adoption of AI solutions already in use. * Measure and report the impact of each initiative on workforce capacity, quality, speed and adoption. * Track developments in AI models, tools and frameworks and recommend where new capabilities can add business value. * Document solution architecture, data sources and procedures so knowledge stays with the business. Scope: * 100% dedicated to the business's AI program * Deliver a portfolio of concurrent initiatives across Sales, Proposals, Project Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service and Sales Administration * Be responsible for the technical quality, testing and implementation of AI solutions; business accountability remains with Process Owners * Work within controlled\-data and information security guidelines Working relationships: * **AI Program Team**: Program Lead and functional leaders from Project Engineering, Service and Product Management * **Director of Product Lines**: deliverable objectives and governance * **Cloud and Data Platform Director**: implementation architecture and architectural governance * **Central Research \& Development**: AI architecture guidance and specialist development support * **Business Process Owners and users**: Sales, Key Account Managers, Proposals, Project Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service, Sales Administration * **Information Technology**: data access, security and licensing Knowledge \& competencies required: * Deep, hands\-on working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot (including Copilot Studio), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and OpenAI ChatGPT, and their enterprise, agent and developer capabilities. * Broad, current knowledge of other modern AI models, tools and frameworks (for example open\-weight models, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol and similar), with the judgment to choose the right one for the job. * Hands\-on experience building solutions with large language models: grounding on company documents (retrieval\-augmented generation), prompt and context design, tool use and AI agents. * Experience with low\-code automation and cloud AI services (such as Power Automate, Azure AI, Google Cloud Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock) is highly desirable. * Strong data\-structuring skills: cleaning, organizing and transforming structured and unstructured data (documents, spreadsheets, email, database exports). * Programming skills in Python or a similar language; comfortable with SQL, application programming interfaces and advanced Excel. * Understanding of how to evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, consistency and reliability. * Strong technical, analytical and logic skills * Ability to understand business processes and translate them into practical technical solutions * Familiarity with enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management (such as Salesforce), product configurators or Bills of Materials is a plus. * Awareness of data security, access control and responsible use of AI with confidential company data * Organized and methodical; able to manage several projects at once and prioritize to meet business objectives * Autonomous, pragmatic and results\-driven; builds practical solutions quickly * Clear communicator, able to work with non\-technical users and write user guidance and documentation * Pedagogical mindset and ability to transfer knowledge * Proficient in spoken and written English Profile: * Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field * At least 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience with AI, data or automation, including internships, co\-op or significant project work. * A portfolio of completed AI or automation projects is highly desirable. Jobs Specifics: * Initial 6\-month contract, 100% dedicated to the AI program, with potential conversion to a permanent position based on delivered value. * Occasional domestic and international business travel to Kestrel offices and/or customer sites, representing up to 10% of working time per year.

jobs.title: AI Training Engineer
jobs.description: **THE ROLE** ------------ AI training that sticks are run by someone who can do the work, not just talk about it. That is the bar for this role. As an AI Training Engineer at Blank Metal, you split your time evenly between two jobs that make each other better. As a member of the training team, you are in front of clients, leading Claude Code and Cowork training. You own the outcome and the agenda. You are heads\-down on Shippy, our internal platform, shipping features and fixes on a two\-week cadence as part of the engineering team. The friction you watch clients hit in training becomes a backlog you fix in the product. The depth you build in the codebase is what makes you credible when a client CTO starts asking hard questions about MCP, RBAC, and platform readiness. You will coordinate with both the Head of Engineering and the Head of Training and Enablement to keep the two halves in balance. Because you deliver real client work half the time, you are held to the same engineering bar as every other engineer here. The 50/50 is the steady state, not a discount on either half. We are looking for candidates who are excited by the challenge of balancing training and engineering. This role is a great fit if you enjoy staying sharp with technical tools while helping others learn to use them effectively. **WHAT YOU GET TO DO** ---------------------- **Lead the Room: Training \& Enablement (50%)** * Serve as lead trainer for Claude Code and Cowork sessions across in\-person, virtual, and hybrid formats, owning session flow and outcomes for groups of 30 to 60 * Command a mixed room: field live questions, manage pacing, and hold authority whether the audience is individual contributors or the C\-suite * Troubleshoot participant setup live, including WSL, API authentication, SSL certificates, path variables, and enterprise IT restrictions, without losing the room * Run technical advisory calls with client IT teams on security posture, RBAC, connector tiering, context architecture, and environment readiness * Translate agentic AI for non\-technical audiences: the difference between chat and agents, security tradeoffs, and governance, in plain language **Ship the Platform: Shippy Engineering (50%)** * Ship features and bug fixes across the Shippy ecosystem (Blank Metal’s internal AI\-enabled operating system) on a two\-week iteration cadence * Pick up backlog assigned by the day\-to\-day engineering lead, keeping the queue moving whether the next task is an integration fix, a API bug, or net\-new work * Demonstrate working fluency across the stack: Next.js/React on Vercel, Neon/Postgres and the Databricks lakehouse, HubSpot, GCal, and Insperity integrations, Google SSO, etc. * Hold opinions and make architecture recommendations with the technical architect, especially on feasibility tradeoffs, API contracts between repos, and how new products plug into the underlying code and infrastructure * Operate as a contributor, not a gatekeeper. The team runs a “whole company can contribute PRs” posture, and your job is to keep things moving and high quality **Build the Bench: Curriculum, Certification \& Mentorship** * Support tiered training tracks (101 vs 201\) and build placement criteria to route participants to the right level * Build and evolve train\-the\-trainer programs, certifying internal client evangelists and Blank Metal support trainers to scale delivery beyond the core team * Progress through Blank Metal’s certification path (shadow, second chair, first chair) on the training side while growing Shippy ownership on the engineering side, so the role compounds rather than fractures * Mentor incoming trainers through the same pipeline and pair with associate engineers on PR reviews, walkthroughs, and bug bashes **Close the Loop: Insight to Product** * Turn friction observed during client engagements and training delivery into Shippy backlog items, so the enablement half is not a one\-way pull * Spot expansion opportunities during training (use cases, workflow gaps, organizational dynamics) and surface them with enough context to scope * Stay current on Anthropic releases, MCP, and agent orchestration so your teaching and your code both reflect the platform’s present state, not last quarter’s playbook **WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED** ------------------------------ * You have shipped software to production and can walk us through what you built, what changed after launch, and how it performed * You meet the same engineering bar as our delivery engineers: strong across a modern stack (TypeScript/React, a backend language, databases, APIs, and cloud), and comfortable owning features end to end * AI\-native fluency with Claude Code and Cowork: connectors, skills and plugins, MCP integrations, token and context management, and agent orchestration. You have built skills, plugins, or custom workflows * You can teach. You have led workshops or enablement sessions, and you know the difference between a session that felt good and one that changed behavior * You can hold a room of 30 to 60 people, technical and non\-technical, and stay credible when a skeptical engineer or a client CTO pushes back * You can talk to an executive and an engineer in the same meeting without losing either * Willing to travel as needed (currently around 30% of engagements) to deliver on\-site training and build client relationships in person **Nice to have** * Experience in private equity, financial services, or healthcare, where most of our training happens * A track record building or scaling a training or certification program * Familiarity with our stack: Next.js/React on Vercel, Postgres, and Databricks **WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE** --------------------------- * Build AI that ships: every project ends in a live deployment, not a slide deck * Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed * Outcome\-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours * AI\-native culture: you will work with peers who deeply understand modern AI’s potential and limits * Real collaboration: open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice

jobs.title: DMPK
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco; Boston; New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- ResearchScience Research **Compensation** ---------------- * $275K – $350K ### **About Us** Edison Scientific builds and deploys AI scientist agents to accelerate science and the development of new medicines. We are an ambitious team run by scientists and engineers from leading institutions across biology, physics, chemistry, and AI. **Role** We’re looking for a DMPK Subject Matter Expert to join our Forward Deployed team, working onsite with pharma and biotech partners alongside our engineers. Your job: ensure our AI agents produce DMPK and PK/PD outputs that are scientifically rigorous, decision ready, and aligned with how drug development teams actually advance compounds. You’ll evaluate agent performance on PK analysis, ADME interpretation, human dose projection, and IND DMPK report sections. You’ll work with our partners’ DMPK, clinical pharmacology, and development teams to identify where AI can streamline their workflows. And you’ll bring real\-world translational experience to everything our platform generates. You’re the person who knows whether an AI\-generated dose projection or DMPK package would hold up to internal governance and regulatory review. This is embedded, partner\-facing work. You’ll build relationships with DMPK and development leaders, understand their program constraints and regulatory requirements, and feed that knowledge back to our AI team. Over time, you’ll define the scientific approaches that train and evolve our agents, shaping how DMPK is practiced across the AI industry. **Responsibilities** * Generate and architect high\-quality DMPK training data spanning the discovery\-to\-IND workflow, in vitro ADME panels, in vivo PK across preclinical species, metabolite identification, NCA outputs, and PBPK/population PK simulations. * Identify optimal data sources, synthetic generation, consortia, licensed datasets, public PK/ADME databases, and beyond. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated DMPK outputs (PK parameter estimates, model fits, ADME interpretations, dose projections, written report sections) for scientific accuracy and regulatory compliance. * Collaborate with Engineering, Evals, and Science teams to benchmark and improve agent performance against gold\-standard DMPK workflows. * Direct and improve agent logic to refine data quality and agent capabilities. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of hands\-on DMPK experience supporting programs from discovery through IND, or direct ownership of 10\+ IND\-reaching programs. * Proven ability to translate CRO bioanalytical data, in vitro ADME results, and in vivo PK study reports into FDA\-ready IND DMPK submissions. * Strong proficiency in PK modeling. Experience with at least one PBPK platform (Simcyp, GastroPlus, or PK\-Sim). * End\-to\-end ADME fluency. * Comfortable operating as the sole in\-house DMPK expert with minimal supervision. * Enthusiastic about iterating with LLM tools to identify data sources and improve agent outputs. **Bonus points for** * Experience leading regulatory DDI strategy, including PBPK\-based DDI predictions submitted to FDA/EMA. * PK/PD modeling or quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) experience. * Previous AI/ML work applied to DMPK or ADME property prediction. * Background at big pharma or CROs supporting large pharma IND programs. **Salary** $220k\- $275k ### **Why join us?** We're a fast\-moving, mission\-driven culture where smart people do their best work and actually enjoy doing it. We also offer full\-time employees the following: * Competitive salary and equity * Full healthcare coverage; we pay 100% of premiums for you and your dependents * Support for growing families, including a yearly new parent stipend and fertility coverage through Carrot * Mental health support through Rula, our in\-network therapist and psychiatrist network with fast availability * 12 weeks of paid parental leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption * Pet care support with a yearly employer\-funded stipend for your animal companions * Commuter benefits so you can pay for transit and parking with pre\-tax dollars * 401(k) company matching * $300 health and wellness benefit quarterly * Lunch is on us every day you're in the office, and dinner is on us when you're working late * Regular team off\-sites and company events *Edison Scientific is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* Compensation Range: $275K \- $350K

jobs.title: Engineer, Performance & Profiling
jobs.description: **Who we are:** --------------- Today, AI is something you rent. Alpaca is building the full stack of hardware, software, models, and applications together to make it something you own. We are developing a new computer architecture that breaks the economics keeping frontier models trapped in datacenters. On top of that, we’re building a platform of models, applications, and services that give that hardware meaning. Personal AI is moving from the datacenter to the desk, and we are driving that change. jobs.title: Engineering Leader, Machine Learning & Ad Platform
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Moxxi, we're redefining performance marketing with cutting\-edge technology and a relentless focus on results. As a profitable, bootstrapped start\-up, we are led by a team of industry veterans in performance marketing, ad tech, and digital publishing. Together, we're building the premier platform to incubate, scale, and optimize digitally born businesses, setting new standards for data\-driven success. Our entrepreneurial team brings proven experience from both global corporations and fast\-growing startups. We're passionate about delivering scalable, profitable outcomes for our partners through advanced profiling, targeting, and continuous optimization. Joining Moxxi means becoming part of a growing start\-up in the heart of NYC, where you'll have the opportunity to accelerate your career, expand your skill set, and shape the future of performance marketing. Headquartered in New York City, Moxxi has recently opened a collaborative office designed for focus, creativity, and purposeful execution. Every project reflects our belief that excellence is built on discipline, curiosity, and integrity. **Moxxi Digital is a proud honoree of Crain's Best Places to Work in NYC 2026\.** We are just getting started and invite you to join us as we continue to build something remarkable. **The Opportunity** ------------------- As Engineering Leader for Machine Learning \& Ad Platform at Moxxi, you'll be a hands\-on technical leader who can architect production systems, build and ship the machine learning models that drive our revenue, and lead the teams that do both. You'll own the intelligence at the core of our performance marketing engine — the ranking, prediction, targeting, and optimization models that decide which offer is shown, where, and to whom — along with the low\-latency platform that serves those decisions on every impression and click. You'll personally design, prototype, and productionize data science and ML solutions, set the technical direction for our ad platform, and lead one to two engineering teams (spanning platform engineering, ML, and data) and the products they own. You'll partner directly with the CTO, Product, and our Ad Ops and Account Management teams to turn revenue goals into models, systems, and measurable results. If you want to be the person who writes the model, designs the system around it, proves its lift with a clean experiment, and builds the team that scales it, this role is for you. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Machine Learning \& Data Science (Hands\-On)** * Design, build, and ship production ML models for ad ranking and decisioning, including click, conversion, and revenue prediction (pCTR, pCVR, EPC, and RPI) that determine which offers and placements are served. * Develop optimization algorithms for bidding, budget pacing, and traffic and yield allocation that maximize revenue and advertiser outcomes under real\-world constraints. * Build audience, lookalike, and targeting models that identify high\-value users and improve campaign performance across publishers and placements. * Own the full model lifecycle: problem framing, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, training, offline evaluation, online deployment, monitoring, and retraining, in Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost/LightGBM. * Design and run rigorous online experiments (A/B tests, multi\-armed bandits, holdouts) with sound statistical methodology, and translate results into clear go/no\-go decisions. * Build the ML platform foundations on GCP — feature pipelines and feature store, training pipelines, model registry, real\-time inference, and model monitoring — using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow. * Apply LLMs and agentic workflows where they deliver measurable value, such as AI\-assisted campaign setup, creative and offer generation, content classification, and operator copilots in Moxxi's ad ops platform. * Partner with Data Engineering to ensure event, tracking, and attribution data in BigQuery is accurate, timely, and fit for both billing and model training. **Technical Leadership \& Platform Engineering** * Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Moxxi's ad platform, including ad serving, real\-time decisioning, tracking, and campaign management. * Stay hands\-on in the codebase — designing, building, and reviewing production code in Golang (backend services) and Python (ML and data services), and guiding React work on operator\-facing applications. * Design low\-latency, high\-throughput serving systems that run model inference within strict performance budgets for latency, throughput, and cost, using Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes (GKE). * Build and maintain integrations with advertisers, affiliate networks, publishers, and ad tech partners via APIs, postbacks, and real\-time event pipelines. * Own system and model reliability end to end — observability, alerting, on\-call, incident response, and blameless post\-mortems — using tools like Datadog ough example — coaching engineers on system design, modeling, experimentation, and ownership. **Cross\-Functional Partnership** * Work closely with the CTO, Product, Ad Ops, and Account Management to translate business goals and operator needs into scoped, prioritized technical and ML roadmaps. * Communicate model performance, experiment results, tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership. * Stay current on ML research and industry changes (privacy regulation, signal loss, partner platform changes) and their impact on Moxxi's models and platform. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5\+ years building and deploying machine learning systems in production. * 3\+ years leading engineering teams as an engineering manager or tech lead manager, including hiring, performance management, and leading multiple engineers or teams. * Hands\-on experience building ranking, recommendation, prediction, or optimization models for ads, search, recommendations, or marketplaces — from feature engineering through online deployment. * Production\-level fluency in Python and the ML stack (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or gradient\-boosted trees), plus strong backend development skills in a compiled language (Go, Java, Scala, or similar). * Strong grounding in statistics, experimentation design, and causal measurement, with a track record of using online experiments to drive product and business decisions. * Proven track record designing and operating low\-latency, high\-throughput, highly available distributed systems, including real\-time model serving. * Experience building ML infrastructure: data and feature pipelines, training pipelines, model deployment, and model monitoring. * Strong data skills — advanced SQL, data modeling, and large\-scale data processing on a cloud data warehouse or big data platform. * Experience building and deploying on a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure) with containerization and orchestration. * Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of making sound, defensible tradeoffs with incomplete information in a fast\-moving environment. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain models and results to technical and business stakeholders alike. **Nice to Have / Bonus Qualifications** --------------------------------------- * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field. * Direct experience in AdTech or performance marketing, especially ads ranking, real\-time bidding, budget pacing, lookalike targeting, or conversion and attribution modeling. * Familiarity with programmatic concepts (OpenRTB, DSPs/SSPs, auctions) and performance marketing economics (CPA, CPC, EPC, CTR, revenue per impression, ROAS). * Experience with GCP's ML and data stack, including Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and GKE. * Experience with deep learning for ranking (e.g., deep cross networks, transformers, sequence models) and distributed training. * Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/integer programming), reinforcement learning, or contextual bandits applied to allocation or bidding problems. * Experience building LLM\-powered and agentic product features, including evaluation frameworks, and using AI\-assisted development workflows. * Experience with event streaming technologies (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent) and real\-time feature computation. * Hands\-on experience with Golang and a modern front\-end framework such as React. * Startup experience — moving quickly, wearing multiple hats, and building teams and ML capabilities from an early stage. * Awareness of privacy regulations and compliance relevant to advertising and consumer data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, TCPA).

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Our Mission** Salt AI is building the intelligence layer for the enterprise. In a world where AI is fragmented across models, tools, and data silos, Salt unifies them through a compliance\-first orchestration platform that helps regulated organizations deploy AI securely and at scale. We're building the systems that power real\-world AI workflows in financial services and other regulated industries. Our platform brings models, data, and existing infrastructure together so enterprises can put AI to work within their operational and compliance constraints. #### **The Role \& How We Work** Forward Deployed Engineers build the systems that make Salt real inside our customers' environments. You'll work with enterprises in financial services and other regulated industries—using their actual data, infrastructure, and constraints—to build the custom software and deep integrations a deployment needs and get it running in production. This is hands\-on engineering, not advisory work. You write the code, build the integrations, and own the rollout into the customer’s environment. You'll exercise technical ownership: propose the approach, solve problems independently, and surface risks and trade\-offs to the Deployment Strategist early. You'll build and harden the systems a defined workflow needs, support the agreed deployment and handoff period, and leave the customer able to operate independently. We’re an AI engineering company pushing the edge of what’s possible. **We build our own agent harness, and our engineers use AI agents to design, build, test, and release Salt.** We’re moving from individual output to true systems\-level leverage: engineers break work into pieces agents can own, set the bar, build automated checks and code reviews that catch what tests miss, and remain accountable for what ships. #### **What You’ll Do** * Build \& Harden Integrations: Design and implement integrations to customer infrastructure–enterprise data sources, identity systems, and internal tooling. Respect customer data and infrastructure boundaries by building permission\-aware integrations that protect credentials and sensitive data, and keep telemetry useful without exposing customer content. * Ship to Production: Get your work running in the customer’s environment – SaaS, VPC, or on\-prem – in partnership with Salt Platform engineers on the infrastructure side. Test integrations and design for failure, recovery, and observability from day one. * Navigate Unfamiliar Environments: Debug in unfamiliar environments where you don’t control the stack and documentation may not exist. Work with the account’s Executive Advisor to get the domain context you need. * Technical Ownership: Propose technical approaches and make decisions within the agreed scope. Weigh the customer’s immediate needs against maintainability, delivery effort, and potential value across other accounts; flag scope changes and material trade\-offs to your Deployment Strategist early. Manage and communicate your work clearly so the delivery team can track progress and dependencies. * Enable Customer Independence: Contribute to the agreed workflow evaluation and handoff, working with the customer and delivery team on acceptance criteria, validation, and regression coverage. Pair with customer engineering teams to review and transfer knowledge as you go. Deliver the runbooks, architecture docs, and configuration details they’ll need to operate independently after handoff. * Feed the Core Product: Bring field learnings back to Product and Platform through engagement debriefs, identifying recurring customer needs and evolving suitable integrations into reusable components or extension patterns. **Must\-Have Core Skills and Experience** * Backend \& Systems Engineering: 6\+ years building and shipping production software, with strong Python skills and deep experience in APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)—reasoning about contracts, interfaces, and failure modes, not just calling SDKs. * AI\-First Engineering Habits: Proven ability to use coding agents and AI\-assisted tools effectively—defining clear constraints and verifying, challenging, and improving agent output while retaining full ownership of what ships. * Practical Architecture: Strong judgment to build clear, maintainable integrations and reusable patterns without over\-engineering or losing important customer\-specific requirements. * Customer\-Facing Execution: Comfort sitting directly with customer engineering teams to debug in an unfamiliar environment, ask sharp questions, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly, find the real constraints, and make progress with incomplete information. * Travel: Willingness to travel for onsite deployment work (averaging \~20%). **Nice to Have** * Hands\-on experience with LLM applications, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, or model deployment. * Experience deploying into customer\-controlled environments (VPC, on\-prem, or air\-gapped) using Kubernetes,Terraform, or other IaC tools. * Background in regulated industries, particularly financial services (life sciences, or government also relevant) and familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, GxP). * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting experience. #### **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive salary based on location and experience * Comprehensive medical, dental, and mental health coverage * 401(k) plan * Fully remote role, collaborating primarily within U.S. time zones #### **Join Us** At Salt AI, we're building systems that help enterprises put AI to work in financial services and other regulated industries. If you want to ship code that operates in demanding customer environments and delivers lasting value, we'd love to hear from you. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: LLM Java Developer
jobs.description: LLM Java Developer is a remote engineering review track for evaluating Java code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Java model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce Java code outputs in a sandboxed environment for LLM Java Developer assignments. * Grade java engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job Java experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for LLM Java Developer work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated Java solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with Java's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Java engineering * Java * Software development **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. jobs.description: ### **Member of Technical Staff, Generalist — Supercompute** **San Francisco, CA · In office, 5 days a week · Full time · 2 openings** ### **About d\_model** d\_model is an interpretability \& alignment AI research lab. We partner with frontier labs to turn their models into capable interpretability and alignment researchers, and we use the agents we build for our own independent research. Our team has worked at OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, EleutherAI and MATS, among other places. ### **About the role** The Supercompute team builds the systems our researchers depend on every day: sandboxes for AI agents, AI training infrastructure, tools for monitoring AI agents, and the tools that keep a fast\-moving research lab coordinated. We're a small team, where every member owns real projects end\-to\-end. We're hiring two software engineers who can take full ownership of at least one internal system; from discovering what researchers actually need, through design and build, to running and maintaining it in production. You won't be handed a spec. You'll sit close to our research team, notice where they're slowed down, and decide what to build about it. This is a generalist role. You'll move between frontend, backend and infrastructure, and you'll get to learn new parts of the stack as our needs change. If you like breadth, autonomy and building tools that make other people faster, this is the job. ### **What you might work on** Projects change with what our research needs, but here are the kinds of things you could own: * **Sandboxes for agents.** Design and run isolated environments where our models write and execute code, use tools and run experiments — safely, secure, reliably and at scale. * **AI training infrastructure.** Build and improve our training systems (pretraining, midtraining, \& posttraining): job scheduling, cluster management, training cookbooks, experiment tracking and the pipelines that move data and checkpoints around. * **Research automation.** Build pipelines for automating the development of reinforcement learning environments, AI research, and AI self\-alignment. * **Apps that speed up researchers.** Build internal tools that help researchers plan, launch, monitor, compare and share experiments, so they spend less time on plumbing and more on research. * **Coordination and work management.** Build the internal systems that help a fast\-growing team track work, share results and stay in sync. ### **What you'll do** * Own one or more internal systems end to end: design, execution and long\-term maintenance. * Find researcher problems before anyone files a ticket, and decide what's worth solving. * Make sound technical decisions on your own, and explain the trade\-offs clearly. * Work across the stack, from user\-facing interfaces to backend services and compute infrastructure. * Keep what you build reliable, observable and easy for others to use. ### **You may be a good fit if you** * Have shipped and maintained fullstack production software — frontend, backend and infrastructure — and are comfortable picking up whichever layer a problem needs. * Have owned a project end to end, from scoping through design, build and ongoing operation. * Have strong product sense: you can talk to users, work out what they really need and build something they'll use. * Work well with a lot of autonomy. You set direction for your own work, make good technical calls without close oversight, and know when to ask for input. * Have experience building internal tools, developer tooling, platforms or infrastructure for other engineers or researchers. * Write clearly and communicate trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Have used AI agents not just as coding assistance, but as components in resilient infrastructure. ### **Bonus points** * Experience with machine learning or large language model training, or the infrastructure behind them. * Experience with high\-performance computing, GPU clusters, job schedulers or container orchestration. * Experience building sandboxed or isolated execution environments. * Entrepreneurial experience — you've founded something, been an early engineer at a startup, or built a product from zero. ### **What we offer employees** * Platinum\-tier medical (Blue Shield PPO or Kaiser HMO); dental and vision * Flexible PTO * Monthly workspace and wellness allowances * One conference a year fully covered * 401(k) with automatic enrollment * $10,000 Lifetime Fertility benefit * Catered lunch daily, and breakfast twice a week in the SF office * SF Moma museum membership ### **Logistics** * **Location:** We currently expect all staff to work from our San Francisco office five days a week. * **Visa sponsorship:** We sponsor visas. jobs.title: Product Engineer - AI
jobs.description: Product Engineer \- AI **Location:** Nashville or Boston (Hybrid) **About Synquery** ================== The world’s most valuable knowledge is locked inside experts’ heads, and accessing that insight has traditionally been manual, slow, and expensive. Synquery is changing this. We’re building a platform where AI agents autonomously find, recruit, match, and interview world\-class experts—creating an end\-to\-end agentic pipeline for human knowledge that is otherwise unwritten. Our clients include top consulting firms, private equity investors, and research organizations, with a far\-reaching addressable market. We’re a small, rapidly moving team seeking Product Engineers to truly own part of the platform—getting close to the problem, writing requirements and docs, and then building the solution yourself. You’ll use AI tools daily, work closely with senior engineers and the CTO, and grow into someone who drives both product vision and technical execution. If you’re early in your career and want to accelerate your growth, this is that opportunity. **What You'll Own** =================== You’ll take ownership for a core product surface based on your strengths and our evolving needs. Current areas include: * Expert sourcing and vetting: AI pipelines for finding and qualifying top experts * AI voice interviewer: autonomous interviews that extract and deliver insight * Client\-facing platform: client portal UI and underlying AI\-powered systems * Agent infrastructure: autonomous agents and pipelines powering the platform * Synthesis products: transforming transcripts into actionable intelligence * New surfaces: building tools from zero as we expand Regardless of what you own, you’ll: * Build close relationships with users to uncover what really matters * Clearly document and define the right things to build, then execute rapidly * Ship working solutions and iterate fast **Day to Day** ============== * Engage with clients and users to understand pain points and needs * Turn insights into clear requirements and product specs * Build features, workflows, and agents using AI\-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) * Collaborate with senior engineers and CTO through design/code reviews * Test and debug AI agents and understand/fix failure modes * Keep the team updated with clear, transparent communication **About You** ============= * Heavy user of AI productivity tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, etc. * Technically comfortable: you can read code, write scripts, debug problems using AI * Quick to pick up new domains, stacks, and codebases * Clear, concise communicator—especially in written form * 1–3 years of experience in product, software, consulting, or early\-stage companies **Nice to have:** experience with LLM APIs, consulting/research workflows, and familiarity with React, Node, or Python. **Where This Goes** =================== We’re building infrastructure for a market in its infancy. Those who join Synquery now will help shape something truly new and will have opportunities for rapid growth and ownership. We want engineers who can communicate with clients, define products, and ship solutions all in the same day—and are committed to investing in your growth to get you there. **What We Offer** ================= * Meaningful equity in a high\-growth, revenue\-positive company * Direct access to the founding team from day one * Competitive early\-career salary * The tools, access, and autonomy to do your best work

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager

Sales Enablement: Write the one\-pagers, decks and comparison sheets our sales team uses with customers. **IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * 3\+ years of experience across product marketing and product management at an AI, developer tools or infrastructure company. * 5\+ years for senior candidates. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, research and sales teams. Familiarity with LLM inference, GPUs, open\-weight model releases, or inference engines like vLLM and SGLang. * Experience at an early\-stage startup, or as one of the first marketing hires. * Experience running paid social or search campaigns. * Video editing skills (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, CapCut or similar). * Working fluency with Webflow, GA4, HubSpot, Figma and Canva. * An existing network of AI creators and developers **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k plan * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Sciforium is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Runtime Lead
jobs.description: Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general\-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing. We are looking for a Runtime Lead to architect and design the runtime software stack that brings the Fabric to life, from the Linux kernel\-mode driver through the user\-mode driver and runtime library that sit between the effcc compiler and the Fabric ABI. You will set the overall technical direction, plan the technical work with engineering management, collaborate with partner teams, and provide technical leadership to the engineers who build it, while staying hands\-on in the code. You will take the stack from pre\-silicon environments, involving QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, and FPGAs, through first silicon to ensure applications run on day one. This is a key role for the System Software team. As such, you will represent the runtime team to the compiler, architecture, digital design, verification, and product teams during all phases of development. **Key Responsibilities** ### **Provide Technical Leadership for the Runtime Team** * Provide technical leadership to the engineers who own the kernel\-mode driver and the user\-mode runtime: guide technical priorities and ownership with the engineering manager, mentor engineers, and help interview as the team scales. * Own the runtime technical roadmap: scope, milestones, and estimates. Work with the engineering management on the tradeoffs needed to hit committed dates, and raise technical risks early. * Set the engineering bar for the team: design reviews, code reviews, coding standards, test strategy, and release practices. * Build consensus on technical decisions within the team and with partner teams. * Stay hands\-on, contributing code and design to the most critical parts of the stack. ### **Architect the Runtime Software Stack** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the runtime software stack: the kernel\-mode driver, the HAL and Fabric ABI, the user\-mode driver and runtime library, and the interfaces used by ML framework backends (e.g., PyTorch). * Help define the split between kernel and user space: what belongs in the driver, what belongs in the runtime,and how the two share memory, synchronization primitives, and error reporting. * Help define the unified memory model between ARM cores and the Fabric accelerator, including SMMU (IOMMU) integration, tensor pool allocation, shared virtual addressing, and zero\-copy data paths. * Help define, with the compiler team, the in\-memory representations generated by the compiler and consumed by the Fabric, along with binary formats, program loading, and the launch ABI. * Help define, with the help of the firmware and architecture teams: the multi\-island task scheduling policy, microcode loading, and the software stack for the embedded risc core. * Keep the stack layered and portable across device generations, and across QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, FPGA, and silicon backends. ### **Represent the Team Cross\-Functionally** * Represent the runtime team in architecture, digital design, compiler, embedded, verification, and product forums, and bring the software point of view into hardware decisions before tapeout. * Keep engineering leadership and program management informed on technical status, risks, and decisions. * Work with product and application teams Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms \& Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product \& Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. The **Software Engineer II** will participate actively in ensuring that the highest standards of quality are being met for the various systems and applications within the Content Platforms \& Operations portfolio. As part of the Production Support Engineering team, the Software Engineer II will be working with both custom\-built legacy and state\-of\-the\-art applications to support the needs of a wide variety of customers across DEEP\&T and The Walt Disney Studios. These include the ordering, creation, safe\-keeping, and transport/delivery of film, television, and music assets around the globe. The Software Engineer II will be responsible for understanding the core functionalities of the systems in the portfolio, build tools to aid in the management and support of the systems, and serve as the escalation for high level production support tickets and requests. As such, the Software Engineer II’s primary functions will be to develop support, monitoring, and deployment tools, help resolve high level support issues, address defects, and maximize up\-time for the entire portfolio. In addition to the rest of the Support Engineering Team, the engineer will engage with other disciplines of the extended project team, including product, information security, QA, software engineering, systems, network, and database teams. The engineer will be expected to work on issues with sometimes incomplete information, communicate with various levels of users (sometimes executives), work with slow or non\-responsive partners, navigate complex bureaucracy, and sometimes work with unfamiliar technology. Serve as initial contact for end users reporting issues or requesting assistance for supported systems and applications * Triage, assign, prioritize and resolve user\-reported incidents and requests using a ticketing system * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and customers and partners across the organization to resolve issues * Develop, expand and administer system monitoring and production support tools * Troubleshoot and resolve production support issues and defects * Troubleshoot and resolve system outages and assist with root cause analysis * Adhere to coding guidelines and best practices set forth by engineering, product, and information security teams * Design, implement, and unit test backlog items for legacy applications * Partner with various teams to identify ways to maximize system up\-time and make system optimizations * Write technical documentation **Minimum Qualifications:** * Minimum 3 years of experience in a production support software engineering role * Expert in supporting and debugging applications in JavaScript (NodeJS, React), Java, SQL and MongoDB, and knowledge of a scripting language (Perl, Python or Ruby) * Strong understanding of information security principles * Strong analytical problem\-solving skills, organizational skills and attention to detail * Basic understanding of networking principles, fast file\-moving technologies/protocols (Aspera products), on\-premise storage/mapping, and cloud\-based storage solutions (AWS S3\) * Strong understanding of JavaScript, Java, .Net, SQL, MongoDB, APIs and messaging services * Proactive work style with the ability to work autonomously * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to create documentation and communicate with a diverse global user community * Effective collaborator and strong ability to work cooperatively with team members across multiple disciplines in a fast\-paced environment * AI literacy * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with working on applications in Linux\-, Windows\- and Cloud\-based platforms * Solid understanding of various deployment tools and CI/CD principles (Jenkins) * Expert domain knowledge of asset management and accelerated transport systems * Able to comfortably multitask and context switch frequently * Able to make important decisions when given incomplete and conflicting information * Highly self\-directed, being able to both manage and (re)prioritize the multiple, concurrent, and competing challenges, issues, ambiguities, and contradictions that sometimes occur during the creation of software solutions in a rapidly changing environment * Good interpersonal and relationship building skills **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Glendale, CA and in Bristol, CT is $119,200\.00 \- $159,800\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **This is a remote position** The Opportunity --------------- AAPC seeks a distinctive type of software engineer: someone who blends strong technical skills with curiosity, initiative, product insight, and a rare passion for delivering value. You will join an engineering team in AAPC’s Technology and Engineering organization that is focused on the marketing domain: our website, digital products, e\-commerce, and the systems that take people from discovery through membership, certification, and renewal. You will work closely with Marketing, who will clarify the customer problem, its importance, and the business rules that guide the solution. You will be responsible for translating that guidance into functional technology that reaches users and delivers measurable benefits. We want engineers who can move from understanding the “what” and “why” to figuring out the “how.” Analyze the problem, manage ambiguity, make sound technical choices, and execute effectively. You need to work quickly, exercise judgment, and own the process end to end. You don’t need a marketing background. What matters is that you can connect systems reliably, build custom software where purchased tools fall short, and hold everything to the same production standard as the rest of our platform. You will partner with our platform engineering team on infrastructure, deployment, and observability, and with our data engineering team so member and customer data arrives complete and ready to use. Modern tooling has fundamentally changed what an exceptional engineer can accomplish. In this role, you will treat AI as an extension of your engineering team. By leveraging agentic coding tools, reusable skills, agentic engineering practices, established components, and internal frameworks, you will orchestrate work that historically required a much larger team. This is a hands\-on lead role. You will be the most senior engineer on the team, setting standards, reviewing designs and code, and helping engineers with strong front\-end and CMS skills grow into well\-rounded engineers. From time to time, you will also step into interim team leadership to keep work moving.What You’ll Do -------------- * Turn clearly articulated customer problems, business needs, and business rules into production\-ready technology. * Own delivery of the software you build, from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, observability, support, and continuous improvement. * Break complex outcomes into executable work and coordinate agents toward a common goal. * Connect the platforms the business already uses through reliable integrations, and build custom services and customer\-facing applications where those platforms fall short. * Work with platform engineering and data engineering so what you build runs on our standard infrastructure and member and customer data flows reliably into our data platform. * Investigate and resolve ambiguity independently when you can determine the answer through technical judgment, research, customer context, or existing standards. * Identify genuine business questions early and return them to Marketing or the responsible stakeholder quickly enough that answers don’t delay delivery. * Make technical decisions autonomously while remaining aligned with shared architectural principles, platforms, and standards. * Deliver valuable increments early, learn from real usage, and iterate rapidly. * Set standards, review designs and code, and mentor the engineers on your team. * Create and improve reusable skills, components, frameworks, workflows, and automation that increase the effectiveness of future engineering work. * Strengthen testing, code review, security analysis, accessibility, quality assurance, monitoring, and incident diagnosis. * Measure success by customer and business outcomes, not by the number of stories completed or the amount of code produced. What We’re Looking For ---------------------- * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with a recent record of writing and shipping production code yourself. * Demonstrated experience taking software from an initial idea through production delivery. * Practical experience across the broader technology lifecycle, including software development, deployment, DevOps, observability, monitoring, and production support. * Ability to work across technical boundaries rather than staying limited to one narrow layer of a system. * Experience integrating with third\-party systems through APIs, webhooks, or events, and designing for the ways they fail. * Strong judgment about when to act independently, when to investigate further, and when a decision must return to the business or another responsible stakeholder. * Experience using agentic coding tools, or compelling evidence that you are actively developing an agentic engineering practice. * The ability to direct, evaluate, and integrate AI\-generated work while retaining full accountability for its co ccessful engineering creates customer and business value. * The initiative to improve the systems and processes around you rather than repeatedly working around the same problems. Experience with marketing automation, CRM, headless CMS, customer data, or e\-commerce platforms is helpful but not required. We value demonstrated capability, judgment, and personal drive more than a particular title or traditional seniority level. We will level this role based on demonstrated capability, from senior through principal.Show Us What Drives You ----------------------- We want to know what you chose to build, not just what an employer assigned to you. We encourage you to share something that demonstrates your curiosity, initiative, and passion for the craft. The subject matter does not need to align with AAPC’s products. We are interested in what you chose to learn, the problems you encountered, the decisions you made, and whether you cared enough to bring the idea to life. AAPC (www.aapc.com) is the world’s largest and fastest\-growing healthcare training, certification, and solutions association. **AAPC Values:** DRIVEN \| Self\-starts and stays highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals. Shares contagious energy and enthusiasm liberally. Takes initiative without always being directed. Demonstrates confidence in decision\-making and effectively balances autonomy and authority with accountability. HUMBLE \| Learns, adapts, and improves relentlessly. Seeks feedback without insecurity and implements coaching. Recognizes others' contributions gratefully. Approaches work and relationships with an abundance mentality. Places the needs of others above self. TRANSPARENT\| Integrity\-centered, honest, truthful, and trustworthy in all aspects of work. Keeps commitments to external and internal parties. Holds self strictly accountable, valuing the trust placed in them by others. SUPPORTIVE \| Empowers and uplifts others. Listens actively and responds with empathy and understanding. Prioritizes well\-being and growth of team members and customers ahead of own interest. Faces challenges together, believing in collective strength and unity. jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ================== AKUVO is hiring an AI \& Automation Engineer to lead how our IT and cloud teams automate repeatable work and operate AI agents safely. You will turn manual IT and cloud tasks into code, and you will run the day\-to\-day IT controls for the AI agents that are becoming part of how AKUVO works. This is a new role on a small team. You will be the team’s go\-to person for automation and agent operations, and you will help others build those skills. You will also support our Azure environment alongside our IT team.**What You’ll Do** ================== **Automation** -------------- * Automate repeatable IT and cloud work such as provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, certificate renewals, patching, and access reviews. * Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub. * Use PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, and Azure Automation or Logic Apps to connect systems and remove manual steps. * Share patterns, review scripts, and help teammates automate their own work. **AI Agent Operations** ----------------------- * Provision and manage identities for AI agents and automations, including service principals and managed identities, with least privilege and regular credential rotation. * Maintain the Agent Registry: what each agent does, who owns it, what it can access, and its current status. * Manage the agent lifecycle: onboarding, configuration and prompt versioning, testing, rollback, and retirement. * Monitor agent activity, usage, and cost, and escalate anomalies to Information Security. * Implement guardrails and controls and submit your own agents and automations for the same independent review as everyone else’s. **Cloud Support** ----------------- * Support our Azure environment alongside our cloud engineer and managed service partner, including deployments, monitoring, and incident response. * Keep cloud spend, including AI and LLM usage, visible and under control. * Document what you build: runbooks, standards, and diagrams. **What You’ll Bring** ===================== * 5 to 10 years of experience in cloud engineering, systems engineering, DevOps, or a related role, with automation as a core part of your work. * Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Azure. * Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or both. * Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. * Working knowledge of Entra ID, including app registrations, service principals, and managed identities. * A security\-first mindset and clear written documentation. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building or operating AI agents or LLM\-based tools, such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or Copilot Studio. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks, or tool permission models. * jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are seeking an Applied Scientist to join our Supply Science team. This team is within the Sponsored Products team, and works on complex engineering, optimization, econometric, and user\-experience problems in order to deliver relevant ads on the Amazon search page world\-wide thereby enhancing the shopper experience. Our work spans ML and Data science across predictive modeling, reinforcement learning (Bandits), adaptive experimentation, causal inference and data engineering. Key job responsibilities Search Supply and Experiences, within Sponsored Products, is seeking an Applied Scientist to join a team with the mandate of creating new ads experience that elevates the shopping experience for our hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. We are looking for a top analytical mind capable of understanding our complex ecosystem of advertisers participating in a pay\-per\-click model– and leveraging this knowledge to help turn the flywheel of the business. As an Applied Scientist on this team you will: * Drive end\-to\-end machine learning projects that have a high degree of ambiguity, scale and complexity * Perform analysis on very large data sets to develop ideas and size opportunities; build machine learning models and conduct analysis to demonstrate potential business value * Design A/B experiments, working with engineers to launch online experiments; conduct statistical analysis of the experimental results to derive understanding * Build efficient and automated processes for large\-scale feature generation, machine\-learning model training, validation and serving. Work with engineers to productionize ML models. * Develop new and innovative machine learning approaches, and collaborate with the science community. A day in the life The successful candidate will be a self\-starter comfortable with ambiguity, strong attention to detail and an ability to work in a fast\-paced environment. About the team We are a customer\-obsessed team of engineers, technologists, product leaders, and scientists. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. jobs.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Supply Tech - Advertising
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Ads is one of the fastest\-growing advertising businesses in the world, connecting brands with hundreds of millions of customers across shopping, streaming, gaming, audio and the open web. Behind every ad that runs on Prime Video, Twitch, IMDb and thousands of external publisher apps and sites is a decisioning platform built by Amazon Ads Supply Tech. That platform makes X trillion ad decisions every day and supports $XB\+ in annual publisher revenue across XX\+ Amazon\-owned publishers and X,000\+ external publishers in streaming TV, audio, display, mobile and podcasts. Every one of those decisions is a science problem: which inventory qualifies for which buyers, how publisher commitments are paced and delivered, which ad wins among competing candidates, and what price maximizes long\-term yield. Each must be solved in milliseconds, under strict latency and cost budgets, while balancing advertisers, publishers, viewers and Amazon. At this scale, a fraction\-of\-a\-percent model improvement is worth $X millions. We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to set the science strategy for this platform. You will decide where machine learning creates the most value, bring intelligence into real\-time runtime systems, and lead models from idea to production. Your work will directly shape three of Amazon Ads’ biggest priorities: growing Amazon\-owned and third\-party supply, enabling full\-funnel advertising, and building agentic, AI\-driven workflows for publishers and advertisers. As a principal, you will be a technical leader across the organization. You will raise the science bar, mentor senior scientists, and influence product and engineering leaders. You will work alongside excellent, driven scientists, engineers and product leaders who take on hard problems and invest in each other’s growth. Few places in the world operate at this scale. Key job responsibilities * Define the ML strategy for the ad decisioning platform. Set a multi\-year science vision across pricing, yield optimization, forecasting, ad selection and commitment delivery, tied to measurable business outcomes. * Identify opportunities to deploy intelligence in runtime systems. Find where rules and heuristics in real\-time serving paths can be replaced or improved by learned models, and partner with engineering to fit them within latency, compute and reliability budgets. * Build ML models that operate at X trillion decisions a day, drawing on approaches such as deep learning, reinforcement learning and bandits, causal inference, forecasting, and auction and mechanism design. * Evaluate ML models rigorously. Design offline, counterfactual and off\-policy evaluations and online experiments. Define metrics that capture long\-term value for advertisers, publishers and viewers, not just short\-term lift. * Refine models for output quality and performance. Improve accuracy, calibration and robustness, cut serving latency and cost, and monitor models in production for drift and degradation. * Lead science across the organization. Set technical standards, review science designs and launches, and mentor and grow senior and principal\-track scientists. * Push the frontier, including LLM and agentic approaches, and contribute to Amazon’s internal and external science community through papers, talks and patents. A day in the life Start the day reviewing off\-policy evaluation results for a new pricing model that projects an X% yield lift, and deciding with your team whether it is ready for an online test. Next, you work with engineers on fitting a deeper model into a millisecond latency budget at X billion requests. At midday, you dig into why a forecasting model drifted during a live sports event, and sketch a fix. Later, you review a scientist’s paper draft and present the science roadmap to product leaders. Throughout, you work with brilliant, driven colleagues who sharpen your thinking and help you grow. About the team Ads Decisioning team brings together applied scientists and product managers to build the intelligence behind Amazon’s publisher business. We serve Amazon\-owned publishers such as Prime Video, Twitch and IMDb, along with thousands of external publishers across streaming TV, audio and display. Our models decide, in milliseconds, which inventory qualifies for which buyers, how commitments are delivered, which ad wins and at what price, balancing advertisers, publishers, viewers and Amazon.
