jobs.title: Senior ML Platform Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: ### **The Bigger Picture** At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots \- technology that allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life. Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day. Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real\-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people. ### **The Role** You'll build the shared workflows behind our ML development: reproducible experiments, trustworthy evaluations, dependable training data, reliable training infrastructure, and models that integrate with the robot software we already run. You'll be the champion for ML developer experience, making the best\-practice workflow the fastest and easiest path for the team. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll write the first implementation, help teams use it, and improve it against real workloads. Some days that means making a training job recover cleanly. Others, it means finding why a promising model behaves differently on Abi. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will lead by influence and set technical direction for ML tooling, not manage a team. You'll partner with our existing DevOps, cloud, and robot software platform engineers and extend it for ML workflows.. Our stack includes, AWS, Nix, ROS 2, and NVIDIA Jetson, third party and custom tooling. What we need is strong MLOps judgment, the drive to learn, and an obsession with making your teammates' workflows effortless. This role is on\-site five days a week in SF ### **What you'll own** * Repeatable experimentation. Establish practical patterns for experiment repositories, configuration, code review, and automated checks. Build reusable libraries, scripts, and templates that let engineers start quickly without leaving behind work only its author can run. * Data infrastructure. Build the multimodal data lake and pipelines that clean, annotate, and serve data for model training. Add quality checks and lineage so every dataset traces back to the robot data it came from. * Experimentation and evaluations. Make it cheap to test new ideas against production baselines and challenger models, and clear when a candidate genuinely wins. Define the path a model follows: candidate, qualified against agreed criteria, approved, then deployed to the robot. * Develop patterns for robot integration testing. Test the complete model path inside the existing robot codebase: inputs, preprocessing, inference, interfaces, and downstream behavior. Work with engineers on CI, simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing that catch failures that software only testing will miss * Cloud and training infrastructure. Own the ML\-specific workflows for provisioning compute, scheduling and managing jobsWork with cloud and DevOps engineers on the underlying infrastructure, access, reliability, and cost. * Reproducible environments and deployable models. Build reliable packages and dependency configurations. Learn and apply Nix packaging, the Nix store, and binary caches. Contribute to existing robot build and release workflows so models reach Jetson with compatible dependencies, tested runtime behavior, and a rollback path. Support staged rollouts or shadow deployments, and monitor how deployed models behave on robots in the field. * Product\-linked reporting. Build dashboards that connect model and dataset versions, evaluation results, and deployed performance to agreed product metrics. Help teams distinguish benchmark gains from improvements in Abi's behavior, reliability, and user experience. * Adoption across the engineering team. Work alongside engineers to understand bottlenecks, advise on technical choices, and make shared tools useful in practice. Provide clear examples, documentation, and handoffs. **Requirements** * 5\+ or more years experience in ML infrastructure, developer platforms, and robotics software. You are comfortable working with robots and embedded systems. * You've built systems other engineers rely on and love to use, not just configured tools for your own experiments. You’ve built internal tooling adopted across multiple teams. * Strong engineering, packaging, and dependency\-management skills. You enjoy hardening production systems. You love breaking complex systems into maintainable, tested components and work confidently in an unfamiliar codebase. * Practical experience with reproducible ML workflows, evaluation, experiment tracking, data lineage, and model artifacts. You know where lightweight conventions are enough and where automation earns its keep. * Experience building data pipelines for ML training, including cleaning, annotation, and dataset quality checks, and training and evaluating classifiers. * Experience operating cloud compute and training workloads, with sound judgment about reliability, observability, performance, and cost. * Comfort debugging across model code, runtime environments, and robot interfaces, including hands\-on testing with hardware. * Clear communication and collaborative judgment. You can advise senior engineers, agree ownership with adjacent teams, and support colleagues without becoming a bottleneck. ### **Useful, but not required** * ML model and code optimization for NVIDIA Jetson and cloud deployments, including quantization, mixed precision, inference compilation with TensorRT or comparable runtimes, and performance profiling across CPU, RAM, and GPU. * Management of distributed training infrastructure, including multi\-GPU and multi\-node workloads, scheduling, checkpointing, and failure recovery. * Experience integrating ML workloads with ROS 2\-based robot software. * Experience with Nix/NixOS and AWS. * Willingness to learn Nix packaging, store semantics, and binary caches. Prior Nix expertise is welcome, not required. Experience supporting simulation or on\-robot evaluation systems, * **Benefits** The expected base salary for this role is $150,000 to $220,000 plus benefits and equity. **PLEASE NOTE:** The advertised salary range is intended as a guide. For an exceptional candidate whose experience and capabilities align strongly with this role, we are open to discussing a package that reflects the value they bring. Given the importance of this hire, we are committed to investing appropriately in the person best placed to help us achieve our mission. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **Our Values** * **Empathy** – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do. * **Play** – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft. * **Never Settle** – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity. * **Tenacity** – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress. * **Unity** – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers. Let’s build the future together.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Apex Clean Energy was founded with a singular focus: to accelerate the shift to clean energy. Through origination, construction, and operation of utility\-scale wind, solar, and storage facilities, distributed energy resources, and green fuel technologies, Apex is expanding the renewable frontier across North America. Our mission\-driven team of nearly 400 professionals uses a data\-focused approach and an unrivaled portfolio of projects to create solutions for the world’s most innovative and forward\-thinking customers. For more information about how Apex is building the energy company of the future, visit apexcleanenergy.com. *Apex strives to excel in every phase of project realization, from origination and financing to construction and asset management. Our mission\-driven team seeks determined, resolute individuals who strive to innovate and go above the call of duty, and who will relentlessly do their part to help accelerate the shift to America’s clean energy future.* **Job Description** The **Senior Infrastructure \& Platform Engineer** owns Apex's foundational enterprise platforms: cloud infrastructure, security tooling, network architecture, and the operational technology integrations that connect our corporate environment to wind, solar, and storage sites across North America. This is not a break\-fix role. It is a platform ownership role with direct exposure to the highest\-priority workstreams in the company and a mandate to build infrastructure that is resilient, documented, and ready to scale. This role sits within the Integrated Technology Solutions (ITS) department and reports to the ITS Director. You will work with cross\-functional teams including Asset Management, Operations, SCADA, and data analysts. You will collaborate with managed service partners, security consultants, and infrastructure vendors — and you will be expected to lead, not just execute. Success in this role looks like: critical infrastructure that is resilient, documented, and understood; security posture that is continuously improved and verifiably measurable; and a platform foundation that other ITS capabilities — AI/ML, Data Governance, OT Security — can be built on with confidence. Our ideal candidate has done this before at a company navigating real complexity: cloud migration, major platform modernization, scaling inflection points. They bring deep technical judgment and the maturity to work in a collaborative, influence\-based organization where how you work with people matters as much as what you build. Hours/Type: Full Time, Exempt Department: Integrated Technology Solutions Travel: 5% **Primary Responsibilities** * Own and continuously improve Apex's core enterprise infrastructure, with particular depth in Azure, where our environment spans multiple subscriptions, resource groups, virtual networking, and integrated platform services across the organization. Responsibilities extend across the full stack: Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, Microsoft 365 services, and on\-premises physical and virtual server and network environments at corporate and operational sites. * Partner with ITS leadership and external security partners to continuously improve the organization's security posture, including identity hardening, network segmentation, and SIEM coverage and alert tuning. * Own and mature Apex's infrastructure\-as\-code practice, building on an existing foundation of Terraform and Ansible. Apply IaC principles to automate provisioning, enforce configuration consistency, and reduce reliance on manual processes across cloud and hybrid environments — with the expectation that what is currently nascent becomes a disciplined, version\-controlled standard under your ownership. * Design, implement, and maintain identity governance controls — including privileged access management, conditional access policies, dynamic group logic, and lifecycle automation for joiners, movers, and leavers. * Architect and support zero trust network access (ZTNA). * Support operational technology (OT) connectivity and site infrastructure, coordinating with others to ensure appropriate segmentation and visibility between corporate IT and field environments. * Develop and maintain infrastructure documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and change records. Create the institutional knowledge that makes the team resilient, not dependent on any individual. * Serve as a technical escalation point for ITS Operations Specialists; mentor junior team members and raise the technical baseline across the team. * Communicate clearly and proactively with ITS leadership, stakeholders, and vendors — translating technical findings into business risk language and written briefings when needed. * Contribute to ITS policy compliance by implementing technical controls that align with documented standards and frameworks. * Identify and anticipate infrastructure risks before they become incidents; bring forward prioritized, actio with SIEM tools, ZTNA solutions, network architecture (segmentation, VLANs, firewall policy). Familiarity with IT/OT convergence environments is a differentiator. * **Security orientation:** You think about infrastructure through a security lens by default. You understand defense\-in\-depth principles and can map technical controls to business risk, communicating that clearly to leadership. * **Project and workstream management:** Capable of managing multiple parallel technical workstreams with competing priorities. You can scope work, communicate progress, flag blockers early, and deliver against commitments without constant oversight. * **Communication:** Strong written communication skills: you can produce a clear technical risk briefing, an architecture summary, or a vendor evaluation memo. You engage well with non\-technical stakeholders and know when to escalate versus when to resolve. * **Collaboration and influence:** Apex ITS operates as a collaborative hub – you'll need to build trust across departments, work with managed service partners and external consultants, and influence outcomes without always having direct authority. * **Character:** Self\-directed, intellectually curious, and calm under pressure. You take ownership, ask good questions, and leave things better than you found them. You don't wait to be told there's a problem. * **Location:** Charlottesville, VA preferred; hybrid schedule available. Some remote flexibility for exceptional candidates, but in\-person collaboration with the ITS team is expected regularly. **Additional Information** **Work Environment:** Works primarily traditional office hours in an indoor office environment. Flexible work hours allowed when work duties and business operations permit. **How You’ll Grow** At Apex Clean Energy, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the dynamic, fast\-paced renewable energy industry. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to a robust multi\-week onboarding experience to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. **What Apex Can Offer You** *At Apex Clean Energy, we know that great people make a great company. We value our people and offer employees a broad, best\-in\-class range of benefits.* * A mission\-driven, energetic environment that supports and encourages our people to do their best work every day. * A respect for and celebration of individuality, differences, and uniqueness * Collaborative and driven professional workforce committed to supporting your ideas and feedback and accelerating your potential * Ongoing support and guidance such as on\-the\-job learning, hands\-on experience, and mentorship * Training, strategies, and tools to support your personal and professional growth * Team atmosphere of diverse professionals committed to making an impact as an organization * Opportunities to volunteer and give back to our local communities * Exceptional benefits such as medical and dental; 401(k) with corporate match * Base and bonus commensurate with experience * Responsible Paid Time Off plus standard company holidays * Benefits Offered: comprehensive high\-deductible health plans, dental and vision insurance plans, short\-term and long\-term disability, group life insurance, 401(k) corporate matching, flexible spending arrangements, company paid parking and cell phone, fitness and wellness corporate discounts ***Apex Clean Energy, Inc.*** *is an Equal Opportunity Employer that recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering
jobs.description: **Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering** **Job Description****About Aspire NorCal** Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres). This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools. Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long\-standing mission focused on post\-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead. **About the AI, Data \& Systems Enablement team** The Data \& Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations \& Principals, Academics \& Teachers, and People \& Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self\-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone. **About the role** Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering leads the engineering that makes Aspire NorCal's data trustworthy. As the team's technical lead, you are the dedicated owner of the data warehouse, semantic layer, integrations, data governance, and the AI platform. You set and uphold the engineering practices every pod builds on: code control, review, testing, and standard toolkits. You own the integration strategy, set the integration priorities, and write the migration plan, then move the 40\+ legacy integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform, and you mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management through pairing and review. This role works closely with the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement, a peer who also reports to the CTO, and with the Senior Analyst for AI, Data \& Systems (Enablement). It has no direct reports, but mentors pod members. This posting is for one opening. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the data warehouse (in partnership with our vendor, KAE) and ensure it remains useful and relevant to achieve the team’s broader goals. Retire legacy data warehouse. * Own Lightdash administration and the semantic layer, which holds the shared definitions and documentation that let teammates and AI find and trust the data. * Own data governance: the data access rules for Lightdash and the warehouse, data classification, and data quality, so that AI answers come only from governed sources, under the asker’s own access rights. * Own the AI platform: approved AI tools, data rules, and technical guardrails, and the technical review of each AI use case. The Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement drafts the AI policy and runs the use\-case pipeline with you. * Create and execute an appropriate strategy for maintaining systems integrations, set integration priorities, write the migration plan, and migrate/retire existing integrations. * In the first six months, serve as technical lead for the implementation of the new HRIS. * Set engineering practices: code control, code review, and standard toolkits, and socialize them throughout the team. * Mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management, through pairing and review. **Qualifications** **Mindsets (required)** * **Intellectual humility:** curious enough to ask the question that shows what you don't know, and secure enough to laugh at yourself. * **Interest in AI that serves Aspire's mission:** has used AI tools on real work, can describe what worked and what did not, and wants to help colleagues use AI to give time back to teachers, principals, and teammates. * **Teaches, coaches, and keeps learning:** leaves people more capable than you found them, and learns from colleagues, customers, and mistakes. * **Service\-minded:** treats principals, teachers, and teammates as customers, with a track record of empathy for the people you serve and curiosity about how schools really work. **Experience (required)** * 15\+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering. * 5\+ years as part of a high performing, mature development team leveraging modern software practices. * Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), dbt, and data pipelines. * Has created AI workflows and automations that colleagues actually used. * Has written or enforced data governance and access controls. * Has migrated legacy data jobs or integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform without losing what users relied on. * Track record of teaching and developing others effectively and treating knowledge\-sharing as part of the job. * Communicates clearly with non\-technical users. * Understands student or employee data privacy obligations (FERPA, California privacy law) and handles sensitive data carefully. **Bonus points for** * K\-12 data experience. * Experience with a semantic layer, Lightdash, or similar AI\-enabled data tool. * A teaching, coaching, or mentoring background. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- The salary range for this role is $168,050 to $215,728 annually in accordance with our salary schedule policy, commensurate with experience. This full\-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Eligible for Aspire health benefits * Retirement through CalSTRS or CalPERS, depending on the role's credential requirements, with a 403(b) option * Paid time off and additional teammate benefits to be determined in accordance with updated employee value proposition to be shared prior to offer. Aspire NorCal is conducting a comprehensive study of our employee value proposition, which could lead to material changes in July 2027\. **Location and work arrangement** --------------------------------- * Preference is given to candidates who reside in a county where Aspire NorCal schools are located (San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, or Sacramento) or in an adjacent county. Periodic travel is required across schools, from East Palo Alto to the East Bay and from Sacramento to Modesto. This is a remote or hybrid role; the arrangement will be determined by the Chief Technology Officer. Employment with Aspire is at\-will. **Application Deadline:** December 4, 2026 **Equal opportunity** Aspire Public Schools is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Aspire Public Schools provides reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process. #### **Disclaimer** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

jobs.description: **About the role** We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to work on our core business platform — the system that runs settlements, payments, invoices, contracts, inventory, and related operations for a large agricultural cooperative. This is a hybrid IC role: you will deliver product features and fixes alongside work that improves how we build and ship — automated testing, CI/CD, reliability, security hygiene, and day\-to\-day engineering quality. Much of the work is in a long\-lived production codebase: you will change existing behavior carefully, refactor toward testability, and leave the next person in a better place. You will partner with existing engineers and an external engineering partner, use AI\-assisted development as a standard part of your workflow, and help raise the bar for how the team ships. **What you will do** * Design, build, and maintain features across the .NET stack (C\#, desktop and service layers) and SQL Server, including business logic that lives in stored procedures * Refactor existing C\# and SQL as you go — characterize current behavior with tests, improve structure incrementally, and avoid big\-bang rewrites * Own work end\-to\-end: understand the business path, implement the change, add automated coverage, and see it through review and release * Strengthen delivery: improve build/test pipelines, migration safety, and the practices that make small, frequent changes the default * Grow automated tests on high\-value paths (unit, SQL/integration, API) so confidence comes from the pipeline, not from babysitting releases * Contribute to Azure\-hosted services and supporting infrastructure with a security\- and operations\-aware mindset * Use AI coding assistants daily — for implementation, review, tests, and investigation — and help the team adopt effective patterns * Collaborate with employees and external engineering partners; mentor peers through clear design, review, and documentation of important decisions **What we are looking for** **Required** * 7\+ years professional software development experience, including substantial C\# / .NET * Strong T\-SQL and SQL Server experience; comfortable reading and changing complex stored procedures and data models * Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps preferred) and a habit of shipping behind automated checks * Working knowledge of Azure services commonly used with .NET applications * Experience owning and refactoring large existing production codebases, not only building new services * Proven practice writing automated tests and improving coverage on systems that already run in production * Fluency with AI\-assisted software development (e.g. Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent) as a core part of how you work — not an occasional experiment * Ability to work hybrid and collaborate effectively with a distributed team * Must be able to attend occasional in\-person meetings in our Omaha office, our headquarters in Aurora, Nebraska, and make occasional trips to other offices as needed **Preferred** * Background in ERP, accounting, payments, inventory, or other financial / transactional systems * Experience with WinForms, WCF, Service Fabric, or similar enterprise desktop/service architectures * Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code, application security hardening, or observability (logging, metrics, alerts) * Agricultural, commodity, or cooperative industry experience **Success in the first year looks like** * You are a trusted owner on meaningful product work *and* on platform improvements that make delivery safer and faster * High\-value paths have better automated coverage, and merges rely on required checks rather than hope * Peers can pick up areas you touch; jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer II
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. **About Axon Vision.** Axon Vision is a new business venture within Axon with one mission: turn any live video feed into a real\-time, AI\-powered sensor. Customers ask a plain\-language question of their cameras and get an alert when the answer is yes. We run AI models against live video at scale, and we hold ourselves to the reliability and trust that public safety demands. We operate like a startup, moving fast and working through ambiguity, with the resources and stability of a larger company behind us. ### **Role Overview** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (L9\) with an infrastructure core, you will own how Axon Vision's software gets built, shipped, run, and kept healthy, with a focus on the cloud services that process detections and the pipelines that deliver them. You have run real production infrastructure and you still write product code. You are as comfortable tracing a failed deployment through a Kubernetes cluster as you are designing a Terraform module, a queue topology, or an authentication flow between services. You thrive where requirements are sometimes unclear, you do your own research, and you turn what you learn into designs the team can build on. You work AI\-first. You use agentic AI tools every day across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and operations, and you keep the human bar high: you write clear specs and acceptance criteria, have the AI check its work against them, and review what it produces as critically as you would a teammate's code. You build reusable AI workflows for the team and help set the standards that keep AI\-assisted development fast, safe, and reviewable. You will work closely with Product, Design, our AI/ML partners, and Axon platform and security teams. As a senior engineer without direct reports, you will also mentor peers, model strong engineering habits, and set a high bar for quality. **Location:** Seattle (WA), Scottsdale (AZ), Boston (MA), Atlanta (GA) ### **What You'll Do** * Own the cloud infrastructure and delivery architecture for Axon Vision. * Design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, queues and streaming, storage, secrets), with a path to run across more than one cloud. * Build and run the release pipeline for Axon Vision services: container image builds, staged rollouts, rollback, and automated verification. * Strengthen the software supply chain: hardened base images, automated dependency updates, and machine\-to\-machine authentication between services. * Improve the performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of real\-time video and model\-inference services, working with AI/ML partners. * Build observability, alerting, and runbooks so the team can see and fix problems before customers do. * Prove ideas quickly with MVPs while planning for scale, reliability, and security. * Write and review code that sets a high bar for quality and security in mission\-critical, real\-time contexts. * Guide the team through trade\-offs among customer needs, performance, and time to market. * Mentor and coach engineers, and help shape CI/CD, planning, and incident practices. * Work AI\-first: use agentic AI tools across design, coding, testing, debugging, and operations, with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and tests the AI is held to. * Create and share reusable AI workflows, tool configurations, and reference implementations, and measure their impact on delivery and quality. * Set standards, review practices, and quality gates for AI\-assisted work on infrastructure and delivery, including guardrails for changes to production systems. ### **What You Bring** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering (or evidence of performing at a senior level), with a record of owning production infrastructure for a real service, including on\-call. * Deep experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent), Kubernetes and containers, and at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Multi\-cloud or migration experience is a plus. * Experience running production releases safely: staged rollouts, rollback, and change management for services with real uptime expectations. * Strong programming skills in Go or Python, and comfort in TypeScript. Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL data stores and with queues or streaming systems such as Kafka. * Practical knowledge of secure delivery: hardened images, dependency management, secrets, and service\-to\ strated AI\-first engineering practice: daily use of agentic AI tools to build and operate real systems, with sound judgment on correctness, security, and cost. You raise the bar for AI\-assisted work rather than lowering it. **Nice to have** * Experience with ML inference services or real\-time video pipelines. * Experience in video and streaming, scale\-up platform teams, or multi\-tenant SaaS products. **Benefits That Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Fitness programs * Emotional and development programs * Plenty of snacks in our offices, and a fun, startup\-like culture to enjoy them in Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.* Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

Trusted by 1,000\+ financial institutions, BeSmartee is expanding its technology to support more of the commercial lending process while continuing to serve mortgage lenders with our established origination solutions. **Role Opportunity** We are seeking a Product Engineer is to turn customer problems into reliable, production\-quality software, owning each outcome from discovery and design through release and operation, while building the shared Platform as a Service (PaaS) and the document processing, financial data, and loan application workflows it powers. **Responsibilities** * Own outcomes end to end: take a customer workflow or application problem from discovery and design through implementation, validation, release, and production follow\-up. * Architect with judgment: translate business goals into technical options, acceptance criteria, and a practical delivery plan; produce clear designs for substantial changes, seek feedback early, and make explicit trade\-offs between customer value, delivery time, quality, and maintainability. * Build the shared platform: develop reusable services and APIs for document processing, financial data, and mortgage loan application workflows, with clear contracts, tenant isolation, configuration, observability, and a practical path for existing applications to migrate onto the platform. * Build across boundaries: implement frontend, backend, data, and integration changes, including REST or GraphQL APIs, asynchronous workflows, data\-heavy user interfaces, and relational data models and migrations, collaborating with specialists where appropriate. * Prevent escaped defects: define meaningful automated test coverage, review edge cases with the Quality Engineer, and own code through review, deployment, secure configuration, and monitoring. * Troubleshoot and improve: lead investigation of complex defects and incidents across application code, data, queues, integrations, and cloud infrastructure; communicate impact clearly, document root cause, and deliver durable fixes. * Partner with stakeholders: work with business, design, quality engineering, and security to clarify workflows, surface customer and delivery risks, and turn strategic initiatives and customer commitments into achievable increments. * Raise the team’s standard: review code and designs, mentor peers, document decisions, and improve developer tooling and delivery practices. * Use AI responsibly: apply AI tools to explore requirements, prototype, write and review code, generate tests, and investigate failures, while choosing appropriate tools and models, managing context and cost, protecting customer and company data, and independently verifying the results. **Qualifications** * Proven ownership: at least 7 years of experience building and operating production software, with a record of designing and shipping complex features or systems and being able to explain the decisions, trade\-offs, and post\-release results. * Agentic engineering (required): hands\-on experience with agentic engineering or AI\-driven development in software delivery, including reviewing, testing, and maintaining AI\-generated work. * Full\-stack depth: strong production experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, modern frontend development, APIs, and backend services (Node.js, React, C\#/.NET, or Ruby valued; equivalent depth in a comparable stack welcome), plus strong data modeling, testing, and debugging skills. * Platform and cloud fluency: understanding of multi\-tenant SaaS and PaaS architecture, authorization, and auditability, and working experience with AWS (or equivalent), CI/CD, containers, and production monitoring. * Clear communication: the ability to explain a technical solution to business and technical stakeholders in clear English, and to communicate directly about risks, estimates, incidents, and trade\-offs. * Domain curiosity: experience in financial services, document processing, workflow systems, or legacy modernization is valuable; the ability to learn the domain quickly is essential. * Independent and aligned: comfortable working independently in a small team as requirements evolve, on an agreed schedule with substantial overlap with US Eastern business hours. **Benefits** * 80% of the Employee medical base plan covered by the company * Medical, Vision, Dental, Short/Long Term Disability, and Voluntary Life plans available * 401K with match * Unlimited PTO * Remote office environment with a great value driven culture *BeSmartee, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: Beacon is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer, AI Security to own the safe use of AI at Beacon and across the companies in our portfolio. You will design and operate the security controls, harden the systems that AI tools and agents connect to, and work closely with engineering on identity, authorization, and network protections for AI agents and other non\-human workloads. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * Give every agent an owner, scoped credentials, least privilege, and approvals where the action calls for it, and track it from creation to offboarding like a user. * Own the security requirements for AI integrations (MCP connections, OAuth grants), memory, and retrieval, and set tenant defaults and approved connectors. * Keep a live view of AI tools and agents, including AI features that vendors turn on inside tools we already use. * Put limits on tool calls, network access, data egress, and resource use. * Threat model and adversarially test our internal AI platform and agents, covering prompt injection, data disclosure, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized actions. Turn findings into regression tests and release gates. * Define the logs AI systems must produce, build detections for risky grants and sensitive data going into AI tools, lead the AI side of incidents, and join the on\-call rotation. * Give a quick yes with conditions on new tools, and keep approved patterns and a pre\-cleared list so most requests need no review. * Add an AI inventory and the same standards to the security baseline for each acquisition. **What we are looking for:** ---------------------------- * About 5 to 7 years in security engineering, application security, or cloud security. * Hands\-on experience securing LLM applications, agents, or AI developer tools, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use. * Strong in non\-human identity: OAuth, SSO, SCIM, service accounts, and secrets. * Writes and ships code, building the tooling instead of stopping at a recommendation. * Explains risk clearly to engineers and non\-engineers, and can say yes with conditions. * Works independently, is comfortable in greenfield work, and is willing to join the on\-call rotation. * Uses AI in everyday work and has informed judgment about where it is useful. **Nice to have:** * Experience building evaluations or adversarial tests for AI systems. * Experience with AI gateways, SSPM, CASB, or DLP tools. * Familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001\. **Our Values at Beacon Holdings:** ---------------------------------- * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Rentals)
jobs.description: New York Engineering In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. #### **What's the role?** The Rentals team builds the property platform connecting residents, property managers, and the systems they rely on *across millions of users and billions of dollars* worth of transactions each month. Our work spans rent payments, property\-management integrations, home search and applications, resident experiences, and building access. The work combines visible product development with demanding systems engineering: keeping data accurate across third\-party platforms, making workflows recover safely from failures, and scaling systems that people depend on to manage their homes. You’ll work directly with product, account managers, and property partners, turn real operational problems into software, and own what you ship in production. *You don’t need to arrive knowing every part of our stack* but we value engineers who can navigate ambiguity, make sound trade\-offs, and learn unfamiliar systems. #### **In this role you will:** * **Own projects from customer problem to production**, working directly with product, sales, account managers, and property partners. * **Build reliable rent\-payment workflows** that handle retries, partial failures, and reconciliation across external systems. * **Integrate new property\-management platforms** and keep property, resident, lease, and ledger data accurate as those systems change. * **Ship complete products** across property\-manager tools and resident web/mobile experiences, from home search and applications to building access. * **Scale ingestion and distributed workflows** while improving correctness, observability, and recovery—not just throughput. * **Build AI\-assisted engineering tools** that shorten the path from a customer problem to a safely shipped fix. **Our stack**: Go and Java; Postgres, Redis, and MongoDB; React and Next.js for web; React Native for mobile. #### **In terms of qualifications, we're seeking:** * 6\+ years building and operating software in production, with substantial backend experience * Experience owning ambiguous problems from inception to production, working across engineering, product, and business teams. * Fluency in: + at least one core backend language like Java or Go + Javascript or Typescript along with UI framework like React or Vue * Solid distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, caching), and you debug across services with logs, traces, and metrics * Excellent communication skills: you will be talking with executives, property managers, sales and account managers * Experience with at least one cloud provider (like AWS or Google Cloud) * Used AI coding agents effectively and take responsibility for validating the code they produce #### **Bonus:** * Built systems that move real money—such as payment applications or automated trading systems—with safeguards, monitoring, and recovery mechanisms. * Experience with authentication, authorization mechanisms (especially OpenFGA) and identity (OAuth, SAML, etc.) * Built and maintained applications in Google Cloud * Polyglot: you know many different languages and paradigms and you’re learning constantly **Benefits:** * **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match** \- Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO** \- Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** \- We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** is **$175,000\-$250,000** and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R369

jobs.title: Head of AI Cybersecurity Engineering

This pivotal role encompasses the complete AI security engineering lifecycle, including AI/ML Model Security, LLM Application Protection, AI Agent Governance, Data Pipeline Integrity, and Adversarial Threat Defense. You will be accountable for securing, scaling, and enabling compliant AI capabilities across every business unit and platform within Biogen's global ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Global Leader of Cybersecurity, you will serve as a key member of the Cybersecurity leadership team, driving strategic accountability through purpose\-built detection systems, automated guardrails, secure\-by\-design AI architectures, and cross\-functional partnerships with Data Science, Digital, and Research stakeholders. Your leadership will be instrumental in shaping AI security engineering strategy and executing a multi\-year roadmap to automate model risk assessment, reduce manual security review cycles, and position Biogen's AI security capabilities as a competitive advantage in regulatory compliance, responsible AI governance, and operational resilience. **What You’ll Do:** * Own the multi\-year AI security engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned to Cybersecurity, Data Science, and enterprise objectives. * Establish stakeholder credibility through data\-driven planning, clear prioritization frameworks, and measurable outcomes. * Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the AI security portfolio, driving the manual review rate toward full autonomous assessment. * Lead strategic evaluation and adoption of emerging AI security technologies, including adversarial ML detection and LLM guardrails. * Develop business cases for AI security investments that articulate value in terms of risk reduction and speed\-to\-deployment. * Direct execution of AI security programs, projects, and operational enhancements through integrated delivery resources. * Manage deliverables, resource allocation, change management, and stakeholder communications. * Drive AI security automation transitioning manual model risk assessments to automated evaluation pipelines. * Lead adoption of MLSecOps and AI\-augmented workflows to accelerate secure AI deployment. * Serve as the AI security subject matter authority across Biogen, engaging with business leaders on AI risk posture. * Work cross\-functionally with Data Science, Digital, Research, Compliance, and Legal teams to drive secure AI adoption. * Establish and maintain AI security policies, procedures, and standards through periodic review and change management. * Support regulatory requirements and serve as AI security authority for audits. **Who You Are:** You are a visionary leader with a rare blend of technical mastery and strategic acumen in AI cybersecurity domains. You possess a strong ability to engage and influence senior executives, guiding them through complex AI security landscapes. Your proactive mindset and innovative approach enable you to anticipate threats and forge solutions that enhance Biogen's AI security posture. You are committed to fostering an environment of continuous learning and improvement, nurturing teams that thrive on autonomy and excellence. Your passion for AI and cybersecurity drives you to push boundaries, securing Biogen's AI capabilities while ensuring compliance and governance remain top priorities. **Required Skills:** * Master's Degree in cybersecurity, computer science, machine learning, or related field preferred. * At least 15 years of experience in cybersecurity, with expertise in adversarial and defensive operations. * Proven track record in designing, building, and deploying production security systems at scale. * Deep expertise in AI/ML security, including adversarial ML, prompt injection, and training data poisoning. * Demonstrated success in managing budgets of $5M\+ and leading teams of 15\+. * Experience in driving large\-scale automation transformations and developing autonomous teams. **Preferred Skills:** * Proficiency in Python, Go, or equivalent production\-grade programming languages. * Strong knowledge of transformer architectures and agentic frameworks. * Experience engaging with Data Science, Research, and Digital leadership on enterprise\-wide initiatives. Job Level: Management **Additional Information** The base compensation range for this role is: $208,000\.00\-$286,000\.00 Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills \& experience, job location, and internal equity. Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long\-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance. In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well\-being* ; including, but not limited to: * Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life insurances * Fitness \& Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability insurance * A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end\-of\-year shutdown time off (Dec 26\-Dec 31\) * Up to 12 company paid holidays \+ 3 paid days off for Personal Significance * 80 hours of sick time per calendar year * Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit * 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions * Employee stock purchase plan * Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year * Employee Resource Groups participation **Why Biogen?** We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid\-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well\-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life\-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives. At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. jobs.title: Senior Database Engineer
jobs.description: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com. As a Senior Database Engineer at Bitwarden you will work with our Engineering teams to lead the design, development, and continual tuning and maintenance of our database systems. You will serve as a technical leader for database query design and the optimization of our existing queries, scripts, and programs. You will support the software development process and contribute directly to the culture of quality within Bitwarden through process improvements, team outreach, and mentoring. To ensure success as a Senior Database Engineer, you should exhibit knowledge of best practices in database management and experience in a similar role. A top\-notch Senior Database Engineer will be someone whose database management skills translate into the efficient flow of information throughout an organization. This is an all\-remote team and we are looking for someone located in the U.S. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Maintain and enhance the performance of existing database scripts, queries, and other database objects * Assist engineering teams in designing new database implementations that meet the organization's data security, storage, and performance needs * Tune existing database scripts and queries for optimal performance and data security * Establish database observability practices and monitor databases and related systems to ensure optimized performance alongside operations staff * Partner with other engineers to develop new scripts and queries that support company growth * Review database and user reports as well as system information * Perform debugging procedures on database scripts and systems, including as a part of incident response * Mentor engineers and provide them with technical support * Adhere to best practices in securely accessing, storing, backing up, and archiving data * Document processes related to database design, configuration, and performance * Keep abreast of developments and best practices in database engineering * Participate in code reviews and learn and spread technical knowledge amongst the engineering organization **WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN** Must haves: * Expert knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL: execution plans, indexing, locking and blocking, and query tuning on very large tables * Experience reviewing other engineers' database code (schema changes, stored procedures, queries, migrations) and giving clear, constructive feedback that developers act on * Experience making schema changes safely on live systems: backward\-compatible migrations, zero\-downtime deployments, and knowing which changes block * Experience operating a large, busy cloud\-hosted database in production (Azure SQL preferred; equivalent experience on another managed platform is welcome) * Ability to diagnose performance problems with evidence, using tools such as Query Store, execution plans, and wait and blocking analysis * Excellent problem\-solving skills: you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution * Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining database findings to developers, SRE and support * Proficiency using source control and working through pull requests * Around 5 years of experience in database engineering, or equivalent depth on a large production system Good to have: * Ability to read and review C\# data\-access code (.NET, Dapper, Entity Framework migrations) * Working knowledge of at least one other RDBMS, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL * Experience with observability tooling, such as Datadog and a telemetry query language like KQL * Scripting for automation in PowerShell or Python * Experience with production incident response and carrying out data fixes under a controlled process * Familiarity with Docker for local and test environments * Sound practice in data security: least\-privilege access and safe handling of production data and secrets **WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS** * Meeting with Talent Acquisition * Interview with the Hiring Manager * Interview with fellow database engineers **A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US** * Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. * Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. * We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. * Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development. *In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $150,000 \- $210,000\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.*

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer
jobs.description: About Blackhawk Network: Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com. **Hybrid flexibility:** At Blackhawk Network, you’ll enjoy the best of both worlds—focused remote work plus in\-person collaboration on **Tuesdays and Wednesdays,** our regular in\-office days at our Pleasanton headquarters. This rhythm gives you the tools, connection, and autonomy you need to make a real impact. Overview: Blackhawk Network is building a cutting\-edge digital platform that connects people and brands through seamless cross\-channel payments, including cash\-in, cash\-out, and mobile transactions. Leveraging advanced technologies like smart contracts, serverless computing, and real\-time payment systems, we are committed to unlocking the next million users through innovation. We are looking for a **Distinguished Engineer** who will lead the architectural vision and drive the development of next\-generation platform capabilities. This role is for a proven technical leader who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, and is passionate about building robust, scalable, and secure systems. You will play a critical role in defining and implementing the architectural strategies that underpin our growth and innovation. Responsibilities: * **Architectural Leadership**: Define and own the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for the entire platform. Lead the design of highly available, scalable, and resilient systems that meet the needs of our global user base. * **Thought Leadership**: Act as a technical authority and thought leader within the organization. Advocate for innovative approaches, new technologies, and best practices that align with Blackhawk's strategic objectives. * **Enterprise Standards**: Author, evangelize, and govern enterprise architecture standards across the company, ensuring consistency and high\-quality design patterns are applied to all projects. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Partner closely with Product Management, Design, and Engineering teams to shape the customer experience, driving unified strategies for customer engagement using modern web standards. * **Mentorship and Guidance**: Provide mentorship to technical leads and principal engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and excellence. * **Innovation and Problem\-Solving**: Drive innovation by designing new solutions to complex problems, conducting hands\-on proof\-of\-concept work, and leading the adoption of emerging technologies. * **Technology Strategy**: Define and refine metrics for assessing application performance, scalability, and reliability. Perform trade\-off analysis to balance the needs for security, performance, and cost\-efficiency in our technology stack. * **Security Focus**: Champion security best practices and lead efforts in threat modeling, penetration testing, and overall security assessments to ensure robust protection of Blackhawk’s digital assets. * **Operational Excellence**: Oversee the execution of performance analysis and capacity planning activities. Ensure adherence to architectural decisions during all iterations of development. * **Evangelism**: Act as an evangelist for new or different technologies and solutions.
