With the agility of a start\-up and the wisdom of seasoned experts, Bot Auto boasts a team that has achieved numerous world\-firsts and unparalleled innovations. United by a shared vision, we create miracles and propel the future of transportation. Join us and transform your dreams into reality. We are looking for an experienced C\+\+ Software Engineer to join our team and play a key role in advancing autonomous driving technology. In this position, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple autonomy teams, developing core libraries and optimizing system performance. You'll collaborate with software engineers, AI researchers, and hardware specialists to create high\-performance solutions that meet the rigorous demands of autonomous driving applications. This is a unique opportunity for seasoned C\+\+ developers to break into the self\-driving industry, gain in\-depth knowledge of the entire tech stack, and make a significant impact on the future of autonomous driving and transportation as a service. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Embedded Engineering * + Design and implement onboard **data storage, logger, and event infrastructure** to support real\-time **C\+\+** autonomous driving applications, with a focus on robustness, scalability, and reliability in challenging environments. + Develop performance\-critical frameworks, reusable libraries, and components using modern C\+\+, forming the foundation of our autonomy stack. * Realtime offloading * + Develop a real\-time, resilient **data offloading system** that seamlessly transfers data from onboard systems to our hybrid cloud infrastructure. * Data Serving * + Convert sensor and component messages into multiple formats to support AI infrastructure, simulation, diagnostics, triaging, and scenario extraction. + Build a flexible **data\-serving SDK (C\+\+) and API service** that enables cross\-functional access to autonomous driving data, ensuring low\-latency and resilient data playback. + Ensure the integrity and quality of autonomous driving **metadata**, from system\-level operations to real\-world execution. * You will also have the opportunity to participate in and learn about: * + Data Lakehouse Ecosystem Infrastructure + Core relational and NoSQL database infrastructure + Data engineering to instrument data and machine learning pipelines + Cloud computing to develop a highly dynamic hybrid cloud infrastructure + Full stack platform projects + Data mining and data science, working with large\-scale autonomous driving and operational datasets ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * **Highly skilled in C\+\+** and good knowledge of Python * Experienced in **multi\-thread programmin**g skills * Experienced in developing and deploying **embedded software** * Experienced in working in **Linux environment** * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. * Ability to adapt quickly to emerging technologies. ### **Preferred** **Qualifications** * Experienced in performance optimization * Experienced in storage system knowledge * Experienced in autonomous driving technologies or similar high\-performance computing systems

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack Software Engineer, Content Collaboration** **Company:** Box **Employment type:** Full\-time **Proposed hiring locations:** United States, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, and Spain **Technology stack:** React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js **About the role** Sharing a file sounds simple. The person sharing it needs to know who can open it, what they can do with it, and whether those permissions have changed. As a Full\-Stack Software Engineer at Box, you’ll work on the interfaces and services that make those answers clear. You’ll build React components, write TypeScript across the stack, and develop Node.js APIs. You’ll own features from the first design discussion through rollout. A typical project might start with a customer who can’t tell why a collaborator lost access to a folder. You’d work with a designer to clarify the message, update the API to return the right information, and test what each person sees when permissions change. **What you’ll do** * Build accessible React interfaces for sharing files, managing collaborators, and reviewing access. * Design and maintain Node.js APIs that validate requests, enforce permissions, and return clear responses to the frontend. * Write and maintain JavaScript and TypeScript across existing services and new features. * Work with product managers and designers to define how features behave, including loading states, failed requests, and changes made by another user. * Test critical workflows from the browser to the API. Use logs, metrics, and customer reports to diagnose production issues and verify fixes. * Review code and technical designs, and help roll out changes safely to customers. **What you’ll bring** * Experience shipping a web application with React and JavaScript or TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience building backend services or REST APIs with Node.js. * The ability to trace a bug from a user interaction through a browser request to server\-side code. * Familiarity with automated testing, Git, and collaborative code review. * Clear written communication and the ability to explain a technical decision to engineering, product, and design teammates. **What would help you stand out** Experience with collaboration software, role\-based permissions, or enterprise SaaS would be valuable. We’d also welcome experience improving keyboard navigation, measuring frontend performance, or migrating an existing JavaScript codebase to TypeScript. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Green card sponsorship * Health insurance * Life insurance * Visa sponsorship Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Platform Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description: At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** Platform Infrastructure Engineers (PIEs) are responsible for managing, maintaining, and evolving the foundational infrastructure that supports our internal Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service platform. PIEs specialize in building robust, scalable, and highly available systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud environments. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature automation to ensure a reliable infrastructure foundation for all platform services and applications. Our team helps to improve automation infrastructure reliability. It empowers Braze's other engineering teams to leverage the infrastructure products and platforms we create easily. Braze operates at a massive scale with over 3\.3 billion monthly active users across our customers, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end\-users daily. We use a diverse technology stack rooted in Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, and more. As a Platform Software Engineer at Braze, you will collaborate with your team and consumer engineering teams to build and continuously improve the infrastructure as a service platform that every other team at Braze depends on. * Design and Manage Infrastructure: * + Build, optimize, and manage foundational systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud resources (e.g., EC2, S3\) + Develop automation frameworks for provisioning and maintaining infrastructure at scale + Design scalable architectures to support seamless operations of platform services * Ensure Reliability and Performance: * + Implement high\-availability and fault\-tolerant infrastructure strategies + Collaborate with Platform Software Engineers and Product teams to establish and meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for infrastructure components + Continuously monitor and optimize infrastructure performance to meet evolving demands * Incident Response and Resilience: * + Be part of a PagerDuty rotation to respond to infrastructure\-related incidents + Implement failover strategies, backups, and disaster recovery plans to mitigate risks + Conduct root cause analyses and retrospectives to improve system resilience * Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: * + Partner with Platform Software Engineers to integrate infrastructure with service abstractions and APIs + Document processes, tools, and best practices to streamline development and operations + Share expertise and mentor team members to foster a culture of operational excellence * Innovate and Automate: * + Stay ahead of emerging trends in infrastructure technology and integrate innovative solutions + Reduce manual tasks by developing automated solutions for infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and maintenance + Optimize for performance, security, and scalability in all aspects of infrastructure design **WHO YOU ARE** * Experience: * + 4\+ years managing and scaling large\-scale infrastructure systems in production environments + Proven expertise with Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and configuration management tools * Skills: * + Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar + Strong understanding of network architecture, security, and performance tuning + Familiarity with containerization, service discovery, and load\-balancing technologies + Have an excellent ability to manage multiple tasks and expectations at once * Mindset: * + Focused on building robust, scalable systems that enhance developer productivity + Collaborative and communicative, with a strong desire to document and share knowledge + Committed to continuous improvement, staying ahead of technological advancements * Have an urge to collaborate, document, and deliver quickly * + Collaborating across the global remote teams, often working asynchronously + Document everything so you don't ne rt, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo. **BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we'd love to meet you **OUR AI\-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** At Braze, we're committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI\-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process. This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Position Summary:** We are hiring a Software Engineer with a 'You Build It, You Run It' mentality to expand automation across the business — building the integrations, data pipelines, and supporting services that eliminate manual work and connect our systems. AI is one of the tools you'll reach for when it fits: RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and prompt engineering where the problem genuinely calls for them, alongside traditional integration and python scripting when those serve better. You'll own the hands\-on automation work while also contributing to our existing systems alongside a team of experienced C\# and Angular developers. This is a builder role with real support behind it: leadership setting direction, access to outside expertise on the hardest problems, and a Pluralsight account to grow your depth. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Vision: Be the best at what we do. Our Mission: Improve lives through technology.** **Summary:** “Customer Inspired” isn’t our slogan — it’s our driving force, and C Spire team members live it. We aim to engage the exceptional and embrace operational excellence to best deliver connectivity and technology solutions that advance our communities and customer’s lives. It’s a challenging goal, but we have a winning team that is looking to grow. You will guide the modernization of a business\-critical operations platform, replacing database\-centered logic with independent Go services. As a hands\-on technical leader, you will shape the migration, build production software, verify that new services preserve legacy behavior, and help teams operate the old and new systems safely side by side.**Responsibilities:** **What You Will Do** In all of your duties, you will have a relentless, obsessive, yet disciplined approach to manage all details to perfection and deliver desired results. * Define the target architecture and sequence the migration of the legacy platform into services with clear boundaries and data ownership. * Move business rules from SQL Server triggers and stored procedures into application code and explicit events while maintaining system performance. * Investigate legacy behavior module by module, compare old and new results, and guide cutovers only after the replacement has demonstrated behavioral parity. * Design resilient, long\-running processes that support retries, compensation, and rollback when work fails or changes course. * Build production Go services, including APIs, data models, tests, and deployment components. * Establish shared standards for service contracts, testing, observability, and security; lead architecture and code reviews and document significant decisions. * Evaluate architectural tradeoffs across performance, reliability, security, and cost, and assess emerging technologies against business and engineering needs. * Mentor senior engineers and technical leads in system design and engineering judgment, including colleagues moving from the existing .NET system. * Partner with product, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders to develop practical technical solutions. * Troubleshoot complex production issues in both legacy and new systems, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your expertise in large\-scale platform migration while broadening your influence on architecture, engineering standards, and the technical judgment of other engineers. **Qualifications:** **What You Will Bring** As a C Spire team member you will bring a relentless obsession to be the best in our industry and a winning mentality, determined to outsmart and outdo competitors. jobs.description: **Discover your potential. Build your legacy.** **Go the distance with Capital Group** At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts. **The role** As an **Enterprise Artificial Intelligence Engineering Manager**, you’ll lead and develop the engineering team that expands the enterprise data and integration capabilities powering Capital Group’s AI experiences. You’ll guide secure, scalable connections between enterprise systems and Microsoft Copilot and custom AI agents, while establishing reusable engineering patterns and a repeatable delivery model. jobs.title: Director, AI Engineer - Data ML Platform
jobs.description: Director, AI Engineer \- Data ML Platform At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI at scale, and where it matters most. How well our sequential models perform depends on the data they learn from, and on how fast we can turn a question about that data into an answer. We’re hiring a Director of AI Engineering to lead the engineering behind that data. That means building the pipelines and systems that bring new data sources in, turn them into model\-ready representations at scale, and let our scientists test a data hypothesis in days instead of months. . **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio\-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline * Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks * Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness * Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards **The Ideal Candidate:** * We’re looking for an engineering leader who thrives embedded in science and research teams. You work side by side with scientists, help shape experiments from the start, and turn research ideas into data systems quickly, without waiting for a handoff. * You design infrastructure that is reliable, reproducible, and versioned, so every experiment can be traced back to exactly the data it used. You know when to harden a pipeline and when to keep it fast and disposable. * You’ll lead a team of engineers who work the same way, partnering closely with our science leadership, but your edge is leverage: knowing which engineering investments will speed up the whole research loop, and delivering them. * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential nce building and leading multi\-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise products or capabilities concurrently * Proven ability to expand and execute long\-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks * Experience establishing cross\-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews) * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. jobs.title: AI Lifecycle Engineer
jobs.description: Remote, Miami, United States ### **About the Role** You'll be the engineer responsible for what AI\-MSL delivers into a customer's production system. AI\-MSL, CloudGeometry's AI Managed Software Lifecycle platform, takes a change request written in plain language and carries it through requirements, specs, code, tests, and documentation, delivered as a branch that's ready for production. AI agents do the work, and a senior engineer oversees every step. That's you. You won't write every line yourself. You'll guide agent work on real customer codebases, decide whether the results are correct, and own what happens once they reach production. On a typical day you might turn a vague request into a clear spec, review a 400\-line change you didn't write, spot an issue that looks fine in review but would fail under load, and then add a check so it doesn't happen again. You'll work across several customer systems with unfamiliar code, past decisions you weren't part of, and business rules nobody wrote down. Getting up to speed quickly in new code is a big part of the job. The title is still new in our industry, but the work is clear: someone has to be responsible for AI\-built software that real businesses rely on. ### **What You'll Do** * Turn requests into clear specs. Work out what a customer or product owner is really asking for and write a spec the agents can follow. Most bad output starts with an unclear spec. * Guide agent work and review it. Run changes through each step, step in when something goes off track, and decide at each checkpoint whether the work moves forward or goes back. You approve what ships. * Review a lot of code you didn't write. Read changes, specs, and test results closely enough to catch what looks right but isn't, like a missed edge case, a test that passes for the wrong reason, or a change that works on its own but breaks this codebase. * Learn new systems quickly. Understand each customer's codebase, including its conventions, usage patterns, and unwritten rules, and keep AppGraph (our live model of the system) accurate as things change. * Turn mistakes into safeguards. When something slips through, add a rule, test, or check so the system catches it next time. * Own production results. Handle deployment, monitoring, incident response, and the cost and speed of agent runs. Once you approve a change, it's yours. * Share feedback with the platform team. You'll see where AI\-MSL falls short before anyone else. Report it clearly and help shape what gets built next. * Work directly with customers. Explain decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical people, and push back when a request needs to change before it can run. * Join a daily standup with the team in Europe and South America (between 07:00 and 11:00 MT) and stay reachable on Slack during your working hours. ### **Must\-Haves** * 5\+ years building and running production software, including fixing things when they break * Strong backend fundamentals. Our stack is TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, but fluency in any typed language matters more than knowing ours already * Strong code review skills. You can read unfamiliar code and find what's wrong with it, and this is the most important skill for the role * 1\+ years of daily hands\-on use of an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, with clear opinions on where it struggles and how you work around it * Good testing instincts. You know the difference between a test that passes and a test that proves something * Experience working in codebases you didn't write, ideally several, and a reliable way of getting up to speed * Experience debugging in production with logs and traces, and handling live incidents * Some cloud experience, ideally AWS * Knowing when to stop and ask. We value people who raise questions early over people who guess * Strong written and spoken English, and comfort working asynchronously across time zones ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Built something with agents beyond a simple chat tool, such as a skill, hook, harness, or agent that runs on its own * Testing frameworks or automated checks for generated code * Legacy modernization or large refactoring projects * Consulting, agency, or managed services experience, switching between customers in the same week * On\-call or site reliability experience * TypeScript, Next.js, and React, for work on the review interface * Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and event\-driven architecture * Writing or open\-source contributions about AI\-assisted development * Spanish, or experience working with teams in Latin America ### **Why CloudGeometry** CloudGeometry is a Silicon Valley engineering company. We're an Anthropic Claude Partner, an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, and a CNCF Kubernetes Certified Service Provider, and we help companies move from scattered AI chat tools to a reliable, well\-governed way of building software. Most engineers using AI today do it on their own, inside processes that weren't built for it. Here you'll work in one that was, on real production systems, with the tools and authority to do it well. * Competitive pay and benefits * Access to Claude Code and the latest AI models * Training budget for courses and certifications * Fully remote, with flexible hours outside one daily standup (07:00 to 11:00 MT) * Experience across many codebases and architectures, which helps your career grow faster Submit Resume Send us an application to jobs@cloudgeometry.com, and we’ll contact you in shortly.

The Quality Assurance team is responsible for testing Functional/Business Requirements within multiple applications to ensure the full and correct linkage and integrity of data and functionality QA Analysts create and maintain Defect/Issues Logs, suggest improvements, re\-test fixes and provide test progress reports. QA analysts perform regression testing to prevent adverse effects on existing functionality; execute Stress and Performance testing, evaluate the application for usability and accessibility, participate in User Acceptance testing, and assist the Training Department if needed. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check\-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore. It is working, with tens of thousands of active customers, a strong financial position, and investors including the YC Continuity Fund behind us. We are looking for a hands\-on owner of finance and operations: a do\-er who makes finance a real partner to every leader in the company and runs the operations that keep it moving. You will put the numbers at the center of how we make decisions including telling us when we should be investing more, not just less. This is not a role for someone who wants to hire a team and manage from above. You will build the model, sit in the budget reviews and negotiate the contracts yourself. If building the financial and operational backbone of the company that brings peace of mind to millions of seniors and their families is how you want to spend the next few years, we'd love to talk. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Own and evolve our data foundation.** Today, our data stack and analytics infrastructure are maintained by backend engineers who have taken on data work alongside their primary responsibilities. You will become the first person dedicated to this area: owning the reliability, structure, and evolution of the systems that bring together data from our product, billing, CRM, marketing, and other platforms. * **Turn raw data into a trustworthy, usable data layer.** Build and maintain pipelines, models, views, and shared definitions that make important business concepts easy to understand and analyze. Reduce duplicated logic across dashboards and queries, establish clear definitions for core metrics, and make it easier for others to answer questions without rebuilding the same logic every time. * **Enable self\-service analytics across the company.** Make it possible for non\-data specialists to answer recurring questions through dashboards, well\-designed data abstractions, documentation, and AI\-assisted tools. * **Own recurring reporting and business visibility.** Maintain and improve the dashboards and reporting used to understand growth, revenue, retention, churn, customer behavior, product adoption, and operational performance. * **Investigate questions, not just fulfill data requests.** When someone asks why churn increased, which customers adopt a feature, where a funnel is breaking, why a marketing channel is performing differently, or whether an experiment worked, you should be able to take an ambiguous question, find the relevant data, explore it, and come back with a clear answer\-or explain what the data can and cannot tell us. * **Partner closely with product, engineering, growth, marketing, and leadership.** Data here is not a separate reporting function. You will work directly with people making product and business decisions, helping them define what should be measured, challenge assumptions, design useful analyses, and interpret results. * **Build the foundations of our data function.** You will have significant influence over how we structure analytics as the company grows: what belongs in the data layer, how metrics are defined and documented, how we monitor data quality, what should be automated, and eventually where additional data specialization or headcount would create leverage. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * **Strong SQL and relational data skills.** You should be extremely comfortable exploring complex production datasets, joining information across systems, understanding imperfect schemas, and turning messy business logic into clear, maintainable queries and models. * **Production data engineering depth.** You understand data pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, databases, data modeling, scheduling, monitoring, and failure modes. You do not need a backend engineer to diagnose every pipeline issue or build every new integration for you. * **Cloud warehouse experience.** Hands\-on experience with BigQuery or a comparable analytical warehouse, including performance, cost, and maintainability tradeoffs. * **Strong analytical judgment.** You understand funnels, cohorts, retention, conversion, segmentation, experimentation, and the difference between an interesting correlation and something we should actually make a decision around. You know when a dataset is too small or biased to support the conclusion someone wants to draw. * **Business curiosity.** You want to understand why a metric changed, not just calculate it. You ask follow\-up questions, inspect unexpected results, notice when two numbers that should reconcile do not, and keep digging until you understand what is happening. * **The ability to communi ime, you will start taking ownership of existing analytics and data work. Fix a broken report. Investigate a real business question. Trace a metric back to its source. Identify places where duplicated or fragile logic is creating risk. By the end of the first month, you should understand both the shape of our data environment and the major areas where improving it would create leverage.### **Days 31 to 60: Take ownership** You are now the primary owner of our day\-to\-day data and analytics work. Recurring reporting and pipelines are reliable and understood. Important metrics have clear definitions. When something looks wrong, you know where to start investigating it. You are independently handling analytical questions from product, growth, engineering, and leadership, and you are beginning to replace one\-off or duplicated analysis with reusable data models and shared logic. You have also developed a point of view on the highest\-leverage improvements to our data foundation. Not a theoretical architecture roadmap, but a prioritized list grounded in the problems you have actually encountered.### **Days 61 to 90: Build leverage** By month three, the goal is not simply for you to be doing the data work that engineers were doing before. The goal is for the company to be better at using data because you are here. Common questions are easier to answer. Core metrics are trustworthy and documented. Repeated manual work is becoming automated. Engineers spend less time maintaining analytics infrastructure and answering ad hoc data questions. Marketing and growth have better visibility into acquisition, conversion, and customer behavior. Product and business teams can make decisions with better information and less friction. Our CRM, billing, marketing, and product data are becoming easier to reason about as a connected customer and revenue lifecycle, even without a dedicated RevOps function. You have a clear roadmap for what comes next: where our data architecture needs to mature, what analytical capabilities we are missing, and which investments will create the most leverage as the company grows.**The team and structure** -------------------------- You will be our first dedicated data hire and work closely with engineering, product, marketing, growth, and company leadership. You will inherit a functioning data environment built largely by backend engineers with strong interest and experience in data and analytics. That means you are not starting from zero: there are existing pipelines, dashboards, reporting, and significant institutional knowledge to build from. But data has historically been one responsibility among many rather than anyone's primary focus. Your role is to change that. You will have significant autonomy over how the data function evolves, while working closely with engineers who know the systems and business logic deeply. This is a hands\-on role: particularly early on, you will move regularly between data engineering, analytics engineering, and analysis depending on where the highest\-value problem is.**Why now** ----------- As the company has grown, data has become essential to understanding who our customers are, how they find us, whether they adopt our products, where they struggle, why they leave, how our revenue changes, and whether the things we build actually improve those outcomes. Until now, engineers have owned much of this work alongside their other responsibilities. That has taken us surprisingly far, but it also means valuable engineering capacity is spent maintaining pipelines, building reports, and answering analytical questions, and there is no single person whose primary responsibility is making our data more reliable, accessible, and useful. We are ready for that to be someone's job. If you like moving between engineering and analysis, digging into messy questions until they make sense, and building the foundations of a data function rather than inheriting a large established team, this is the role.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Position Summary** As the Lead Engineer, AI Security, you will secure the digital fabric enabling our company’s rapid AI transformation. You will focus entirely on discovering, managing, and securing machine identities, service accounts, API keys, and automated tokens. A primary objective in this role is mapping and restricting data access rights for non\-human actors—both independent automated systems and AI agents operating on behalf of human users. You will act as the critical bridge between core identity security operations and our AI enablement initiatives, ensuring that tools like Microsoft Copilot and emerging LLM technologies operate under strict least\-privilege principles. **Core Responsibilities** * NHI Governance \& Lifecycle: Discover, inventory, and classify all non\-human identities, including Azure/Entra Enterprise Applications, AWS IAM Roles, service accounts, and API keys. * Data Rights \& Privilege Mapping: Analyze, map, and audit the data rights/permissions held by NHIs to understand what sensitive data they can access, either independently or through inheritance from their human owners. * AI \& Copilot Guardrails: Partner with the AI Enablement team to define and enforce access controls for Microsoft Copilot and future AI models, ensuring AI agents cannot access or expose restricted corporate data. * Least\-Privilege Enforcement: Design and implement automated policies to remediate over\-privileged service accounts and eliminate "privilege creep" within AWS and Microsoft environments. * Blast Radius Reduction: Formulate strategies to untangle complex human\-to\-machine permission chains, ensuring a compromised human account does not inadvertently grant an AI or machine identity elevated data rights. Monitoring \& Incident Response: Establish continuous monitoring for anomalous NHI behavior and integrate machine identity alerts that facilitate the AI Observability and Runtime monitoring requirements of the security operations pipeline. * **Required Technical Experience** * Cloud Identity Infrastructure: Deep, hands\-on experience managing identity frameworks in AWS IAM and Azure AD / Entra ID (specifically Workload Identities, App Registrations, and Managed Identities). * Data Security \& Governance: Proven experience auditing data access paths, file\-share permissions, or cloud data store policies (S3, Azure Blob, SharePoint/OneDrive permission structures) and utilizing tools such as Microsoft Purview or Cyera (or equivalent DSPM platforms). * AI Security Context: Familiarity with the security implications of AI deployment, data ingestion pipelines, and how tools like Microsoft Copilot inherit user\-level permissions. Automation \& Scripting: Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) or using API\-driven tools to automate the discovery and rotation of machine credentials. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying dedicated Non\-Human Identity Management (NHIM) or Secrets Management platforms. * Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator, or CISSP. Excellent cross\-functional communication skills * \#LI\-JV1 **Location** Canandaigua, New York **Additional Locations** Chicago, Illinois, Rochester, New York, San Antonio, Texas **Job Type** Full time **Job Area** Information Technology **The salary range for this role is:** $98,800\.00 \- $177,600\.00 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, the prevailing minimum wage for the location, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. At Constellation Brands, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. **Equal Opportunity** Constellation Brands is committed to a continuing program of equal employment opportunity. jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility. You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected. **About the role** ------------------ Coram is hiring an AI Native GTM Engineer to make our sales organization faster, sharper and more efficient through AI, automation and the tools we already own. You will sit on the Strategy \& Operations team and treat the go\-to\-market motion as a system to be engineered. The role sits where GTM systems architecture meets field execution: you are both a builder and the person who unblocks others. This is a builder role, not an admin role. You will ship agents, workflows and internal tools that reps and managers use every day, and you will measure whether they move pipeline, productivity and data quality. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build AI agents and workflows for sales.** Design and deploy agents and automations to make the sales organization more efficient and productive. * **Turn signals into action.** Connect signals from all our data sources so reps know whom to engage, why, when and how. * **Automate the manual work.** Map how AEs, managers, channel and CS teams spend their time, then remove repetitive steps with automations across HubSpot, Salesloft, Nooks, Clay, Slack and Zapier. * **Get more out of the existing stack.** Before buying anything new, push the tools we already pay for to their limits: integrations, APIs, webhooks, custom objects and native AI features. * **Build internal tools.** Extend our internal tools and GTM connectors to optimize all our GTM motions. * **Make AI workflows reliable.** Prototype quickly, put tools in front of users, then harden what works with validation, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, monitoring and error handling. * **Unblock the field.** Unblock sellers who are stuck, then fix the root cause of the issue. * **Measure everything.** Define a baseline before each build, instrument it, and report on hours saved, adoption, meetings booked, pipeline created and data quality. * **Document and enable.** Write clear documentation, set up new hires on their tools, train the field on what you ship, and iterate weekly on feedback. * **Scout what's next.** Test new models, agent frameworks and AI\-native GTM tools, and recommend what Coram should adopt, replace or retire. **What you bring** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related technical field. * 1 to 3 years of experience in software engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, growth engineering, solutions engineering or a similar technical role. * A systems thinker: you see how data, tools, processes and people connect, and you fix root causes instead of symptoms. * AI native: you use tools like Claude, Cursor or Codex daily as a builder, and you have personally built LLM\-powered workflows or agents, not just prompts in a chat window. * A track record of automations, integrations, internal tools or data workflows you built yourself, not only administered. * An understanding of, or strong curiosity about, B2B revenue workflows: lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting and pipeline generation. * Strong analytical skills: you can define a metric, pull the data and tell whether your build worked. * A driver, not a passenger: you operate autonomously, ship a first version in days, then iterate based on usage. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce administration, including workflows, custom objects and APIs. * Exposure to sales engagement and dialer tools such as Salesloft, Outreach or Nooks. * Experience building with agent frameworks, MCP servers or retrieval over internal data. * Time spent at a high\-growth B2B startup, or working directly with a sales team. * Familiarity with channel or partner\-led sales models. * A portfolio of side projects, internal tools or automations you can walk us through. **Tools, location and logistics** --------------------------------- **Our stack:** HubSpot (CRM), Salesloft (sales engagement), Nooks (dialer), Clay (enrichment), Fireflies (call recording), Slack, Zapier, Claude and our internal sales app. **Location:** Onsite 5 days a week in Sunnyvale, CA. **Team:** Reports to the Senior Director of Strategy \& Operations, working alongside Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Sales leadership. **Why join:** You get direct access to a fast\-growing sales team as your users, a leadership team that wants AI in every workflow, and the room to build the GTM system rather than maintain someone else's. **What we offer:** ------------------ * 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance * Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays * 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options * Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company * Referral bonuses * Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites * The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.) We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness. Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist - Applied Machine Learning and Optimization
jobs.description: Serve as an experienced individual contributor responsible for framing business problems as analytical, statistical, predictive, and optimization solutions; developing and validating models; and partnering with engineering teams to move approved models into governed production use. Use Python, SQL, Snowflake, Azure, and appropriate modeling methods to create explainable, reproducible, and measurable solutions while applying responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, and MLOps standards throughout the model lifecycle. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** ==================================== * Partner with business owners, analysts, and subject\-matter experts to translate operational problems into testable hypotheses, objective functions, constraints, target variables, evaluation criteria, and measurable business outcomes. * Explore and profile enterprise data; identify data limitations, bias, leakage, missingness, quality concerns, and suitability for statistical, predictive, optimization, or AI/ML methods. * Design and develop statistical analyses, forecasting models, predictive models, machine\-learning solutions, and mathematical optimization approaches appropriate to the business problem. * Perform feature engineering in partnership with data engineers and analytics engineers, using governed and reproducible data inputs rather than unmanaged one\-off datasets. * Build baselines, select methods, conduct experiments, tune models, and evaluate results using appropriate holdout, cross\-validation, back\-testing, scenario, sensitivity, and error\-analysis techniques. * Document model assumptions, intended use, limitations, training data, features, evaluation results, fairness or risk considerations, explainability, thresholds, and human\-oversight requirements. * Validate model outputs with business SMEs, compare recommendations with historical and scenario\-based outcomes, and incorporate approved feedback without obscuring model limitations. * Collaborate with data engineering and MLOps resources to package, register, deploy, monitor, retrain, version, and retire models through controlled environments and release processes. * Define and monitor model\-performance, drift, data\-quality, business\-outcome, and operational metrics; investigate degradation and recommend corrective action. * Create clear visualizations, analytical narratives, model cards, experiment records, and decision\-support materials for technical and nontechnical audiences. * Apply enterprise AI governance, responsible AI, privacy, security, architecture, SDLC, and regulatory requirements; surface residual risks and obtain required approvals before production use. * Advance reusable modeling practices, peer review, testing standards, and knowledge sharing across the team; provide technical guidance on complex analytical work. * The requirements herein describe the general nature and level of work performed by the employee but are not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as needed. Requirements: **Minimum Requirements:** ========================= **Education and Experience** ============================ * Undergraduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field; graduate degree preferred for roles with advanced optimization or research responsibilities. * 6\+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, operations research, machine learning, optimization, or a related quantitative discipline. * Advanced proficiency with Python and SQL and experience using common data\-science, statistics, machine\-learning, and optimization libraries. * Experience developing models using Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and working with Azure\-based data, application, or ML services. * Experience with problem formulation, feature engineering, experiment design, model selection, model evaluation, explainability, and communication of uncertainty and limitations. * Experience moving models beyond notebooks into versioned, testable, monitored, and supportable production workflows in partnership with engineering teams. * Experience with forecasting, predictive modeling, mathematical optimization, or decision science; operations research and constraint\-based optimization experience strongly preferred when supporting planning and scheduling use cases. * Knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, governance, and documentation practices. * Relevant Azure, Snowflake, data science, ML, or analytics certification preferred. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ----------------------------------- * Deep knowledge of statistical reasoning, machine learning, model evaluation, experimentation, and the appropriate use and limitations of quantitative methods. * Able to frame ambiguous business problems, distinguish predictive questions from optimization or rules\-based problems, and select methods based on evidence rather than novelty. * Able to evaluate model performance using technically sound and business\-relevant measures and clearly explain tradeoffs, uncertainty, limitations, and residual risk. * Strong Python, SQL, data exploration, feature engineering, visualization, and reproducible research skills. * Strong understanding of data leakage, bias, drift, explainability, human oversight, privacy, security, responsible AI, and model governance. * Able to collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, MLOps engineers, application teams, analysts, product owners, and business SMEs across the full model lifecycle. * Able to independently lead complex analytical work, review the work of peers, maintain rigorous documentation, and influence decisions through evidence and clear communication. * Able to balance model accuracy with interpretability, operational constraints, reliability, cost, maintainability, and business adoption. * Must be able to read, write, and speak English. Compensation: $135000\-$145000/Annually

jobs.description: Product Engineering Organization **Overview** As a Delivery Manager, you hold program\-level execution accountable on a day\-to\-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents. Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent\-driven development model with three concurrent layers \- governance, execution, and learning \- that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence\-gated dashes, not sprints. The activities that used to define this role \- status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk\-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation \- are increasingly AI\-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross\-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self\-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence\-gated delivery. **Work you'll do:** * Program\-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted. * Day\-to\-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI\-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs. * Drive cost\-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization. * Operational integrity of the evidence\-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand. **Core Responsibilities** * **Outcome\-Driven Leadership:** Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted \- not at a sprint boundary. * **Delivery Leadership and Advocacy:** Champion fit\-for\-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority. * **Craft Mastery:** Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth \- coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI\-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions. * **Communication:** Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade\-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co\-creation workshops. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross\-skilling. * **Discovery \& Delivery Proficiency:** Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence\-gate discipline \- proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement. * **Customer\-Centric Delivery:** Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively. * **Operational Excellence:** Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI\-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity. * **Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation:** Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co\-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI\-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions. * **Domain Expertise:** Rapidly acquire domain\-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment. **The Team** US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four\-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. **Qualifications** **Required Experience** * 10\+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross\-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders. * Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent\-driven, evidence\-gated delivery patterns. * Experience working in a product\-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve. * Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data\-driven delivery governance. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. * Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role * Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week **Required Skills** * Coordination at scale: Track record of managing dependencies, surfacing risks, and driving alignment across teams that do not naturally talk to each other. * Engineering fluency: Able to follow technical conversations, ask useful questions, and challenge feasibility claims constructively. More than passive listening. * Evidence orientation: Comfortable measuring delivery by outcome validation rather than velocity proxies. Able to hold the line on evidence gates. * AI\-augmented working practice: Fluent with current GenAI assistants and agentic delivery tooling. Able to direct AI output for status, risk, and coordination tasks rather than only consume or produce it manually. * Specification literacy: Able to read and reason about charter, persona, intent, constitution, and blueprint artifacts and understand how a program is governed through them. * Communication: Writes clearly. Presents to senior stakeholders without over formatting. Tells the truth about status, including bad news, without varnish. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. skills, with close attention to detail. * Clear written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to collaborate with technical and business partners and translate business requirements into technical data solutions. * Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross\-functional team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree. * Qlik or similar integration experience. * Experience with enterprise data governance, lineage, and metadata management. * Experience working with EHS, regulated, or compliance\-sensitive data. * Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Continuous\-learning mindset and adaptability to new technologies and processes. * A track jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1\.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI\-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ Docusign is seeking a hands\-on Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and deliver full\-stack and AI\-enabled products across Customer Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success. This individual contributor will provide technical leadership while remaining actively involved in software development. Working directly with business stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams, the engineer will own solutions from discovery and architecture through implementation, production operations, and continuous improvement. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, GTM Engineering. **Responsibility** * Lead the architecture and hands\-on development of full\-stack applications, including frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, data models, and enterprise integrations * Partner with Support, Services, Customer Success, and Product teams to identify business opportunities and translate complex workflows into scalable technical solutions * Design and deliver conversational and agentic AI experiences that improve knowledge discovery, case resolution, customer adoption, and operational efficiency * Build custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrate enterprise services and headless SaaS platforms through secure, reliable interfaces * Establish AI evaluation practices, security guardrails, authorization controls, and observability to support trustworthy production AI systems * Collaborate with product, design, data, and analytics teams to deliver intuitive experiences grounded in enterprise knowledge and business context * Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, deployment practices, and production monitoring * Mentor engineers, influence cross\-functional technical decisions, and communicate architectural tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders * Own solutions throughout their lifecycle, from early prototypes through production deployment, operational support, and iterative improvement **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience designing, developing, testing, and operating enterprise full\-stack applications and backend services * Experience in software architecture, APIs, distributed systems, data modeling, and cloud\-based application development * Experience delivering AI\-enabled products, including conversational or agentic AI solutions, into production * Experience delivering solutions supporting customer support, professional services, or customer success workflows * Experience designing secure, scalable, platform\-neutral architectures and enterprise integrations * Experience leading technical decisions, mentoring engineers, and maintaining high standards for code quality and operational reliability * Experience partnering directly with product and business stakeholders to solve ambiguous problems **Preferred** * Experience building AI\-powered enterprise applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, and agent orchestration * Experience designing or integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers * Experience with customer\-facing digital support, enterprise search, knowledge management, or conversational platforms such as Sierra AI or Fluid Topics * Experience integrating Salesforce, Certinia, or other enterprise SaaS platforms through APIs or MCP * Experience building secure AI experiences using enterprise knowledge and data, including evaluation, access controls, and observability * Strong user\-experience judgment and experience collaborating with product and design teams * Strong communication skills **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: California: $186,100\.00 \- $300,550\.00 base salary Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $178,900\.00 \- $262,825\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance. **AI in Our Hiring Process** At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human\-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy. We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer (R-20111)
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with Dun \& Bradstreet** At Dun \& Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers. The Senior AI Software Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, building, and deploying production\-grade AI/ML and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. This role brings proven, hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs), agentic AI systems, and end\-to\-end MLOps pipelines, along with experience delivering cloud\-native AI services, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior AI Software Engineer will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable, high\-impact AI solutions, while providing technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers. ### **Essential Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and deploy AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including agentic and conversational AI capabilities, using agentic AI frameworks and LLMs (e.g., Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK, Gemini) * Develop LLM\-based capabilities, including embeddings, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and vector database integration. * Build and maintain MLOps and CI/CD pipelines for model training, validation, and deployment. * Deploy and operate scalable, cloud\-native AI services on GCP and Kubernetes using Docker and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). * Develop data pipelines and APIs that integrate AI/ML models into enterprise applications. * Support monitoring, model performance evaluation, and incident response for AI services in production. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and contribute to technical design reviews; provide guidance and mentorship to other engineers. * Recognize opportunities for continuous improvement, including evaluating emerging AI tools and technologies. * Additional duties as assigned. ### **Skills and/or Certifications Needed:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years of proven experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions in production. * Proven hands\-on experience with: * Agentic AI frameworks (Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK) * Large Language Models (Gemini) * Python application development and APIs (FastAPI) * Cloud\-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform * Event\-driven workflows and orchestration * Enterprise collaboration integrations (Microsoft Teams, Graph API) * Experience with GenAI frameworks such as LangChain and Hugging Face. * Proven experience developing LLM\-based applications, including RAG pipelines and vector databases. * Experience building end\-to\-end MLOps pipelines using tools such as Vertex AI Pipelines, MLflow, or Kubeflow. * Proven experience deploying scalable AI/ML services using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform. * Experience building data pipelines that support AI/ML services. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code reviews, and version control in an agile environment. * Experience with AWS AI/ML services is a plus. * Experience with multimodal AI solutions (text, image, audio) is preferred. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success. * Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs. * Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite skills. **Benefits We Offer** * Generous paid time off in your first year, increasing with tenure. * Up to 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave after one year of employment. * Paid sick time to care for yourself or family members. * Education assistance and extensive training resources. * Do Good Program: Paid volunteer days \& donation matching. * Competitive 401k with company matching. * Health \& wellness benefits, including discounted Wellhub membership rates. * Medical, dental \& vision insurance for you, spouse/partner \& dependents. **Pay Transparency** Dun \& Bradstreet is an equal employment opportunity employer and believes in honesty and transparency in the employment hiring process, including pay transparency. Accordingly, listed on this posting is a good faith reasonable estimate of the salary range and other compensation in the job posting, as of the date of this posting. Actual compensation decisions for base salary and other compensation will be dependent upon a wide range of factors including but not limited to: an individual’s skill sets, experience, qualification, training, education, location, and any other legally permissible factors. Successful applicants will also be eligible for D\&B’s generous benefit package, outlined above. All Dun \& Bradstreet job postings can be found at https://jobs.lever.co/dnb. Official communication from Dun \& Bradstreet will come from an email address ending in @dnb.com. Notice to Applicants: Please be advised that this job posting page is hosted and powered by Lever, a subsidiary of Employ Inc. Your use of this page is subject to Employ's Privacy Notice and Cookie Policy, which governs the processing of visitor data on this platform. ***Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)******:*** *Dun \& Bradstreet provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, genetic information, protected military and veteran status, ancestry, marital status, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by law.
