jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us! Start your next chapter and join EMD Serono. Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us. United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe. This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US. **Your Role:** Health data is messy. It sits in legacy systems, unstructured reports, and spreadsheets only one person understands. Our customers know the answers they need are in the data somewhere. You help them get there. You'll spend your time with stakeholders across customer and internal teams, translating needs into clear requirements and seeing the plan through to delivery. This role is hybrid in Billerica, MA or St. Louis. MO. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Meet with customer stakeholders to understand the questions they need answered and where their current processes fall short. * Translate those needs into clear, prioritized requirements and user stories. * Work with forward\-deployed engineers to deliver against defined requirements. * Feed what you learn in practice back to Syntropy's product team, so customer needs shape the offerings we bring to market. * Support project day to day, including timelines, scope, and status updates. * Present status to customer and internal leaders. * Escalate open issues and new scope so delivery stays on track. **Who You Are:** **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Business or Information Technology discipline. * 2\+ years in delivery, consulting, business analysis, informatics, or technical project management within healthcare, life sciences, or pharma. * 2\+ years of experience with agile practices, including user stories, backlogs, and sprint ceremonies. * 2\+ years of experience working across stakeholder personas including clinicians, researchers, and engineers. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to health data privacy, security, and governance frameworks. * Experience with data platforms or programming languages. * Experience supporting requirements discovery with non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort with design thinking or prototyping tools such as Figma Make. * Clear writing and confident presenting. * Familiarity with clinical terminologies such as SNOMED, ICD, FHIR. * Familiarity with common data models such as OMOP, mCODE. Pay Range for this position: $78,100 \- $117,200 / year The offer range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base pay compensation for this position. The actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level of experience, education, skills, and other job\-related factors. Position may be eligible for sales or performance\-based bonuses. Benefits offered by the Company include health insurance, paid time off (PTO), retirement contributions, and other prerequisites. For more information click **here**. **What we offer:** We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress! Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: **Company Description** EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full\-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next\-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients. We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need. We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. **Job Description** The Senior AI Agency Engineer designs, builds, and deploys enterprise\-grade AI solutions that connect generative AI, workflow automation, compliance controls, and business systems to accelerate pharmaceutical and healthcare marketing operations. This role combines the responsibilities of a senior software engineer, solutions architect, and client\-facing technical consultant. The individual leads technical discovery with clients, translates business requirements into scalable technical solutions, develops integrations and AI workflows, and partners across product, engineering, data, security, and delivery teams to bring production\-ready AI solutions to market. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in modern software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, enterprise integrations, and generative AI technologies, along with the communication skills needed to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by: **Client Discovery \& Technical Leadership** * Lead technical discovery sessions with client business, IT, architecture, security, data, and operations teams. * Translate business objectives, workflows, and operational challenges into technical requirements, architecture designs, and implementation plans. * Assess enterprise application landscapes, integration requirements, data environments, security constraints, and operating models. * Serve as a trusted technical advisor to clients and internal stakeholders. * Communicate complex AI, data, platform, and integration concepts to both technical and executive audiences. * Identify technical risks, dependencies, assumptions, and mitigation strategies early in engagements. * Develop technical prototypes and proofs of concept to validate solution feasibility and accelerate decision\-making. **Solution Architecture \& Engineering** * Design end\-to\-end solutions that connect AI Agency capabilities with client systems, data sources, content repositories, workflows, and approval environments. * Build and configure production\-quality integrations using APIs, webhooks, event\-based patterns, secure file exchanges, connector frameworks, and enterprise integration platforms. * Develop client\-specific configuration and deployment assets while preserving the integrity of the shared platform architecture. * Contribute hands\-on code across backend services, integration components, data pipelines, AI workflows, and supporting user experiences. * Design and implement AI\-enabled workflows using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent orchestration, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and human approval checkpoints. * Implement authentication, authorization, identity federation, secrets management, data mapping, error handling, observability, and audit requirements. * Create technical prototypes when needed to validate feasibility, reduce ambiguity, or accelerate client decision\-making. * Support the transition from prototype to stable, supportable production deployment. **Enterprise Integrations \& Data Engineering** * Design, build, and maintain integrations using APIs, webhooks, event\-driven architectures, secure file exchanges, and enterprise integration platforms. * Develop system connectors to enterprise platforms including: + Veeva Vault / PromoMats + Salesforce Marketing Cloud + SharePoint + Adobe Experience Cloud + Snowflake + BigQuery + Vertex AI * Build and maintain data pipelines supporting reporting, analytics, and AI workflows. * Design data mapping, transformation, validation, and synchronization processes. * Partner with data engineering teams to support ETL/ELT and analytics initiatives. **Cloud Infrastructure, Deployment \& Operations** * Develop cloud\-native solu production cloud\-based AI, data, or enterprise application solutions. * Advanced programming skills in Python and at least one additional modern language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, Java, or .NET. * Significant experience designing: + APIs + Data pipelines + Event\-driven architectures + Enterprise integrations + Authentication and security frameworks + Distributed systems * Hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies including: + LLMs + Prompt engineering + RAG + Embeddings + Vector databases + Agent orchestration + AI evaluations + Observability and guardrails * Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, containers, and cloud\-native development practices. * Strong communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence **Additional Information** **OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:** **Patient Minded** I act with the patient’s best interest in mind. **Client Delight** I own every client experience and its impact on results. **Take Action** I am empowered and empower others to act now. **Grow Talent** I own my development and invest in the development of others. **Win Together** I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results. **Communication Matters** I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue. **Embrace Diversity** I create an environment of awareness and respect. **Always Innovate** I am bold and creative in everything I do. Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e\-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA. EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job\-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time. From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at applicantsupport@eversana.com. Follow us on LinkedIn \| Twitter

jobs.description: ### **General Information** **Locations**: Orlando, Florida, United States of America * Location: Vancouver * State: British Columbia * Country: Canada Role ID 216266 Worker Type Regular Employee Studio/Department Other Work Model Hybrid ### **Description \& Requirements** Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Our research and engineering organization is moving to an autonomous development model; AI agents take on routine work such as scheduling, status, meeting notes, and tracking, and people make the decisions. You will spend 100% of your time on the delivery system; it is not part of a product or backend team. Development Directors are your customers; they set the requirements and priorities, and you decide how it is built. The Senior Software Engineer, Delivery Systems will report to the Head of Development. This is a hybrid role, onsite three days a week in Orlando, Florida, Montreal or Vancouver Canada. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain the agents and integrations that run scheduling, status, meeting capture, reporting, and the rollup across teams. * Set up Linear as the team's planning and coordination layer, and connect it to GitLab, Perforce, Slack, and Google Workspace. * Turn existing team tooling, such as epic automation and an intake knowledge base, into shared, maintained services. * Work closely with Development Directors and Technical Owners to understand their workflows and turn them into tools they use every day. * Build in human checks: approvals, audit trails, and clear points where a person reviews what an agent produced. * Follow our security and data\-handling rules: credentials kept out of agent context, meeting transcripts and internal documents in approved stores, and access limited to what each agent needs. * Measure whether the system works, through adoption, time saved, and how accurate its status and off\-track flags are, and fix what doesn't. * Keep the system running: monitoring, documentation, upkeep, and a way to pause it. * Work with our agent platform team so delivery agents run on the same foundation as our product agents. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years as a software engineer, working on internal tools, developer productivity, or workflow automation. * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agents or automation, for example with Claude Code, LLM APIs, MCP, or similar tools, including tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. * Strong skills in Python or TypeScript, and experience building small services, APIs, and webhook integrations. * Experience integrating work\-tracking and collaboration tools such as Linear, Jira, GitLab, or Google Workspace. * Experience with cloud deployment and CI/CD, for example on AWS with GitLab CI. * Experience with security, permissions, and data privacy. * Experience working directly with non\-engineering users and turning their needs into tools they adopt. * Experience with game development, Perforce, or tools built for producers, program or project managers. We are a diverse, goal\-driven team that offers real influence and autonomy to every member. jobs.title: Linux Platform Operations Engineer
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. The Cloud and Connectivity organization is actively looking for a Linux Platform Operations Engineer to join them. Do you like to solve challenges and have an interest in large scale impact? Would you like the ability to impact a global public and private cloud infrastructure operations through AI and Automation? If so, please apply. **What You’ll Be Doing:** We are seeking a Linux \& OpenShift Platform Operations Engineer with experience supporting and managing enterprise Linux and OpenShift environments. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in maintaining system stability, automating operational tasks, and ensuring high availability for mission\-critical workloads, including leveraging modern AI\-driven automation tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to improve efficiency and streamline engineering workflows. This position requires in\-depth technical expertise, being a team player, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving and operational excellence. This role will have the opportunity to work with the latest Public and Private cloud IaaS services. Our goal is to improve all aspects of our infrastructure availability and reliability through repeatable patterns, new architectural designs, and improvements in observability to prevent outages and increase value across the organization, including the adoption of AI\-powered automation and operational tooling. The role will partner with our global Lilly operations SMEs and connect with other platform infrastructure operations SMEs to deliver the daily operations associated with this area. **How You’ll Succeed:** * Be Bold: You will drive Infrastructure Operations to never have to fix the same problem twice through adoption of AI OPS, Event Driven Automation, and robust Observability. * Be Fast: You will accelerate initiatives in areas such as: Infrastructure AI OPS automation, cloud IaaS management, and cloud infrastructure as code to enable critical business projects. * Be Proactive: You will have groundbreaking chances to transform our operations processes using proactive, predictive, and automated AI \& Observability capabilities. * Be Your Best: You will bring a high learning agility and Infrastructure operations / engineer skills to help us enable the Lilly Technology strategy, identifying tech opportunities, and accelerate our AI OPS journey. **What You Should Bring:** * Linux Server \& OpenShift Management Manage and support Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu, and SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES). Experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, and containerized platforms. Handle VMware Vsphere, Linux\-based VMs, and physical server management (HP, DELL, IBM). Configure and maintain Linux network services (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls, TCP/IP). Technical expertise and leadership to turn ideas and concepts into operation solutions. Linux, Dell SAN storage or Cloud certifications are a bonus, or we are willing to help you develop. * Automation \& Scripting Develop and manage Ansible playbooks for automation of system configurations and deployments. Leverage AI\-driven automation tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to enhance scripting efficiency, accelerate development, and streamline operational workflows. * Incident \& Change Management Follow ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change management processes using ServiceNow. Manage incident resolution and root cause analysis for critical server issues. Oversee change management processes, ensuring minimal impact to production environments. * Technical leadership supporting enterprise grade infrastructure solutions and leading the deployment at multiple global locations. Strong Hands\-on experience performing troubleshooting and Linux system administration with automated infrastructure availability and resiliency and resiliency at enterprise scale, including exposure to modern AI/ML\-driven operational frameworks. * Consistent track record of high quality, agile focused, team\-based solution delivery. **Additional Information:** * Onsite role located in Indianapolis, IN (relocation required). * Expected Shift hours: 11:30am – 8:30pm US Eastern Standard Time (EST) / 12:30\-9:30pm US Eastern Daylight\-Saving Time (EDT) * Shift rotation: Monday \-Friday /Thursday \- Monday * Less than 5% travel. **Your Basic Qualifications:** * High School Diploma/GED (or equivalent) with 6\+ years of experience system administration * 5\+ years’ experience as a Linux OS/ Platform Engineer. * Experience with cloud IaaS platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, deployment, and ongoing support. * Demonstrated experience or exposure to AI\-enabled automation tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or similar), with the ability to apply them in engineering or operational contexts. * Experience leading a global large\-scale Infrastructure project. * Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1 **Additional Skills/Preferences:** * Experience in Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, AWS and Azure environments. * Redhat Satellite patch management tools experience. * Experience in RedHat OpenShift and Containerized solutions. * Experience managing GPFS clusters. * Centrify or similar authentication management tools. * Experience in a regulated or healthcare environment. * Proficient in utilizing monitoring tools such as Splunk or similar platforms. Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $66,000 \- $154,000 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). jobs.description: **Data Architect / Integration Engineer** ========================================= **Program:** VA Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) SISS **Location:** Remote **About Emerging Tech** ----------------------- Emerging Tech LLC is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), 8(a), and HUBZone\-certified federal contractor delivering innovative technology solutions to government agencies. We specialize in Healthcare IT, cybersecurity, systems engineering, and digital modernization, supporting critical federal programs and helping our clients solve complex technical challenges. At Emerging Tech, we value our people and are committed to creating opportunities for professional growth, collaboration, and career development. **Position Overview** --------------------- Emerging Tech is seeking a Data Architect / Integration Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) SISS program. This individual will provide technical leadership and hands\-on integration architecture expertise across a complex healthcare IT environment. The role requires the ability to establish integration strategy and architecture while working closely with architects, engineers, clinical teams, functional specialists, and other technical stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with healthcare interoperability standards, interface architecture, data exchange, multi\-vendor integration, and enterprise healthcare systems. This person must be adaptable, comfortable learning complex environments, and able to support evolving priorities based on government direction. **Important:** This position does not require hands\-on database administration or the creation of logical or physical data models. The primary focus is healthcare data integration, interoperability, and integration architecture. **Priority consideration will be given to candidates with existing VA access.** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Provide strategic direction and hands\-on technical leadership for healthcare data integration and interoperability. * Develop integration architecture strategies, blueprints, interface control documents (ICDs), data flow diagrams, and technical recommendations. * Define and support integration patterns across enterprise systems, interfaces, vendors, and clinical applications. * Support API management, interface engines, push/pull architectures, and data exchange workflows. * Collaborate with clinical, functional, and technical teams to support integration across pharmacy, laboratory, imaging/radiology, scheduling, and other ancillary systems. * Establish multi\-vendor integration governance, including service\-level expectations, data contracts, payload completeness, system availability, and delivery performance. * Evaluate authoritative data sources, data migration approaches, integration dependencies, and technical challenges. * Develop integration assessments, mappings, engineering courses of action, and current\- and future\-state architecture recommendations. * Support enterprise analytics, dashboards, and reporting that provide visibility into system interfaces, data exchange pathways, message types, and routing patterns. * Develop metrics related to interface volumes, clinical and operational data dependencies, integration performance, and capacity planning. * Translate market activation plans into executable interface and data migration runbooks. * Support cutover readiness activities, including mock conversions, dress rehearsals, and deployment preparation. * Troubleshoot integration defects and coordinate root cause analysis and remediation across EHR vendors, middleware, and downstream systems. * Support the program's Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) migration by developing integration architecture patterns and supporting the transition of workloads, interfaces, and clinical data flows from on\-premises or legacy middleware environments to OCI\-based services. **Required Qualifications \& Experience** ----------------------------------------- **Healthcare Interoperability \& Interface Design** * Experience with healthcare interoperability and semantic standards, including HL7, CCD, FHIR, and DICOM. * Knowledge of medical ontologies and clinical vocabularies such as ICD\-10, LOINC, and SNOMED\-CT. * Understanding of healthcare data exchange, clinical messaging, and interface design. **Integration Architecture \& Data Movement** * Experience with API management and interface engines. * Knowledge of push/pull architecture and enterprise data exchange patterns. * Understanding of clinical information exchange, including patient demographics, orders, results, and other clinical data sets. * Experience integrating healthcare applications, ancillary systems, and third\-party vendor platforms. **Clinical Systems \& Healthcare Applications** * Experience supporting integrations across clinical domains and ancillary systems, including: + Pharmacy + Laboratory + Imaging and radiology + Scheduling + Other clinical and operational applications * Understanding of interface patterns required for commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) EHR deployments across multiple markets. **Multi\-Vendor Integration \& Governance** * Experience supporting integration governance across multiple vendors and platforms. * Understanding of service\-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, payload completeness, uptime, and data delivery performance. * Ability to establish and evaluate interoperability standards for vendor solutions, system connectivity, medical devices, and mobile applications. **Healthcare Security, Compliance \& Privacy** * Knowledge of HIPAA, PII, and PHI requirements. * Understanding of data encryption in transit and at rest. * Familiarity with identity and access management standards, including SMART on FHIR and OAuth 2\.0\. **Enterprise Architecture** * Ability to understand complex enterprise architecture environments, system boundaries, foundational components, and end\-to\-end data flows. * Knowledge of authoritative data sources, data migration approaches, timelines, and implementation challenges. * Experience developing architecture assessments, data mappings, integration blueprints, hybrid designs, and engineering recommendations. **Analytics \& Reporting** * Experience supporting enterprise analytics and dashboards that provide visibility into system integrations, interfaces, data types, and vendor\-specific implementations. * Ability to develop reporting and metrics related to interface volumes, clinical data dependencies, integration pathways, and capacity planning. **Delivery \& Site Activation** * Experience translating deployment and market activation plans into executable integration and data migration runbooks. * Familiarity with cutover readiness, mock conversions, and dress rehearsals. * Ability to troubleshoot integration defects and coordinate root cause analysis and remediation. **Cloud \& Migration Support** * Experience supporting on\-premises and cloud migration initiatives. * Understanding of integration architecture and data flow transitions to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or comparable cloud environments. * Ability to support continuity of routing, data quality, performance, and compliance during migration. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Existing VA access. * Experience supporting VA EHRM or other large\-scale federal healthcare IT modernization programs. * Experience with Oracle Health/Cerner environments. * Experience supporting multi\-site or enterprise\-wide EHR deployments. * Experience working within complex, multi\-vendor healthcare integration environments. * Experience supporting OCI migration initiatives. **Why Join Emerging Tech?** --------------------------- * Competitive compensation * Benefits effective Day 1 * 401(k) retirement plan * Federal holidays and PTO * Opportunities for professional growth and career development * Collaborative team environment supporting meaningful federal combination of education and professional experience. * Two or more years of related experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, software development, data integration, or a comparable technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical experience. * Advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex transformations, relational data modeling, query optimization, and troubleshooting of large or complex datasets. * Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language for automated data processing, integration, or software\-driven analytical solutions. * engineering and delivery practices, including version control, testing, code review, and deployment workflows. * Ability to apply data quality controls, troubleshoot complex data and system issues, requirements. * Familiarity with statistical forecasting, predictive modeling, machine learning, or AI\-enabled automation. * Experience supporting airline operations, transportation, workforce Endeavor Air employees receive a competitive total compensation package which includes a variety of benefits to choose from and some of the best perks around.* Free or reduced\-rate travel privileges on Delta Air Lines and 80\+ air carriers worldwide for employees and eligible family members * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans * 401(k) with Company Match starting on Day 1 * Operational Performance Rewards (OPR) Program * Life and AD\&D Insurance, Short and Long\-term Disability, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), and voluntary supplementary benefit options FLSA Status: Salary Minimum Position Pay Range: USD $75,700\.00/Yr. jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer, Trust & Evaluation
jobs.description: ### **Principal AI Engineer, Trust \& Evaluation** * JR\-164772 * Hybrid * Toronto * Redwood City * Technology * Full time **Who are we?** Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. **Job Summary** Sets the technical direction for the evaluation and trust capabilities of Equinix's GenAI platform, and designs, develops and deploys them. Builds platform features that let teams evaluate their agents at scale: golden datasets, synthetic test data, scoring with LLM\-as\-judge, and monitoring of agent quality in production. Designs and tests the trust controls that agents run on, including agent identity, access, guardrails and data boundaries. Leads the investigation of the hardest agent failures and fixes them in the platform. Serves as the hands\-on technical lead of the Trust \& Evaluation team, and partners with product, platform, security and governance leaders to turn ambiguous problems into robust, secure, observable and performant solutions. Knowledge and Application Applies expert knowledge of software engineering practice and of LLM and agent concepts (prompting, retrieval, tool and function calling, orchestration, MCP). Has deep expertise in evaluation methods (code\-based checks, LLM\-as\-judge, human review, golden datasets, regression suites) and evaluation statistics (sampling, variance across runs, agreement between reviewers). Has a deep understanding of AI security risks such as prompt injection and data leakage, and of identity concepts such as OAuth, token exchange and per\-user access. Sets the standards and practices that the team and other teams follow, and keeps them current with industry research. Complexity and Problem Solving Works on complex, open\-ended problems that span teams, where the right approach is not yet known. Leads the investigation of the hardest agent failures (retrieval, tool call, prompt, model, data or infrastructure) and follows them until they are fixed. Decides which metrics reflect real quality and sets the bar for release. Makes architecture decisions with long\-term impact on the platform, and resolves trade\-offs among quality, cost, latency and security. Work is reviewed at design and milestone gates for results against long\-term goals. Collaboration and Interaction Partners with product, platform, security, legal and governance leaders, and with forward\-deployed engineers and agent builders across the company. Turns the needs of agent builders into a platform roadmap. Explains results, risks and trade\-offs to senior and non\-technical stakeholders. Mentors engineers, raises the technical bar of the team, and leads through influence across teams. **Responsibilities** Evaluation platform (primary focus) * Own the architecture and roadmap for platform evaluation features, and build them: dataset creation and versioning, golden datasets, synthetic test data and reusable metric templates * Design and build the scoring approach for agents jobs.title: EverHealth - AI Automation Analyst (Remote, US)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **EverHealth AI Analyst** EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. **Responsibilities** **Build AI Products \& Automation** * Build automations and AI agents from early prototype to something a team runs every day. * Apply AI models where they improve speed, accuracy, or quality, and test their output against real data until quality is consistent. * Write, test, and version the prompts that production workflows depend on. * Flag where a model is unreliable for a task and recommend a different approach instead of forcing it. **Connect Systems** * Connect the systems a team depends on so data and actions move automatically instead of by hand. * Build connections that hold up in production: authentication, error handling, and edge cases, not just the happy path. * Partner with our platform engineer on anything that should become part of shared infrastructure rather than a one off connection. **Maintain Agents \& Products** * Own what you build once it is live. Monitor runs, catch problems early, and fix them quickly when an upstream system or a data change breaks something. * Keep credentials, connections, and access organized and secure, following team governance practices. * Track how automations and agents perform, and look for ways to make them more reliable or extend them. **Discover \& Analyze Processes** * Sit with teams to map how a process works today, step by step, and identify the manual, repetitive, or error prone parts. * Recommend which processes are good automation candidates and which need to be fixed first, since automating a broken process only makes it break faster. * Gather the inputs, systems, and rules an automation needs before the build starts. **Partner, Document \& Hand Off** * Work with function leaders and their teams to gather requirements and confirm that what you built does what they actually need. * Partner with the platform engineer and forward deployed engineers on larger builds, owning the pieces suited to your level. * Document every automation: what it does, what it touches, who owns it, and how to troubleshoot it. Hand it off with clear instructions so the owning team can run it day to day. * Help shape how this team works as it grows, from build standards to how we engage a function, since you are one of the first people on it. **Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role** * 2\+ years in automation, operations, revenue operations, analytics, IT, or a related role where you built or maintained workflows or tooling. * Hands on experience with a no code or low code automation tool such as Zapier, n8n, or Power Automate. * Comfort working with APIs and JSON and reading or lightly editing code. You do not need to be a software engineer, but a webhook or an API doc should not scare you off. * Exposure to AI tools and prompt writing, plus a clear interest in getting good at it. * Strong process thinking. You can look at how something is done and see where it breaks or wastes time. * Careful, organized, and good at documentation. You keep track of what you built and why. * Clear written communication, since much of the work is explaining a process or a handoff to another team. * Comfortable working independently in a fast changing environment with shifting priorities. **Preferred Experience** * Healthcare technology, SaaS, or another highly regulated environment. * Experience with CRM and other core business systems. * Direct experience with LLM APIs and prompt engineering for production use. * Process mapping or continuous improvement methods. * Building internal dashboards or reporting. * Experience on a team that was being stood up from scratch. **Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. **Benefits and Perks:** * Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid * Continued investment in your professional development * Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend * 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting * Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off * Employee Stock Purchase Program **Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $55,000 to $80,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one\-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players' associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. **About the Company** Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world\-class investors, operators, and sports \& entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next\-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. **Position Summary** The Senior Director, AI Deployment is a hands\-on delivery leader accountable for putting AI into production and generating measurable business results. This leader will build and run the AI Deployment Team: 3 to 5 forward\-deployed AI practitioners who embed with business units, uncover real workflow problems, build and deploy solutions, and leave each team more capable and self\-sufficient. Think forward\-deployed engineers, built internally. The core job is to re\-engineer how work gets done and deploy AI and autonomous agents into production workflows. Success is measured by workflows redesigned, agents and applications running in production, and business impact validated with Finance and business owners, not by roadmaps, training hours, or pilots. The Senior Director sets deployment priorities enterprise\-wide, partners with IT, engineering, data, cybersecurity, legal, and enterprise architecture to deploy safely and at pace, and advises executives on where AI will and won't create value. Governance, platforms, and adoption programs matter, and this leader makes them serve deployment rather than replace it. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. Build and Lead the AI Deployment Team * Recruit and lead 3 to 5 forward\-deployed AI practitioners: builders with real engineering depth, business fluency, and credibility with operators and executives. * Set the standard for craft: technical practices, code and design review, evaluation discipline, and delivery cadence. * Define the engagement model: how business units are selected, how embeds are scoped and run, what success looks like, and how work is handed off. * Stay hands\-on: scope problems, shape architecture, review work, and build alongside the team when it matters. * Allocate the team to the highest\-value opportunities, make explicit tradeoffs, and decline work that won't move a business outcome. * Develop team members into the next generation of technical and business leaders. 2\. Embed, Re\-engineer Workflows, and Deploy to Production * Embed with business units to see how work is actually done and identify where AI can change cost, speed, quality, or revenue. * Redesign workflows end to end rather than layering AI onto broken processes, deciding what to automate, augment, or eliminate. * Build and deploy LLM\-based applications, autonomous agents, and workflow automation into production, integrated with systems of record, enterprise data, and APIs. * Favor working software over decks and pilots, moving quickly from problem to prototype to production. * Operate what ships: own monitoring, evaluation, cost, incident response, and iteration until ownership transfers to the business. * Turn each engagement into reusable patterns, components, and playbooks so every deployment is faster than the last. 3\. Deliver and Prove Measurable Business Impact * Agree on baselines and success metrics with the business owner before building anything. * Measure realized outcomes (cycle time, cost to serve, throughput, error rates, revenue impact), validate them with Finance, and distinguish measured results from estimated productivity gains. * Red artnership and Prioritization * Prioritize deployments with executive leadership by value, feasibility, and risk, maintaining a living portfolio rather than an annual roadmap. * Advise on investment, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and where AI should and shouldn't be applied. * Represent the AI deployment mandate and results to senior executives and, as needed, the board. What Success Looks Like * The AI Deployment Team is hired, operating, and sought out by business leaders. * Multiple AI solutions and agents are live in production across business units, with impact validated by Finance and business owners. * Business units that worked with the team run and extend their solutions independently. * Reusable patterns and standard guardrails are shortening the path from problem to production. * Deployments are monitored, owned, and auditable, and governance is seen as speeding work up. **Qualifications** Required Experience * 12\+ years in software engineering, ML or AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or technology delivery, with increasing scope and leadership responsibility. * Deep, hands\-on experience deploying LLM\-based applications, agentic systems, and workflow automation into enterprise production, including systems you personally built or directly led. * A record of measurable business outcomes from production deployments, with specific results, baselines, and how impact was validated. * Strong technical depth: able to write and review code, design architecture, and integrate with enterprise systems and APIs. Working knowledge of RAG, tool use and agent orchestration, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, observability, and guardrails. * Experience hiring, coaching, and leading small, high\-caliber technical teams with a high bar for quality. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders and operators to diagnose workflows and redesign how work gets done. * Experience deploying AI within enterprise security, privacy, and risk requirements, including human\-in\-the\-loop controls and auditability. * Executive presence: earns the trust of engineers and front\-line operators and communicates credibly with senior leadership. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. Preferred Experience * Background in forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or embedded technical consulting. * Experience re\-engineering workflows in finance, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, customer service, or software engineering. * Experience with major cloud AI ecosystems and enterprise AI platforms (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud). * Experience with MLOps and LLMOps: model evaluation, observability, cost management, and lifecycle management. * Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks, data privacy requirements, and enterprise AI governance. * Experience standing up a new delivery function or building a technical team from the ground up inside a large organization. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior AI Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and supporting the company’s AI\-enabled analytics capabilities, enabling Commercial, Finance, and Operations leaders to ask business questions in plain language and receive accurate, governed answers. Working closely with Commercial, Finance, Operations, and IT Data Engineering, this position designs, develops, and deploys large language model (LLM)\-powered analytics solutions on Microsoft Azure data platforms and maintains the Power BI semantic models and dashboards that serve as their trusted foundation. The Senior AI Analytics Engineer focuses on delivering reliable AI\-driven insights, standardizing KPIs, and supporting the organization’s shift toward centralized, governed analytics. #### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy an AI analytics engine that answers commercial, financial, and operational questions in natural language. * Build LLM\-powered applications and agents in Python using Azure OpenAI or similar services, including prompt design, tool calling, and orchestration. * Develop natural\-language query capabilities, such as text\-to\-SQL or text\-to\-DAX, over curated datasets in Azure Data Lake Gen2 and Databricks SQL. * Connect AI solutions to Power BI semantic models and governed metric definitions to ensure answers align with standardized KPIs. * Create evaluation datasets and automated tests to measure answer accuracy, detect errors, and monitor quality over time. * Deploy, monitor, and support AI services in production, managing reliability, performance, and cost. * Maintain and optimize Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and dashboards that support commercial and operational reporting. * Improve dashboard performance, refresh reliability, and usability. * Reduce manual reporting workflows by enabling self\-service, AI\-assisted analytics. * Document AI solutions and support user adoption, training, and trust in AI\-generated insights. #### **Qualification Guidelines** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. #### **Education/Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, statistics, business analytics, or a related field required. * Five or more years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role required, including at least one year of experience building LLM\-based or AI applications. * Experience developing Power BI solutions in an enterprise environment required. * Experience in multi\-unit retail or restaurant environments preferred. #### **Language Ability** Excellent verbal and written communication skills are necessary. This position requires strong written, verbal, and group communication skills. The ability to read, write, and comprehend complex instructions and correspondence is necessary. This position also requires the ability to read, analyze, create, and interpret financial reports, business requirements, technical documentation, and data models, and to explain AI\-generated results and technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. This position requires advanced business math skills. #### **Reasoning Ability** This position requires strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities and the exercise of independent technical judgment in designing AI solutions, evaluating system performance, investigating discrepancies between AI\-generated answers and reported figures, and supporting data validation efforts. #### **Computer Skills** Exceptional computer skills are required, including proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite and other appropriate software. Strong proficiency in Python and LLM APIs, such as Azure OpenAI, is required for building production AI applications. Proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service is required, including semantic model development, publishing, and performance optimization. Experience with Microsoft Azure\-based data platforms is required. #### **Supervisory Responsibilities** This position has no supervisory responsibilities. #### **Physical Demands** This position primarily involves sustained computer and technology use and may be performed from a seated or standing position. Occasional movement throughout the work environment and lifting or moving items weighing less than 20 pounds may be required. Occasional travel of less than 20% may be required based on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. #### **Special Requirements/Certification** * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience evaluating and testing AI output for accuracy, reliability, and security. * Strong expertise in DAX and data modeling, including star schema design, semantic model optimization, and Row\-Level Security (RLS). * Advanced SQL skills for querying, validating, and transforming data across enterprise datasets. * Experience working within Microsoft Azure data environments, including Azure Data Lake Gen2, Azure Data Factory pipelines, and Databricks SQL or similar cloud data warehouse platforms. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI services, or Databricks AI/ML tools preferred; relevant Microsoft or Databricks certifications are a plus. #### **Additional Information** The above job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as assigned by their supervisor, policy, and company management. Work location and onsite attendance requirements will be determined by the company in accordance with company practice and business needs.

jobs.title: Machine Builder
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **About the team:** The Automation Engineering Team is responsible for delivering robotics\-driven automation deployments across a wide range of customer applications. The team partners cross\-functionally to translate customer requirements into deployed systems, ensuring solutions are integrated, commissioned, and validated to perform reliably in real manufacturing environments. Automation Engineering works closely with customers, internal technical teams, and external integrators to execute deployments on schedule while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, and repeatability. **About the role:** As a Machine Builder, you will play a critical role in bringing Formic's robotic systems into live production environments. You will support system integration through hands\-on build, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation in the shop, followed by on\-site installation and commissioning at customer facilities. **In this role, you will:** * Support internal system integration for robotics\-driven automation solutions, including mechanical and electrical setup, quality checks, documentation, testing, program updates, troubleshooting, FAT, and final pack\-out * Install and commission Formic solutions at customer sites in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and Project Managers * Perform mechanical installation, power\-up, testing, troubleshooting, fine\-tuning, performance validation, and final documentation * Support refurbishment and reconditioning of returned systems as needed * Validate system performance and identify improvements during testing, commissioning, and live production deployments * Test and troubleshoot new automation solutions under development * Follow Formic's standardized processes, tools, SOPs, and all applicable safety requirements * Coordinate with OEMs, vendors, and system integration partners to support system delivery, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives * Support early\-stage product deployments, including hands\-on installation, commissioning, and validation of newly developed automation solutions * Provide diagnostics and troubleshooting support for newly deployed products that have not yet transitioned to the service team * Document lessons learned and help develop SOPs, deployment procedures, and best practices to support scalable product rollouts **What makes you a great fit:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with industrial 6\-axis robots in installation, maintenance, repair, programming, troubleshooting, or technical support roles * 3\+ years of experience installing and commissioning industrial machinery * Experience with end\-of\-line automation systems such as robotic palletizing, depalletizing, and case packing preferred * Willingness to travel up to 50–60% for multi\-day customer deployments and commissioning activities * Highly action\-oriented with strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to navigate unfamiliar challenges independently * Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills * Comfortable using hand tools and working in hands\-on technical environments * Strong PC and general technical proficiency * Valid driver's license and access to a personal vehicle for local travel (mileage reimbursed per Formic policy) * Ability to lift 50\+ pounds * Ability to work independently while representing Formic professionally in customer environments * Experience with industrial robots such as FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa/Motoman, or Universal Robots preferred **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person's merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to accessibility@formic.co. **AI Use:** At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI\-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.description: US \- Remote • Canada \- Remote Security Remote Full\-time **Company Overview:** --------------------- Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action. We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. You'll partner closely with our threat and detection engineer, and every finding becomes a detection or a guardrail. This isn't a traditional full\-time red team role, and external pentests and bug bounty stay with our vendors. We're looking for someone who is fully AI\-pilled: you don't write code by hand \- agents build your attack tooling and run your emulations, and you think at the systems level about where we're exposed and how to close it. You see the big picture, focus on the risks that matter, and treat security as a business enabler. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Build and run our adversary emulation program, testing ourselves on a regular schedule and tracking what we detect and what we miss. * Reproduce newly published attack techniques against our environment within a day, and tell us quickly whether we're exposed. * Partner with detection engineering on purple team exercises: you find the gap, they build the detection, and you prove it works. * Turn findings into guardrails with our platform security team, so fixes are enforced by default rather than documented. * Test our identity attack surface \- Okta, Auth0, OAuth integrations, tokens, and non\-human and agent identities. * Assess our SaaS and internal tool estate for misconfigurations, over\-permissioned integrations, and lateral movement paths. * Test acquired companies as they join, and help them close gaps as they adopt our infrastructure. * Attack our AI agents: prompt injection, tool abuse, data exfiltration, and over\-privileged agent access. * Contribute adversarial checks to Pulse, our AI PR reviewer, so issues are caught before they ship. * Hunt for blind spots \- the systems, tools, and paths nobody is watching. * Define and track adversarial testing metrics (e.g. technique coverage, time to reproduce, time to detection, findings closed), and communicate risk and progress to engineering and business leaders. * Mentor engineers and security teammates on how attackers think. ### **Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience in security, with at least 4 years hands\-on in red teaming, adversary emulation, or offensive security. * Experience running adversary emulation programs and working from frameworks like MITRE ATT\&CK. * Purple team experience: working side by side with detection engineers and validating detections against real techniques. * Strong knowledge of identity and SaaS attack paths: Okta, Auth0, OAuth/OIDC, session and token theft, and non\-human identities. * Solid cloud attack experience in GCP, Kubernetes, Azure, or AWS. * Hands\-on experience with AI/LLM attack techniques \- prompt injection, tool abuse, and agent hijacking \- or a strong point of view on them. * Fully AI\-centric workflow: agents build your tooling and run your tests, and you think at the systems level rather than writing code by hand. * Ability to track new attack research and turn it into a working reproduction quickly. * Pragmatic, big\-picture judgment: able to prioritize the risks that matter and turn findings into fixes, not just reports. * Excellent communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bonus: detection engineering experience (e.g. Sigma or SIEM queries); testing newly acquired environments; experience with HIPAA/HITRUST environments, SOC 2 Type II audits, or healthcare data protection. **Why You'll Love Working With Us:** ------------------------------------ We value our team at Function and offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible working hours, and a dynamic work environment where creativity and innovation are encouraged. If you are a highly motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about using technology to improve people’s lives, we would love to hear from you. At Function, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender identity, ancestry, religion, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital status, Veteran status, or any other occupationally irrelevant criteria. Join the Function Health team and become a part of our mission to build a healthier future for all. Discover more about us and how we're changing the face of healthcare at Function Health. ***Important Notice:*** *Legitimate communication from the Function Health team will always come from an email address ending in @functionhealth.com. Function Health will never request personal information such as banking details or payment during the hiring process. Please be cautious of communications or job offers that come from other email domains, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. If you ever have doubts about the legitimacy of a communication, please reach out to us directly at* *talent@functionhealth.com**.*

ability and troubleshooting mindset **Nice to Have:** * Terraform or other infrastructure as code * Event\-driven systems: queues, sessions, idempotency, retries, dead\-lettering * Cloud security: managed identity, encryption, key management, least privilege * Azure Government or another regulated cloud environment * Healthcare integration standards (HL7 v2, FHIR, NCPDP) or integration engines like Mirth * Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, or Datadog * Using AI coding tools well, and knowing how to review what they produce **Additional Details:** This is an on\-site (hybrid), full\-time, salaried position. At this time, this position is not eligible for employment sponsorship. Reporting to the Director of AI, you will lead the design, build, and deployment of production AI systems \- RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and Copilot integrations \- on our Azure and .NET/Python stack. You will set engineering standards for a growing AI team, mentor developers, and partner directly with business units to turn ambiguous problems into shipped, governed, production\-grade AI products in a regulated insurance environment. **How you'll make an impact** * **Translate Business Problems into Technical Solutions:** Work side\-by\-side with business leaders and subject\-matter experts to unpack ambiguous, unstructured challenges and shape them into well\-scoped, buildable AI solutions with a clear delivery path. * **Own AI Solution Architecture:** Design and defend end\-to\-end architectures for GenAI and agentic systems on Microsoft Foundry \- spanning Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Foundry Tools, and Copilot Studio \- that meet enterprise security, scalability, and data\-residency requirements. * **Lead Hands\-On Delivery:** Write and review production code (C\#/.NET and Python) for RAG pipelines, AI agent orchestration, and API integrations; remain a strong individual contributor while leading the team. * **Set Engineering Standards:** Establish patterns for agentic development, evaluation, testing, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), and observability so AI solutions are repeatable and maintainable \- not one\-off prototypes. * **Mentor and Grow Engineers:** Coach AI developers through design reviews, pairing, and career development; raise the technical bar across the team. * **Ship to Enterprise Surfaces:** Deliver AI capabilities into internal applications, Microsoft Teams, and M365 Copilot, integrating through Foundry agents, Service Bus, Azure Functions, and other cloud\-native services. * **Build Governance In:** Implement responsible\-AI controls \- Entra ID/RBAC, IaC Policy, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, audit logging \- aligned to Gallagher compliance expectations from day one, not as an afterthought. * **Drive Evaluation and Reliability:** Define measurable quality bars (groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost) and build the evaluation harnesses to enforce them before and after release. * **Communicate Up and Across:** Translate technical trade\-offs into clear recommendations for the Director of AI and business stakeholders; manage delivery risks and dependencies proactively. **About You** **Required** ============ * **Experience:** 7 or more years in software engineering, including experience in building LLM/GenAI systems in production and 2\+ years leading engineers or owning technical direction. * **Azure Depth:** Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure compute (Functions, Container Apps, or App Service). * **Languages:** Strong .NET/C\# plus working proficiency in Python; able to review and contribute in both. * **GenAI Engineering:** Proven delivery of RAG architectures, agent orchestration (Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain), and prompt/evaluation pipelines. * **API and Integration Skills:** Designing secure REST APIs and event\-driven integrations (Azure API Management, Service Bus) within an enterprise identity model (Entra ID, RBAC). * **Delivery Discipline:** Agile experience with Azure DevOps (or equivalent) \- backlogs, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management. * **Leadership:** Track record of mentoring engineers, running design reviews, and owning technical decisions across multiple concurrent initiatives. **Preferred Differentiators** ============================= * **Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior AI/ML delivery in insurance, financial services, or healthcare, with familiarity with model risk management or responsible AI guidance. * **Familiarity with AI\-enabled and spec\-driven development:** Using AI\-assisted tooling and agent workflows across the SDLC to quickly deliver production\-grade systems. * **Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code:** Building applications tightly aligned to Terraform\-deployed, optimized infrastructure. * **Evaluation and MLOps Maturity:** Built LLMOps tooling \- automated evals, red\-teaming, drift/cost monitoring \- at enterprise scale. * **Architecture Credentials:** Azure certifications (AZ\-305, AI\-103\) or equivalent demonstrated architecture ownership. **Professional Qualities** ========================== * **Bias for Shipped Outcomes:** Measures success by working software in users' hands, not demos or decks; cuts scope intelligently to ship. * **Calm Technical Authority:** Makes and defends decisions under ambiguity, and changes course quickly when evidence demands it. * **Force Multiplier:** Gets more from the team than from their own keyboard \- through mentoring, standards, and unblocking others. * **Governance as a Feature:** Treats compliance, security, and auditability as design inputs that build trust, not friction to route around. * **Clear Communicator:** Explains complex systems simply to executives and precisely to engineers; writes things down. * **Pragmatic Curiosity:** Tracks the fast\-moving AI landscape but adopts new tools only when they solve a real AJ Gallagher problem. **Compensation and benefits** At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being * Career development opportunities and ongoing learning * A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership * The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact **At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

Electrical Engineering or related discipline * Minimum of 3 months of relevant experience **Knowledge Skills and Abilities:** * Working knowledge of applying Matlab/Simulink to internal combustion understanding of internal combustion engine design, operation, and testing. * Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present simulation results to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field of study. * Vision to set calibrations in internal combustion engines. * Advanced experience in applying MATLAB/Simulink and Python in engineering analysis and simulation. * Advanced proficiency in applying Matlab/Simulink code to complex propulsion systems, with demonstrated success in optimizing transients, steady state, and overall performance. * Deep expertise in internal combustion engine control
