This role is critical to helping our sales team land new logos, enabling our account management team to drive more adoption, and for our RevOps systems to operate with minimal toil. You will pair technical expertise with business acumen to design and implement systems that improve data quality, accelerate deal velocity, and provide visibility into the health of our business. You’ll also own the context layer behind our AI\-powered GTM motion, making sure our LLM workflows get the right customer, product, and pipeline data at the right time. You’ll join a small team that works across sales, account management, operations, analytics, and engineering. If you’re a builder who thrives in ambiguity and loves to see the direct impact of your work, this is a job for you. ### **What you'll do** * Build and refine the agents and models that decide which accounts we sell to and who owns them, rooted in a deep understanding of our ideal customer profile and full revenue lifecycle. * Leverage coding agents to build internal software tooling for sales on a platform our engineers maintain. Turn sales prototypes into tools the whole team can depend on, then keep improving them with the people who use them. * Use agents and data to build, measure, and continuously improve automation for lead routing, deal stage progression, renewal tracking, and post\-sales engagement. * Implement and optimize integrations between HubSpot, systems of record, enrichment tools, and analytics platforms to ensure accurate, timely, and complete revenue data to drive pre\- and post\-sales growth. * Create automation for data hygiene, enrichment, and deduplication to maintain a single source of truth for customer, deal, and revenue records. * Partner with GTM leadership to translate process requirements into scalable workflows that serve sales, marketing, and customer support teams. * Design and maintain context pipelines for AI\-powered GTM workflows such as account research, lead scoring, outbound personalization, and deal briefs. Decide what CRM, enrichment, call transcript, and product data goes to LLMs, how it’s retrieved and structured, and how output quality is measured. ### **Who you are** * **You are agent\-first**. You direct agents with clear, specific instructions to get work done, and you put systems in place to check that the work was done correctly. You know HubSpot deeply, including workflows, reporting, and the API. * **You are a B2B SaaS growth expert.** You have experience in growth, marketing, sales operations, BizOps, or related roles. You know the best tools, systems, and strategies to build a scalable growth engine for a B2B SaaS company. * **You are a context engineer for GTM.** You’ve built production LLM workflows for sales or marketing, not just used AI tools. You know how to assemble the right context (ICP definitions, account data, call notes, product knowledge) through retrieval, structured prompts, and tool and agent design. You evaluate outputs rigorously and know when to use an LLM and when to write a rule. * **You are technical.** You work in GitHub every day through coding agents. You're at home with APIs, serverless infrastructure on AWS, and enrichment providers. * **You are data\-driven.** You think in terms of revenue metrics, pipeline health, and data integrity, and you can design systems that measure and optimize them automatically. * **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self\-motivated, curious, self\-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours. * **You move fast.** We move fast at Stedi. This requires an ability to match our pace and not get lost when managing competing priorities. You communicate what you are working on, and proactively ask for help or feedback when you need it. **We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note: * All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com. * If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.** We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi. *At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*

jobs.title: Program Manager – Foundational Engineering Leadership – Associate
jobs.description: **WHAT WE DO** At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets. Foundational Engineering, which is comprised of our Technology Division and global strategist’s groups, is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here. **THE TEAM** This team provides operational efficiency and aligns engineering to the firm’s OneGS strategy. It is a mechanism to eliminate duplication across organizations, avoid cost, and protect developer productivity. The team's core capability is to qualify and prioritize demand for engineering engagement. We partner with the sales and relationship owners of existing and prospective clients of the firm to defend and grow existing business, while nurturing new relationship mandates. The key stakeholders who benefit from these service offerings are (i) engineers who interact with Technology companies, (ii) sales relationship owners (primarily concentrated in IBD, AMD and PWM), (iii) senior leaders (Engineering and EO) who meet with Technology companies, (iv) functions related to vendor lifecycle, specifically technology risk, third party risk, strategic sourcing, (v) compliance and (vi) technology companies and venture capital portfolio companies who wish to engage with the firm. **ABOUT THE JOB** GS Innovation Center is a platform and program to accelerate the use of external cloud and artificial intelligence technologies and reduce the time\-to\-decision for new vendor solutions. This will allow Engineering and Markets Teams to evaluate solutions on their ability to meet the business and technology needs of Goldman Sachs first, without incurring the up\-front legal, security, and technology complexities inherent to operating within a regulated financial institution. As a GS Innovation Center Program Manager, you will participate in GS Innovation Center projects and programs helping to implement internal controls governance processes, tooling, lab scalability and expansion to ensure that our services scale to meet diverse client requirements. You will work backwards from the client to solve technical challenges and prioritize GS Innovation Center use cases that best align with the firms overall Digital Strategy. You will be responsible for handling all aspects of GS Innovation Center projects and tasked with employing every phase in the program’s life cycles to assist in delivering them in a successful and timely manner. Our \#1 business principle is "Our clients' interests always come first. Our experience shows that if we serve our clients well, our own success will follow". Every client is given maximum attention to understand their needs. We adopt the most appropriate approach to drive the business of the client or institution towards the desired growth. We now want to apply the same approach to the way we build products and deliver client\-centric, world class products through the collaborative work we do. **Your key responsibilities would include:** *Own the PoC lifecycle* * Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of vendor proofs of concept (PoCs) in the GS Innovation Center. This covers intake, prioritization, scoping, execution, and results analysis to help teams make a go/no\-go recommendation * Run program governance, project prioritization, roadmap planning and resource planning. Prioritize use cases that best align with the firm's Digital Strategy *Scope and plan* * Gather input from diverse stakeholders including senior leaders and vendors. Coordinate across groups to define requirements and success criteria * Build and maintain detailed PoC plans. Track key deliverables, milestones, objectives and key results (OKRs), and progress * Clear legal and control requirements * Manage the execution of evaluation paperwork between GS and the third\-party vendor. * Work with Legal, Compliance, Tech Risk, Operational Risk and Internal Audit to review controls and processes periodically *Execute and evaluate* * Review the pre\-lab and post\-lab surveys and provide timely input * Make sure PoC testing teams deliver test results on time. Collate and analyze the results to support project decisions *Communicate and report* * Give key stakeholders regular PoC status updates * Prepare presentations and supporting documentation for audiences from working teams to senior leadership *Manage risk and improve* * Identify ri ss departmental boundaries. Resolve them or escalate them * Help improve the lab's governance processes, tooling and scalability so the program can scale **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical discipline * 5\+ years of experience in technical program or project management, or in a similar technical leadership role * Experience running cross\-functional programs with multiple senior stakeholders and competing priorities * Proven ability to influence and build consensus across teams and levels without direct authority * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with working knowledge of program management processes, artifacts and tools * Excellent written and verbal communication. You can present clearly to technical, business, executive and vendor audiences, and work with global teams. * Strong attention to detail, time management and organization. You stay effective under pressure and are comfortable with uncertainty and change * Working knowledge of business management practices such as OKRs, vendor management, and financial planning and analysis * Experience with vendor evaluations, third\-party risk, or technology risk and control processes, ideally in a regulated industry is preferred * Familiarity with cloud or AI technologies * Proficiency in Jira and Confluence is preferred **ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS** At Goldman Sachs, our culture is one of teamwork, innovation and meritocracy. We often say our people are our greatest asset and we take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative work spaces and mindfulness classes to working from home and flexible work options, we offer our people the support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office. We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits Healthcare \& Medical Insurance We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance. Holiday \& Vacation Policies We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year. Financial Wellness \& Retirement We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities. Health Services We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices. Fitness To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount). Child Care \& Family Care We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available. Benefits at Goldman Sachs Read more about the full suite of class\-leading benefits our firm has to offer. jobs.title: Senior Ads ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gravity** ----------------- Gravity is the ad network for AI. We place relevant, sponsored suggestions inside AI platforms, right when someone is deciding what to do or buy. Everyone at Gravity believes three things: * AI should be free for everyone. * Most people will never pay for an AI subscription. * Someone has to pay for the compute, and advertising is the answer. If you believe these too, you'll probably fit right in. We built our ad engine from the ground up for AI interactions. Any AI platform can plug in with one integration, and we're already live on 50\+ of them, reaching millions of conversations every day. You can read more about us at trygravity.com. We've raised $38\.5M from investors like Lightspeed, Committed Capital, Basis Set and Caffeinated Capital. We work in person in San Francisco, 6 days a week. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Ads ML Engineer** to own Gravity's entire ad engine. This is a senior IC role. You'll set the roadmap, working with our engineering team and our CEO, Zach. * **Conversation understanding.** Build semantic analysis of conversations from scratch, so the engine knows what each moment is about. * **Identity and audiences.** Build our identity graph and lookalike products. * **Attribution.** Build the attribution products that prove what's working for advertisers. * **Auto\-scaling.** Build the auto\-scaling that controls spend across different performance objectives. * **Data.** Decide what data to buy. * **Training and deployment.** Train the system and deploy it on live traffic. * **Continual learning.** Build an engine that keeps learning, and run RL on the best\-performing ad formats. * **Roadmap.** Own the roadmap for all of it. We're not tuning an old ad engine. We're rethinking how one should work: built for many performance objectives, and creating ads that fit the conversation and the person's history. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * **Experience.** 5\+ years in ML, most of it on ads, ranking or recommendations. * **End to end.** You've built or scaled an ad engine and shipped models on live traffic that moved revenue. * **Range.** You've worked across several of identity, lookalikes, attribution, RL and continual learning. * **AI\-native.** You're ahead of the curve on AI. You build your own workflows and systems with it, and most of your routine work already runs without you. * **Ownership.** You don't need to be told what to do. You take responsibility, you follow through, and you don't drop the ball. * **No bullshit.** You say what you think and you do what you said. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * LLM\-based ad matching. Very few people have done it. **Compensation** ---------------- * $260K – $520K base * $625K – $1\.25M equity * Health benefits * Unlimited PTO Compensation Range: $260K \- $520K

You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, product partners, and Accounting and Finance stakeholders to solve complex business problems while building reliable, scalable, and supportable software. You'll gain experience across cloud services, microservices, APIs, event\-driven architecture, databases, data engineering, integrations, and user\-facing applications. * **Solve interesting engineering problems.** The team works on challenges involving high\-volume transactional processing, accounting rules, distributed systems, data quality, security, reconciliation, resiliency, and auditability. * **Grow alongside experienced engineers and architects.** BAC's engineering model increasingly emphasizes technical knowledge sharing, cross\-training, architecture awareness, and season readiness across the team. jobs.description: If you are currently an employee of Herc Rentals, please apply using this link: ***Herc Employee Career Portal*** Founded in 1965, Herc Rentals is one of the leading equipment rental suppliers in North America with 2025 total revenues reaching approximately $4\.4 billion. Herc Rentals’ parent company, known as Herc Holdings Inc., listed on the New York Stock Exchange on July 1, 2016, under the symbol “HRI.” Herc Rentals serves customers through approximately 607 locations and has about 10,000 employees in North America as of June 30, 2026\. **Job Purpose** --------------- Herc Rentals is one of the largest equipment rental suppliers in North America, supporting construction, industrial, and infrastructure customers nationwide. Our Cybersecurity team protects the people, customers, systems, and data that keep that business running. Joining us means working with a modern, cloud\-first security stack, an emphasis on AI and automation, a collaborative team, and real opportunities to grow your career in cloud security engineering. Short Description Herc Rentals is seeking a skilled and forward\-thinking Cloud \& AI Security Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure cloud infrastructure across our enterprise environment, with a strong emphasis on leveraging artificial intelligence and automation to enhance our security posture and protecting against advanced threats. You will serve as a key technical contributor in protecting Herc Rentals' cloud\-hosted systems, data, and applications from evolving cyber threats while ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices. **What you will do...** ----------------------- **Cloud Security Architecture and Engineering** * Design and implement security controls, policies, and guardrails across cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and related platforms. * Develop and maintain secure cloud architecture patterns for infrastructure, applications, and data pipelines. * Configure and manage cloud\-native security services including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network segmentation, and logging. * Conduct regular security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modeling for cloud workloads. **AI and Automation Integration** * Implement data governance and data loss prevention (DLP) controls for AI systems to prevent sensitive data — including customer PII, contracts, and financial information — from leaking into prompts, model training data, or third\-party model APIs. * Discover, assess, and govern the use of unsanctioned AI and SaaS tools ("shadow AI") across the organization, establishing approval, monitoring, and offboarding processes to reduce data exposure and compliance risk. * Define and enforce safe data\-handling standards for prompt and model\-response content across internally built and vendor\-provided AI services. * Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance threat detection, anomaly detection, and automated incident response capabilities. * Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate response times across the security operations lifecycle. * Evaluate and implement AI\-powered security platforms and tools, ensuring they are deployed securely and aligned with Herc Rentals' standards. * Identify opportunities to apply AI\-driven insights to improve vulnerability management, access governance, and cloud compliance monitoring. **Security Operations and Incident Response** * Monitor cloud environments for security events, misconfigurations, and anomalous activity using SIEM and cloud\-native monitoring tools. * Participate in incident response activities, including investigation, containment, remediation, and post\-incident review for cloud\-related security events. * Collaborate with the broader Cybersecurity team to develop and refine playbooks, runbooks, and response procedures. **Compliance and Risk Management** * Ensure cloud environments comply with applicable regulatory frameworks and standards, including NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, and PCI DSS. * Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analyses for cloud\-hosted systems and AI workloads. * Partner with IT, DevOps, and application teams to integrate security into the software development lifecycle and cloud deployment pipelines (DevSecOps). * Maintain documentation of security configurations, controls, and audit evidence. **Collaboration and Continuous Improvement** * Work cross\-functionally with infrastructure, application development, and operations teams to embed security into cloud initiatives from inception. * Stay current on emerging cloud security threats, AI security risks, and industry developments, including OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS frameworks. * Contribute to security awareness efforts and provide guidance to internal teams on cloud security best practices. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 to 5 years of experience in cloud security engineering or a closely related cybersecurity discipline. * Hands\-on experience securing cloud environments in AWS, with working knowledge of Azure. * Proficiency with cloud security tools and services such as AWS Security Hub, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and related platforms. * Knowledge of adversarial machine learning concepts and AI\-specific attack vectors. * Strong understanding of IAM, network security, encryption, and cloud security architecture principles. * Experience with security automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), and DevSecOps practices. * Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to security use cases, including anomaly detection and automated threat response. * Experience with AI security tooling, including tools designed to secure LLM integrations, model endpoints, and AI\-driven workflows. * Knowledge of compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, and PCI DSS. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel. * Experience with container security and Kubernetes environments. * Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), CompTIA Security\+, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate, or an AI security/governance credential such as ISACA AAISM or AAIA. Equivalent certifications or practical experience may also be considered. * Experience working in a regulated industry environment. **Skills** ---------- * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a security\-first mindset. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative team player with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. * High attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risk. **Req \#:** 70394 **Pay Range:** Based on qualifications. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: **WHY HILLPOINTE?** *Hillpointe is a fully integrated real estate development and investment management firm focused on developing market\-rate workforce housing across the Sun Belt. Ranked at the top of NMHC's list of Builders and Developers, our team ensures best\-in\-class execution.* *Built on its long and proven track record of real estate development, the firm's investment approach is centered around its in\-house general contracting expertise, enabling direct control of cost and delivery timeframe. For each project, Hillpointe directly controls land acquisition, land development, construction, procurement of building materials, asset management, and capital markets. This is more than just a job \- it's a career\-defining opportunity! At Hillpointe, you'll be part of a dynamic, innovative team that has tangible impacts on day\-to\-day operations and contributes directly to overall success.* **Director of Engineering** The Director of Engineering owns how Alinos (CRM, PMS \& More) gets built, shipped, secured, and run, and is accountable for replacing our property management system in 2027\. This player\-coach role leads a nine\-seat engineering team, sets the architecture, runs delivery, and reports progress, risk, and cost to the executive team in plain business terms. **Key Responsibilities:** * Ship the Alinos PMS and cut the portfolio over from the current vendor by October 2027\. * Build the Lease App, covering the applicant application, screening, and lease\-execution flow. * Build TourPointe, covering the resident portal, self\-guided tours, and augmented reality touring. * Build AI Wayfinding to guide prospects and residents through communities. * Rebuild live AI tour coaching and extend call and conversation capture to service and resident\-experience teams. * Build Prospect Touring so prospects can tour with residents after hours and at lightly staffed communities. * Build the self\-storage kiosk so prospects can tour on\-site with a remote team member from the centralized HUB. * Build mobile\-first operations so site teams run on company phones with location\-aware task assignment and confirmation. * Consolidate internal tools by bringing internal communication and design workflows onto Alinos. * Harden the platform with network isolation of non\-production environments, removal of single points of failure, separation of identity and PII data, rotating secrets, and edge security. * Move the platform from a shared\-database monolith toward domain services, and own the product roadmap that runs on the platform. * Own the Alinos architecture, including domain boundaries, data model and ontology, API contracts, identity, and the path from a shared database to domain services. * Set and enforce engineering standards for code review, testing, trunk\-based development, feature flags, and build\-once, promote\-everywhere releases. * Own DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and reliability with the Tech Lead, including infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, incident response, backup, and disaster recovery. * Own security and compliance for resident PII and payment data, and lead the platform toward SOC 2 readiness. * Lead data migration and cutover from the incumbent PMS, including integrations, parallel runs, and rollback plans. * Make build, buy, and integrate decisions with a clear cost and risk case. * Put AI to work in the product and in how the team builds, using LLMs and agent frameworks where they move a metric. * Stay hands\-on by reviewing pull requests, unblocking hard problems, and writing code when the roadmap needs it. * Lead a team of nine, including a Tech Lead, product/UX engineering, telephony, and full\-stack engineers. * Hire the open seats, then coach, set goals, and run performance management. * Build a team that owns quality, with full\-stack engineers owning QA and every release meeting a written definition of done. * Create clear decision rights between engineering, product, data, and implementation. * Report weekly to the executive supervisor and monthly to the executive team on delivery, risk, spend, and platform health. * Translate technical trade\-offs into business terms, including dates, dollars, headcount, and operational impact. * Run engineering within the approved labor and non\-labor budget, and manage cloud and vendor spend. * Partner with Alinos Product, Implementation, Operations, Data, IT, and the centralized operations and property teams to turn real workflows into shipped software. * Within 30 days, assess the architecture, codebase, and security posture, and present a written 2027 delivery plan with dates, staffing, and risks to executives. * Within 90 days, hire the open full\-stack seats, own on\-call and the release process, and close the top security risks. * Within 180 days, get an approved PMS cutover plan with migration, parallel\-run, and rollback steps, and keep roadmap builds shipping on a predictable cadence. * By October 2027, bring Alinos PMS live across the portfolio and retire the incumbent PMS on schedule. * Track releases shipped on the committed date, production uptime and incident recovery time, escaped defects, open security findings, and engineering spend against budget. **Qualifications:** * 7\+ years in professional software engineering, with 3\+ years leading engineering teams and managing managers or tech leads. * Track record shipping and operating a production platform that replaced or consolidated legacy systems on a fixed date. * Deep hands\-on experience with cloud\-native architecture on AWS, including ECS/Fargate containers, Aurora PostgreSQL, VPC networking, API Gateway, IAM, Secrets Manager, and WAF. * Working fluency in React, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, with the ability to review code and make architecture calls credibly. * Built or ran CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and incident management at production scale. * Experience securing systems that hold PII or payment data, including network isolation, secrets management, least\-privilege access, and audit readiness. * Has reported to executives on delivery, budget, and risk, and can defend a plan with numbers. * Hired, coached, and managed performance on a team of 8\+ engineers. * Nice to have: production generative AI work, including LLM integration, agent frameworks, or AI\-assisted development workflows. * Nice to have: AR or immersive experience development for mobile (ARKit, ARCore, Unity). * Nice to have: proptech, real estate operations, or other operations\-heavy domains with complex workflows. * Nice to have: Microsoft Azure experience (Container Apps, App Configuration, Entra ID), and experience migrating between clouds or consolidating legacy environments. * Nice to have: SOC 2 audit experience. * Nice to have: telephony, WebRTC, or real\-time communication systems experience. * Nice to have: data platform exposure with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or change\-data\-capture pipelines. * Nice to have: monorepo tooling (Turborepo) and ORM or schema layers (Prisma, ZenStack).

jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us. **About The Role:** Homebound is seeking an exceptional Senior/Staff AI Engineer to accelerate our mission of building the leading vertical AI stack for residential construction. Our proprietary platform captures granular data at every stage of the homebuilding process, enabling us to develop novel LLM\-powered applications that improve efficiency and quality across the board. We are a small, fast\-moving team with multiple AI products already in production and a rapidly growing AI platform. In this role, you will lead the research and implementation of cutting\-edge advancements in AI, design and deploy impactful features, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to shape the future of homebuilding. **What You'll Do:** * Shape the vision for how AI, particularly LLMs, integrate into Homebound’s products and operations. Define technical standards for experimentation, deployment, and evaluation. * Design and build scalable AI systems that can handle real\-world production workloads and evolve with the business. * Deliver high\-quality, production\-grade code daily while ensuring observability, maintainability, and reliability. * Raise the bar across engineering by teaching AI best practices, reviewing designs, and guiding engineers through complex technical challenges. * Stay abreast of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, bringing forward cutting\-edge ideas while focusing investment where it creates clear business impact. **What You Have Done In Your Career:** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on AI systems. * Shipped LLM\-powered features into production, including hands\-on experience with some or all of the following: + RAG + eval frameworks + agentic loops. + sandboxes for agents + systems to edit memory + managing subagents + Pydantic AI + agent observability * Fluency in Python. Proven ability to design systems that balance rapid experimentation with long\-term reliability and maintainability. * A strong understanding of metrics and data science logic **Who You Are:** * You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes. * You’re excited to learn and grow as part of a small, nimble, high\-impact team. * You communicate clearly and proactively \- especially in writing without AI assistance. * You’re humble, good\-natured, and bring a positive energy to your team. **Our Commitment**: We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page. Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. **Our Compensation Philosophy**: Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: 2027 Hearst AI Newsroom Developer Fellowship Program
jobs.description: **Role Overview** ----------------- The **Hearst Fellowship for Newsroom AI Development** is a one\-year program focused on building tools for journalists and experiences for readers with cutting\-edge technology. The successful candidate will embed on the **DevHub** , Hearst’s San Francisco\-based editorial innovation team, and will work on AI\-assisted projects, tools and news products with our core product and engineering teams and our top metro newsrooms: San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, Austin American\-Statesman, San Antonio Express\-News, (Albany) Times Union and our Hearst Connecticut newsrooms. Fellows will receive training, mentorship and real\-world experience alongside top journalist\-programmers who build interactive experiences and automation tools focused on building connections to the local communities we cover. Hearst Fellows are full\-time employees with competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance, relocation allowance and a housing stipend. **What the DevHub Does** ------------------------ The Hearst DevHub is a team of editorial engineers, AI developers, data journalists, interactive designers and content strategists who collaborate with local newsrooms to create best\-in\-class digital experiences. We make things like election results pages, AI tools, searchable databases, severe weather trackers, elegantly designed alternative story forms and whatever else you can dream up. You can learn more about the DevHub here . **What This Fellowship Could Mean for Your Future** --------------------------------------------------- Our goal for the program is for Fellows to earn full\-time employment at the end of the yearlong term. We want to train our next builders, and then continue supporting them as they grow into our future leaders. While participation in the program is not a guarantee of future employment, our goal is to recruit candidates who eventually will join our full\-time professional staff. All of us here have an investment in your future and in the future of Hearst Newspapers. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ The successful candidate will do the following on the DevHub: * Create AI tools for newsrooms and experiences for readers that adhere to our strict editorial standards and company policies. * Work with newsrooms on best practices for AI usage. * Enrich existing tools and interactives with fresh approaches to workflows, data analysis and visualization. * Innovate with new technology to benefit journalists and the communities we cover. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- The experience you gain as a Hearst Fellow is the start of a strong foundation for your journalism career. Our objective is to recruit, train and retain journalists who have experience with AI, data journalism and programming. Candidates should be college graduates with interest, experience or background in journalism and AI. **How Fellows Are Selected** ---------------------------- Hearst DevHub team members will conduct multiple interviews and test the top candidates. If you are offered and accept a position, you will be assigned a mentor, and we’ll help you develop relationships with seasoned professionals throughout Hearst Newspapers and beyond. **Requirements and Information** -------------------------------- Please see our Fellowship website . In addition, candidates must be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area and work a hybrid in\-office schedule. To be considered you must submit all required documents in PDF format: * One\-page resume that includes past journalistic experience, academic major and minor, date or expected date of graduation, permanent and current addresses, email, website, and social media addresses (if applicable). * Reference page that includes three work references including titles, email addresses and phone numbers. * Page with links to portfolio or digital work samples. **Deadline to apply for the Fellowship program is Jan. 4, 2027\.** **Additional Information** -------------------------- * **Sponsorship:** This position does not provide immigration sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship. * **Accommodations:** We are committed to an accessible application process. If you need an accommodation to apply, please contact hnpemployment@hearst.com . This email address is for accommodation requests only. \#LI\-DH1 \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: AI Solutions Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About CAMP Systems:** At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting\-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we're shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we've grown to a dynamic team of 1,600\+ employees across 14 locations globally\-all united by a passion for innovation and excellence. **Our Mission \& Vision:** We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences. **Our Values \& Excellence Mindset:** We are customer obsessed, trust\-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative. **What You Will Experience in This Role:** **About CAMP Aviate** CAMP Aviate brings together aviation ERP solutions, AI products, workflow applications, and integration capabilities to help aviation businesses plan and operate more effectively. Our AI Solutions include AI Operations Manager, AI Technician, and AI Analyst. They can work with CAMP ERP products or complement other enterprise systems. **The opportunity** Our strongest AI conversations start with a customer's own data and operational problem. We are looking for a Sales Solutions Engineer who can turn that material into a credible demonstration, a practical pilot, and a clear technical path forward. You will work with our AI commercial leader, customer\-facing teams, Product, and Engineering. This role combines hands\-on data work with technical discovery and live customer engagement. You should enjoy opening a dataset as much as presenting its implications to an operations leader. **Responsibilities:*** Build and deliver customer\-specific demonstrations using operational data, workflows, and use cases. * Inspect, map, validate, transform, and troubleshoot structured data using SQL, APIs, scripting, and analytics tools. * Lead technical discovery on customer systems, data sources, integrations, security needs, and desired outcomes. * Scope pilots with clear technical requirements, assumptions, dependencies, and success criteria. * Explain current capability accurately and identify where configuration, integration, or product development is needed. * Handle routine technical presales work and engage Product or Engineering for deeper architecture or feasibility questions. * Turn successful demonstrations, data mappings, and integration approaches into reusable playbooks. * Help account teams present AI Solutions effectively to executives, operational teams, and IT stakeholders. **You have:*** At least four years in Sales Solutions Engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or a similar customer\-facing technical role. * Hands\-on experience with SQL, APIs, data mapping, validation, transformation, and integration troubleshooting; ability to use Python or comparable scripting tools. * Experience building or adapting demonstrations and proofs of concept with customer data. * Working knowledge of AI, analytics, and LLM\-based applications, with sound judgment about technical limits. * Strong discovery, problem\-solving, live demonstration, and communication skills across technical and business audiences. * Comfort with evolving products and willingness to travel for important customer work. **Why Work at CAMP?** Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation. CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer \- vets/disabled CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. jobs.title: Chief Engineering, Technology, and AI Officer
jobs.description: CDS Global is undertaking a significant transformation of its platforms, engineering practices, operating model and use of artificial intelligence. CDS Global seeks an exceptional executive to lead Engineering, Architecture, Technology Modernization and Applied AI while serving as a strategic partner to Product, Commercial and Client leaders. The successful executive will combine deep software and platform credibility with enterprise transformation experience. This person will determine how CDS Global stabilizes, modernizes, integrates, re\-platforms, replaces or retires capabilities while protecting service continuity, client commitments, security and trust. This is a builder mandate. The executive must create the engineering system, leadership depth, partner ecosystem and AI\-enabled practices required to turn product direction and client needs into scalable, reliable and economically responsible outcomes. **Engineering Organization \& Delivery** ---------------------------------------- * Builds a high\-performing engineering organization with clear ownership, standards and measurable outcomes. * Transforms Engineering from a capacity\- and project\-oriented delivery model toward an increasingly platform\-oriented operating model characterized by durable ownership, reusable capabilities, measurable engineering effectiveness and clear accountability for production outcomes. * Improves delivery predictability, engineering capacity transparency, quality, reliability, security and developer effectiveness. * Balances client commitments, roadmap delivery, platform investment, maintenance, technical debt, modernization and innovation. * Reduces dependence on individual knowledge holders through architecture, documentation, leadership development and succession. **Architecture \& Modernization** --------------------------------- * Sets coherent architectural direction across platforms, cloud, APIs, integration, data, event\-driven systems and observability. * Creates a sequenced modernization roadmap for business\-critical legacy platforms. * Uses pilots and proofs of concept to answer explicit investment questions with entry, exit, scale and stop criteria. * Protects continuity, controls and client trust while reducing fragility, complexity, technical debt and scarce\-skill dependency. **Applied AI \& AI\-Augmented Engineering** ------------------------------------------- * Defines a focused applied\-AI portfolio tied to product, engineering and operating outcomes. * Establishes measurable AI value criteria, including adoption, quality, productivity, revenue enablement, cost\-to\-serve, client value and operating capacity, and recommends when initiatives should scale, change direction or stop. * Moves selected use cases from discovery to pilot, production and scaled adoption. * Uses AI responsibly across code understanding, development, testing, documentation, migration, workflow automation and client\-facing capabilities. * Establishes evaluation, monitoring, security, data, privacy, human\-review and accountability practices with appropriate enterprise partners. **Product, Client \& Commercial Partnership** --------------------------------------------- * Partners with Product to translate market and client needs into scalable capabilities, coherent roadmaps and sound technical choices. * Engages strategic clients and partners where architecture, integrations, modernization, data or AI are material. * Ensures commitments are technically supportable, economically responsible and aligned with platform direction. * Brings engineering evidence, capacity, risk and economics into product lifecycle and portfolio decisions. **Investment, Partners \& Governance** -------------------------------------- * Owns Engineering and Technology budgets, workforce planning, material vendors and strategic investment recommendations. * Creates transparent governance across engineering, modernization and AI investments, and provides executive oversight of the technology responsibilities within the enterprise compliance and assurance program, including Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance and applicable System and Organization Controls (SOC 1 and SOC 2\) examinations. In partnership with Security, Compliance, Finance, Legal and control owners, establishes clear responsibilities, a coordinated assessment calendar, ongoing control monitoring, evidence readiness and timely remediation of findings. Escalates material gaps, overdue actions and resource needs to the President. * Leads build\-buy\-partner\-integrate\-orchestrate decisions and manages dependency risk. * Measures progress through enterprise outcomes rather than activity or pilot volume. **Talent \& Transformation** ---------------------------- * Assesses and evolves the organization, leadership structure, skills, decision rights and ways of working. * Recruits and develops Engineering, Architecture, Platform and AI leaders. * Builds technical caree bilities, roadmap choices and technical investment decisions. Has partnered with Product, Finance and business leaders to develop return on investment (ROI) business cases addressing expected benefits, development and ongoing operating costs, assumptions, risks and investment trade\-offs. Has then stewarded approved initiatives through Engineering, aligning architecture, capacity, delivery sequencing, quality and production readiness with the agreed requirements and business case. Must distinguish reusable product value from one\-off customization and demonstrate how feedback and delivery results informed subsequent decisions. Company\-wide Product leadership is not required; Product strategy and product\-management accountability remain distinct from this role. * Commercial and financial acumen: Understands recurring\-revenue economics and how engineering and technology choices affect revenue, margin, retention, implementation effort, cost to serve and enterprise value. Has managed meaningful budgets, workforce plans, partners and investment trade\-offs. * Build\-buy\-partner judgment: Has demonstrated judgment to build, buy, partner, integrate, orchestrate, encapsulate or retire capabilities and understands the strategic and economic consequences of vendor and platform dependency. * Risk, security and responsible technology leadership: Has operated where cybersecurity, privacy, data stewardship, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and responsible AI materially influenced technology decisions. * Has led Engineering and Technology participation in material security, compliance and assurance programs, preferably including PCI DSS and SOC 1/SOC 2 Type 2 examinations, including scope management, control implementation and operation, evidence collection, assessor and auditor engagement and remediation of findings. Can demonstrate sustained control effectiveness between assessments and explain personal accountability, cross\-functional governance and how modernization preserved compliance and assurance coverage. * Client and external credibility: Can engage enterprise clients, prospects, strategic partners and senior operators; translate technology into differentiated and supportable value; and prevent technically or economically unsound commitments. * People and leadership builder: Has recruited, developed and retained senior Engineering, Architecture, Platform and AI leaders; built succession depth; and created an accountable, collaborative and low\-ego culture across distributed teams. *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel assigned to this job.* **Benefits** ------------ CDS Global offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including: * **Health coverage:** Two medical plan options—High Deductible and Traditional—plus comprehensive dental and vision plans. * **Time off and protection:** Generous PTO, holiday pay, basic and voluntary life insurance, AD\&D insurance, and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage. * **Retirement:** A 401(k) retirement savings plan that allows employees to begin contributing immediately and includes a company match based on a percentage of employee contributions. * **Wellness and development:** Wellness and tuition reimbursement programs. * **Family support:** Paid parental leave for new parents. * **Child and dependent care:** Up to $750 per month in reimbursement for qualified child and dependent care expenses. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Post\-offer, pre\-employment background checks are conducted on qualified candidates. Pre\-employment drug and/or health screenings may be required for some positions. **If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be just the right fit.**

jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- **Black Book** is looking for a **Mid\-to\-Senior DevOps Engineer** with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Operations to help build, automate and operate the CI/CD and cloud platforms that support our automotive data and technology products. As part of the Hearst Transportation group, Black Book combines automotive expertise, data science, predictive analytics, APIs and modern cloud technology to help dealerships, lenders, OEMs, insurers, fleet operators and other automotive businesses make better decisions. You’ll work closely with software engineers, data engineers, data scientists and analysts to improve how applications and infrastructure are built, deployed, monitored and supported. **Hybrid:** This hybrid role is based in our **Lawrenceville, Georgia** office. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build and operate highly available AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure. * Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and automation. * Improve CI/CD and GitOps workflows. * Automate operational tasks with Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar tools. * Troubleshoot production issues across applications, containers, networking and cloud infrastructure. * Improve observability, reliability, security, performance and cost efficiency. * Partner with development and data teams to promote DevOps and shift\-left practices. * Participate in incident response and help eliminate root causes. * Document solutions, share knowledge and mentor teammates. * Support customer\-impacting issues when needed. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- This is not a ticket\-driven infrastructure role. We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys automation, troubleshooting complex problems, improving platforms and taking ownership from idea through production. Our environment includes: **AWS • Kubernetes/EKS • Pulumi • Argo CD • Azure DevOps • Python • PowerShell • Bash • Linux • Windows • Grafana • AI Engineering Tools** You don’t need experience with every tool. Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and the ability to learn matter more than matching our stack exactly. ### **Required Qualifications** * Minimum of 3 years’ experience in DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Operations. * Experience building or supporting production cloud infrastructure. * Strong AWS knowledge or experience with another major cloud provider. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code such as Pulumi, Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of automation and shift\-left engineering practices. * Ability to automate using Python, PowerShell, Bash or another programming language. * Experience with Linux and/or Windows environments. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others. * Strong communication, ownership and technical judgment. * Ability to use modern AI development and engineering tools, such as **Claude Code and similar AI agents** , to accelerate development, troubleshooting, automation, documentation and research, going beyond basic prompting or code completion. ### **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required: EKS, Helm, Argo CD, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, networking and DNS, REST or GraphQL APIs, .NET, Node.js, DevSecOps, SRE practices, MCP servers or AI agent/tool integrations. We value engineers who can: * Give agents clear context, constraints and acceptance criteria. * Build reusable **skills, hooks, instructions and workflows** . * Connect agents to appropriate tools, repositories, APIs and documentation. * Use automated validation and guardrails around agent\-driven work. * Critically review AI\-generated code, infrastructure and recommendations. * Understand the security implications of agent access and permissions. * Recognize when AI is the right tool—and when it isn’t. We view AI as an engineering multiplier, not a substitute for engineering judgment. **How We Work** --------------- We value engineers who: * **Shift left** and automate recurring problems. * **Own outcomes** , not just assigned tasks. * **Keep learning** and adapt as technology changes. * **Embrace ambiguity** and work through unfamiliar problems. * **Choose simplicity** over unnecessary complexity. * **Use AI effectively** while validating its work. * **Think about the customer** and the reliability of the systems they depend on. * **Share knowledge** and help the team improve. **Benefits** ------------ As part of Hearst, Black Book offers modern, flexible benefits designed to support you and your family. Benefits include: * Medical, dental and vision coverage * HSA contributions * 401(k) matching * Emotional wellness support * Paid time off * Paid parental leave * Volunteer days * LGBTQ\+ health services * Additional benefits to meet you and your family’s needs

jobs.description: **Job Description** **Director, Solutions Architecture \- Enterprise Architecture** Fitch Group is seeking a Director, Solutions Architecture based in our New York office, reporting to the Lead Enterprise Architect for the Fitch Group line of business you support. This is a hands\-on architecture role built around one core relationship: engineering squads. You'll partner directly with the teams building technology across your line of business, helping them design solutions, navigate architecture standards, and build with confidence. specific context \- what works for one squad won't work for all of them. * Champion AI\-Based Development: Help squads adopt AI\-assisted and agentic development \- coding assistants, AI\-driven testing, and agentic workflows \- and establish the patterns, guardrails, and metrics that let them ship faster with confidence rather than treating AI as a novelty. * Drive Down Technical Liabilities: Use the Tech Roadmap (Invest/Maintain/Divest/Research) and the enterprise architecture graph of dependencies to give squads a clear view of their technical debt \- what to retire, what to orchestration, observability, tool use \- to production workflows. * Influence\-Based Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive adoption across teams without direct authority \- earning buy\-in through trust and results, not org\-chart power. * Customer\-Facing Orientation: You think of engineers as your customers. consistent buy\-in without slowing everyone down. * Track Record Driving AI Adoption: Demonstrated success introducing AI\-based development practices \- coding assistants, agentic workflows, or developer\-productivity tooling \- to engineering teams and getting real, sustained usage rather than shelfware. * Technical Debt and Dependency Management: Experience mapping system dependencies and leading modernization or automated\-upgrade programs across a codebase or platform. **What Would Make You Stand Out:*** MCP and Agent Tooling Experience: Hands\-on work building tools that let AI agents discover, query, or act on internal systems. * LLM Observability: Experience standing up or operating observability platforms for LLM agents \- traces, cost, safety evaluation. * Cross\-Team Schema or API Governance: Experience leading standards work across a large number of engineering teams. * Technical Leadership Through Expertise: A track record of being the go\-to technical voice on jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- **Homecare Homebase (HCHB)** is the software platform behind home health and hospice care across the United States, supporting scheduling, clinical documentation, coding, compliance and revenue cycle for agencies serving millions of patient visits each year. We are seeking a **Principal AI Platform Engineer** to build our AI software factory. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will write code every day, ship the first working version of our agent platform yourself, and then teach engineering teams to build on it. You will have no direct reports at the start. The platform will run agents against our production codebase, with people writing specifications and validating results and agents doing most of the implementation. You will also serve as the senior technical authority on AI built into our products. Our primary stack is .NET and Azure, with Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure AI Foundry and MCP\-based tooling, alongside other languages and frameworks. The agent platform must work across all of them. This is a greenfield effort, so you will set the standards rather than inherit them. **Is This Role for You?** ------------------------- This role is for someone who builds. You’ll set standards, shape how teams use AI and influence the roadmap, but you’ll do it through working code and reference implementations, not decks, review boards or org charts. If your recent work has mostly been leading teams, advising executives or designing solutions that others implement, this probably isn’t the right match. Expect to spend most of your time coding, especially in your first few months. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ **AI Platform Architecture and Development** * Design, write and operate the agent platform that runs autonomously against our production codebase, taking work from specification to pull request with human review. * Implement agentic patterns, orchestration and tool integration for real\-world engineering workflows. * Make the platform effective across our full technology stack, not only one language or framework. * Define the agent templates and shared framework that every team uses. * Own the AI lifecycle from concept through deployment, operation and iteration on Azure and Azure AI Foundry. * Shape how work is handed to agents and review the results, from concept to specification through pull request. **Developer Experience and Integration** * Partner with application teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing products and workflows. * Build the APIs, SDKs, MCP servers and extension points that engineering teams build on. * Establish how MCP servers, tools and agent skills are packaged, versioned, discovered and distributed to teams, such as through an internal registry or catalog with access controls. * Design tool access with per\-tenant data scoping, so that an agent acting for one agency can reach only that agency’s data. **Context and Knowledge Engineering** * Design the context, skills and retrieval patterns that make AI agents effective in large codebases, including an application\-level knowledge map that tells an agent which module a ticket belongs to and what it affects. * Decide when retrieval is the right tool and when curated context is better. * Establish versioning, review and governance for shared AI assets. **Evaluation, Safety and Operational Quality** * Build evaluation frameworks that measure AI output quality and detect regressions. * Define guardrails, failure handling and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for regulated environments, including keeping PHI out of agent context, prompts and logs. * Monitor and optimize AI systems for reliability, accuracy and cost efficiency, with token budgets, rate limits, retry caps and step limits. * Establish observability best practices across supervised and autonomous AI usage. **Enablement and Technical Leadership** * Mentor engineers across the organization and raise AI engineering capability at scale, by building working examples in their own codebases. * Define engineering standards and shape the AI technical roadmap with the CTO. **Innovation and Applied Research** * Evaluate emerging capabilities in LLMs, agentic AI, RAG and MCP, and bring what proves out into production. * Advise on build, buy and partner decisions across the AI toolchain. * Maintain a working view of commercial and open\-weight models, and match model tiers to tasks by cost, latency, quality and data\-handling terms. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Within your first 90 days, a working agent template and shared framework that engineering teams can adopt, with at least one team using it on real tickets. * Telemetry in place for token spend, agent launch frequency and traceable tool calls. * A baseline for measuring the impact on our development process: time saved, delivery velocity and cost. * One common standard across teams such as clinical, revenue cycle and integration, so that each team owns its knowledge but no team builds its own agents, models or tiers. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years in software engineering, with recent hands\-on coding. You write code today, not only review it. * 3\+ years building and operating production AI systems in which agents call tools or change code. RAG or machine learning products alone do not meet this bar. * Proficiency in Python and modern AI tooling (for example LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs). * Hands\-on experience building MCP servers or equivalent tool interfaces, including authentication and per\-tenant access control. * Ability to make agents effective across multiple languages and technology stacks, not only one. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads in cloud environments (Azure preferred). * Solid grasp of LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and context engineering. * Proven RAG experience, and judgment on when retrieval beats curated context. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability, including quality measurement, cost and token management. * Working knowledge of handling regulated data such as PHI in AI systems. * Demonstrated record of mentoring engineers and raising technical capability across teams. * Evidence of your own work: a repository, code sample or demo of agent or MCP work that you personally built. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience integrating AI into C\# and .NET applications. * Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code on large codebases. * Familiarity with vector databases and retrieval tooling (for example pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search). * Exposure to LLMOps and evaluation tooling (for example Azure AI Foundry, MLflow, LangSmith, CI/CD). * Familiarity with agent\-to\-agent communication standards such as A2A, and judgment on when a multi\-agent design is warranted over a single agent with tools. * Experience with large legacy codebases and incremental modernization. * Interest in healthcare, EHR or revenue cycle applications. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Sponsorship:** This position does not provide immigration sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship. **What You Can Expect From Us** ------------------------------- **We don't just help our clients succeed; we help our employees succeed.** Competitive pay, robust benefits and professional development opportunities are a few of the many reasons Homecare Homebase is a great place to build your career. * **Meaningful work.** Make a difference in the lives of clinicians and home\-based care teams—and ultimately the patients they serve. * **Leaders who care.** Work in a culture where leaders value, support and invest in their people. * **Flexibility.** We value work\-life balance and offer career opportunities designed to support life’s changing demands. * **A company that gives back.** Each year, Homecare Homebase supports charitable initiatives that align with our mission of empowering exceptional care and helping others in need. **Sound like a good fit? We’d love to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About CAMP Systems:** At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting\-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we're shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we've grown to a dynamic team of 1,600\+ employees across 14 locations globally\-all united by a passion for innovation and excellence. **Our Mission \& Vision:** We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences. **Our Values \& Excellence Mindset:** We are customer obsessed, trust\-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative. **What You Will Experience in This Role:** We are seeking a full stack Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in **.NET** and **Angular** to join our talented engineering team. Working part of an Agile Scrum team, you will play a key role in designing, building, scaling, and maintaining enterprise\-grade web applications that serve a diverse range of customers. This is a hands\-on position, we want someone who is focused, and passionate about coding, and development. You will work closely with product managers, designers, and other developers to create seamless, performant, and highly scalable solutions. We expect all our team members to contribute towards building a culture of continuous learning and improvement. We are open to new approaches and ideas. CAMP offers a unique domain, as well as a chance to be part of a product that affects the readiness, safety, and performance of business aircraft from nearly every major manufacturer. Like many of our team, if you are selected, with hard work, a continued quest for knowledge, and a knack for troubleshooting, there are endless possibilities for growth and development. As an engineering team, we are moving decisively toward AI\-driven software development, and this role will use AI coding tools and frameworks extensively as part of daily work, including setting the standard for how the team adopts them. Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development is required for this position. **Responsibilities:*** **Design \& Development:** Architect and implement robust, scalable, and high\-performance web applications using .NET (Core, ASP.Net, Web API) and Angular and ExtJS. * **Code Quality:** Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following the industry's best practices. Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers to ensure coding standards are met. * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Manage the full software development lifecycle, from gathering requirements to deployment and ongoing maintenance. * **Collaboration:** Work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA engineers, and other developers to deliver high\-quality features on time. * **Performance Optimization:** Focus on optimizing the performance of both front\-end and back\-end components, ensuring the application scales effectively and provides an excellent user experience. * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Implement unit tests, integration tests, and other automated tests to ensure the reliability and stability of the application. * **Troubleshooting \& Debugging:** Investigate production issues, resolve defects, and implement preventative measures for future releases. * **Continuous Improvement:** Stay up to date with the latest technological trends and frameworks and evaluate new tools and techniques to improve development workflows and application performance. * **Leading Technical Design:** Lead technical design discussions and drive alignment across the team on implementation approaches for complex features and systems. * **Architectural Decisions:** Make and document key architectural decisions, weighing trade\-offs in scalability, maintainability, and performance. * **Managing Technical Risk:** Identify technical risk early across the codebase and delivery timeline, and proactively raise and mitigate issues before they become blockers. * **Mentoring Engineers:** Mentor and coach engineers across the team, providing technical guidance, code review feedback, and support for their growth and development. * **Improving Engineering Practices:** Drive continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling, and standards across the team. * **AI\-Driven Development \& Enablement:** Champion the use of AI coding assistants and LLM\-based tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) across the team; establish best practices for AI\-assisted code review, prompting, and quality guardrails, and mentor other engineers in using these tools effectively. **Technical Skills:*** **Backend:** Expertise in .NET Core (C\#), ASP.NET MVC, Web API, NHibernate, and Oracle (or equivalent relational database systems). * **Frontend:** Strong proficiency with Angular, HTML5, CSS3, and TypeScript. * **APIs:** Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and working with OAuth and JWT authentication. * **Cloud:** Experience with AWS cloud platform. * **ML/AI:** Experience with LLM integration, NLP, training and utilization of ML models. * **Version Control:** Proficient in Git for version control. * **Unit Testing \& TDD:** Experience with automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jasmine. * **AI\-Assisted Development:** Required, hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) and LLMs to accelerate development, automate testing, and improve code quality. **Preferred Qualifications:*** **Enterprise Architecture:** Highly proficient with 8\+ years of experience building scalable enterprise\-grade systems with a focus on performance, maintainability, and extensibility. Solid understanding of object\-oriented design and software engineering principles. * **Web Application:** Solid experience in data driven web applications using Angular, other JavaScript frameworks. * **Agile Methodology:** Proven experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments. * **Containerization:** Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies. * DevOps: Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools (CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code). * **AI Tooling Leadership:** Experience evaluating, piloting, or rolling out AI development tools at a team or organizational level. * **UI/UX Design:** A good understanding of UI/UX design principles and experience working closely with designers to create intuitive and visually appealing applications. **Education \& Experience:*** **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. * **Experience:** Minimum of 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 5 years of experience working as a full\-stack engineer in .NET and Angular. **Core Competencies:*** Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical team members. * Self\-driven with a focus on delivering high\-quality results on time. * Ability to handle multiple priorities and navigate complex technical challenges. **Why Work at CAMP?** Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation. CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer \- vets/disabled CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com . All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.
