jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Owner
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Hearst Corporate GenAI, within the Office of the CTO, helps our diversified businesses develop AI fluency and transform how work gets done. We test frontier capabilities, build useful systems, develop reusable methods, and help business teams adopt them. Our remit spans workflow transformation, product development, AI software factory practices, and AI\-assisted cybersecurity. **About the role** ------------------ As Senior Technical Product Owner, you will identify valuable AI opportunities, decide what to build, and personally implement solutions. You will combine product ownership with hands\-on building to take AI\-enabled products and workflows from discovery into use. This senior individual contributor role requires independent product judgment, technical problem solving, and accountability for adoption and results. You will work across OpenAI, Anthropic's Claude, and other relevant AI systems on workflow transformation, AI fluency, product development, and software factory capabilities. Your implementation work will inform product decisions and produce approaches businesses can reuse, including defensive AI work with security partners. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Discover problems with business teams, challenge inherited workflows, and set priorities based on business value, technical feasibility, and opportunities for reuse. * Create, use, test, and maintain reusable agent skills: modular instruction sets for product work and key business workflows, with reference material and scripts as needed. Define when each skill applies and its acceptance criteria, gather user feedback, and adapt skills across systems where useful. * Build and maintain AI\-enabled applications, automations, and integrations using suitable models, APIs, platforms, and AI coding tools. Connect tools and data, inspect generated code, debug failures, and verify complete workflows. * Own smaller solutions through release and improvement using team engineering standards. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex integrations, shared infrastructure, and architectural decisions. * Turn implementation findings into roadmap decisions. Identify missing data, tool actions, or product capabilities; decide what to configure, build, reuse, or stop, with clear acceptance criteria. * Evaluate capabilities from OpenAI, Anthropic, and emerging providers against real tasks. Test quality and failure cases, and account for cost, permissions, data handling, and human review. * Own adoption and outcomes with business sponsors. Use feedback and Product Ops analysis to improve what you ship, and agree ongoing support and ownership. **How you will work** --------------------- You own product priorities, acceptance, and the quality of what you implement. Hands\-on building is a continuing part of the role. Forward Deployed Engineers provide deeper engineering and shared standards; the Technical AI Project Manager also implements workflow improvements while coordinating delivery. Product Ops supports measurement; business and security owners retain their operating and risk decisions. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Typically 5\+ years in technical product ownership, software delivery, solutions engineering, or equivalent depth, including independent product decisions and work with senior stakeholders. * Demonstrated hands\-on delivery of AI\-enabled workflows or applications, including creating, adapting, and using modular agent skills. Be able to show what you built, how you tested it, and how it improved after feedback. * Ability to use AI coding tools to implement and debug working solutions. Practical understanding of APIs, authentication, structured data, and code review; ability to explain and verify generated code. * Product judgment across discovery, prioritization, acceptance, and adoption, including when a platform configuration is sufficient and when deeper engineering is needed. * Evidence of resolving ambiguous problems, making consequential tradeoffs, influencing business and technical leaders, and helping colleagues develop their capabilities. **How you will grow** --------------------- Bring strong professional judgment and a willingness to rethink established methods. We look for people who question inherited workflows, test what AI can now do, change course when evidence warrants it, and teach others. You will deepen this practice through real delivery, experimentation, and feedback. We assess learning behavior and demonstrated work; we do not expect a finished transformation playbook on day one. **Useful additional experience** -------------------------------- Experience with computer\-use agents that operate browser or desktop interfaces, or always\-on agents that retain context and perform scheduled or event\-driven work, is desired but not required. Relevant engineering experience includes reliable tool execution, monitoring, and recovery from failures. Experience with Python or TypeScript, agent SDKs or managed runtimes, MCP integrations, multimodal systems, and AI\-assisted security is useful. We value demonstrated problem solving and the ability to learn as the field changes; no single framework or model version defines this role. **What success looks like** --------------------------- Agree initial milestones with your manager and partners based on the work and its readiness. **Timeframe** **Expected progress** First 30 days Identify a valuable workflow and build a working prototype using suitable AI systems, tools, or data, with clear evaluation criteria. By 60 days Take a small solution into user testing or controlled use; resolve implementation issues and use the evidence to refine priorities. By 90 days Show an adopted improvement with clear support ownership. Publish a tested agent skill that another business can use or adapt. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more. **Compensation** The base salary range below is the Company's good\-faith estimate for this position in the posted work location at the time of posting. Final starting salary will be based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, education, location and market considerations. Base Salary Range: $180,000 — $210,000 USD

jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- MHK is hiring for a technically savvy Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) who will help ensure the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of our healthcare technology platforms. This role is expected to change and improve our reliability, availability, scalability, and performance – not just maintain existing systems and processes. Additionally, you'll focus on keeping production systems healthy and resilient, monitor and improve system reliability, establish and maintain service\-level objectives, respond to and lead production incidents, identify systemic causes of failures, and build automation that eliminates repetitive operational work. The ideal candidate will improve the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of our systems while solving complex production challenges through expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, and data\-driven analysis. **Hybrid:** This hybrid role is based in **Tampa, FL** and requires working in the office **3** **days per week** . **Position Responsibilities** ----------------------------- * Reliability \& Production Engineering: Own and improve the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of MHK production applications and infrastructure; establish and continuously improve SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and reliability metrics. * Observability \& Monitoring: Design, implement, and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and observability solutions; improve visibility into application and infrastructure health. * Incident Response \& Problem Management: Lead and participate in production incident response; diagnose complex issues; coordinate recovery; conduct root\-cause analysis and drive corrective actions through completion. * Automation \& Toil Reduction: Identify repetitive and error\-prone operational work and develop automation using Python, Bash, or similar tools to reduce manual intervention and operational toil. * Capacity, Performance \& Scalability: Analyze system performance, capacity, latency, error rates, resource utilization, and scaling requirements; identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability risks. * Reliability \& Resilience Engineering: Identify single points of failure, evaluate system dependencies and failure modes, and develop strategies to improve high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and system resilience. * Cloud \& Infrastructure Reliability: Support and improve the reliability of AWS production environments, including networking, storage, IAM, DNS, load balancing, databases, and related cloud services. * Release \& Change Reliability: Partner with Engineering and QA to establish production\-readiness standards, deployment safeguards, health checks, rollback strategies, and operational validation for production changes. * Documentation \& Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, service documentation, escalation procedures, and incident response processes. * Cross\-Functional Reliability Partnership: Partner with Software Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and other technical teams to identify reliability risks and implement sustainable solutions. **Position Requirements** ------------------------- * Five (5\) or more years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. * Strong understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, reliability metrics, service ownership, resilience engineering, and disaster recovery. * Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and infrastructure in high\-availability environments. * Hands\-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, and improving AWS cloud environments, including compute, networking, storage, IAM, DNS, load balancing, databases, and related services. * Experience leading production incident response, troubleshooting issues across applications, infrastructure, databases, networking, and cloud services, and completing root\-cause analyses, post\-incident reviews, and corrective actions. * Strong knowledge of observability practices, including monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, and service health analysis. * Strong Linux systems administration, networking, performance optimization, capacity planning, and reliability troubleshooting skills, including TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, firewalls, and VPC networking. * Ability to develop automation using Python, Bash, or similar tools; reduce operational toil; communicate complex technical issues clearly; and collaborate effectively with Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and technical leadership. ### **Education/Certification Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Relevant professional experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a closely related discipline including supporting high volume java applications. * Professional certifications related to AWS, cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related technical disciplines preferred. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Pre\-Employment Requirements:** All prospective employees must pass a background check and drug screening. **Benefits** ------------ At MHK, we support employees with meaningful work, opportunities to grow and benefits designed to promote health, financial security and overall wellbeing. Highlights include: * **Health coverage:** Medical, dental and vision plans for full\-time employees. * **Retirement:** 401(k) with a generous company match. * **Time off:** Generous paid time off and holiday policy. * **Benefits eligibility:** Benefits begin on the first day of the month following employment. * **Health and wellness:** Exercise and health club reimbursement opportunities. * **Dependent care:** Monthly dependent care reimbursement opportunities. * **Income protection:** Short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Life insurance:** Basic term life and AD\&D insurance.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer - Digital Transformation and AI Methods for Turbomachinery
jobs.description: The successful candidate will combine engineering expertise with experience deploying advanced digital technologies to accelerate product development, improve engineering productivity, and enhance product performance. This role will serve as the technical leader for the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Generative Design, and Digital Thread capabilities across Component Design \& Analyses (CDA) teams in Engines \& Power Systems (EPS) Strategic Business Group. As a recognized technical authority, the Chief Engineer will partner with component teams, systems engineering, data science, advanced technology, and Chief Technology Office, to establish next\-generation engineering methodologies that transform how turbine\-engines and energy systems are designed. jobs.title: ServiceNow AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: As a ServiceNow AI \& Automation Engineer at Honeywell Aerospace, you are responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining intelligent automation solutions and AI\-enabled capabilities across the enterprise ServiceNow platform. This role focuses on leveraging ServiceNow’s native automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and integration capabilities to streamline business processes, improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the overall user and service experience. You will report directly to our IT Manager and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on hybrid work schedule. The ideal candidate possesses strong ServiceNow development and engineering experience, practical knowledge of AI and automation technologies, integration expertise, and the ability to deliver enterprise\-grade solutions aligned with platform governance, architecture, security, and development standards.

jobs.title: Senior AI Identity Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= The Senior AI Identity Security Engineer will design, implement, automate, and operationalize identity security solutions for Agentic AI applications, AI agents, non\-human identities, APIs, MCP services, and multi\-cloud workloads. This hands\-on role requires strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, Workload Identity Federation, REST APIs, API security, and identity automation, along with knowledge of Agentic AI architecture, MCP, AI/API Gateways, PBAC, PlainID, and Google Cloud IAM. The engineer will partner with applications, AI, cloud, API, architecture, and cybersecurity teams to securely accelerate enterprise adoption of Agentic AI while maintaining least privilege, governance, and auditability.**Responsibilities** * Design and implement secure identity patterns for AI agents, non\-human identities, MCP services, APIs, and Agentic AI solutions. * Engineer and troubleshoot OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, JWT, scopes, claims, delegated/application permissions, OBO, and token\-exchange flows. * Implement Microsoft Entra ID, Agent Identity, workload identities, service principals, and Federated Identity Credentials. * Design Workload Identity Federation and secretless authentication between Microsoft Entra and Google Cloud. * Secure end\-to\-end Agentic AI flows across agents, MCP servers/tools, AI/API gateways, APIs, and enterprise resources. * Implement PBAC/dynamic authorization using PlainID or comparable authorization technologies. * Develop secure REST API integrations and automate identity processes using Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Python, PowerShell, or Infrastructure as Code. * Automate Agent Identity onboarding, provisioning, permissions, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Monitoring
jobs.description: Hummingbird is a remote\-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime. Since our launch in 2017, we’ve helped major financial institutions and tech\-savvy trailblazers alike (e.g. Plaid, Raymond James, Crypto.com etc.) orchestrate their compliance programs through our thoughtfully designed, intuitive, AI powered compliance tools. We believe finding and stopping financial crime is a problem rooted in code, language and design, so we built the product that the heroes doing this work deserve. We are customer\-obsessed, and we love building and shipping great products. We set a high bar, challenge our assumptions, seek diverse opinions, and support each other to do our best work. We do our best to write inclusive, descriptive and accurate job descriptions, but we’re not always perfect. If you’re interested in the role, **we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t feel like you meet everything we’re looking for**. We’re always iterating and improving, and it’s possible that your experience is even more impactful than we could have imagined. **About the role** At Hummingbird, we want to build better software to fight financial crime. Our engineering team is responsible for making that a reality. They dive deep into the problems that make financial crime fighting so difficult and design flexible, scalable solutions that empower our customers to catch bad actors. Our product sits at the intersection of financial technology, data science, security, policy, law enforcement, and design. As employees at a small startup, software engineers at Hummingbird have the opportunity to wear many hats and learn and grow across a multitude of dimensions. In this role, you'll help build the future of Transaction Monitoring at Hummingbird. You will improve a live, customer\-facing risk detection product while helping a small team solve challenging data\-processing, reliability, and scalability problems. Your engineering judgment will directly influence how the product evolves. **What you'll do:** * **Write code to fight financial crime:** First and foremost, our software engineers use their skills to serve our shared mission. You'll build easy\-to\-use tools that help our customers utilize data and leverage automations to identify and address suspicious activities. * **Build highly scalable, reliable monitoring products:** You’ll play an outsized role in evolving our transaction monitoring product, architecting the rule execution, enrichment, and data\-processing systems that let it scale through high data volumes and complex workflows. You’ll make it more reliable, faster, and easier to observe, so our customers can count on it every day. * **Tackle the challenges of working in a high\-security, high\-stakes environment:** We work with some of the most sensitive data you can imagine and provide a critical service to our customers. Security, reliability, and correctness must always come first. * **Partner cross functionally** with Product and Customer Success to solve real customer problems. * **Own work through design, delivery, and production.** **What we're looking for:** * **You’ve built and run data systems at scale.** You’ve designed, shipped, and operated large production data\-processing systems. * **You make pragmatic architecture decisions.** You know when to move fast and when to invest in reliability and maintainability, and you can explain the tradeoffs. * **You know the stack.** You’re fluent in SQL, comfortable with data pipelines, and have hands\-on experience with distributed systems. * **You work well with data science and ML.** You’ve worked closely with data scientists or ML specialists to turn models and insights into production systems. * **You own outcomes end to end.** You take work from a fuzzy problem to a production system and keep improving it after launch. * **You follow the problem across technologies.** You pick up new tools, languages, and domains when the work needs them. * **You build with the customer in mind.** You care how compliance teams actually use what you build, and that shapes your technical decisions. * **You take quality and security seriously.** Testing and secure design matter even more when customers rely on your systems to catch financial crime. * **Bonus:** Experience with fraud, AML, or transaction monitoring. **Technologies we use and teach:** * AWS, Azure, PostgreSQL, Redis * Terraform, CircleCI, Nix, Docker * Ruby/Rails, Python * OpenAI * React, JavaScript, TypeScript, GraphQL, d3 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please don't hesitate to contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description: IHG is seeking a **Director, Contact Center – Application \& AI Engineering**. In this role, you will own the software the service organization works in every day: *the agent desktop*, *supervisor and administrator experiences*, the *AI\-assist layer*, the shared micro\-frontend shell, and the API/BFF edge to core systems. You will also leverage your assembled experience from CCaaS and SaaS platforms, as well as carrier and messaging infrastructure, internal systems of record, and software this team writes. As our director, you will maintain and build \- composition coherent, fast, and changeable, holds a defensible build\-versus\-configure point of view based on architecture and total cost, and keeps low the cost of absorbing a new channel, AI capability, or personalization signal without a re\-platform. **Your Day to Day** * **Experience surfaces (build)** Own the roadmap, architecture, quality, and delivery for the agent desktop, supervisor console, administrative tooling, and AI\-assist experiences. Reduce handle time and cognitive load rather than adding another window. Own accessibility, performance budgets, and browser and device standards. * **Shared shell and edge (build)** Own the micro\-frontend shell: composition model, versioning, design system consumption, shared state, authentication session handling, and the contract that lets other teams ship into the shell. Own the API/BFF edge: aggregation, orchestration, caching, resilience, rate limiting, contract governance, and observability. Keep the shell and BFF as the seam where vendor\-specific behavior terminates and is normalized. * **Purchased solutions (evaluate, configure, integrate)** Lead technical evaluation of CCaaS and adjacent platforms across agentic and conversational AI, quality management and analytics, workforce management, real\-time agent assist, coaching, and messaging across SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and WeChat. Distinguish true partnership from stated integration capability, in writing. Own configuration, integration, upgrade, and lifecycle engineering, and the documented lock\-in and exit\-cost position ahead of contract decisions. * **AI engineering and governance** Deliver AI\-assist in production: retrieval and grounding, prompt and context engineering, summarization and disposition, next\-best\-action, and agentic workflows. Nothing ships without an evaluation harness, quality baseline, and rollback path. Own the human\-in\-the\-loop model and the technical controls behind Legal, Privacy, Security, and Risk policy. * **Data and integration foundation** Treat identity, profile, interaction history, and reservation context as a gating condition for personalization, available at the moment of contact with defined latency and completeness. Own integration contracts with core systems and escalate gaps that make committed outcomes undeliverable. * **Organization and delivery** Build and lead a multi\-disciplinary organization across frontend, backend/platform, integration, and applied AI. Establish CI/CD, environment strategy, test automation, release management, and progressive rollout. Own production reliability and on\-call, and technology spend with Finance and Procurement. * **Cross\-functional leadership** Serve as the primary engineering counterpart to Contact Center Operations. Represent the contact center technology position in architecture forums, vendor negotiations, and executive planning. Reduce silos through shared roadmaps, shared metrics, and joint intake. **What We Need from You** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degree beneficial but not required. * 10\+ years in software engineering, with 5\+ years leading teams and 2\+ years leading managers or team leads. Ownership of a production, business\-critical application portfolio with reliability accountability. Contact center, customer service, or comparable operational\-workforce technology, including hands\-on exposure to a major CCaaS platform. Track record of both building custom software and standing up purchased platforms, with the judgment to explain each call. Led technical vendor evaluation and participated in commercial negotiation. Delivered AI or ML into production with real users, not proof\-of\-concept only. Operated where long tenure and established process mean change requires bringing people along. * **Technical skills and knowledge** Modern frontend and micro\-frontend composition (module federation or equivalent, design systems, versioning across independently deployed surfaces); BFF and API design across REST, GraphQL, event\-driven and streaming patterns, contract governance, resilience and failure isolation; CCaaS architecture and interaction models, including routing, telephony and voice, digital and asynchronous messaging, presence and state, recording, and reporting data models; carrier and communications\-layer concepts including numbering, SIP, and messaging deliverability and compliance; applied AI engineering, including LLM integration, retrieval and grounding, prompt and context engineering, tool\-calling patterns, evaluation methodology, and latency and cost management; identity, access, and session management across composed applications; cloud, containerization, IaC, CI/CD, and modern observability; security, privacy, and regulatory considerations for guest data, payment data, and recorded interactions. * **Leadership capabilities** Communicates architecture and trade\-offs in business terms to non\-technical executives; decides and documents under incomplete information, distinguishing reversible from irreversible; builds credibility with operations leaders and frontline staff by understanding their work first; develops engineers and managers, and hires above the current bar. **Travel:** 10% **Location:** Our **hybrid work structure** is an expectation of **three (3\)** days a week in the **ATLANTA office**. This expectation may be adjusted with the changing needs of the business. \#LI\-ZY1 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today. **Important information**: * The salary range listed is the lowest to highest pay scale we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the pay range will be based on several factors, including relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics, and business or organizational needs. * No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until it is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or other form of compensation allocable to a particular employee remain in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. * EEO Is The Law \- click here for more information about Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity. * If you require reasonable accommodation during the application process, please click here. * IHG does not accept applications, inquiries, or unsolicited CVs/resumes from staffing or recruiting agencies. Please click here for our agency policy. * If you are a resident of or applying to a job opening in the State of Washington, please click here to read about applicable benefits. * For roles or applicants in San Francisco only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Lead Instrumentation Engineer, Data & Standards
jobs.description: **Your Job**INVISTA is seeking a **Lead Instrumentation Engineer, Data \& Standards** to provide technical leadership for capital projects and operating sites while advancing how instrumentation data is managed throughout the asset lifecycle. This role combines deep instrumentation knowledge with technical assurance, coaching and data stewardship. You will help engineers and project teams identify gaps, challenge technical deliverables and improve engineering standards and work processes while building a more complete, structured and valuable foundation of instrumentation data. The preferred location for this role is at one of our sites within the Greater Houston area with flexible schedule. Alternative office location option is at our Victoria, TX operating site. Travel of approximately 25% is expected, primarily to our Texas operating sites. **Our Team** This role is part of the Project Engineering \& Governance team. You will partner across engineering, capital projects, reliability and operating sites to provide instrumentation technical guidance and improve the quality and accessibility of engineering information. You will build relationships across these groups to understand existing information, identify gaps and develop scalable approaches that improve instrumentation engineering and data practices across multiple sites. **What You Will Do** * Provide instrumentation technical leadership for capital projects and operating sites, coaching engineers and independently reviewing engineering deliverables to identify risks, gaps and improvement opportunities. * Perform technical reviews of instrumentation specifications, instrument indexes, drawings, controls narratives and other engineering deliverables to ensure appropriate requirements are captured and technical gaps are addressed. * Own and improve the lifecycle management of instrumentation data, including engineering standards, work processes, data governance, critical metadata requirements and strategies for identifying and closing information gaps. * Establish functional requirements and stewardship practices for instrumentation data systems, supporting consistent project setup, contractor deliverables, data transfers and integration of information into structured systems of record. * Partner with engineering, project, reliability and site teams to understand existing instrumentation information, prioritize gaps and develop efficient approaches including field verification, bulk\-data methods and structured\-data workflows. * Establish and improve instrumentation engineering standards and work processes across multiple sites while identifying opportunities to use automation, analytics and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency. * Coordinate with project teams, contractors and specialized technical resources to support instrumentation deliverables, data\-quality improvements and effective project execution. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * 5 or more years of instrumentation engineering experience supporting operating facilities, capital projects, reliability initiatives, or a comparable industrial environment. * Experience supporting capital, reliability, or plant improvement projects, including knowledge of project phases, instrumentation engineering deliverables, and project execution requirements. * Experience reviewing and applying instrumentation specifications, instrument indexes, drawings, controls narratives and related engineering documentation. * Experience working with an instrument data management platform or structured instrumentation data. * Experience independently identifying technical or data\-quality gaps, developing solutions, prioritizing work and leading improvements across multiple stakeholders. * Travel up to 25% **What Will Put You Ahead** * 8 or more years of instrumentation engineering experience supporting capital projects, operating facilities or a comparable industrial environment. * Experience with Hexagon Smart Instrumentation (SPI/INtools), including functional stewardship, data standardization or project data integration. * Experience establishing instrumentation\-data governance, metadata standards or engineering information\-management practices. * Experience improving instrumentation data across multiple operating sites or converting legacy engineering information into structured data. * Experience with engineering document and data\-management systems such as Meridian. * Experience using bulk\-data techniques, analytics, automation or artificial intelligence to improve engineering\-data workflows. * Experience supporting reliability initiatives within an operating chemical, petrochemical, refining or other process\-manufacturing environment. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** INVISTA is a global manufacturer of chemical intermediates, polymers and fibers. From parts for the automotive industry to medical equipment, air bags, food packaging, carpet and clothing, our ingredients in the nylon 6,6 and polypropylene value chains help bring many of life's essential products to market. A subsidiary of Koch Industries since 2004, INVISTA is committed to innovation and responsibly creating more value for its customers and society while consuming fewer resources to make these products. See the bigger picture at INVISTA.com. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E\-Verify. Please click here for additional information. (For Illinois E\-Verify information click here , aquí , or tu ). \#LI\-SM1

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description: AI Engineer (AWS BedRock, LangChain, LangGraph, VectorDB, LLMs, MCP, Embedding, RAG)** **Position Overview:** We are looking for an experienced and motivated AI Engineer to join our team in building cutting\-edge applications powered by AI technologies. As a AI Engineer, you will work with LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) to create intelligent, scalable, and efficient AI\-driven applications. You will play a key role in integrating these advanced technologies into real\-world use cases, including text generation, knowledge retrieval, and recommendation systems. **Key Responsibilities:*** **LangChain Development:** Develop GenAI applications using LangChain, including building chains, agents, and integrations for a variety of use cases. * **LangGraph Development:** Utilize LangGraph for building workflow agents, controlling states, and developing intelligent decision\-making systems. * **Vector Database Integration:** Design, implement, and maintain vector database solutions (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, FAISS) for efficient storage and retrieval of embeddings. * **LLM Integration:** Leverage LLMs to generate high\-quality outputs for various use cases, such as conversational agents, document summarization, or content generation. * **Embedding Building:** Develop embeddings for text, images, and other media to integrate into retrieval systems and enhance search relevance and accuracy. * **RAG Implementation:** Design and implement RAG workflows to improve accuracy and context in AI applications by combining real\-time retrieval with language model generation. * **MCP Integration:** Work with the Microsoft Cognitive Platform (MCP) for AI and cognitive services, integrating them with LangChain and LangGraph for enhanced capabilities. * **Optimization \& Fine\-Tuning:** Continuously optimize AI models, embeddings, and retrievers for performance and efficiency. * **Collaboration \& Problem\-Solving:** Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineers to understand business needs and deliver AI\-driven solutions. **Required Skills \& Qualifications:****Technical Skills:*** **Model Selection \& Evaluation:** Compares foundation models (such as Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Llama, and Mistral) for latency, accuracy, and cost, using model evaluation and prompt routing. * **RAG \& Knowledge Bases:** Connects foundation models to enterprise data sources and vector stores via Bedrock Knowledge Bases for grounded responses. * **Agent \& Workflow Engineering:** Builds multi\-step workflows and agents using Bedrock Agents, Bedrock AgentCore, and AWS services like Lambda, API Gateway, and Step Functions. * **Safety, Governance \& Optimization:** Configures Bedrock Guardrails, IAM permissions, logging, prompt caching, and model distillation for production reliability and cost control. * **LangChain**: Hands\-on experience with LangChain for developing intelligent workflows, managing chains, and leveraging its powerful capabilities for building GenAI applications. * **LangGraph**: Proficiency in LangGraph for designing advanced workflows and agents with state management, decision\-making, and loops. * **Vector Databases (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, FAISS)**: Experience working with vector databases to manage and search embeddings, and optimize large\-scale retrieval tasks. * **Large Language Models (LLMs)**: In\-depth understanding of LLMs, such as GPT, BERT, and other transformer\-based architectures, and how to integrate them into GenAI applications. * **Embedding Creation and Integration**: Expertise in building embeddings using models like sentence\-BERT, OpenAI embeddings, or custom models for a variety of data types (text, images, etc.). * **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Proven experience in designing and implementing RAG systems that combine real\-time retrieval with language model generation. * **Microsoft Cognitive Platform (MCP)**: Familiarity with integrating Microsoft Cognitive Services, such as Azure Cognitive Search, Azure OpenAI, or other Microsoft AI tools, into GenAI applications. * **Model Context Protocol (MCP) \- Building or exposing Resources , Prompts , tools to LLM based AI Agents .** * **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**: Strong understanding of NLP techniques, including text classification, entity recognition, sentiment analysis, and text summarization. * **AI Model Optimization**: Experience in model fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, and optimizing LLMs for specific tasks. * **APIs \& Microservices**: Familiarity with designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and microservice architecture for scalable AI solutions. **Additional Skills:*** **Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)**: Experience deploying GenAI applications on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, with an emphasis on cloud\-based AI solutions. * **Machine Learning Frameworks**: Knowledge of popular ML frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face, and how to use them for model training and inference. * **Data Engineering**: Strong skills in handling large datasets, including data preprocessing, data cleaning, and data augmentation, to support AI model training. * **Version Control**: Proficiency with Git and GitHub for version control, collaborative development, and code review processes. * **Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Thinking**: Excellent problem\-solving skills with a strong analytical mindset to break down complex AI challenges into manageable components. * **Collaboration \& Communication**: Strong teamwork and communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams and deliver high\-impact solutions. **Preferred Qualifications:*** **Advanced Degree**: A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field. * **GenAI Application Development**: Experience in building AI\-driven applications or platforms with a focus on generative models, search systems, and conversational AI. * **Familiarity with LlamaIndex, FAISS, or Similar Tools**: Knowledge of popular vector search tools and libraries beyond LangChain and LangGraph is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary / Objective** As a Sr. Software Engineer at name.com, you will be a key member of our team, a dependable and responsible performer who takes on increasing responsibilities across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). In this role, you tackle diverse and complex challenges, applying expert\-level coding, design, and development skills to lead innovative, large\-scale projects within your Scrum team. Trusted for your sound judgment and technical expertise, you contribute to evolving technology choices, best practices, and processes while partnering with Product Management and other teams to deliver holistic solutions. This role reports to the Manager, Software Engineer. **What You'll Do** * Design, research, and implement technical solutions to meet business requirements * Drive the evolution of our technical strategy, best practices, and technology stack by researching, proposing, and implementing new solutions * Mentor and guide junior engineers, and multiply the team's effectiveness through code reviews, technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment * Provide technical leadership by anticipating challenges, making key architectural and design decisions, and shaping the direction of large\-scale projects and services * Listen to and guide technical debates to help the team reach a consensus, then clearly communicate and back that decision * Lead the end\-to\-end state serialization is preferred * Experience in migrating legacy frontend or backend codebases to Laravel/Vue.js is a plus * Broad professional experience with SQL databases (e.g., MySQL) * Extensive experience in designing and building secure RESTful APIs * Understanding of DevOps practices and tools, including CI/CD and containerization, is a strong asset * A mindset of automation and a desire of clarity, inconsistencies, technical limitations) to help course\-correct * Ability to travel as needed * Ability to work across time zones as part of a global organization as needed * Reliable transportation to the workplace **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times **Salary Range** The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is $122,000 \- $160,000 plus benefits as described below. In addition, the successful candidate will be eligible to receive other compensation from time to time in the form of discretionary and/or nondiscretionary bonuses and long\-term incentive plan. Actual compensation will be influenced by a candidate’s qualifications, internal employee equity considerations, and location. We will not ask for information about a candidate’s current or past compensation for purposes of developing an offer of employment. US team members (and their spouses, domestic partners, and/or dependent children) are covered by generously subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance which includes company contributions to a Health Savings Accounts. In addition, team members can enroll in the company’s 401(k) plan with up to a 5% match. You receive 15 days of paid vacation yearly, increasing to 20 days after one year. Additionally, you get 5 days of paid sick leave, 13 paid holidays, and 20 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents, 12 weeks for others. Also, there’s an opportunity for tuition reimbursement for qualifying expenses. While we strive to support our candidates, not all roles will qualify. Eligibility will be reviewed on a case\-by\-case basis. **Accommodation Statement** We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Name.com/Identity Digital will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact our Recruiting Team at careers@identity.digital.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Container Security
jobs.description: **Onwards Together!** --------------------- Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi\-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters. Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running. **Location:** **5 on\-site days a week in Sunnyvale, CA Headquarters.** **Our Team's Vision:** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- At Illumio, our engineering team thrives on visionary leadership, customer\-centric innovation, and relentless execution. We tackle the most critical and complex challenge in modern cybersecurity: stopping malicious actors and containing cyber threats before lateral movement turns an attack into a widespread business catastrophe. As an engineer here, you will design, build, and optimize massively scalable distributed systems that power the future of zero trust, segmentation, and automated breach containment. Working across a high\-performance stack—from operating system internals to highly available multi\-cloud scaling and immersive data visualizations—you will solve complex networking, massive real\-time telemetry processing challenges. If you are eager to conquer deep systems\-level problems, build fault\-tolerant software at a massive scale, and create a safer digital future for the world’s largest enterprises, join our mission and engineer the defense systems of tomorrow. **Your Impact:** ---------------- * You will build a new, unprecedented way to orchestrate Zero Trust Segmentation down to the application / pod level, identifying easily blocking pathways of attacks in the container ecosystem * You will understand and enhance modern container platforms such as Kubernetes, Istio, OpenShift, AKS, EKS, GKE etc. * You will have the opportunity to own and design critical features and subsystems, work out all the details, and defend the design before your peers. * You will deliver a rock\-solid implementation that is elegant, simple, scalable, stable, secure, and supportable. Our product protects the critical infrastructure of large enterprises. It must work. * You will also mentor junior engineers, new\-grads, and interns to help them grow as engineers and become productive members of the team. * You will have the opportunity to work with the field organization and key customers to shape this novel product. **Your Toolkit:** ----------------- * Bachelor’s in computer science or equivalent degree. Master’s degree a plus * 5\+ years building distributed \& scalable software systems. * Proficient in at least one higher\-level language such as Go, Python , Java, etc. * Experience building large, distributed, and scalable software systems. * Familiarity with, and passion for Kubernetes and related technologies. * Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, networking concepts, and debugging skills. * Experience with networking and security controls is a plus * General TCP/IP networking knowledge * Unix/Linux programming environment experience \#LI\-KD1 \#LI\-ONSITE **Our Commitment** Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success. *All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E\-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third\-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.* *For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* Compensation Range: $172K \- $198K

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Great Purpose. Great People. Great Opportunities.** **At Imagine Learning, we Empower Potential** \- in students, educators, and each other. As the leading provider of digital\-first K–12 curriculum solutions, we’re committed to igniting learning breakthroughs that spark curiosity, creativity, and confidence. Every day, our team designs innovative tools that help educators personalize instruction and engage students in meaningful ways. We’re shaping the future of learning through our **Curriculum\-Informed AI™** approach \- technology that understands instructional context, respects educator judgment, and transforms how teachers personalize learning at scale to unlock each student’s potential. Together, we’re reimagining what’s possible and **transforming education**. That same spirit of innovation and purpose drives our team culture. At Imagine Learning, you’ll find opportunities for meaningful work, continuous growth, and connection with passionate colleagues who care deeply about making a difference. jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. As a Machine Learning Engineering Manager, you will onboard and oversee junior scientists and technical leads, partnering closely with Product, Software Engineering, and UX teams. Your focus will include developing and innovating machine learning ecosystems that upgrade job seeker journey experience end to end. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Coach Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists on the Journey team to improve their performance, advise them on their career direction, and develop their qualifications. * Work to understand, prioritize, and plan the team’s work items without external guidance. * Ensure delivery of machine learning solutions, set expectations for what can be done and by when, and prioritize incoming projects. * Improve existing Agile, ML, and A/B testing processes and develop new ones. * Scope projects, gather and improve on requirements, and delegate work effectively. * Partner with and provide project direction and feedback to cross\-functional peers, including Product Managers, Software Engineers. * Remove roadblocks and give individual contributors autonomy and ownership. * Brainstorm with teammates about practical experimental design, navigating production codebases, and model development. * Be prepared to closely engage and contribute directly to implementation when necessary. **Skills/Competencies** ----------------------- * Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field and a minimum of 8 years of related experience; or a Master’s degree with a minimum of 6 years of experience; or a PhD with a minimum of 3 years experience * Demonstrated achievement as a Manager in Machine Learning Engineering, overseeing teams of 3 or more, and addressing intricate, large\-scale problems * Well\-versed in coding (Python, Java, Go, or C\+\+) and experience with SQL Databases like Presto, and data processing frameworks like Spark * Have full\-stack experience in data collection, aggregation, analysis, visualization, productionisation, and monitoring * Highly effective in coaching Machine Learning Engineers, facilitating qualification enhancement, and fostering career development **Salary Range Transparency** ----------------------------- Tier 1 \- United States of America 163,000 \- 245,000 USD per year Tier 2 \- United States of America 182,000 \- 272,000 USD per year Tier 3 \- United States of America 199,000 \- 299,000 USD per year Tier 4 \- United States of America N/A Tier 5 \- United States of America 227,000 \- 341,000 USD per year**Salary Range Disclaimer** --------------------------- The salary range for this role reflects the minimum and maximum compensation for the role. jobs.title: Information Security Engineer - Principal
jobs.description: Established in 2021, **Independence Pet Holdings** is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America. We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well\-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi\-brand and omni\-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands. **Position Summary** * We are seeking a talented and experienced Lead Cybersecurity Engineer to join the North America Information Security team, reporting directly to the Director of Security Engineering. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role focused on implementing, configuring, optimizing, and governing security solutions across cloud and legacy environments. * The successful candidate will help support a unified enterprise security model, including the continued transformation of legacy environments into target\-state security capabilities. The role requires strong Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security experience, practical engineering judgment, clear communication, and the ability to work across Security Engineering, Security Operations, GRC, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, application, and business teams. * This role is expected to solve complex technical problems, drive disciplined remediation, produce clear documentation and evidence, and provide quality review and escalation support for repeatable work performed by offshore or managed\-service partners. **Job Description** * Collaborate with the Security Engineering team to implement, configure, and enforce security solutions across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, identity, application, and legacy environments. * Align engineering work to enterprise security architectures, CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft security baselines, internal security policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. * Manage, configure, and optimize security platforms such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, threat intelligence, cloud security, endpoint protection, email security, data protection, encryption, and vulnerability management tools. * Develop practical automations, integrations, dashboards, and recurring reports that improve visibility, reduce manual effort, and strengthen response efficiency. * Implement and improve Microsoft security technologies such as Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft XDR, Sentinel, Purview, Entra ID, and related Azure and Microsoft 365 security capabilities. * Manage the security of collaboration and email platforms, including proper data governance, secure configuration, monitoring, and data loss prevention support. * Support endpoint and cloud workload protection activities, including baseline enforcement, exposure review, policy tuning, and technical validation of control effectiveness. * Manage vulnerability scanning and exposure\-management activities across applications, systems, endpoints, servers, cloud workloads, and supporting infrastructure. * Validate findings, assess exploitability and business context, coordinate remediation with IT and application owners, and ensure evidence is sufficient for closure. * Drive timely remediation of critical and high\-risk findings, including coordination of emergency changes, temporary mitigations, validation testing, and escalation when deadlines or risk tolerance are at issue. * Maintain clear remediation documentation, including affected assets, owners, remediation plans, dependencies, exceptions, validation results, and recurring problem patterns. * Collaborate with DevOps, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, and product teams to integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows. * Promote DevSecOps practices, secure configuration, secure coding awareness, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation in the development lifecycle. * Contribute to disaster recovery and operational resilience procedures to ensure security controls support business continuity, compliance, and incident readiness. * Support identity and access security initiatives involving Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, just\-in\-time access, Entra ID, Active Directory, Ping Identity, and related IAM or CIAM platforms. * Support regulatory and audit readiness efforts by implementing controls, collecting technical evidence, explaining engineering decisions, and remediating control gaps. * Participate in assessments and continuous improvement activities to define, measure, visualize, and improve key cybersecurity metrics. * Serve as a trusted advisor to security, development, infrastructure, cloud, and business teams on complex security issues and risk mitigation strategies. * Provide technical guidance, quality review, and escalation sup ifying, owning, and resolving problems through closure. **Preferred Qualifications** * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CEH, GIAC, or comparable practitioner\-level credentials. * Microsoft security certifications such as SC\-100, SC\-200, SC\-300, AZ\-500, MS\-102, AZ\-104, or Security\+ are preferred. * Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other compliance\-heavy environments. * Experience supporting multi\-brand, multi\-entity, acquisition, or legacy\-to\-target\-state security transformation environments. * Experience reviewing, guiding, or quality\-checking work from offshore teams, managed\-service providers, or cross\-functional delivery partners. * Experience building dashboards, runbooks, standard operating procedures, technical control narratives, or remediation playbooks. **Technical Skills and Tools** * **Microsoft Security:** Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft XDR, Sentinel, Purview, Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Azure security posture, and Microsoft 365 security architecture. * **Cloud and Infrastructure Security:** Azure security architecture, cloud workload protection, network security fundamentals, secure configuration, hybrid environments, and AWS/GCP awareness as a plus. * **Vulnerability and Exposure Management**: Scanning, validation, exploitability analysis, remediation coordination, patching, exception awareness, evidence collection, and reporting. * **Endpoint, Email, and Data Protection**: Endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, email security, DLP, encryption, data governance, collaboration security, and secure baseline enforcement. * **SIEM, Detection, and Automation**: Sentinel or comparable SIEM experience, alert enrichment, query logic, dashboarding, reporting, scripting, automation, and integration of security tooling. * **DevSecOps and Application Security**: CI/CD security, secrets handling, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation in development workflows, and practical secure coding awareness. * **IAM / CIAM**: Entra ID, Active Directory, Ping Identity or comparable platforms, MFA, SSO, Conditional Access, PIM, RBAC, JIT access, and least\-privilege control design. * **Documentation and Metrics**: Diagrams, data flows, procedures, runbooks, control evidence, remediation plans, dashboard interpretation, and executive\-ready status summaries. Compensation Base pay range: $170,000 – $220,000 per year. This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job\-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes the benefits listed below. All of our jobs come with great benefits including healthcare, parental leave and opportunities for career advancements. Some offerings are dependent upon the location of where you work and can include the following: * Comprehensive full medical, dental and vision Insurance * Basic Life Insurance at no cost to the employee * Company paid short\-term and long\-term disability * 12 weeks of 100% paid Parental Leave * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Retirement savings plan * Personal Paid Time Off * Paid holidays and company\-wide Wellness Day off * Paid time off to volunteer at nonprofit organizations * Pet friendly office environment * Commuter Benefits * Group Pet Insurance * On the job training and skills development * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Interview Technology Notice: Please note that phone and video interviews or screenings may be recorded and transcribed using interview technology to support our recruitment process. By continuing with the interview, you consent to this use. Text Messaging Notice: If you provide a mobile phone number, you may receive job\-related communications via text message. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of text communications at any time by replying “STOP.”

jobs.title: AI-Native Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Zensar Technologies** Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track\-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform. https://www.zensar.com **Working at Zensar** Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees. **Role Description** We are looking for a full\-stack, AI\-native software engineer to build capabilities that will help secure the products of today and the AI\-built, agent\-operated systems of tomorrow. Your technical leadership will be vital in solving some key challenges ahead of us, whether it's architecting an always\-on API platform that scales to our enterprise, modernizing legacy applications and monolithic architectures that predate how fast code and risk move today, or prototyping how security keeps pace as AI reshapes the way software gets built. Resource You will collaborate with leadership and engineers equally to put in place an execution plan, using agile methodologies, to develop/test/deploy/support industry\-leading services for our customers. Location USA – Remote. **Who You Are** * You've made the shift from being an experienced, effective software engineer to being an AI\-native one: * You have proven experience serving as a software engineer for development of web application projects for enterprises supporting 10K\+ customers. * You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact. * You know when to build and when to buy — you can justify choosing a custom\-built solution over an off\-the\-shelf or cloud\-native service. * You possess a deep understanding of API and service design, including RESTful and event\-driven patterns, designed with the caller in mind — a frontend, another service, or an AI agent invoking your API as a tool. * You are decisive without being divisive — you can analytically and logically pick from solutions and drive forward. * You have proven ability to balance multiple priorities and participate in decision\-making that spans organizational boundaries. * You have excellent communication and organization skills. * AI\-assisted development is your default way of working, not an occasional convenience — you use agentic coding tools as a core part of how you plan, build, and test software. * You can read AI\-generated code critically and catch what it gets wrong — a subtle bug, a security gap, a design choice that won't hold up at scale. * You think in systems: given an ambiguous problem, you can break it down, weigh real trade\-offs, and reason about where a design will break under load or misuse. * You use spec\-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software. * You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind. **Minimum Qualifications** * Demonstrated fluency in leveraging AI technologies across the entire software development lifecycle, including breaking down user stories into actionable tasks, AI\-assisted coding and testing, automated defect resolution, and deployment of fully tested software. * Server\-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client\-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies. * Expertise in building secure, large\-scale systems using fault\-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB \& Kafka); experience with building and deploying with cloud\-native technologies. * CISSP/CCSP or similar certification useful. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or a related field. Zensar values your privacy. We’ll use your data in accordance with our privacy statement located at: https://zensar.com/privacy\-notice **Indigo Slate is a full\-service human experience company.** We are a digital organization backed by a global engineering leader, and we’re dedicated to helping clients build transformative experiences from start to finish. We create smart experiences that deliver powerful results through a profound intersection of marketing, technology, business, and creative. We understand that brands are no longer judged through their advertising, but through each touchpoint, both internal and external, building strength with every experience. At Indigo Slate, we harness a mix of skills unique in our industry—equal parts strategic consultancy, creative agency, and technology thought leadership—to build and run some of the best experiences on the planet. jobs.title: Director, AI Engineer - Data ML Platform
jobs.description: Posted Date 11/19/2026 Description Director, AI Engineer \- Data ML Platform At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI at scale, and where it matters most. How well our sequential models perform depends on the data they learn from, and on how fast we can turn a question about that data into an answer. We’re hiring a Director of AI Engineering to lead the engineering behind that data. That means building the pipelines and systems that bring new data sources in, turn them into model\-ready representations at scale, and let our scientists test a data hypothesis in days instead of months. . **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio\-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline * Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks * Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness * Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards **The Ideal Candidate:** * We’re looking for an engineering leader who thrives embedded in science and research teams. You work side by side with scientists, help shape experiments from the start, and turn research ideas into data systems quickly, without waiting for a handoff. * You design infrastructure that is reliable, reproducible, and versioned, so every experiment can be traced back to exactly the data it used. You know when to harden a pipeline and when to keep it fast and disposable. * You’ll lead a team of engineers who work the same way, partnering closely with our science leadership, but your edge is leverage: knowing which engineering investments will speed up the whole research loop, and delivering them. * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowerin livering multiple enterprise products or capabilities concurrently * Proven ability to expand and execute long\-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks * Experience establishing cross\-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews) * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $269,100 \- $307,200 for Director, AI Engineer McLean, VA: $269,100 \- $307,200 for Director, AI Engineer New York, NY: $293,600 \- $335,100 for Director, AI Engineer San Francisco, CA: $293,600 \- $335,100 for Director, AI Engineer San Jose, CA: $293,600 \- $335,100 for Director, AI Engineer Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please.
