jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Sr. AI Software Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department, and has no direct reports. Be a part of a growing team that is directly impacting the way our business operates. In this role you embed with business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering. You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier agent systems where an orchestration layer routes to specialized agents with scoped tools, defined boundaries, and a clean handoff to a human. * Integrate with business systems through approved connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $100,200\-$140,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed; we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application. *Our office locations are designed to bring people together, foster collaboration, and build meaningful connections. While some roles are aligned to a specific office location, work arrangements and role locations may change over time to support business and team needs. Relocation assistance is not provided, whether for the initial move or for future changes in work location or role.* **Remote Eligibility:** At the time of hire, candidates for remote positions must reside in one of the following states: AL, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NJ, NV, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer (New York City)
jobs.description: We're looking for a hands\-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems. We're taking a different approach to Customer Success. Rather than primarily coaching customers on how to use Insycle, our team works directly in their environments to investigate problems, build solutions, and deliver results. Think of it as Customer Success with a Forward Deployed Engineer mindset. With our secure Support Access, you'll be able to configure and test solutions directly in customers' Insycle environments. Customers retain control over approving and executing changes to their CRM data. You'll own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, ongoing adoption, renewals, and expansion. You'll build relationships, understand customers' business challenges, and help them get lasting value from Insycle. This role combines hands\-on technical problem\-solving with customer relationships and business understanding. You'll have the autonomy to investigate challenges, design practical solutions, and see your work make a difference. **Location:** Hybrid, New York City. We're looking for candidates based in the NYC metropolitan area who can work from our New York office and collaborate effectively with our team and customers during U.S. business hours. Requirements: * **Relevant experience:** You have 3\+ years of experience in technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, RevOps, or a similar customer\-facing B2B SaaS role. * **Customer account ownership:** You have experience directly managing ongoing customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts, taking responsibility for customer outcomes, adoption, and retention—not solely responding to technical support requests. * **Technical problem\-solving:** You enjoy investigating complex problems, working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions. * **CRM and data experience:** You're comfortable with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms, including data management, business rules, workflows, and automation. * **Ownership and initiative:** You work independently, take responsibility for outcomes, and follow through without needing constant direction. * **Customer communication:** You can explain technical concepts clearly, understand business needs, and build strong customer relationships. * **Judgment and attention to detail:** You think through consequences, validate your work, and favor simple, reliable solutions. * **Teamwork and growth:** You enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, learning from feedback, and helping the team improve. Experience with CRM data quality, deduplication, data transformation, record matching, or integrations is a plus. Software development experience is not required. What you’ll do: #### **Solve customer data challenges** * Understand customers' business goals and translate their requirements into practical data solutions. * Investigate CRM records, fields, workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes. * Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf. * Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results. * Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved. #### **Drive adoption and customer outcomes** * Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly. * Help customers move from one\-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability. * Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases. * Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle. #### **Build relationships and grow accounts** * Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion. * Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through. * Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes. * Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk. * Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth. #### **Improve how we work** * Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems. * Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience. * Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results. * Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective. Why join Insycle: You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help. We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth. How we work: Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team: * **Care deeply:** Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed. * **Everyone builds:** Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions. * **Better together:** Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success. * **Quality counts:** Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results. * **Positive energy:** Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges. * **Own the outcome:** Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results. * **Choose simplicity:** Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity. * **Raise the bar:** Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve. Compensation and benefits: * Annual base salary of $90,000 \- $120,000, depending on relevant experience and location. * Annual performance\-based bonus with a target of 10% of base salary. * Equity through stock options. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with a 4% company contribution. * Paid time off, sick leave, flexibility for unexpected needs, and paid holidays. Company Overview: Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce. Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system. Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time. As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards. We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes. * Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf. * Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results. * Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved. #### **Drive adoption and customer outcomes** * Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly. * Help customers move from one\-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability. * Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases. * Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle. #### **Build relationships and grow accounts** * Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion. * Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through. * Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes. * Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk. * Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth. #### **Improve how we work** * Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems. * Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience. * Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results. * Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective. Why join Insycle: You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help. We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth. How we work: Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team: * **Care deeply:** Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed. * **Everyone builds:** Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions. * **Better together:** Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success. * **Quality counts:** Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results. * **Positive energy:** Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges. * **Own the outcome:** Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results. * **Choose simplicity:** Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity. * **Raise the bar:** Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve. Compensation and benefits: * Annual base salary of $80,000 \- $100,000, depending on relevant experience and location. * Annual performance\-based bonus with a target of 10% of base salary. * Equity through stock options. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with a 4% company contribution. * Paid time off, sick leave, flexibility for unexpected needs, and paid holidays. Company Overview: Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce. Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system. Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time. As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards. We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

jobs.title: Faculty Search in AI for Scientific Discovery in Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: The **Department of Mechanical Engineering** at **Johns Hopkins University** seeks applications for tenure\-track/tenured faculty positions focused on data science (DS) and artificial intelligence (AI) for scientific discovery in mechanical engineering. We seek scholars who combine expertise in mechanical engineering with the development of novel AI or machine learning methods, systems, or architectures to advance scientific discovery and engineering innovation. Areas of interest include mechanics of materials, fluid mechanics and thermal processes, biomechanics and mechanical engineering in biology and medicine, robotics and control, energy and the environment, nano/microscale science and engineering, space engineering, and other research areas represented in the department. We particularly welcome research that complements and expands the department's strengths and creates opportunities for collaboration with existing faculty. Johns Hopkins University has made a landmark investment in data science and artificial intelligence by establishing the **Johns Hopkins Data Science and AI Institute** (DSAI Institute). The Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University is adding 150 new faculty positions, including 30 Bloomberg Distinguished Professorships. A new half\-million\-square\-foot building is being constructed, and an unparalleled computational infrastructure is now operational. This expansion will establish Johns Hopkins as one of the largest and leading engineering schools with a top AI research program. Outstanding candidates at all academic ranks will be considered. The successful candidate will have a tenure home in the Department of Mechanical Engineering and an affiliation with the DSAI Institute. A joint appointment with another department is also possible. Faculty in the Department of Mechanical Engineering work with colleagues across Johns Hopkins on research in materials, fluids, robotics, energy, health, and space. They also contribute to the **Johns Hopkins Turbulence Databases** (JHTDB), which provide access to detailed flow simulation data, and the **Artificial Intelligence for Materials Design Laboratory** (AIMD\-L), which combines automated experimentation with AI to study and develop materials for extreme environments. jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: * **This role is based in Newport Beach, CA and candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance from the office.** Lancium is a Texas\-based energy technology and infrastructure company focused on developing and operating gigawatt\-scale AI data center campuses. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, we integrate grid interconnections, behind\-the\-meter generation, and energy storage to deliver the reliable, large\-scale power infrastructure required to support advanced AI workloads. As of August 2026, Lancium has approximately 4 GW of capacity under lease and a development pipeline exceeding 15 GW of powered land, positioning us as one of the largest power\-secured AI infrastructure platforms in North America. In August 2026, Lancium announced a $3 billion strategic investment and partnership with NVIDIA. Lancium is also backed by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners, Blackstone Multi\-Asset Investing, and Shell, reflecting strong institutional support for our vision of becoming a leading provider of AI infrastructure at scale. The rapid growth of artificial intelligence and the enormous energy demand it creates are defining forces of our time. Meeting that demand with reliable power, while integrating clean energy resources wherever possible, is central to this transformation. Lancium is at the epicenter, uniquely positioned to enable the next generation of AI infrastructure and the opportunities it will unlock. If you want to help shape this global transformation, read on! **What You Will Do** The DevSecOps Engineer designs, implements, and maintains secure infrastructure and automated software delivery processes for Lancium. Working with software development and IT teams, this role integrates security into the software development lifecycle, improves system reliability, and supports identity and endpoint security through Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure infrastructure and automated deployment processes. * Collaborate with software development teams to incorporate security, reliability, and operational requirements into application architecture and delivery workflows. * Identify and remediate weaknesses in infrastructure, applications, and security configurations; prioritize fixes based on risk and operational impact. * Monitor networks, servers, and applications for availability, capacity, performance, and security; troubleshoot issues and support incident response. * Conduct vulnerability assessments and risk analysis, coordinate remediation, and verify that corrective actions are effective. * Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines, including code, dependency, container, and secret scanning; maintain secure handling of deployment credentials. * Configure and maintain Microsoft Entra ID identity and access controls, including single sign\-on, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, and least\-privilege access. * Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune enrollment, device compliance, endpoint security, configuration, and application policies for Windows and macOS; align device compliance with Entra ID access policies. * Maintain infrastructure configurations and operational documentation in version control, and automate repeatable tasks using scripts and configuration management tools. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or at least three years of relevant DevSecOps experience supported by equivalent education and training. * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins, and integrating automated security checks. * Experience using network, server, and application monitoring tools to troubleshoot availability, performance, and security issues. * Experience administering Linux systems and automating infrastructure configuration with tools such as Ansible; familiarity with infrastructure as code. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, including access controls and secure infrastructure configuration. * Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash for scripting and automation, and experience with Git and version control workflows. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including enterprise applications, single sign\-on, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, and role\-based access control. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows and macOS device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, endpoint security policies, and application deployment; understanding of its integration with Entra ID. * Working knowledge of vulnerability management, secrets management, and least\-privilege access, with the ability to communicate risks and document technical procedures clearly. **What We Will Provide** * Our benefits and perks add to a total rewards experience for our employees that foster a supportive, flexible, and inclusive environment. Current full\-time employee benefit offerings include: * Employer\-subsidized health, dental, and vision benefits * $50,000 of basic term life insurance coverage paid for by Lancium, as well as 100% of short\-term disability premiums. Additionally, we provide options for additional life insurance coverage for employees, their spouses, and children. Employees also have the option to enroll in long\-term disability coverage (LTD) at their own expense. * Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Limited Purpose Flexible Spending Accounts, and Health Savings Accounts (with employer contribution; $400 employee only coverage, $700 for all other tiers of enrollment in our HDHP). * Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off * Paid parental leave * 11 paid holidays * Fidelity safe\-harbor 401(k) with 100% match up to 4%

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – AI & Business Applications
jobs.description: The Senior Software Engineer – AI \& Business Applications (Internally Titled: Senior Software Engineer)plays an important role in developing software and AI\-powered solutions that improve how teams work across Landscape Forms. Working directly with business partners, this position identifies operational challenges, translates needs into technical solutions, and independently designs, builds, deploys, and improves applications that create meaningful business value. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building production\-ready software, and applying artificial intelligence to real business challenges. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals, practical AI development experience, and the ability to take ownership of solutions from concept through implementation. **Who We Are** Landscape Forms is the industry leader in integrated solutions of high\-design site furniture and advanced LED lighting. For more than 50 years, we have produced site furnishings that help designers and other clients achieve beautiful, functional environments that enhance the experience of outdoor space. Our secret is simple: Design, Culture, and Craft drive everything we do. **What You Can Expect** Support, stability, and the opportunity to grow within a design\-driven, collaborative environment where technology and innovation help shape how we work. Landscape Forms takes pride in offering a competitive benefits package including, but not limited to, insurance benefits available your first day, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, wellness programs, quarterly profit\-sharing bonuses, and paid time off. **Location Expectations** This position is remote within the United States, with regular collaboration across business functions and technical teams. **How You Contribute** * + Partner directly with business teams to understand workflows, identify challenges, gather requirements, and translate business needs into practical software and AI\-powered solutions. * + Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain production\-ready applications, owning solutions from initial discovery through implementation and ongoing improvement. * + Build full\-stack and backend applications, including user interfaces, APIs, databases, and integrations that connect enterprise systems and structured or unstructured data. * + Develop, test, and deploy AI\-powered applications, intelligent agents, and automated workflows using large language models (LLMs), retrieval techniques, and tool integrations, with appropriate evaluation and safeguards. * + Rapidly prototype and validate solutions with users, evolve successful concepts into production, and measure adoption and operational impact to ensure meaningful business value. * + Implement secure application architecture, authentication, authorization, and data protection practices to ensure reliable and responsible solutions. * + Evaluate business challenges and recommend practical solutions, whether through traditional software, automation, or AI, considering performance, security, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. * + Troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve applications while sharing technical knowledge, establishing reusable development practices, and helping teams adopt new solutions. **What We're Looking For** * + Approximately 7\+ years of professional software development experience preferred, or equivalent demonstrated experience independently designing, building, and delivering complex production applications. Proven technical ownership and capability are more important than years of experience alone. * + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent education, training, or practical experience will be considered. * + Strong full\-stack or backend development experience using technologies such as C\#, .NET, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, including API development, system integrations, and SQL or NoSQL databases. * + Hands\-on experience developing AI\-powered applications or workflows, including integrating LLMs, AI services, or intelligent automation into functional software solutions. * + Demonstrated ability to independently manage software projects from requirements gathering and architecture through development, deployment, and ongoing support. * + Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, evaluate opportunities, and translate needs into effective technical solutions. * + Experience implementing authentication and authorization, including approaches such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or role\-based access controls, along with strong application and data security practices. * + Familiarity with cloud platforms, software testing, CI/CD, and production application monitoring, along with strong problem\-solving, communication, and organizational skills. **Additional Experience We'd Value** * + Experience with agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), semantic search, vector databases, AI evaluations, or frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. * + Experience with front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue, along with containerization, deployment automation, and application observability. * + Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI services, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Dataverse, or Power Platform. * + Experience integrating ERP, CRM, or other enterprise systems, particularly within manufacturing, operations, or supply chain environments. **Build Technology That Makes a Difference** If you're a software engineer who enjoys solving real business problems, building applications from the ground up, and exploring what's possible with AI, we'd welcome the opportunity to connect. At Landscape Forms, you'll have the opportunity to work across departments, collaborate with people who bring different perspectives and expertise, and develop technology that makes everyday work more effective. From modernizing business applications to creating intelligent workflows, your work will help shape how we innovate, collaborate, and grow.

jobs.title: Release Strategist, Professional Services
jobs.description: #### **About the Job:** Most companies don't have a "release problem" so much as a way\-of\-working problem. Shipping live functionality to their customers takes too long, depends on a few heroes, or happens with fingers crossed, and AI\-assisted development is raising the stakes. LaunchDarkly Professional Services is helping our most strategic customers change that, and we're hiring a Release Strategist to lead those engagements. As a Release Strategist on LaunchDarkly's Professional Services team, you are the "product manager" for each customer engagement, responsible for defining how that customer achieves release excellence by evolving their software and agentic release processes. You join the sales cycle early to define the problem and quantify what it's costing them, then own the engagement through delivery and adoption until the change sticks. You own the "why" and the "what"; our Solutions Architects, who serve as our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), own the "how." Day to day, you'll partner with a Solutions Architect on each engagement, combining their technical judgment with your view of the commercial context, customer priorities, and relationship dynamics. Neither of you can do the job alone. You own the problem, the value, the scope, and the success criteria; your Solutions Architect owns the technical approach and its quality. You'll also work closely with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers, and you'll lead without direct authority, so influence, clarity, and trust matter more than title. This is a new role, and its shape will flex and adapt as the business grows. Early on, expect to lean into scoping, delivery, and change leadership on both the pre\-sales and post\-sales side of the business. As we establish a feedback loop through customer delivery, you'll extend that product mindset from individual engagements to our offerings themselves, and help write the playbook for how we package engagements, measure success, and bring on the next Release Strategist. #### **Responsibilities:** * **Product \& Value** + Scope the problem and the value if solved: join sales cycles from early discovery, map the customer's organization and decision landscape, and quantify the business value of their release and delivery problem. + Define the customer engagement like a product: identify the business challenges and, with your Solutions Architect, the technical ones behind them; set the MVP or first phase, success criteria, and timeline; write the engagement plan (the outcomes, deliverables, and acceptance criteria the team delivers against); and shape the SOW with PS leadership so what we sell is what we can deliver. + Own scope and prioritization: decide what we do first and what we defer, manage scope as the engagement evolves, and continuously assess whether it still serves both the customer's outcomes and LaunchDarkly's interests, reshaping the plan when they diverge. + Own the outcome from go\-live, the point where the customer starts working the new way, through adoption: capture feedback, iterate, and prove the business value defined at the start. * **Change \& Adoption** + Facilitate discovery and design sessions mapping release processes and visualizing "who should get a feature and when" without the technology or process on how to accomplish it. Adapt or invent new collaborative practices when a customer's situation doesn't fit one we already use, to turn ambiguous goals into clear, owned success plans. + Lead and grow our change management practices: align customer teams on new ways of working, address resistance, and drive adoption so changes stick after the engagement ends. Scope the ongoing support plan and create the documentation and enablement the customer needs to sustain it. * **Executive \& Growth** + Act as a trusted advisor to VP and C\-level stakeholders: set expectations, present progress, risks, recommend data\-driven decisions, and drive decisions quickly. + Monitor account health and surface expansion or renewal signals; scope the next engagement as a natural outcome of delivered value. * **Offerings \& Playbook (grows as our FDE engagement volume does)** + Turn what you learn across engagements into a feedback loop for our offerings: capture patterns, help shape how we package engagements and measure success, and help write the playbook, including how we bring on future hires. * **Delivery \& Execution** + Run the delivery rhythm: status calls and reporting, accountability to tasks and deadlines across the engagement team, and escalation of technical or political blockers. + Keep a running view of budget/burn against SOW and flag over/under\-projection early; partner with PM\-type support (where it exists on an account) for detailed tracking and change\-order mechanics. * **Customer Landscape** + Our customers struggle with long lead times, risky deployments, feature flag sprawl, unclear ownership of releases, and a gap between what engineering ships and what the bu /renewal signals to Sales or AM; comfort with a role that may take on commercial ownership over time. + (Bonus) Experience operating in a scaling PS org where role boundaries are still being defined. **Travel** * Travel roughly once per quarter for customer workshops and team onsites; more frequent travel may be needed around specific engagements. **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for Level P4:* * Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* \- *$171,200**\- $235,400*\*\* * Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago \- $154,100* *\- $211,860*\*\* * Zone 3: *All other US locations \- $145,500* *\- $200,090\**\* *LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big\-bang" technology migrations. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by: * Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages * Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts * Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize * Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types * Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. ### **Description and Requirements** The Lenovo AI Technology Center (LATC)—Lenovo’s global AI Center of Excellence—is driving our transformation into an AI\-first organization. We are assembling a world\-class team of researchers, engineers, and innovators to position Lenovo and its customers at the forefront of the generational shift toward AI. Lenovo is one of the world’s leading computing companies, delivering products across the entire technology spectrum, spanning wearables, smartphones (Motorola), laptops (ThinkPad, Yoga), PCs, workstations, servers, and services/solutions. This unmatched breadth gives us a unique canvas for AI innovation, including the ability to rapidly deploy cutting\-edge foundation models and to enable flexible, hybrid\-cloud, and agentic computing across our full product portfolio. To this end, we are building the next wave of AI core technologies and platforms that leverage and evolve with the fast\-moving AI ecosystem, including novel model and agentic orchestration \& collaboration across mobile, edge, and cloud resources. This space is evolving fast and so are we. If you’re ready to shape AI at a truly global scale, with products that touch every corner of life and work, there’s no better time to join us. **The role** We are looking for a first\-line engineering manager to lead our US team. You will be responsible for the people: their growth, their careers and how well they work together. You will also bring enough technical depth to guide the work: review plans and results, help the team choose sound approaches, and keep quality high. The team works closely with colleagues across Lenovo's global organization, so you will be a key link between the US team and partners in other regions. This is a people\-leadership role first. Expect most of your time to go to managing, developing and supporting the team and to planning and delivery, with a meaningful share on technical direction and review. You will not be a primary individual contributor, but you should be comfortable reading code, interpreting experiment results and joining technical discussions as a peer. **Wh****at you will do** **Lead and grow the team** * Hold regular 1:1s with each team member; set clear goals and give timely, specific feedback. * Build an individual development plan with each person and support their growth through stretch assignments, mentoring, training and promotion readiness. * Run performance and talent reviews, compensation input and promotion cases with clear evidence. * Hire and onboard new team members; build a team that people want to stay on. * Notice and address workload, morale and collaboration issues early. **Plan and deliver** * Turn team priorities into clear workstreams with owners, milestones and success measures. * Track progress, surface risks early and remove blockers. * Balance commitments against capacity, including compute resources. * Work with program managers on planning, status and delivery. **Guide the technical work** * Review experiment designs, results and readiness of the team's work. * Help the team make sound technical choices, and know when to bring in deeper expertise. * Raise the bar on rigor: reproducible experiments, consistent tracking, fair evaluation and documented results. * Keep up with developments in the field and help the team judge what is worth adopting. **Collaborate globally** * Work day to day with colleagues and technical leads in other regions: align priorities, share work and keep joint projects moving across time zones. * Build strong working relationships across cultures and locations, and help the US team do the same. * Work with product and partner teams to deliver what they need. * Represent the team's work clearly to leadership and partner teams. **Minimum qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6\+ years in machine learning engineering or applied AI research, including hands\-on development of deep learning models. * 2\+ years leading people, as a people manager or as a technical lead with clear mentoring and coaching responsibilities. * Solid working knowledge of modern AI models, including large language models: how they are trained, adapted and evaluated. * Proficiency in Python and a major deep learning framework; able to read and review code and experiment results. * Clear written and spoken communication, including difficult performance and career conversations. * Flexibility to join occasional early\-morning or evening meetings with colleagues in other regions. **Preferred qualifications** * Master's or PhD in a relevant field. * Experience taking AI models from research to products. * Hands\-on experience in one or more areas of model development, such as training and fine\-tuning, model optimization and efficiency, generative models, data, or evaluation. * Experience with large\-scale training on shared compute. * Experience managing a mix of researchers and engineers, including early\-career engineers. * A track record of growing people into more senior roles. * Experience working with globally distributed teams across time zones and cultures. \#LATC *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.* **Additional Locations**: * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville * United States of America * United States of America \- North Carolina * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Staff Backend Engineer** LiteLLM is the world’s most popular open\-source AI Gateway, used by Adobe, Netflix, NASA, NVIDIA and much of the Fortune 500\. Every LLM call these companies make runs through our code, so when we break, they break. We’re a team of about 20, and we’re hiring senior and staff backend engineers to own the core of the gateway and keep it fast and reliable as traffic grows. **About the role** You’ll own critical parts of the LiteLLM proxy: routing, auth, caching, spend tracking, guardrails and observability. The job is to make these systems correct, fast and dependable at 1B\+ requests a month. That means hunting down silent failures, fixing the root cause in code rather than adding another dashboard, and refactoring components that keep breaking without changing how they behave. You’ll set the bar for how our mostly early\-career team writes, tests and ships backend code. **What you’ll do** * Own core proxy components end to end, from design through production, including the incidents * Find and remove whole classes of bugs, like race conditions, stale cache state across replicas, and errors that get silently swallowed instead of shown to users * Make sure every guardrail and policy check (e.g. apply\_guardrail) is logged, traceable and fails loudly when it should * Build guardrails that run inside the gateway and block common attacks on LLM APIs, MCP servers and agents * Keep our observability integrations (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) accurate at 1B\+ requests a month, with minimal latency overhead and no memory leaks (e.g. from Prometheus metric cardinality) * Help migrate performance\-critical paths from Python to Rust without breaking behavior * Raise the bar for the team on code review, testing and debugging **What we’re looking for** * 5\+ years building backend systems in production, with real ownership of something mission\-critical: payments, gateways, core APIs, data stores, or anything else where downtime hurts customers * Strong Python, and experience with async or high\-throughput services (asyncio, FastAPI or similar) * A track record of making production systems more reliable through code: refactors, re\-architectures, migrations, or fixing a root cause for good * An excellent debugger across services, databases (Postgres, Redis) and distributed systems * High ownership, meaning you take responsibility for the customer impact of what you ship * BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent proof you’re exceptional **Nice to have** * Rust, Go or C\+\+ in production * Time at a fast\-growing startup with a large, real codebase * Experience with LLM APIs, proxies or API gateways * Open\-source contributions **Why LiteLLM** * Your code runs in the critical path for some of the biggest companies in the world * Real ownership of core systems on a small, senior\-leaning team * Profitable, growing fast, backed by Kleiner Perkins * $250\-$350k base \+ equity, health, dental and vision. Onsite in San Francisco. **About LiteLLM** LiteLLM is a Python SDK and proxy server for calling 100\+ LLM APIs in the OpenAI format, with 60K\+ GitHub stars. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

jobs.description: Forward Deployed Engineer Team Lead/Consultant \| Mid\-Level \| Full time Job No. R00374051 \| Multiple Locations **We Are** Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Marketplace
jobs.description: **Innovate in Charlotte** Thank you for dedicating your time and talent to Lowe’s. We want to give you more opportunities to learn and grow, so if you find a position you’re interested in below, we encourage you to apply! **Your Impact** =============== Help shape the technology that powers Lowe’s Marketplace and expands what customers can discover and shop across Lowe’s digital experiences. This Lead Software Engineer will be a key technical leader within Marketplace, solving complex engineering challenges, strengthening platform reliability, and helping the team deliver capabilities that support a growing digital assortment. This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people\-management position. You’ll lead through technical expertise and influence: setting technical direction, making architecture and design decisions, unblocking complex problems, mentoring engineers, and driving delivery across a distributed U.S. and India team. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to troubleshoot, review code, and contribute hands\-on when the work calls for it. This team works in an AI\-enabled development environment, using tools such as Devin and Codex heavily in day\-to\-day engineering. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals and the judgment to evaluate, troubleshoot, improve, and take ownership of AI\-generated code rather than simply accepting its output. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Provide technical leadership for a six\-engineer Marketplace pod distributed across the U.S. and India, guiding technical execution without direct people\-management responsibility. * Set technical direction and provide architecture\-level guidance for complex enhancements, new features, and production issues across Marketplace systems. * Remain hands\-on as an engineer by contributing to delivery, reviewing solutions, troubleshooting issues, and stepping into code when needed. * Drive reliable engineering solutions that help Marketplace capabilities and product information move effectively through the ecosystem and reach Lowe’s customers. * Influence and align senior engineering managers, engineering and product directors, product managers, business leaders, and adjacent Marketplace teams to resolve issues and deliver outcomes. * Provide technical input during Agile ceremonies and help the team execute effectively within two\-week sprints. * reporting, and operational trends to proactively identify problems and improve system health. * Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar, and build shared technical ownership so the team can make strong decisions and solve problems without depending on a single person. * Bring forward new technical ideas and improvements that strengthen engineering execution, reliability, and Marketplace capabilities. **What You Bring** ================== * Demonstrated experience leading through technical influence, mentorship, architecture, and delivery ownership as a senior individual contributor; direct people\-management experience is not required. * Strong communication skills and the ability to align technical and non\-technical partners across teams, functions, and time zones. * Deep technical problem\-solving and solution\-design skills, with the ability to think at a solution\-architecture level when evaluating complex systems and tradeoffs. * Strong hands\-on backend engineering experience with Java and/or Kotlin. * Experience working with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. * Experience with CI/CD practices and modern software delivery. * Ability to diagnose production issues, assess impact, identify root causes, and guide teams toward durable solutions under pressure. * Strong engineering judgment when reviewing code, including the ability to evaluate correctness, efficiency, maintainability, and operational risk. * Experience working in Agile software development environments and guiding technical execution across sprint\-based delivery. **It's a Plus if You Have** =========================== * Experience building or supporting marketplace, e\-commerce, catalog, product\-data, or other large\-scale digital platforms. * Experience working with AI\-assisted or agentic software\-development tools and reviewing AI\-generated code in production engineering workflows. * Experience using observability, reporting, or operational data to identify trends and proactively improve system reliability. **Why Join Us?** ================ * **Impactful Work:** Shape the engineering behind Lowe’s Marketplace, helping expand the assortment customers can discover and shop while strengthening the reliability and capabilities that support its growth. * **Growth Opportunities:** Continuous learning with the latest tech trends and opportunities to explore new tools and frameworks. * **Collaborative Environment:** Work with smart, passionate people in a culture that values collaboration, inclusiveness, and innovation. * **Great Benefits:** Competitive salary, flexible working hours, health benefits, and career development programs. **Benefits** ============ * 401k with up to 4\.25% match * Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan (15% discount of strike price) * Tuition\-Free Education * 10\-week Maternity/Parental Leave * 10% Associate Discount * For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits **About Lowe’s** Lowe’s Companies, Inc. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,750 home improvement stores, 540 branches and 120 distribution centers. Lowe’s is a core value S\&P 500 equity stock and a dividend aristocrat. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com. *Lowe’s is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law.* Pay Range: $111,600\.00 \- $212,000\.00 annually Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities. At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter. This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today. **The Role** ------------ The Principal Software Development Engineer is a hands\-on technical architect responsible for designing, building, and supporting complex ServiceNow data and integration solutions. The role ensures ServiceNow has trusted customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, configuration\-item, install\-base, and sold\-product data required to support Enterprise and Public Sector customer\-service and ticketing workflows. This engineer translates business and architecture requirements into scalable ServiceNow data models, APIs, ingestion pipelines, and reusable integration patterns. The role works across ServiceNow, enterprise data platforms, API gateways, messaging platforms, databases, and cloud services, while providing technical leadership for data quality, integration reliability, security, and maintainability. **Location** ------------ This is a work from home position within the US. **The Main Responsibilities** ----------------------------- * Architect, design, build, and maintain ServiceNow foundational data and integrations for customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, configuration\-item, Install Base Item, and Sold Product data. * Govern ServiceNow CMDB\- and CSDM\-aligned data models, including CI classes and relationships, identification and reconciliation rules, source keys, normalization, deduplication, data quality, authoritative sources, source\-to\-target mappings, lineage, ownership, reconciliation, and sustainable target\-state interfaces. * Build scalable inbound, outbound, and bi\-directional integrations using Scripted REST APIs, REST Messages, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, Data Sources, Import Sets, Transform Maps, IRE APIs, JDBC, JSON, and scheduled or event\-driven processing. Connect ServiceNow and external ServiceNow instances with Palantir Foundry, Data Hubs/Databricks, Apigee, Kafka, databases, inventory platforms, and other enterprise systems through secure, reusable patterns. * Use complex SQL across enterprise systems and data platforms to profile data, identify authoritative records and relationships, verify completeness and quality, find duplicates and gaps, and determine foundational data for ServiceNow. Review production data flows and large data sets for record counts, duplicates, completeness, mappings, performance, pagination, batching, timeouts, and incremental\-load behavior. * Design and maintain ServiceNow eBonding and B2B integrations, including ticket or case synchronization, correlation identifiers, field and choice mappings, comments, attachments, priorities, authentication, customer onboarding, UAT, cutover, and production support. Develop secure API and connectivity patterns using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, client credentials, Application Registries, role\-based service accounts, secrets management, firewall rules, and access governance. * Establish integration observability, persistent processing records, error handling, retries, replay and recovery, dashboards, runbooks, and support procedures. Lead root\-cause analysis of complex issues across ServiceNow, APIs, MID Servers, data platforms, databases, authentication, networks, and upstream or downstream systems. * Provide technical leadership through architecture decisions, design and code reviews, production\-readiness assessments, mentoring, stakeholder workshops, solution documentation, and hands\-on delivery of the most complex work. Ensure development, test, and production solutions meet enterprise security, data governance, compliance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability standards. **What We Look For in a Candidate** ----------------------------------- * 10\+ years in software engineering, enterprise integration, data engineering, or solution architecture, including 7\+ years delivering advanced ServiceNow development and integrations. jobs.title: Senior AI-Native Software Engineer, Product R&D
jobs.description: #### **About the Role** We partner with global enterprises to design and build the products and platforms at the center of their business. This engagement is a new research and development (R\&D) team inside a major US healthcare organization. It runs like a set of small startups: intentionally small, hands\-on, and accountable for shipping real products that real customers use, with access to customers, data, and scale already in place. We are looking for senior\-level engineers who are, above all, strong problem solvers. You will take loosely defined problems, figure out what is worth building, and build it end to end, from first prototype to production. This is an AI\-native team: engineers build with AI coding agents by default, and technology choices are guided by what large language models (LLMs) handle best. We want software engineers first, with deep fundamentals and broad range, who will raise the level of the team around them. #### **What You'll Do** * Take ambiguous problems from idea to production, deciding what to build, prototyping quickly, and shipping what proves its value. * Build customer\-facing products end to end: front end, back end, data, and deployment. * Partner directly with product leaders to understand the problem, the users, and the reasoning behind each product decision, and make sound prioritization decisions without a dedicated product manager. * Use AI coding agents such as Codex or Claude Code to move faster, and help your teammates get more out of them. * Build LLM\-powered features where they add real value, and measure how well they perform in production. * Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed, learning, and durability. * Build platform components the whole team can reuse to deliver the next product faster. * Own what you build in production: deploy it through CI/CD (continuous integration and delivery), monitor it, and keep it reliable for the people who use it. * Help shape how the team works as it grows, from engineering practices to the hiring bar. #### **What We're Looking For** * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including senior\-level ownership of products in production. * An exceptional problem solver who can break down vague, open\-ended problems and find a practical path to a working product. * A full\-stack generalist who has worked across front end, back end, and data, and has moved comfortably between languages, frameworks, and problem domains. Breadth matters more to us than deep specialization in a single stack. * A fast learner who picks up new languages and tools as the work requires. We are not hiring for a specific tech stack; adaptability matters more. * A track record of building products that reached real users, especially new applications where you personally owned the outcome. * A daily user of AI coding agents, with sound judgment about their strengths and limitations. * Solid engineering fundamentals: you can solve the problem yourself, which is what lets you direct AI agents and judge what they produce. * Product judgment: you can weigh business value, user need, and engineering cost, and decide what to build first. * Production experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Docker, CI/CD, and monitoring, including work on large\-scale systems. * A collaborator who works well with people outside engineering and has shaped technical direction beyond your own team. * At home in a small, startup\-style team where everyone owns outcomes end to end. * Fluent English, both written and spoken. * Healthcare experience is not required. #### **Nice to Have** * Experience shipping LLM\-powered or agentic features in a production product. * Experience building products in an R\&D, innovation, or startup environment. * Flexibility to travel occasionally if needed. #### **Why Lumenalta is an amazing place to work at** At Lumenalta, you can expect that you will: * Be 100% dedicated to one project at a time so that you can innovate and grow. * Be a part of a team of talented and friendly senior\-level engineers. * Work on projects that allow you to use leading tech. #### **Location** This role is remote within the United States only. Candidates must reside in the United States while assigned to our client and be physically located within the United States when performing project work or accessing project systems or data. Availability to work overlapping Pacific, Central, or Eastern U.S. time zones. Travel is not required, but flexibility for occasional travel is a plus. #### **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted until **December 6th, 2026**. Candidates can expect feedback by **December 14th, 2026**.
