jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About MBC** MBC Holdings of Ohio is a family owned construction group based in Archbold, Ohio, in its third generation of leadership. Three operating companies sit under it. Miller Bros. Const., Inc.: heavy civil construction, founded in 1944, self performing site work for private and public owners across 12 licensed states. Cardinal Aggregates: a limestone quarry with its own trucking fleet, producing over a million tons a year. Black Swamp Steel, Inc.: rebar and structural steel erection, based in Holland, Ohio. Together that is roughly 750 people, a large owned equipment fleet, and 3 businesses that measure success differently: job cost, tons and yield, and crew productivity. **Summery:** Each of our companies runs on its own systems: an ERP on IBM i, HCSS for operations, Samsara for equipment, BambooHR for people, SQL Server behind custom applications. Those systems grew up separately. This role connects them, so the numbers leadership relies on come from one governed place and reporting gives time back to running the work. The Data Engineer is a new seat, created to change that. You'll design and own a cloud data architecture built for where the business is going: a lakehouse on Microsoft Fabric (or an equivalent Azure design) with OneLake storage, medallion layers, pipelines and notebooks, and governed semantic models that Power BI and, later, AI tools run on. Today's systems are the sources. The platform is new, and you draw it. You report to the IT Director, work alongside the IT team, and recommend the platform choices in your first 90 days. This is an architect and builder role. The seat owns the architecture and the outcome. **Responsibilities:** * Design the target data architecture in your first 90 days and own it from there: a cloud lakehouse on Microsoft Fabric or Azure, OneLake or ADLS storage, Delta tables, medallion layers (bronze, silver, gold), workspaces and environments (development, test, production), the security model, naming standards and cost controls. Write the design down, with the reasoning behind each decision. * Build and run ingestion from the ERP (IBM i, DB2\), operations and project management systems, equipment telematics, HR and payroll, SQL Server applications and other approved sources, using change data capture or incremental loads where the source allows. * Build the pipelines and notebooks that move data through the layers: Data Factory pipelines and dataflows for orchestration, Spark notebooks (PySpark or Spark SQL) for transformation, with scheduling, monitoring, alerting and recovery built in. * Set the integration standard (patterns, tooling, error handling, retries, logging and alerting) and build system to system integrations on it through APIs, webhooks, file transfers and database interfaces. Retire the manual handoffs and older workarounds they replace. * Write and tune production SQL: transformations, views, stored procedures and validation logic. * Administer SQL Server application databases: performance, indexing, maintenance jobs, access and schema changes. * Design Power BI semantic models on the gold layer (star schemas, DAX, Direct Lake or import, incremental refresh, row level security by company and role) and publish certified datasets that report authors across the business build on. * Run the Power BI environment: workspaces, gateway, deployment pipelines, capacity and access. * Coach report authors in finance and operations, and review their reports until they are qualified to publish on their own. * Put automated data quality checks and reconciliations to source systems in place. Keep the data dictionary, lineage and business definitions current with the people who own the data. * Set the master data rules for records shared across the three companies (jobs, equipment, employees, vendors, cost codes) with the people who own them. * Treat data work as code: source control, peer review, automated testing and deployment. * Manage Fabric capacity and platform cost, reported monthly. * Prepare the data foundation for AI use cases (clean, governed, documented data with access controls) and support a future ERP selection with data profiling and migration planning. **Requirements:** * Advanced SQL: complex T\-SQL, query tuning, stored procedures, indexing and execution plans. * SQL experience with DB2, ideally on IBM i, or the ability to get productive with it within 90 days. * SQL Server database administration: performance, indexing, maintenance, security and access. * Dimensional modeling: star schemas, normalization, slowly changing dimensions. * Designing and building a cloud lakehouse on Microsoft Fabric or Azure: OneLake or ADLS, Delta or Parquet, medallion architecture, and the reasoning to defend the design to an IT Director and a CFO. * Building and operating pipelines and notebooks on that platform: Data Factory pipelines and dataflows, Spark notebooks (PySpark or Spark SQL), and an orchestration tool such as Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, SSIS or dbt. * Integration design: REST APIs, OAuth and API keys, JSON, webhooks, file and database interfaces, idempotent loads and error handling. * Power BI semantic models on a lakehouse: DAX, relationships, Direct Lake and import modes, incremental refresh, row level security and performance tuning. * At least one programming language for data work. Python or C\# preferred. * Git and automated deployment for data code, plus a working habit of testing, reconciling and documenting what you build. * Data security fundamentals: least privilege, encryption, secrets management, and care with payroll and personnel data. * The ability to explain what the data does and does not say to finance and operations leaders in plain language. * 5 or more years building and operating data pipelines, integrations and models, at least 3 in a Microsoft data environment. * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. If you meet most of this and the rest looks learnable, we would like to hear from you. **Nice to have:** * Construction ERP data, especially eCMS on IBM i. Viewpoint, Sage, CMiC or Procore also count. * HCSS products (HeavyJob, HeavyBid, Equipment360, Dispatcher), BambooHR, and telematics or equipment data from Samsara or OEM feeds. * Fabric capacity planning and cost management, or the Azure equivalent. * Real time or event based ingestion (Fabric Real\-Time Intelligence, Event Hubs or similar) for telematics and equipment data. * Integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate or a commercial iPaaS. * Data catalog and governance tools such as Microsoft Purview. * Microsoft certifications: DP\-700, DP\-600 or PL\-300\. * Experience replacing spreadsheet and desktop database workarounds with governed integrations at a mid size company.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Data Engineer — MCL Construction \| Omaha, NE** ================================================= **Turn Data Into Impact. Build What’s Next.** **MCL Arena Mentality** ----------------------- At MCL, we step into the arena together. Our core values guide how we show up every day, from how we lead and work together to how we serve our clients and communities. The Arena Mentality means putting those values into action: taking ownership, tackling challenges, supporting your team, speaking up, and bringing solutions to the table. As MCL grows, every employee has the opportunity to make an impact, influence our projects, and help shape what comes next. You’re not just filling a role. You’re part of the team building what’s next. **What You Bring to the Arena** ------------------------------- As a Data Engineer, you’ll play a key role in how MCL connects, manages, and uses data across the organization. You'll work alongside our ERP, Business Intelligence, and AI teams to build reliable data solutions that help drive smarter decisions and improve how we operate. * Take ownership of designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines across our enterprise systems. * Develop and optimize databases, data warehouses, and data models to support business needs. * Ensure data is accurate, secure, and reliable by identifying issues and improving data quality. * Connect data from CMiC and other business applications to support reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives. * Partner with internal teams to deliver trusted data for Power BI dashboards, financial reporting, and operational insights. * Anticipate challenges, troubleshoot complex data issues, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency. * Own data engineering projects from initial planning through implementation and ongoing support. **The Skills Behind the Build** ------------------------------- * Have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field (equivalent experience considered). * Bring 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, database development, or data integration. * Have experience designing, maintaining, and optimizing relational databases and complex queries. * Are proficient in Python or similar scripting languages and familiar with structured data formats such as JSON. * Have experience with Microsoft data platforms such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies. * Understand data governance, security, and Power BI data requirements. * Bring strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to take ownership of your work. * Experience with ERP systems, CMiC, or construction\-related data is a plus. **Build What’s Next** --------------------- You’ve built the technical experience. We want to give you the opportunity to put it to work. MCL is growing, and so is the role data plays in how we build. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, introduce new solutions, and help shape how our teams use technology and information to make better decisions. Build smarter systems. Solve complex challenges. Help shape what comes next. **More ownership. More innovation. More room to grow.** Since 1987, MCL has built its reputation on quality work, lasting relationships, and people who take pride in doing things the right way. **What We Offer** ----------------- * 100% employer\-paid healthcare premiums for you and your dependents * Profit sharing * 401(k) with employer contributions * Employer\-paid short\-term disability * Generous PTO * A team\-focused culture **We’re the people you build with. Build your career with MCL.**

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure at Mercor, you'll design and build the core services and platforms that the rest of engineering builds on. You'll work closely with engineers across product, research, and operations to turn hard scaling problems into well\-designed, well\-tested software. This is a software engineering role first. You'll spend most of your time designing systems, writing and reviewing code for services, platforms, and tooling that the rest of engineering builds on, ensuring they hold up in production at scale. We're hiring across Infrastructure: Platform, Developer Platform, Storage and Databases. We team\-match after the first screen, so apply even if your background leans toward one area. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- * Design and build multi\-tenant platform services that give dozens of teams isolated capacity, routing, quotas, and observability on demand, owned from architecture review through production. * Scale the gateway that fronts every model provider we use, so internal teams and products get reliable, fair, cost\-aware access to inference without filing a ticket. * Build the internal platforms and APIs that product and research engineers rely on every day, and treat them with the same design and testing rigor as customer\-facing code. * Design data models, storage layers, and workflows on Postgres, MongoDB, and Temporal that hold up at the next 10x, including schema evolution, sharding and partitioning strategies, and migrations. * Build developer\-facing platform components (sandboxes, job execution, service frameworks) where coding agents are first\-class users alongside humans. * Write design docs, lead architecture reviews, and set the patterns for how services at Mercor handle concurrency, retries, idempotency, and backpressure. * Improve the performance and efficiency of hot paths, and make architectural changes that bend the cost curve. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We care far more about how you reason about systems than which tools you've used. Strong candidates typically have: * Strong software engineering fundamentals: you design systems before you build them, write code you're proud of in Python or Go, test it, and review others' code with care. * A deep grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, concurrency, failure modes, backpressure, idempotency, and capacity planning. * Experience designing APIs and services used by other engineers, and evolving them without breaking their consumers. * Solid experience with relational and/or document databases: data modeling, query performance, and safe migrations. * Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure (we're on AWS) and containers. Deep Terraform or Kubernetes expertise is not required; you need to be curious and fast to pick it up. * High ownership: you see a gap, write the proposal, ship it, and stand behind it in production. **You Might Be a Great Fit If** ------------------------------- * You're a backend engineer who keeps getting pulled toward the platform layer because that's where the hardest problems are. * You've built internal platforms, SDKs, or shared services that other engineers loved using. * You've worked on multi\-tenant systems, rate limiting and quota systems, API gateways, or LLM/inference serving. * You've used databases, message queues, or workflow engines at meaningful scale and understand their tradeoffs from the inside. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building developer experience tooling, such as CI pipelines, build systems, local development environments, or internal CLIs that make engineers faster. * Interest in contributing to developer productivity work alongside your core focus: cutting CI time, improving test reliability, or building sandboxes and guardrails for coding agents. **How We Work** --------------- * Small, senior team with direct access to the Head of Infrastructure and to engineering leadership. * In\-person five days a week in SF. Infra is a team sport for us. * We use AI coding agents heavily and expect you to as well; the interesting work is deciding what they should do, not typing. * Weekly on\-call rotation with structured handoffs; on\-call load is a metric we actively drive down. **Benefits** * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance **Benefits:** * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid vacation and sick days * Parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free mental health services * $200 monthly wellness reimbursement * $1\.5K monthly meal stipend * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * Free Equinox membership * Up to $15K relocation bonus Mercor is an **Equal Opportunity Employer** and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Mercor does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by California or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, California, or local laws and ordinances. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. This Policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, discipline, termination, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. This Policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any employee or applicant based on any legally protected status. Compensation Range: $160K \- $500K

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Your Team Responsibilities: Private capital index calculation is a demanding engineering problem. Inputs are irregular, sparse and often revised. The measures are non\-linear and solver\-based, and the published output is a number that clients rely on for a decade. Every run must reproduce bit\-for\-bit against the validated code. You will build the calculation library itself, including the plugin contract, the solver, the aggregation logic and the test harness that confirms results have not changed. Your Key Responsibilities: * Design and build the measure library: money\-weighted (IRR, pooled, neutrally weighted), multiples, time\-weighted (Modified Dietz, unitised, index\-level chaining), public\-market equivalents (Direct Alpha, KS\-PME, Long\-Nickels) and real\-asset measures, each exposed through a stable, versioned, conformance\-tested interface. * Implement numerically sound logic: exact decimal arithmetic throughout, no floating\-point types for money or IRR solves, a safeguarded solver that brackets before iterating, and a canonical flow order for summation. * Make every calculation reproducible: pin each run to a data snapshot, engine version, measure version and input hash, so replays produce identical output and any mismatch is flagged. * Build and maintain the conformance harness: golden vectors from the methodology documents run on every build, with invariant tests for date\-shift, netting, weight sums and monotonicity. * Optimise batch performance across roughly 15,000 funds and roughly 150 definitions in a single pass rather than 150 separate passes, with caching keyed on the data snapshot so re\-ingested extracts invalidate stale results. * Work with methodology, data and product teams to turn methodology documents into tested code, and review changes to numerical code. Your skills and experience that will help you excel: * Strong software engineering experience in a typed language, with linting and tests that enforce numerical rules and act as the specification. * Working knowledge of fixed\-precision and floating\-point arithmetic, and a clear sense of where the two must never mix. * Root\-finding and numerical methods, including bracketing, convergence, ill\-conditioning, and recognising when a converged result is still meaningless. * A disciplined testing habit: test claims rather than asserting them, since plausible but wrong numbers are the main failure risk in this domain. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with performance measurement or financial calculation libraries, ideally for private markets. * Experience building versioned, reproducible computation pipelines. About MSCI: **What we offer you** * Salary range: $133,000 \- $173,000 / year plus eligible for annual bonus * Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing. * Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces. * A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. * A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. * Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development. * Multi\-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles. * We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride \& Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum. At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry\-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry. MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research\-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private\-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates. MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please email Disability.Assistance@msci.com and indicate the specifics of the assistance needed. Please note, this e\-mail is intended only for individuals who are requesting a reasonable workplace accommodation; it is not intended for other inquiries. **To all recruitment agencies** MSCI does not accept unsolicited CVs/Resumes. Please do not forward CVs/Resumes to any MSCI employee, location, or website. jobs.title: CAPITAL MARKETS REVENUE PLATFORM DEVELOPER - (VP)
jobs.description: **Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?** Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details. **JOB SUMMARY** The Capital Markets Revenue Platform Developer (VP) is the senior technical owner of a business\-critical revenue tracking application used across debt, equity\-linked, private placement, and advisory businesses. The platform consolidates transaction data from internal and external sources, creates transaction records and related tranches, supports revenue workflow and reporting, and notifies stakeholders when new activity is created. This role owns the technical direction of the platform. The successful candidate will maintain and enhance the current Angular and Java/Oracle application, lead its modernization to a React\-based, containerized architecture, and set engineering standards for the supporting team. This is a hands\-on senior role that combines full\-stack engineering, technical leadership, and direct partnership with Front Office, Finance, and Operations stakeholders. PLATFORM AND INTEGRATION LANDSCAPE * Application stack: Angular front end, Java services, and Oracle database, migrating to React and containerized deployment. * Upstream data sources: market\-data and reference\-data providers such as Bloomberg, the enterprise data warehouse (including FX rates), and market transaction data feeds such as IGM. * Business users: capital\-markets analysts who enter transaction data and middle\-office syndicate teams who review and approve it. * Downstream consumers: the general ledger (Oracle GL) for daily accruals and expenses, Hyperion for P\&L reporting, the enterprise business\-intelligence platform for analytics, and the client\-data hub for client information and accrual exchange. * Reporting: SSRS\-based user reporting, including transaction reports, rules reports, transaction summaries, and daily transaction listings. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. Technical Leadership and Ownership * Own the technical roadmap, target architecture, and engineering standards for the revenue tracking platform. * Lead design reviews, set coding and testing standards, and mentor developers, analysts, and support staff on and offshore. * Translate business priorities into a sequenced delivery plan, and communicate scope, dependencies, risks, and status to senior business and technology stakeholders. * Act as the escalation point for significant production, data, and delivery issues affecting revenue reporting. * Represent the platform in architecture, change\-advisory, audit, and risk governance forums. * Evaluate build\-versus\-buy options, vendor products, and platform services, and present recommendations with clear cost, risk, and resiliency analysis. 2\. Application Development and Modernization * Design, build, test, and maintain user interfaces, services, APIs, database components, and integrations for the revenue tracking platform. * Enhance the existing Angular application and Java services while defining and executing a phased migration to React. * Modernize the application for containerized deployment, including Docker images, environment configuration, health checks, logging, and deployment automation. * Partner with architecture, infrastructure, and information security teams to establish a secure, supportable target\-state platform. * Identify and remediate technical debt, obsolete dependencies, performance constraints, and operational risks without disrupting critical business processes. 3\. Capital Markets Transaction and Revenue Workflows * Support workflows for debt, equity\-linked, private placement, and advisory transactions. * Develop functionality that captures transaction data, creates transaction shells from inbound data, and manages one or more uniquely identified tranches per transaction. * Support enrichment and reconciliation of transaction data received from enterprise transaction\-processing, market\-data, and customer\-relationship\-management platforms. * Build and maintain the maker\-checker workflow that allows analysts to enter transactions and middle\-office syndicate teams to revie trol, and data lineage. SUCCESS MEASURES * Revenue workflows and transaction data are processed accurately, completely, and on time. * Downstream general\-ledger, P\&L, business\-intelligence, and client\-data interfaces deliver complete and reconciled data within agreed cut\-offs. * New functionality improves user efficiency while preserving data integrity, access controls, and auditability. * The migration to React and containerized deployment progresses through measurable, production\-ready milestones with minimal business disruption. * Application availability, performance, incident response, and data\-quality metrics meet agreed service levels. * Releases demonstrate appropriate automated testing, production\-readiness evidence, and controlled implementation. * Recurrent production issues, manual workarounds, and technical debt are reduced through durable engineering improvements. * Engineering standards, documentation, and cross\-training reduce key\-person dependency and raise team capability. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely\-related discipline or relevant work experience **“Visa sponsorship/support is based on business needs. jobs.title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, AI Platforms & Enablement
jobs.description: What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit amongst our global community of optimists and problem\-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs. Join us and play your part in something special! The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, AI Platforms \& Enablement supports multiple AI and automation products and services, keeping them reliable, secure and performing well for the business. The role drives internal and third\-party service reviews covering platform performance, key performance indicators, service improvements, customer satisfaction, quality and processes, and maintains the platform infrastructure behind Markel's enterprise AI portfolio, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, Claude, Harvey AI and future AI services. This role goes beyond servicing the platforms. The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer builds and maintains the platform configurations, automations and solutions that enable Markel associates to use AI safely and productively. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technologist who pairs strong platform administration with practical engineering skills: configuration management, scripting, workflow automation, integrations and reusable solution components. This is not a full\-time software development role; it suits someone who builds to make the platforms, and the people who use them, more effective. The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer partners closely with AI engineers and architects, the Cloud Infrastructure team, Global Security Services, Audit, IT Global Risk \& Compliance, Identity, Architecture, End User Computing, Microsoft and other AI vendors, and the U.S. and International AI Centers of Enablement. This role reports to the IT Manager, AI Platforms \& Enablement and resides within the Global Employee Experience department in Core Technology Services. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Platform Engineering \& Configuration** ----------------------------------------- * Design, build and maintain configurations for AI and automation platforms, including tenant and admin settings, Copilot Control System, Copilot Studio and agent settings, Power Platform environments, Managed Environments, Environment Groups, and DLP and connector policies. * Manage platform configurations as repeatable, documented and version\-controlled builds wherever possible, with configuration baselines that make drift easy to detect and correct. * Engineer and maintain the Power Platform environment strategy (Green / Yellow / Red zones), application lifecycle management (ALM) pipelines, solution deployment and environment provisioning. * Build and maintain the integrations, custom connectors and identity configuration (Entra ID app registrations, service principals, security groups) that AI platforms and agents depend on, in partnership with Identity, Security and Architecture. * Evaluate, pilot and implement new AI platform features and services, defining the configuration, controls and support model needed for production readiness. * Support and govern the use of Azure AI Foundry in partnership with AI engineers and architects and the Cloud Infrastructure team, including access and onboarding, approved models and deployment guardrails, responsible AI and content safety settings, and cost and usage visibility. **Automation \& Solution Enablement** ------------------------------------- * Automate platform administration and governance tasks such as provisioning, licensing and AI credit allocation, inventory, clean\-up of inactive and orphaned resources, and access reviews, using PowerShell, Power Platform CLI, Microsoft Graph and Power Automate. * Build reusable solutions, templates, agents and starter kits that help makers and business teams adopt AI quickly and within established guardrails. * Partner with business stakeholders and the AI Centers of Enablement to turn use cases into well\-architected platform solutions, and advise makers on design, performance and supportability. * Build the data feeds and reporting automation that surface utilization, platform health, compliance, cost and value. **Service Delivery \& Operations** ---------------------------------- * Support multiple AI and automation products and services so they stay reliable, available and responsive for the business; own complex incidents, problems and changes in ServiceNow, perform root cause analysis and drive permanent fixes. * Drive internal and third\-party service reviews with Microsoft and other AI vendors, covering platform performance and KPIs, service improvements, customer satisfaction, quality and processes. * Maintain platform capacity, licensing, consumption and release readiness, including changes a future. **Pay information:** The salary range for this position is $87,100\-$145,100\. The posted salary range reflects the lowest and highest base salary applicable to this role across our U.S. locations. Individual offers are determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, internal equity, and other job\-related factors. As a result, the salary offered for a specific location will fall within a narrower range than the overall range displayed in this posting. This position may also be eligible to participate in the Company's annual incentive plan.**Who we are:** Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20\+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory and investment operations around the world. **We’re** **all about people \| We win together \| We strive for better** **We enjoy the everyday \| We think further** **What’s** **in it for you:** In keeping with the values of the Markel Style, we strive to support our employees in living their lives to the fullest at home and at work. * We offer competitive benefit programs that help meet our diverse and changing environment as well as support our employees’ needs at all stages of life. * All full\-time employees have the option to select from multiple health, dental and vision insurance plan options and optional life, disability, and AD\&D insurance. * We also offer a 401(k) with employer match contributions, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, PTO, corporate holidays and floating holidays, parental leave. **Are you ready to play your part?** Choose **‘Apply Now’** to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you. **Caution: Employment** **scams** Markel is aware of employment\-related scams where scammers will impersonate recruiters by sending fake job offers to those actively seeking employment in order to steal personal information. Frequently, the scammer will reach out to individuals who have posted their resume online. These "job offers" include convincing offer letters and frequently ask for confidential personal information. Therefore, for your safety, please note that: * All legitimate job postings with Markel will be posted on Markel Careers. No other URL should be trusted for job postings. * All legitimate communications with Markel recruiters will come from Markel.com email addresses. We would also ask that you please report any job employment scams related to Markel to rarecruiting@markel.com. Markel is an equal opportunity employer. This includes race; color; sex; religion; creed; national origin or place of birth; ancestry; age; disability; affectional or sexual orientation; gender expression or identity; genetic information, sickle cell trait, or atypical hereditary cellular or blood trait; refusal to submit to genetic tests or make genetic test results available; medical condition; citizenship status; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; marital status, civil union status, domestic partnership status, familial status, or family responsibilities; military or veteran status, including unfavorable discharge from military service; personal appearance, height, or weight; matriculation or political affiliation; expunged juvenile records; arrest and court records where prohibited by applicable law; status as a victim of domestic or sexual violence; public assistance status; order of protection status; status as a smoker or nonsmoker; membership or activity in local commissions; the use or nonuse of lawful products off employer premises during non\-work hours; declining to attend meetings or participate in communications about religious or political matters; or any other classification protected by applicable law. Should you require any accommodation through the application process, please send an e\-mail to the rarecruiting@markel.com. No agencies please.

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer – Full-Stack TypeScript & LLM Consumer Products
jobs.description: **Founding Product Engineer – Full\-Stack TypeScript \& LLM Consumer Products** =============================================================================== **San Francisco, CA · New York, NY · London, UK \| On\-site \| Full Time \| Direct Hire \| Mid to Senior Level \| ASAP Start** **MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group** is looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to join a seed\-stage consumer AI company that has become one of the fastest\-growing consumer AI products of the year. The company builds a personal AI assistant that people use inside the messaging apps they already have. It does not just answer questions: it carries tasks out for the user, from bookings and purchases to email, calls and content, and nothing irreversible happens without the user's approval. The team is still very small, so every engineer owns whole products and has a direct impact on what millions of users experience. **THE CHALLENGE** ----------------- You will build what people actually touch: the conversation itself across messaging apps and group chats, the moments where the assistant asks before it spends money or sends something on the user's behalf, onboarding, payments and the web surfaces around them. On a team this size you take a product from the first sketch to production and to the numbers after launch, working side by side with the agent and infrastructure engineers so that new capabilities ship as product, not as demos. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ * Own user\-facing features end to end, from idea to production to the next iteration, across messaging and the web. * Design the moments of trust: approvals, receipts, confirmations and recovery when a task goes wrong. * Build onboarding, subscriptions and billing as the product moves from waitlist to paid. * Work closely with agent and infrastructure engineers so new capabilities reach users as polished product. * Read conversations, talk to users and turn what you learn into what ships that week. **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** --------------------------- * At least **3 years** of software engineering experience, with a record of **shipping polished consumer products end to end**, ideally as an early engineer or a founder. * Strong **full\-stack** skills in **TypeScript** and a modern web stack, and the judgment to choose the simplest thing that works. * Experience building on **large language models (LLMs)** in a product people use every day. * Real product taste: you notice latency, wording and edge cases, and fix them without being asked. * Speed: you ship in days, measure and ship again. * Based in, or willing to relocate at your own cost to, **San Francisco, New York or London**, to work on\-site. * Fluent English, as you will work daily with the founders and users. **NICE TO HAVE** ---------------- * Experience at a fast\-growing consumer or AI\-first product company. * Experience with messaging platforms, payments or subscription billing (not required). A particular framework, prior messaging experience or a degree are not required. **POSITION DETAILS** -------------------- Work arrangement: On\-site Schedule: Full Time Employment type: Direct Hire (permanent) Seniority: Mid to Senior (3\+ years) Start date: ASAP Location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; or London, UK Meaningful founding equity, comprehensive benefits and the tools you need to do your best work. The hiring process is short: a conversation with a founder, a working session on a real problem and a decision within days. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** ---------------------- You must already hold the right to work in the United States (San Francisco and New York) or in the United Kingdom (London). Visa sponsorship is not available; H\-1B transfers and TN status may be considered. **HOW TO APPLY** ---------------- If you want to build a consumer AI product that people use every day, with real ownership from day one, we want to hear from you. Apply through this platform with your updated CV, your expected gross annual salary in USD, the hub you would work from and your availability to start.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Infrastructure)
jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **Job Overview** ================ As a **Member of Technical Staff** in our **Infrastructure team,** you will own the shared infrastructure that product, data, research, and operations teams use to process and deliver data. You will set technical direction with those teams, implement changes yourself, and shape how engineers use AI agents to build and maintain the platform. **What You Will Own** ===================== * Build and operate shared services, APIs, and self\-service tools that let teams run data jobs, find and access datasets, and diagnose failures on their own. * Use production metrics and feedback from users to decide what to improve. That might mean shortening the wait between processing steps or moving rarely accessed data to a lower\-cost storage tier while meeting retrieval latency targets. Measure the result against a baseline after rollout. * Lead platform changes across teams. Agree on service targets and ownership with the teams affected, plan migrations together, and follow through until teams have adopted the change. * Build agent harnesses for recurring engineering tasks. For example, give an agent investigating a failed job access to relevant logs and an isolated environment where it can reproduce the failure, test a fix, and submit the change for review. **What We Look For** ==================== * You have designed, built, and operated production infrastructure. You can reason through failure modes and make tradeoffs among reliability, performance, and cost. Experience with data production workflows or shared storage services is a plus. * You can identify the problem worth solving when requirements are incomplete, explain the tradeoffs, and bring teams with competing priorities to a decision without formal authority. * You can guide a coding agent through an infrastructure change. You break the work into verifiable steps, provide the context it needs, review its code and test results against acceptance criteria, and know when to take over. * You can design and debug an agent harness. You can scope tool permissions, use an execution trace to understand why a run failed, and turn that failure into a regression test to verify a change to the harness. **What We Would Like to See When You Apply** ============================================ * Describe an infrastructure change you led, the problem it solved for users, and a tradeoff you made. Include a before\-and\-after measure that shows what changed. If you worked with an agent, tell us what you delegated and how you verified its work. * **Important Note for Applicants: Your resume must include the exact word “Maxinsights”. Our internal agent automatically filters out applications that omit it.** **Default Benefits:** ===================== * Health insurance * Vision care * Dental coverage * 401(k) * Paid holidays * PTO (Paid Time Off) * Sick leave

Experience with data analysis, quality, and profiling; including data exploration tools including but not limited to Rapid SQL, AQT, Information Analyzer, and Informatics. **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** Education, experience and tenure may be considered along with internal equity when job offers are extended.; $96,179 \-144,331 annually. **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** ADRC hours are 7am \- 5pm. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.** **YOUR IMPACT** --------------- You will be the technical lead your team and clients rely on to tackle the hardest engineering challenges, make sound architectural decisions, and ensure the delivery of complex, high\-quality solutions that create lasting impact. You will own the technical direction for your team, designing and delivering complex software systems while setting the engineering standards that define how great software gets built. You will mentor engineers at all levels, help clients make smart technology decisions, and bring the kind of judgment and depth that turns a good team into a great one. or equivalent experience * 8\+ years of experience developing full\-stack applications, with expert\-level proficiency across frontend and backend frameworks such as JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Angular, Next.js, Vue.js, Java, Spring, C\#, or Node.js; deep knowledge of API lifecycle management, software design patterns, and distributed systems architecture, with experience managing technical debt and building reusable components adopted across teams * Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex cloud solutions independently, including multi\-tier cloud migrations, scalable and fault\-tolerant infrastructure, and cost\-effective cloud\-native architectures on platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * Experience establishing agentic engineering standards, reusable workflows, and tooling that measurably improve engineering productivity and delivery quality across teams * Experience driving AI capabilities that teams build upon, owning evaluation frameworks, self\-learning loops, and security controls that improve release quality over time * A security\-first mindset — able to engage as an expert on standards, compliance, and regulation, architect complex authentication solutions, and lead testing strategies that establish the code quality bar for the team * Experience leading collaborative, cross\-functional engineering teams and fostering a strong engineering culture * Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and the local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues. jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps & Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Healthcare quality is complex. Medisolv helps make it manageable \- and actionable. We partner with hospitals, health systems, ACOs, and payers to bring clarity to quality data, connecting clinical and claims information into a single, reliable view. More than 1,800 organizations and 130M\+ patient records rely on Medisolv to measure, report, and improve performance across 500\+ measures tied to CMS, The Joint Commission, and other programs. With support from Bessemer Venture Partners Forge, we're continuing to grow our platform and expand our impact \- investing in advanced analytics, AI, and new capabilities that help healthcare organizations stay ahead of change and improve outcomes with confidence. **About the Role** We are looking for a hands\-on Senior DevSecOps \& Cloud Platform Engineer to build, secure, and operate the cloud foundation behind Medisolv's Lilac healthcare analytics platform. This role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, security operations, developer enablement, and production reliability. You will own automation across AWS, infrastructure as code, secure delivery workflows, identity and access, Snowflake platform controls, observability, disaster recovery, and compliance evidence. You will also help evolve the platform from customer\-specific infrastructure toward reusable, parameterized, and versioned capabilities that can be deployed consistently across clients. Success means faster and safer delivery, less manual provisioning and configuration drift, lower support and infrastructure burden, stronger auditability, and a scalable foundation for a multi\-client SaaS product. **What You'll Do** * Build and operate secure, resilient AWS infrastructure using Terraform and disciplined infrastructure\-as\-code practices; maintain clear environment and state boundaries, reusable modules, tested changes, and controlled promotion paths. * Own and improve GitHub\-based engineering workflows, including GitHub Actions, Atlantis plan/apply processes, branch protections, approvals, runners, secrets, release controls, and automated validation for application, data, and infrastructure changes. * Embed security into delivery through least\-privilege IAM and jobs.description: Overview: Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026! **Position Summary**: We're hiring an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer I to help build and maintain our metric intelligence platform: the agents, skills, and backend services that turn governed business metrics into automated analysis for teams across the company. This position is part of the Enterprise Data Services Division\-we own the company's metric definitions, the semantic layer that serves them, and an AI\-powered analytics platform built on top. Metric logic lives in version\-controlled code; agents and applications read from it rather than reinventing it. This is an engineering role, not a prompt\-writing role. Most of the platform's skills are deterministic Python, with AI agents orchestrating them. You'll spend more time making things correct, tested, and reliable than making them clever. Geo\-Salary Information: ***An in\-person interview may be required during the hiring process*** State specific pay scales for this role are as follows: $83,670\.00 to $161,815\.00 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA) $76,064 to $147,104 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME) $68,457 to $132,394 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV) In CA: Typical hiring range is $98,194 \- $153,428 The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location. Responsibilities: **Essential Job Functions:** **Agents and skills management** * Build, test, and maintain the Python skills and AI agents that run on the platform. * Keep a clean skills catalog: versioning, documentation, ownership, and retiring skills that are no longer used. * Build evaluation and regression checks (test sets, validators, output\-format rules) so agent quality is consistent from run to run. * Monitor agent usage, cost, and failures, and fix the root cause rather than the symptom. **Platform backend maintenance** * Maintain the platform's agent runtime, built on a TypeScript agent framework (Mastra): agent workflows, tool definitions, memory, and model configuration. * Maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that link agents to the warehouse, semantic layer, BI tools, and other company systems. * Keep the platform's API services, scheduled jobs, and data pipelines healthy; handle framework, SDK, and model version upgrades. * Triage and resolve failed jobs, broken connectors, data\-quality alerts, and user\-reported issues. * Improve CI/CD, logging, and monitoring so problems surface before users find them. * Write runbooks so any teammate can operate the platform. **Data foundation (working knowledge)** * Understand how the gold data layer and semantic models feed the platform, and make small, reviewed changes to them. * Work with the metric tree, the map of how business metrics drive each other, to connect new metrics and their relationships to the platform. * Trace a number from the platform back to its source data when something looks wrong. Qualifications: **Education:** **Minimum** * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative, technical, engineering, or business\-related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preferred** * Masters Degree in a quantitative field * CS, engineering, math, or stats degree preferred **Experience:** **Minimum** * Typically requires 2 years of relevant experience in AI native analytics **Preferred** * Experience with native AI implementations in Insurance industry **Knowledge and Skills:** **Programming** * Python: writes, tests, and debugs modular code independently. Deterministic Python * TypeScript/JavaScript: can read and change an existing backend codebase. Mastra is TS\-based, so this is required. * SQL: joins, aggregations, and window functions against a warehouse; can sanity\-check a metric's output. **LLM and agent fundamentals** * Has built at least one working LLM application end to end, such as a tool\-calling agent, a RAG app, or an MCP server. A shipped side project counts. * Understands prompts versus tools versus retrieval, context limits, and why agent output is nondeterministic. * Has an instinct for evaluation: tests agent output against expected answers instead of eyeballing it. **Engineering hygiene** * Daily use of Git and GitHub: branches, PRs, code review * Works with REST or JSON APIs and reads API documentation without direct supervision **Data and domain basics (concepts only)** * Understands what a semantic layer, dimension, and metric are, and how they differ from raw tables * Can read a dbt model and YAML config and follow the lineage About the Company: ***Why choose a career at Mercury?*** At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it. Users will ask questions in plain language, get accurate answers grounded in product and institution knowledge, and take action without leaving their workflow. This is an early\-stage product area. Choosing the right use cases, and the right quality bar, is the job. You will find where an assistant genuinely beats search, documentation, and a support call, and where it does not, then take the best opportunities to production on our shared AI platform. You have shipped LLM\-powered features to external customers, not just prototypes, and you care about answers that are accurate, grounded in sources, and honest about what they cannot do. **Key Responsibilities:** **Product Strategy and Roadmap** * Define the product vision and roadmap for assistant experiences across lending and account\-opening products. * Work with product teams to identify and prioritize use cases (for example product guidance, knowledge retrieval, natural\-language questions about data and reports, and guided actions) by user value, feasibility, and risk. * Build business cases and success metrics for each use case before investing. * Evaluate build, buy, and partner options for core components and make the tradeoffs visible. **Discovery and Customer Engagement** * Research the top questions and tasks of loan officers, processors, institution staff, and end customers, and validate that an assistant beats existing self\-serve and support options. * Work with design partners and early\-access customers to test and refine assistant behavior. * Synthesize qualitative research, usage data, and support data into clear opportunities. **Cross\-Functional Delivery** * Partner closely with the AI platform team on shared capabilities such as retrieval, tool access, guardrails, and observability, and shape what the platform needs to support. * Work with engineering, design, and data science teams using agile practices to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and the evaluation approach. * Define how quality is measured before and after launch: answer accuracy, groundedness, task completion, and when to hand off to a human. * Work with support, documentation, and content owners so the knowledge behind the assistant stays accurate and current. * Coordinate with security, privacy, legal, and compliance on data access, permissions, disclosures, and regulatory expectations for AI in financial services. * Own launch readiness: go\-to\-market coordination, documentation, training, and customer communication. **Measurement and Iteration** * Track KPIs such as answer quality, resolution and deflection rate, task completion, adoption, escalation rate, and cost per conversation. * Build feedback mechanisms that surface wrong or unhelpful answers quickly and feed them into iteration cycles. * Communicate performance transparently to leadership and stakeholders. **Qualifications:** **Product Management** * 3\+ years of product management experience in an enterprise B2B SaaS environment. * Strong discovery skills, including user research, and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear, prioritized scope. * Ability to define success metrics and build a business case for an investment. * Strong organizational, storytelling, and presentation skills. Working knowledge of agile methodologies. * Excellent collaboration skills within and across teams. **AI Experience** * Demonstrated track record of taking an LLM\-powered feature to production for external customers, including owning scope, evaluation, and post\-launch iteration. Not internal tooling or prototypes. * Hands\-on understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, prompt and tool design, evaluations, and guardrails, enough to partner credibly with engineers and data scientists. * Familiarity with responsible AI considerations such as accuracy, hallucination risk, bias, and privacy. * Experience with conversational interfaces, search, or knowledge products is a plus. **Background and Education** * Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred. Computer science background (education or other demonstrated proficiency) preferred. * Consumer or mortgage lending software experience is a plus. Compensation Range: $104,148 \- $162,800 Apply for this Job

jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- MetroSys is seeking an experienced **Senior AI Infrastructure \& Data Center Architect** to design, deploy, and optimize enterprise infrastructure environments supporting GPU\-accelerated computing, artificial intelligence platforms, and high\-performance workloads. This is an **IT infrastructure\-focused position**, requiring deep expertise in enterprise data center technologies, compute architecture, high\-performance networking, storage systems, virtualization, and NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing complex enterprise infrastructure solutions and integrating NVIDIA GPU platforms into existing or newly developed data center environments. This individual will be responsible for infrastructure architecture, technical assessments, solution design, hardware selection, deployment planning, and operational readiness. The role requires a strong understanding of how GPU compute, networking, storage, and infrastructure management technologies work together to support enterprise AI workloads. **This is not an AI application development, data science, or machine learning engineering position.** The focus is on building and supporting the underlying IT infrastructure required to operate enterprise AI environments. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Enterprise Infrastructure \& Data Center Architecture** * Design and architect enterprise data center infrastructure supporting GPU\-accelerated computing and high\-performance workloads. * Develop end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions integrating compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and management platforms. * Assess existing customer environments and identify infrastructure requirements for deploying NVIDIA AI computing solutions. * Create high\-level and low\-level infrastructure designs, technical diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and implementation plans. * Lead infrastructure discovery sessions, technical assessments, and architecture workshops with enterprise customers. * Evaluate hardware platforms, infrastructure dependencies, scalability requirements, and operational considerations. * Design highly available, resilient, and scalable infrastructure environments. * Provide technical guidance on data center modernization, infrastructure consolidation, and emerging accelerated computing technologies. ### **NVIDIA GPU \& Accelerated Computing Infrastructure** * Design infrastructure solutions utilizing NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and enterprise GPU computing platforms. * Architect GPU compute environments incorporating NVIDIA Hopper, Blackwell, and other accelerated computing technologies. * Evaluate GPU server platforms, compute density, hardware compatibility, and infrastructure sizing requirements. * Design and support GPU cluster infrastructure for enterprise AI and high\-performance computing environments. * Provide architectural guidance on NVIDIA Base Command Manager, NVIDIA Mission Control, and related infrastructure management technologies. * Support infrastructure deployment, configuration, validation, and operational readiness for NVIDIA\-based computing environments. * Evaluate GPU resource allocation, cluster performance, capacity requirements, and infrastructure utilization. * Work with hardware manufacturers and infrastructure vendors to develop integrated computing solutions. ### **High\-Performance Networking** * Design high\-bandwidth, low\-latency networking environments supporting GPU clusters and distributed computing. * Architect NVIDIA InfiniBand and high\-speed Ethernet networking solutions. * Design network fabrics utilizing RoCE, RDMA, and other high\-performance interconnect technologies. * Evaluate NVIDIA Spectrum Ethernet and Quantum InfiniBand switching technologies. * Develop network architectures supporting east\-west traffic, high\-throughput data movement, and distributed GPU workloads. * Integrate accelerated computing environments with existing enterprise networking infrastructure. * Evaluate network performance, redundancy, scalability, and resiliency requirements. * Troubleshoot complex network connectivity and performance issues affecting GPU infrastructure. ### **Enterprise Storage \& Data Center Systems** * Architect high\-performance storage environments supporting GPU\-intensive computing workloads. * Evaluate enterprise SAN, NAS, NVMe, NVMe\-oF, and parallel file system technologies. * Design storage connectivity and data access architectures for large\-scale compute clusters. * Integrate enterprise storage platforms with NVIDIA GPU computing environments. * Evaluate storage performance, throughput, latency, and scalability requirements. * Support infrastructure solutions involving Linux, virtualization platforms, and containerized infrastructure environments. * Assess data center requirements including rack architecture, power distribution, cooling, and hardware density. * Collaborate er infrastructure teams, IT directors, and technology leadership. * Translate technical requirements into infrastructure designs and implementation strategies. * Develop architecture documentation, technical proposals, and infrastructure equipment specifications. * Collaborate with technical sales teams and engineering resources during solution development. * Evaluate infrastructure technologies from NVIDIA, Cisco, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, AMD, and other enterprise technology providers. * Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects. * Present infrastructure recommendations and solution designs to technical and executive stakeholders. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 10\+ years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure engineering, data center architecture, or solutions architecture. * Extensive experience designing and implementing complex enterprise infrastructure environments. * Strong technical understanding of NVIDIA GPU computing infrastructure and accelerated computing platforms. * Experience with enterprise server architecture, compute platforms, and large\-scale infrastructure deployments. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, including high\-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, or RDMA technologies. * Strong understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, NVMe, and high\-performance storage architectures. * Experience with Linux\-based infrastructure environments and enterprise virtualization technologies. * Knowledge of GPU cluster architecture, infrastructure management, and compute resource allocation. * Experience developing infrastructure architecture documentation, high\-level designs, low\-level designs, and bills of materials. * Understanding of data center hardware requirements, including rack density, power, cooling, and physical infrastructure considerations. * Experience integrating compute, networking, and storage platforms into enterprise environments. * Strong troubleshooting, infrastructure assessment, and technical problem\-solving skills. * Ability to lead customer\-facing architecture discussions and provide technical recommendations. **NVIDIA Certifications** ------------------------- Candidates holding one or more of the following NVIDIA professional certifications are strongly preferred: * **NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Infrastructure (NCP\-AII)** – Demonstrates expertise in NVIDIA AI infrastructure architecture, deployment, and enterprise computing environments. * **NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Networking (NCP\-AIN)** – Demonstrates expertise in high\-performance networking technologies supporting accelerated computing infrastructure. * **NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Operations (NCP\-AIO)** – Demonstrates expertise in operating, administering, monitoring, and maintaining NVIDIA AI infrastructure environments. Candidates with multiple NVIDIA certifications will receive additional consideration. Equivalent hands\-on experience designing and deploying NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure will also be considered. **Preferred Technical Experience** ---------------------------------- * NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and accelerated computing platforms. * NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures. * NVIDIA Spectrum Ethernet and Quantum InfiniBand networking. * NVIDIA Base Command Manager and Mission Control. * GPU cluster design, deployment, and administration. * InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, and high\-performance Ethernet networking. * Enterprise storage solutions and parallel file systems. * Linux infrastructure administration and cluster management. * Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift infrastructure. * VMware or other enterprise virtualization technologies. * Enterprise data center infrastructure and hardware integration. * Infrastructure automation and configuration management. * High\-performance computing (HPC) architecture. * NVIDIA AI Factory infrastructure design and deployment. iMuT0HDC9y

At Microsoft Security, we are committed to making the world a safer place by developing an end\-to\-end security cloud that simplifies and strengthens our customers' security postures. With ever\-increasing threats, regulatory requirements, and estate complexity, organizations face daunting challenges managing and securing vast amounts of data across on\-premises, multi\-cloud, and SaaS environments. Our team is building a high\-scale, exabyte\-scale data platform to help enterprises: • Inventory and map their entire digital estate: From devices and users to permissions, data systems, and virtual machines, we help organizations discover and gain visibility into every asset. • Integrate and normalize data: By pre\-integrating security data from disparate sources and standardizing it, we empower customers to store, retain, and use security logs more efficiently and affordably. • Answer critical security and governance questions: From identifying what systems exist and what's in them, to ensuring compliance with legal and corporate policies, we provide customers with insights and control over their security landscape. By leveraging an advanced security graph, built using AI and machine learning algorithms, we enable organizations to detect patterns, uncover threats, and make informed decisions about their digital estate's security posture in real time. jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: **Your Job** Molex is seeking a motivated Software Engineer, Developer Productivity (AI Agents), to join our Optical Systems Business Unit in Fremont, California. In this role you will contribute to AI\-assisted firmware development for next\-generation optical transceivers \- including OSFP and QSFP\-DD form factors at 800G and 1\.6T \- serving datacenter and telecom markets. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in Python and software testing, and hands\-on experience with AI coding agents. You will collaborate with firmware, hardware and test engineering teams across multiple time zones to build tools that help engineers use AI coding agents with confidence. This position is open to recent graduates and early\-career professionals. You will learn through hands\-on projects, code reviews and mentoring from your manager and experienced firmware engineers. **Our Team** Molex brings a rich heritage in the optical industry, with the highest performing and field\-proven solutions spanning components, modules and integrated line\-cards. Our comprehensive optical, mechanical, electrical and software design capabilities allow us to serve the high\-density, high\-bandwidth and flexible networking needs of hyperscale datacenter, datacom and telecom customers. Continuous innovation in component integration, miniaturization and manufacturing automation keeps our products at the leading edge of optical networking. **What You Will Do** * Build, test and maintain AI development tooling, such as agent rules, skills, hooks and CI checks * Develop and test Python and shell scripts that automate builds, code review steps and release checks * Add evaluation cases drawn from real defects and planted bugs, and run them to check rule, workflow and model changes * Extend static analysis and CI checks that enforce firmware coding and safety rules * Implement the team's guardrails and review standards for AI\-generated changes, including traceability to the engineers who approve them * Troubleshoot and resolve tooling issues reported by firmware engineers in Windows and Linux development environments * Compare AI models and tools on quality, speed and cost, and summarize the results * Collect and analyze data on tooling use and failures, and report findings to the team * Document tools and workflows, and help firmware engineers adopt them * Learn how firmware is developed, reviewed and released, and how it controls optical hardware **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field * Experience programming in Python, through coursework, internships, projects or professional work * Knowledge of data structures, algorithms and software testing * Familiarity with shell scripting in bash or PowerShell on Linux and Windows * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents, including reviewing and testing the code they generate * Experience with Git version control, such as branching and merging **What Will Put You Ahead** * Experience with C, embedded systems or microcontroller programming * Experience with compilers, parsers or static analysis tools, such as libclang or tree\-sitter * Experience extending AI agents with custom tools, MCP servers or agent SDKs * Internship, co\-op or work experience in developer tools, build systems or CI/CD pipelines * Background in statistics, experiment design or machine learning evaluation * Background in optics, photonics or digital communications For this role, we anticipate paying $110,000 \- $120,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading\-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most.
