jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Data Products
jobs.description: **About mpathic** mpathic builds AI that understands clinical and human conversations: analyzing therapy and clinical\-trial sessions, producing expert\-labeled data for AI builders, and publishing open safety benchmarks. **About the role** We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build and improve ML\-powered products, with a particular focus on the data that makes them effective. You’ll work across the ML lifecycle, combining hands\-on engineering with strong data skills to create reliable datasets, pipelines, and data\-driven product capabilities. This is a generalist ML engineering role with a data focus. You’ll contribute to production systems while improving how data is collected, prepared, accessed, and used for training and inference. **What you’ll do** * Build, deploy, and maintain ML models and services in collaboration with engineering and product teams. * Build reliable ML pipelines from the ground up for conversational audio and transcripts: ingestion, validation, diarization, and overall quality. * Create and maintain versioned datasets and features for training, evaluation, and inference. * Provision and manage AWS resources your pipelines and tools run on, using infrastructure as code. * Establish checks for data quality, freshness, schema changes, and training\-serving consistency. * Build workflows for labeling, enrichment, deduplication, and dataset curation with our clinical experts. * Explore data to identify quality issues, coverage gaps, and opportunities to improve model performance. * Own well\-scoped projects and communicate data assumptions, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly. **What you’ll bring** * Practical experience shipping ML systems, typically 2–6 years of relevant work or equivalent. * Strong Python skills, with experience building and operating real\-world data systems at scale, including storage, serving, dealing with contamination, noise and real\-world data quality challenges. * Proven track record of excellence building and maintaining data pipelines and reproducible, versionable workflows. * Solid ML fundamentals and an understanding of how data quality affects model performance. * Hands\-on AWS experience (EC2, S3\), infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) plus at least one database or warehouse. * Strong experience processing and manipulating datasets with inconsistent schemas, and imbalanced or unrepresentative data. * Familiarity with data modeling, storage formats, and batch or streaming processing. * Experience standing up processes and systems from the ground up, and sound judgement with handling sensitive health data. * Good software engineering practice: testing, version control and code review. **Helpful additional experience** * Workflow orchestration and distributed processing tools, such as Airflow, Dagster, or Spark. * Docker and CI/CD. * Dataset versioning, lineage, and reproducibility. * Annotation platforms, active learning, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Comfortable shipping quickly and iterating on feedback. * Building data APIs or internal tools with lightweight frameworks (FastAPI, Streamlit, etc.). * Clear, direct communication, both written and verbal. * Startups and cross\-functional teams.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Evaluation
jobs.description: **About mpathic** mpathic builds AI that understands clinical and human conversations: analyzing therapy and clinical\-trial sessions, producing expert\-labeled data for AI builders, and publishing open safety benchmarks. **About the role** We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build and improve ML\-powered products, with a particular focus on evaluating their quality and reliability. You’ll work across the ML lifecycle, combining hands\-on engineering with rigorous experimentation to understand how systems perform and where they need to improve. This is a generalist ML engineering role with an evaluation focus. You’ll contribute to production systems while helping the team make sound decisions about models, data, and product changes. **What you’ll do** * Build, deploy, and maintain ML models and services in collaboration with engineering and product teams. * Design evaluation approaches that reflect product needs and real\-world operating conditions. * Create and maintain evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and automated regression tests that measure safety, empathy, and risk. * Select appropriate metrics, analyze performance across meaningful data segments, and investigate failure modes. * Design experiments and use statistical methods to judge whether an improvement is real. * Connect offline evaluation results with what customers see in production. * Develop tools that make evaluation repeatable and useful throughout development and release workflows. * Communicate findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to clinicians, product leads, and customers. **What you’ll bring** * Practical experience developing and shipping ML systems, typically 2–5 years of relevant work or equivalent. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with common ML frameworks. * Solid ML fundamentals, including training, validation, generalization, and common sources of model error. * Experience with evaluation metrics, benchmark design, and systematic error analysis. * An understanding of statistical inference, sampling, confidence intervals, and experimental design. * Experience identifying data leakage, evaluation bias, and gaps in test coverage. * Good software engineering practices, including testing, version control, and code review. * Skill at turning ambiguous product goals into measurable quality criteria. **Helpful additional experience** * A/B testing and production performance monitoring. * Human evaluation, annotation guidelines, and inter\-rater agreement. * Speech or conversational data: transcripts, diarization and multi\-speaker setups. * Evaluating ranking, retrieval, recommendation, or generative AI systems. * Robustness testing, calibration, fairness analysis, or distribution shift detection. * Building evaluation tooling and integrating quality checks into CI/CD workflows. * Clear, direct communication, both written and verbal. * Startups and cross\-functional teams.

jobs.title: Early Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: **About Multiply** Multiply is building the AI\-native media agency for B2B companies, combining AI agents with expert strategists to transform how businesses run and optimize paid advertising. Our platform connects to advertising channels, CRMs, and customer data to continuously create, manage, and optimize campaigns. We're building autonomous AI agents that make decisions, execute workflows, learn from results, and improve performance over time. We're also building a Marketing Intelligence platform that learns from thousands of campaigns and ads to uncover insights about buyers, creative performance, and channels, making every campaign and Ad smarter than the last. We're a fast\-growing, venture\-backed startup tackling complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI, automation, and large\-scale marketing data. Our goal is to fundamentally change how marketing gets done. **Role Description** We're looking for an exceptional AI\-native engineer who loves building products, solving hard problems, and shipping fast. As an early engineer at Multiply, you'll work directly with the founders to build and scale our AI\-powered platform. You'll have significant ownership over product features, technical architecture, and engineering decisions. This isn't a role where you'll be handed detailed specifications. You'll take ambiguous problems, figure out what matters, and ship solutions to customers. You'll work across the stack, from intuitive product experiences to sophisticated AI agents and backend systems. You'll join a small, ambitious team in San Francisco where your work will have an immediate impact on our product, customers, and company. **What you’ll do** * **Build AI\-powered products**: Own and ship end\-to\-end features that customers use every day, from intuitive interfaces to complex backend systems. * **Develop autonomous AI agents**: Build agents that reason, plan, execute actions, and continuously improve marketing workflows. * **Engineer reliable AI systems**: Design agent orchestration, tool integrations, evaluations, observability, and feedback loops to make AI systems dependable in production. * **Integrate data and build intelligence:** Connect advertising platforms, CRMs, and other data sources to power intelligent automation, uncover insights, and improve decision\-making. * **Move fast with AI**: Leverage AI coding tools and modern development workflows to prototype, build, and ship at exceptional speed without compromising quality. * **Own problems end\-to\-end**: Work directly with founders and customers to turn ambiguous ideas into working products, from initial design through production. * **Shape our engineering foundation**: Influence architecture, tooling, technical decisions, and engineering culture as the team grows. **What We Mean by "AI\-Native"** AI isn't just a feature we're building — it's fundamental to how we build software. We expect engineers to actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI\-powered development tools to accelerate development, testing, and experimentation. We're looking for engineers who constantly explore new AI capabilities, rethink traditional development workflows, and combine AI\-driven speed with strong engineering judgment. **Qualifications** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building and shipping production applications across the stack. * Hands\-on experience with modern AI development tools and a demonstrated ability to use them effectively. * Experience building AI\-powered applications or workflows, ideally using LLMs or agents. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to independently take ambiguous problems from idea to production. * Product\-minded engineering approach — you care about the user experience and business impact, not just the code. * Comfortable moving quickly, learning new technologies, and making pragmatic technical trade\-offs. * High ownership, curiosity, and a bias toward action. **Bonus Points** * Experience with agent frameworks, orchestration, tool calling, or evaluation systems. * Experience building integrations with third\-party APIs or complex data systems. * Previous experience at an early\-stage startup or building your own products.

jobs.title: Client Technology Engineer - MSP
jobs.description: **See the Bigger Picture. Solve Problems Before They Start.** At **My IT Crew**, we believe the best IT environments are built through thoughtful planning, consistent standards, and a commitment to getting things right before problems arise. We're looking for a Client Technology Engineer who enjoys getting hands\-on with technology, visiting client locations, and making meaningful improvements to the systems businesses rely on every day. If you're naturally curious, take ownership of what needs to be done, and prefer finding the root cause over applying temporary fixes, this could be the opportunity for you. **Position:** Onsite Technical Alignment Engineer (TAM) **Reports to:** Technical Alignment Team Lead **Location**: Client Sites – Onsite **Department:** Service Delivery **Work Arrangement:** Field\-Based, with daily travel to client locations **The Role: Make Every Client Visit Count** As a Client Technology Engineer, you'll be responsible for evaluating client environments, identifying areas that need attention, and bringing their technology closer to established MITC standards. Your work will help reduce recurring issues, uncover potential risks, and give clients a more stable and dependable IT experience. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of technical improvements, work alongside different teams, and help shape the standards that guide how we support our clients. **Your responsibilities will include:** * Conducting regular onsite assessments to evaluate client systems, infrastructure, and overall technical alignment. * Identifying weaknesses, inconsistencies, and potential points of failure, then taking action to address them. * Digging deeper into recurring issues to determine their underlying causes and implement long\-term corrections. * Reviewing existing technology setups against MITC standards and recognized industry best practices. * Recognizing potential security, infrastructure, and operational risks and ensuring they are addressed or escalated appropriately. * Partnering with the Project Team during new client implementations to establish environments that meet our technical expectations from the start. * Maintaining clear records of site assessments, technical findings, completed work, and recommended next steps. * Supplying our vCIO with reliable information about client infrastructure to support technology planning and strategic decisions. * Contributing ideas that improve internal procedures, technical standards, and the consistency of our service delivery. * Keeping teammates informed of changes to technical standards and practices that may affect their work. * Recording work performed and time spent accurately in our service management system. **This is a field\-based position that requires daily travel to client sites. Applicants must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.** **Who Will Thrive in This Role?** We're looking for someone who doesn't simply complete a checklist but understands why the work matters. You'll need to be comfortable working independently, interacting with clients, and recognizing opportunities to improve an environment even when no one has reported a problem. The right person will bring: * **A prevention\-first mindset.** You look for warning signs, address weaknesses early, and believe lasting solutions are better than repeated fixes. * **Initiative and ownership.** You can identify what needs attention, determine the next steps, and follow through without constant supervision. * **Strong people skills.** You can work professionally with clients, explain technical findings clearly, and make every onsite interaction a positive experience. * **Attention to detail.** You understand that accurate documentation and consistent technical standards are essential to reliable IT operations. * **A collaborative attitude.** You share knowledge, support your teammates, and put the team's success ahead of personal recognition. * **A broad perspective.** You consider how technical decisions affect the client's business, the wider IT environment, and MITC's ability to deliver dependable service. * **Flexibility in the field.** You're comfortable traveling between client locations and adapting to different environments and priorities. **Technical Experience That Helps You Succeed** You don't need to know everything on day one. We value the right mindset, a willingness to learn, and the ability to turn knowledge into practical improvements. The following experience would be an advantage: * Familiarity with Windows environments and Microsoft technologies. * Previous experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment. * Relevant industry certifications, including Microsoft certifications, CCNA, or similar credentials. **Why Join My IT Crew?** * **Make a lasting impact.** Help strengthen client environments instead of repeatedly dealing with the same technical problems. * **Expand your experience.** Work across different client infrastructures and encounter a variety of real\-world technical challenges. * **Take ownership.** Have the opportunity to identify improvements and contribute to how technical standards are developed and maintained. * **Learn with a team.** Exchange knowledge with colleagues and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement. * **Build your future.** Develop your technical capabilities in an organization that values initiative, accountability, and practical problem\-solving. If you enjoy investigating how systems work, spotting what others might overlook, and leaving every environment better than you found it, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply today and help My IT Crew build stronger, more reliable technology environments—one client visit at a time.**

jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description: **About** **Nooks.ai****:** =========================== Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals. Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. **The Role** Nooks builds AI agents that change how sales teams prospect, sell, and close. As an Agent Product Manager, you make those agents work inside our customers’ businesses. You’re on point for each customer engagement you’re staffed on. That runs from the first conversation with their sales leadership to an agent their reps rely on every day, and then on as it takes over more of their workflow. Some mornings you’ll sit with a CRO and their RevOps team working out where AI can move their numbers. That afternoon, you’ll be configuring, testing, and refining the agent that does it. Here the same person owns the strategy and the build, and that person is you. What this role isn’t: account management. You won’t carry a quota, handle renewals, or own the commercial relationship. Our AEs and CSMs do that. Your job is making sure the agents deliver: how they’re designed, how they’re built, whether reps actually use them, and what results they drive. You’ll be one of the first people on a brand\-new team, so there’s no playbook yet, and you’ll write it. You’ll make big calls without waiting for sign\-off, and you’ll bring in our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, and Engineering teams to move faster. **What you’ll do** * **Run customer engagements start to finish.** Take each one from discovery to a live agent to wide use across the team, and own the result. * **Represent Nooks to senior leaders.** Build credibility with VP\- and C\-level sales and revenue leaders, and help them plan where agents fit in their org. You’ll also lead executive reviews, escalations, and updates. * **Diagnose, then build.** Learn how the customer’s reps and managers actually work, where time and pipeline leak, and how their stack fits together (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, MCP). Then design and ship agents that fix it, and keep improving them after launch. * **Grow usage and impact.** Track how agents perform once they’re live, get reps using them, and spot the next workflow worth automating. * **Leave a playbook behind.** Package what works into templates and frameworks that make the next deployment faster for everyone. * **Feed the product.** Bring what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering as sharp, prioritized input that shapes what we build. **Who you are** * **2\+ years of client\-facing work at a top strategy firm**. Other great paths: investment banking or PE, founding a startup, or a product, strategy, or forward\-deployed role at a fast\-growing tech company after consulting. * **You’d rather build it yourself.** Writing the deck isn’t enough; you want to ship the thing. * **Technically fluent.** You’re comfortable with AI tools, can reason about how an agent should be designed, and earn credibility with engineers and execs alike. * **Senior leaders listen to you.** You’ve advised executives at large organizations and become the person they call first. * **You move fast and want more.** You pick things up quickly, compete hard, and reach for scope before it’s handed to you. * **Unfazed by a blank page.** Undefined problems energize you, and you’re happy working out the answer as you build it. **Bonus points** * A degree in CS, engineering, or math, or real hands\-on building experience * An MBA * You know how sales and revenue teams operate and the tools they live in * You’ve shipped and iterated on AI agents in production **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------------------ Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5, AI Observability
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **The Opportunity** ------------------- The AI Observability team makes AI, ML, and Agentic systems transparent, reliable, and production\-ready at scale. We build end\-to\-end observability for ML and GenAI workloads, capturing model inputs, features, predictions, outcomes, and behavior across online and batch systems. Our platform enables teams to monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and failures, turning the ML system from a black box into an explainable, debuggable system. We provide developer\-friendly libraries, dashboards, and alerts so teams can debug issues, respond to incidents, and ship AI\-powered products with confidence. We're looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to build the frameworks behind Netflix's AI Observability platform, model performance, evaluation, and vendor integration surfaces. You will design reusable infrastructure that enables ML/AI practitioners across domains to monitor model quality in production, evaluate LLM and agentic systems, and adopt vendor tooling through a consistent, self\-serve platform. AIP owns the generic, reusable infrastructure; domain teams own their domain\-specific evals and remediation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, machine learning, and data teams to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong background in AI or ML infrastructure and a passion for building scalable, robust systems. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Build the observability framework and platform capabilities that give ML and GenAI systems metrics, logs, and distributed traces across online inference, batch scoring, feature pipelines, and agent orchestration, so teams can instrument their systems consistently. * Build the primitives that let teams monitor model performance (accuracy, calibration, error rates), data quality, drift, and degradation on their own systems, rather than monitoring individual models yourself. * Build and extend evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems that support response quality, grounding and hallucination, task success, tool\-use and trajectory correctness, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge and human\-in\-the\-loop scoring, giving teams reusable building blocks to define and run their own evals. * Lead build\-vs\-buy evaluations for observability and eval tooling, and own the SDKs, connectors, and APIs that integrate vendor platforms into a consistent, well\-supported interface, so ML and product teams can onboard models and agents with minimal friction. * Build reusable libraries, SDKs, and templates that make observability and evaluation the default for new systems ("observability\-by\-default"), lowering the barrier for teams to instrument and evaluate their work. * Provide the dashboarding, alerting, and SLO/SLI building blocks (plus sensible out\-of\-the\-box templates) that teams use to track model performance, latency, cost, and reliability. **To succeed in this role, you will need:** ------------------------------------------- * Experience in software, AI/ML, or platform engineering, with hands\-on time in production observability, monitoring, or ML/LLM evaluation * Proven track record of designing standards, libraries, SDKs, or frameworks that other teams build on and adopt, reflecting a platform and enablement mindset rather than shipping features for a single use case. * Strong coding skills in Python and at least one of Java, Go, or Scala, with experience building production services * Practical experience operating ML models in production (online serving and/or batch), including drift, model performance, and data quality. * Hands\-on experience with modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or similar). * Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Ability to work cross\-functionally with ML, data, infra, and product teams, and to communicate clearly about system behavior, quality, and risk. * Experience with vendor integration and VPC deployment. * An AI\-Native Engineering Mindset who uses AI tools as a core part of their own workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, and code review. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Hands\-on experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Arize, Braintrust, LangFuse, Weights \& Biases, Galileo, Vertex AI Model Monitoring, SageMaker Model Monitor). * Experience building or shipping LLM/GenAI applications and evaluating them: prompt/result logging, evaluation metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience evaluating agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step reasoning, and trajectory/task\-success measurement. To learn more about our AI Platform, you can review the relevant talks/blog posts on the Netflix AI Platform Research website . Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $500,000\.00 \- $860,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. **With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America.** There are now companies operating entirely AI\-first on Netic. You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible. As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll dive deep into cutting\-edge research, understand the business functions we put on autopilot inside\-out, and execute targeted ML projects that deliver pure magic. **What You'll Do:** * **Study the frontier:** Track frontier work in traditional ML, LLMs, multimodal models, retrieval, and agentic systems—then distill it into ideas we can ship. * **Identify high‑ROI projects:** Partner with GTM and ops teams to spot bottlenecks in products; define ML projects that unlock significant leverage for customers. * **Build targeted models:** Own the full cycle—data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment—delivering systems that solve real customer pain points. * **Productionize solutions:** Integrate models into our real\-time platform via robust APIs and streaming pipelines, ensuring model performance and guardrails from day one. * **Self‑direct \& ship:** Operate like a founder—set technical roadmap, validate quickly, and iterate based on real\-world results. **What You'll Bring:** * **Deep ML experience:** Extensive work with cutting\-edge ML techniques; fluent in PyTorch or JAX and modern serving frameworks. * **Research‑to‑revenue record:** Proof you’ve taken novel ML concepts from paper prod with measurable $$ impact or user growth. * **Full‑stack pragmatism:** Comfortable with ETL, feature stores, cloud\-native infrastructure, and A/B experimentation. * **Data engineering skills:** Experience working with complex, real\-world data streams and building reliable training pipelines. * **Product intuition:** Ability to understand customer workflows and translate business needs into technical solutions. * **Ownership model:** You default to action, uphold a high craftsmanship bar, and treat failure modes as learning‑rate multipliers. **Our values** * Obsess over the customer * Every second counts * Sweat the details * There are no blockers * Be self\-directed * Seek and speak the truth * Enjoy the ride *We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.* Compensation Range: $145K \- $330K

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Records Platform (T3\)** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. **Summary** The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds and maintains features for Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use it to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential. Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best\-in\-class product that meets customers where they are. Positioned between the Software Engineer and Staff Engineer roles, the Senior Software Engineer owns features from design through production and makes sound technical decisions within their area. They raise code quality on the team and help newer engineers grow. This role requires strong skills in .NET, SQL Server and cloud technologies, plus the judgment to work effectively in Neumo’s AI\-assisted, agentic delivery model. The Senior Software Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, build, test and maintain features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Contribute to platform modernization by decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and reducing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Take on meaningful parts of our modernization work, resolving compatibility issues and validating changes. * Build self\-service configurable features that support each jurisdiction’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Develop and tune search features, including indexing, relevance and query performance, for large volumes of recorded documents. * Support customer migrations by building and testing data migration tooling, with a focus on data accuracy and record integrity. * Work from approved specifications in Neumo’s agentic delivery model. Use AI agents to draft code and tests, then review, correct and own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, including reviews of AI\-generated code, and hold a high bar for correctness, maintainability and test coverage. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues related to performance, reliability and data quality, and take part in on\-call rotations and post\-incident reviews. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and monitoring to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Participate in sprint planning and backlog refinement. Give realistic estimates and raise risks early. * Document key design decisions and platform knowledge, and share expertise through pairing and walkthroughs so critical knowledge doesn’t live with one person. * Mentor Software Engineers and newer team members on coding practices, debugging, testing and how the Records platform works. * Partner with product managers, QA, architects, Staff and Principal Engineers, and implementation teams to clarify requirements and keep designs consistent with Neumo’s platform direction. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. * Follow secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in full\-stack development and cloud software, with a focus on Microsoft technologies. * Advanced coding skills in .NET, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer, Records Platform** **About Neumo** Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems. That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades. **Summary** The Staff Software Engineer is the technical lead for key projects on Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use Records to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential. Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best\-in\-class product that meets customers where they are. The Staff Engineer designs and builds scalable solutions, guides project\-level technical decisions, and sets the technical standards the team works to. This role requires deep expertise in cloud\-based micro service architecture and technology. It also requires leadership skills: influencing team decisions, championing quality and mentoring Senior Engineers, many of whom work alongside newer team members. The Staff Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform. The manager leads people and delivery, and the Staff Engineer leads on technical depth and direction. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Serve as technical lead on key Records projects. Work with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, shape solutions and guide implementation from design through production. * Design, build and maintain advanced features within the Records platform, such as eRecording and eSubmission, automated indexing, search, certified copy requests, property fraud alerts, and ID verification and payment integrations. * Provide technical direction for the broader modernization. That includes decoupling tightly coupled components, replacing manual configuration with configurable, self\-service setup, and removing dependencies on specific peripherals. * Design for configurability across jurisdictions, so the platform fits each county’s statutes, workflows and level of digital maturity without custom code. * Own the technical direction for Records search, including indexing strategy, relevance, query performance and scaling for large volumes of recorded documents. * Design data migration approaches that move customers and their historical records onto the modern platform with full data accuracy and record integrity. * Partner with Senior Engineers, product, architects and leadership to create, refine and document technical standards, including standards for search and related infrastructure. * Write and maintain architecture decision records so the reasons behind key choices outlast any one person. * Set the code review and quality bar for the team, including review standards and test strategies for AI\-generated code under Neumo’s agentic delivery model. * Help the team work well from approved specifications. Write precise specs, show how to direct AI agents effectively, and make sure engineers own what ships. * Conduct thorough code reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve hard performance, reliability and data quality problems. * Lead the technical response to serious production incidents, and make sure post\-incident follow\-up actually improves the platform. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated testing and observability to support reliable, repeatable releases. * Mentor Senior Engineers on design, code quality and development standards, and help them grow into technical leaders. * Reduce key\-person risk by documenting platform knowledge and spreading expertise through pairing, design reviews and walkthroughs. * Build on Neumo’s shared enterprise services, such as identity and access, payments, notifications, reporting and search, instead of rebuilding them within Records. Partner with Platform Engineering where Records needs something new. * Embed secure development practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management and access control, in line with the frameworks our government customers require. * Stay current with emerging technologies in search, cloud and AI\-assisted engineering. Run small, deliberate experiments and br ooks Like** *First 30 days.* You understand the Records monolith: its main domains, where they’re tightly coupled, and which customers and workflows depend on each. You’ve mapped how the platform talks to printers, scanners and other peripherals today, and where those dependencies are hard\-coded. You’ve walked through the current UI with staff and public users to see where the experience breaks down. You know where manual configuration slows down onboarding and support. You’ve built working relationships with your manager, product, architects and the engineers on the team, and you’ve seen the agentic delivery flow end to end. *By 60 days.* You’ve proposed a domain\-by\-domain modernization plan that ranks domains by customer value, risk and coupling, and names the first domain to pull out of the monolith. You’ve written architecture decision records for the key patterns: * **Service boundaries and APIs.** * **Data ownership.** When to use specific databases. * **A peripheral abstraction layer.** This lets the platform work with any standard printer or scanner rather than specific models. * **The modern React UI approach.** Including a shared component library and accessibility standards. You’ve also outlined the design for self\-service configuration, so customers and implementation teams can set up workflows, fees and document types without engineering help. Code review and testing standards, including for AI\-generated code, are documented and in use. *By 90 days.* The first domain is being extracted from the monolith and is close to production, with data migration and rollback plans in place. A working proof of concept shows the platform using standard printer and scanner protocols on at least two device types it couldn’t use before. The first modern UI screens are built on the shared component library and validated with real users. Senior Engineers are leading parts of this work with your guidance, and the full modernization has a clear technical path. *By the end of year one.* * **Domains.** Several domains run as independent services, with a published roadmap for the rest of the monolith. * **Peripherals.** The platform is peripheral\-agnostic in production. New customers can use their existing printers and scanners without custom work, and hardware\-related support tickets are going down. * **UI.** Key staff and public workflows run on the modern UI, with measurably better usability, accessibility and task completion times. * **Self\-service.** Customers can configure common settings themselves, which shortens onboarding and reduces requests to engineering. * **Upgrade and search.** The .NET upgrade is complete, and search performance and data migration quality have measurably improved. * **Team.** Senior Engineers are visibly stronger technical leaders, and modernization standards are being used as the model across Records. **Neumo Summary** With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security
jobs.description: Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3427 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. About the Role: Our apps and websites run on APIs. A public API gateway and a federated GraphQL platform carry billions of requests a month, covering listings, search, sign\-in, saved homes, and the leads we send to agents. As the founding Staff engineer for API security on our new Edge and API Security team, you'll set the technical direction for how we protect them. You'll decide how every API is authenticated, which operations are allowed, how abuse is detected and stopped, and how new APIs ship secure by default. You'll work hands\-on and lead through influence across platform, product, identity and security teams, with leadership backing and a clear mandate. Top Reasons to Apply: * A Key technical role on a high impact team. You'll shape its architecture, standards and hiring from day one. * Real scale: billions of API and GraphQL requests a month, and abuse that ranges from scraping to account takeover. * Direct business impact: your work protects consumer accounts, the quality of leads sent to agents, and the data that powers our business. * A modern stack, all managed as code: an API gateway, Apollo GraphQL Federation, Kubernetes and policy\-as\-code. * Room to apply automation and AI to detection and response. * Leadership that wants guardrails built into the platform, not more tickets. What You'll Do: * Own the API security architecture across the API gateway and the GraphQL platform, and set the multi\-quarter roadmap. * Define and enforce an authentication standard for every public API, and lead the migration of existing unauthenticated APIs to it, working with the owning teams. * Secure GraphQL end to end: approved\-operation lists and persisted queries, depth and cost limits, field\-level authorization, and safe schema change. * Protect high\-value flows such as sign\-in, registration, account and lead submission against credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and fake submissions. * Make "secure by default" real, using admission policies, CI checks and gateway policies that stop an unprotected API from reaching production. * Build detection and alerting on API abuse, so attacks surface in minutes, not in downstream business reports. * Lead response to API attacks and abuse, and turn every incident into a lasting fix. * Mentor engineers, set API security review standards, and help hire the rest of the team. What You'll Bring: * 8\+ years in security, platform or backend engineering, with 5\+ years focused on API or application security at large scale. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * Deep knowledge of API security: OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, JWT, API keys and client identity, mTLS, and the OWASP API Security Top 10\. * Hands\-on GraphQL security experience: federation, persisted queries and safelists, query cost analysis, introspection controls, and authorization patterns. * Experience operating an API gateway (such as Tyk, Kong or AWS API Gateway), including policy design, rate limiting and key management. * Kubernetes and policy\-as\-code experience (ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, OPA or Kyverno), plus infrastructure as code and CI/CD. * Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Go, TypeScript or Python, and comfort reading and changing service code. * Experience with abuse and fraud patterns: credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and bot\-driven form abuse, and how to detect them with logs and SQL. * A record of leading multi\-team technical initiatives, and of explaining risk to executives in business terms. Nice to Have: * Experience with Apollo GraphQL Federation and its router, or with Auth0 or similar identity platforms. * Experience with mobile app attestation (App Attest, Play Integrity) or API bot protection. * Experience building a security function or team from scratch. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location * Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Apply Now

jobs.title: SCADA Engineer
jobs.description: Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future\-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast\-paced, mission\-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. **What** **we're** **looking for:** Nexamp is looking to hire a SCADA Engineer. You will be responsible for supporting the reliable monitoring and control of Nexamp's solar photovoltaic and battery energy storage assets by engineering, integrating, and maintaining SCADA systems and field communications. This role ensures accurate telemetry, dependable remote control and alarming, and timely resolution of operational issues that support Nexamp's 24/7 Operations Center. By maintaining reliable and secure SCADA functionality across the asset portfolio, in this role you'll contribute directly to asset availability, operational performance, and the continued growth of Nexamp's renewable energy fleet. You will be hybrid out of the Lawrence or Boston office. You will report to the Director, Operational Technologies. **What you'll do:** * Support and troubleshoot SCADA, telemetry, communications, alarming, and control issues for Nexamp's 24/7 Operations Center, restoring reliable monitoring and control of field assets and participating in the after\-hours on\-call rotation as required. * Maintain and optimize SCADA databases, point configurations, alarm logic, HMI graphical displays, and control mappings to ensure accurate, usable, and reliable real\-time operational information. * Commission and integrate new solar PV and battery energy storage assets into Nexamp's SCADA environment, including field\-device configuration, communications setup, protocol configuration, I/O mapping, and end\-to\-end functional testing. * Troubleshoot and resolve SCADA communications, telemetry, networking, and field\-device issues across centralized and site\-level OT infrastructure to minimize downtime and maintain reliable remote operations. * Configure and support SCADA\-connected field equipment and supporting OT infrastructure, including RTACs, meters, reclosers, routers, switches, and related control and communications devices. * Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Cybersecurity, vendors, and other stakeholders to maintain data integrity, reliable telemetry, secure remote control, and continuous improvement of SCADA performance. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, including SCADA point lists, system configurations, network diagrams, technical specifications, commissioning records, and operating procedures. **What you'll bring: (adding in required skills AND Nexamp competencies)** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with SCADA systems in energy, utilities, or industrial automation sectors. * Experience with HMI/SCADA platforms such as Ignition and AVEVA System Platforms. * Experience in managing SCADA databases containing electrical components, such as maintaining SCADA point lists and parameters, control mappings, etc. * Skilled in configuring and troubleshooting SEL RTACs, reclosers, meters, and industrial control devices. * Good understanding of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC/UA, and IEC 61850\. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, including troubleshooting within OT/ICS environments. * Experience in commissioning and resolving site technical issues, independently troubleshooting challenging SCADA related technical issues * Proficient with operational and analytical software tools, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and database platforms such as Microsoft Access or similar. * Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today. * Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization. * Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. * Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. * Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. * Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions. ***If you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.*** ***At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.*** **You'll** **love working here because:** Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer\-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more! **Compensation** (only for required states) *The reasonably estimated hourly rate for this role at Nexamp ranges from $45 \- $50 per hour. In addition to base pay, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non\-annual sales incentive plans, or other non\-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company's stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location.* *Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third\-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate. Our innovative, all\-in\-one platform streamlines business operations, empowering providers to work smarter and more efficiently.### **About The Rol****e** This is a newly created role, and one of the first two engineering hires NikoHealth has made in the United States. You'll report directly to the CTO and own how data gets into our platform, out of it, and between the databases underneath it. Almost everything hard about bringing on a new customer is a data problem. Getting years of patient, order, and billing history out of a competitor's system and into ours currently runs on hand\-run scripts, CSVs on a shared drive, and transform logic that lives outside version control. There's no CI on it, no dry run, and no safe way to re\-run a failed load. Every migration adds weeks to an onboarding. Your first job is to turn that into a tested, repeatable pipeline, and then make how long onboarding takes a number we can actually report. It's the single clearest path we have to landing revenue we've already signed. The scope is the databases themselves and everything that moves data in and out of them. It's deliberately focused: this is the constraint on how fast we can bring customers live, and we'd rather you fix it properly than spread across everything. **What you'll do in the first 6 months*** Get the migration pipeline into version control and under CI, with a dry\-run mode and re\-runs that don't corrupt anything. * Publish our import contract, so onboarding teams and customers both know what good input looks like before anyone starts. * Put a real measurement on onboarding time\-to\-live, reported separately for enterprise and small business. We can't currently tell a prospect how long it takes. * Own database configuration, backup, and restore across the fleet, and prove a restore actually works. * Plan the consolidation of our two database engines. Every customer runs both MySQL and PostgreSQL side by side with a live bridge between them, and untangling that is yours to scope, sequence, and execute. **What we're looking for*** 5\+ years in data engineering, data platform, or a closely related role. * Strong SQL, including performance work on large tables, against PostgreSQL or MySQL. You'd work in both. * Production ingestion pipelines you built and operated, where idempotency and safe re\-runs were a design concern rather than an afterthought. * Experience migrating customer data between systems where the source was messy and the customer was watching. * Python, C\# to the level where you own the transform layer outright. * Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, including the harness around them: tests, project instructions, and a loop you can run again. ### **Nice to have** * dbt, or a strong opinion about what the ETL layer should look like. * Healthcare claims formats, particularly X12 837 and 835\. * A MySQL to PostgreSQL consolidation you've actually done. We're not asking for HL7 or FHIR. If you have it, great, but it isn't what this job needs. ### **How we work** **We're honest about what this is.** The current state is rough and needs dedicated investment. Some of the tooling was built as a workaround years ago and quietly became permanent. We're also genuinely mid\-decision on real things and we'd rather hire someone who helps make those calls than pretend they're already made. **We work with AI agents, seriously.** The team works agentically and so will you. What matters is what you do after the agent produces something: tests, linters, project instructions, a loop you can run again. If your answer to a bad result is a longer prompt, we're probably not a fit. **Most application development is done by a long\-standing engineering partner.** Some data work runs through them today as ticketed requests, and part of the point of this role is that it stops having to. **No layers, and no new bottlenecks.** You'd be one of the first two engineering employees here, reporting to the CTO. Nobody sits between you and the person who decides. In return, we'd ask that what you build outlives you being on call for it: automation only its author understands is a different dependency, not a fix for the first one. jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate. Our innovative, all\-in\-one platform streamlines business operations, empowering providers to work smarter and more efficiently.### **About The Rol****e** This is a newly created role, and one of the first two engineering hires NikoHealth will made in the United States. You'll report directly to the CTO and own how our software gets released and run while working closely with other senior engineers. We operate dozens of .NET services deployed per\-customer on Windows Server and IIS in AWS, managed with Terraform and Octopus Deploy. Across hundreds of provider tenants that's thousands of running application instances. Today a change waits for the next release train, and the train then takes weeks to reach the whole fleet, so end\-to\-end a given feature takes months. Improving our deployment and development experience is the first job. After that there are dozens of areas of platform investment needed to support how fast we're scaling. **What You'll Do*** **Own our CI/CD pipeline end to end**, with the authority to change what it deploys and how. * **Own developer experience**. Reproducible builds, a local environment someone can actually stand up, and fast honest feedback on every change. This is half the job, not a side effect of the other half. * **Get our automated regression suite running in CI**. It exists, it's substantial, and it isn't currently executed. * **Cut release lead time** and get the fleet inside a published, committed release window. * **Make fleet version state answerable by a query** instead of by a person, so anyone can see what a customer is running. * **Design and publish an access model**, so provisioning stops routing through one inbox. * **Start bringing runtimes and dependencies current**, beginning with the shared libraries everything else depends on. * **Document and share what you learn**, so infrastructure knowledge stops being concentrated in one place. **What You'll Bring*** 5\+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering. * Production Terraform, including state you owned and drift you had to reconcile. * Production Windows Server and IIS, application pools included. * End\-to\-end ownership of a CI/CD pipeline in a previous role. * AWS at the level this estate uses it: EC2, ALB, VPC, IAM. * A track record of replacing a manual process with a measured and automated one, where you can tell us the before and after. * Evidence you've made other engineers faster, not just the systems. Build times, local setup, test feedback, whatever it was. * Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, including the harness around them: tests, project instructions, and a loop you can run again. ### **Nice to have** * Octopus Deploy, or another deployment orchestrator you owned. * Single\-tenant or multi\-tenant SaaS at meaningful scale. * Healthcare, HIPAA, or another regulated environment. ### **How we work** **This is brownfield and we're honest about it.** Some of this estate is well\-built and some of it grew. We're not asking you to rewrite it, because hundreds of providers bill claims through it every day. We're asking you to make it measurable, make it safe to change, then change it. If you've built a career inheriting other people's systems and making them boring, you'll like it here. **We work with AI agents, seriously.** The team works agentically and so will you. What matters is what you do after the agent produces something: tests, linters, project instructions, a loop you can run again. If your answer to a bad result is a longer prompt, we're probably not a fit. This is also why developer experience sits in this role rather than somewhere else: an agent is only as good as the feedback loop it runs in, and ours needs work. **Most application development is done by a long\-standing engineering partner.** You'd own the pipeline, the infrastructure, and the environments, and over time the standards their code meets before it ships while working closely with our off\-shore development team. **Two people isn't a platform team, it's the start of one.** Until it's three, coverage is shared between you, the CTO, and our head of engineering. Everyone here is remote, and we'd like your hours to overlap the US East Coast. **This is the start of the engineering team, not the end of it.** We're hiring more engineers through 2027\. The people who join first get the widest scope, the most say in how the team gets built, and first choice about what they own as it grows. ### **How to apply** Apply through the link on this page. Use AI to help write your application if you want to, we do too. We read every one ourselves, and we can tell when nobody read the posting. jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the role** ------------------ As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer working at Northbeam, you will work with a small engineering team to create a scaleable, observable, reliable platform for data ingestion, processing, and serving. Responsibilities will range widely and evolve, as they tend to at startups. The following all fall within the Infrastructure team's remit: * CI/CD and dev infrastructure * Security * DR policies * SSL cert management and DNS * Infrastructure as Code * Kubernetes Care and Maintenance * Capacity planning and budgeting * Observability * Scaling plans and automation * Guidance for best use of cloud infrastructure * … and more Success in this role will require significant existing experience, interest in continuously learning and iterating on existing solutions, a penchant for automation over "clickops" and one\-offs, and ability to effectively collaborate with engineers, auditors, product managers, and more. **Your Impact** --------------- You'll wear many hats, juggle diverse tasks, and probably find yourself learning new skills on the fly – while also teaching a few. If you thrive on variety and love diving in, you'll fit right in. Here's a taste of what might come up: * **Capacity management:** tune the footprint you have, project what you'll need. Cloud provider out of hardware in Iowa? No problem, you and the team can ship multi\-region support in under 3 weeks. * **Migrations:** move a high\-volume pipeline off a managed service onto Kubernetes with zero data loss, cut its cost by a meaningful amount, and find a bug the old system had been hiding for years. * **Incident response:** handle the traffic spike nobody saw coming, then build the thing that takes care of it automatically next time. * **Reliability and DR:** run failover drills at peak traffic, restore production in another region, handle providers taking a 4 hour downtime "maintenance window" without anyone noticing. * **Security:** automate workflows to route automated security discoveries to the right people, fix critical CVEs, create structures and automations that help the rest of the eng team stay on top of the recent flood of vulnerabilities. * **AI infrastructure:** run the LLM gateway the company builds on, and work alongside AI agents that triage incidents and draft PRs with you. * **Developer platform:** introduce on\-demand preview environments, manage CI runners, and make it easy for app teams to do the right thing without filing a ticket. * **Communication:** Create technical documentation that's useful for engineers, understandable for stakeholders, and not soul\-crushing to read. You will work with great people who have done this many times before. You will teach them some new tricks, and maybe learn some old ones. You'll be a key player in keeping our platform reliable, efficient, and scalable. We'll laugh, we'll cry, we'll tell stories of yore. If this sounds like your kind of chaos, we'd love to hear from you. **What You Bring** ------------------ * **Experience and judgement:** When it comes to **cloud infrastructure**, you are the person people go to with their thorniest questions. Everyone has Claude; you have Claude, lived experience, and taste. * **Bias for Automation:** **You automate things**. You create bots. You might have a home lab. You are allergic to clickops. * **Technical direction**: You've **set the infrastructure roadmap for a team or company**, not just executed one. You can take something vague like "we should be multi\-region," turn it into a phased plan with real tradeoffs, get buy\-in, and see it through. * **Security as a practice**: You've led a company through **security certifications** and kept it there. You decide where to invest and where to accept risk, explain those calls to leadership in plain terms, and build processes that make the secure path the easy one without slowing everything to a crawl. * **Reliability ownership:** You've designed for failure before it happened: DR, failover, capacity planning, cost. When incidents happen you lead the response, and afterward you work with the team to fix the root causes. * **Observability strategy**: You make it, you tweak it, you don't tolerate neither alert noise nor silent failure. Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, whatever; you've used enough of them to have opinions, and you can use any of them to get the job done. * **Effective collaboration**: You work across engineering, data, product, and leadership. People follow your standards because they make their lives easier, not because they were told to. **Bonus Skills and Experience:** -------------------------------- * Experience in marketing, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech, where traffic spikes on someone else's schedule. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Boston, MA 02110
