jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: OneOncology is positioning community oncologists to drive the future of medical care through a patient\-centric, physician\-driven, and technology\-powered model to help improve the lives of everyone living with cancer and other diseases. Our team is bringing together leaders to the market place to help drive OneOncology’s mission and vision. Why join us? This is an exciting time to join OneOncology. Our values\-driven culture reflects our startup enthusiasm supported by industry leaders in oncology, urology, technology, and finance. We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to improve and build new processes that support the meaningful work of independent physicians and the patients they serve. **Job Description:** This Full Stack Engineer is dedicated to OneCenter and OneAnalytics—the platform our partner practices use to measure clinical quality, operational performance, and financial results. OneCenter is a React web application backed by Python and FastAPI services on Azure, while OneAnalytics is the analytics layer within the platform, built on Databricks and Azure SQL and surfaced largely through embedded Power BI. In this role, you will own the application layer surrounding the analytics stack, including the embedded Power BI experience and its supporting wrapper, the APIs that deliver Databricks and Azure SQL data to the front end, and the integration of Databricks Genie conversational analytics into OneCenter. You will partner closely with the Analytics team, which builds the semantic models, dashboards, and Genie spaces, while you build and enhance the product experience our partner practices use every day. Our engineering team is small and growing, so breadth matters more than specialization. We are looking for an engineer who is strong across the full stack, comfortable working close to data, and ready to grow into deeper architectural responsibilities with support from senior engineers. This is a full\-time remote position within the United States. Employees located in the Nashville, TN area have the option to work from the Nashville office. **Responsibilities****:** * Build and ship features in the OneCenter web application using React, backed by Python and FastAPI services running on Azure. * Design and maintain FastAPI services that deliver analytics data, user context, and practice configuration to the front end, using Pydantic models and generated OpenAPI schemas as the contract between services and the front end. * Own the OneAnalytics user experience within OneCenter, including navigation, filtering, load performance, and functionality that makes analytics accessible and useful for practice leaders and physicians. * Build and maintain the embedded Power BI experience, including embed token generation, report and workspace management, filters, bookmarks, and the supporting wrapper application. * Implement and verify row\-level security to ensure each practice can access only its own data, and monitor and tune embedded report performance and capacity utilization. * Query and integrate data from Databricks, including SQL warehouses, Unity Catalog, and Delta tables, and Azure SQL into application features. Write and tune SQL and partner with Analytics and Data Engineering on the models and views supporting the application. * Use async endpoints, background tasks, caching, and pagination to keep large analytic result sets responsive in the browser. * Integrate Databricks Genie into OneCenter using Genie Conversation APIs, enabling practice users to ask questions of their data in natural language. Build supporting guardrails, including authentication, governed access through Unity Catalog, result rendering, and feedback capture. * Use AI\-assisted development tooling to improve development efficiency and code quality. * Write unit and integration tests, participate actively in code reviews, and document solutions so they can be effectively maintained by the broader team. * Build to HIPAA and HITRUST expectations, including least privilege, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging, tenant isolation, and appropriate handling of protected health information. * Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering, Product, and practice\-facing teams to understand how physicians and practice administrators use data and translate reporting and analytics needs into scalable product features rather than one\-off solutions. * Additional responsibilities as assigned to help drive our mission of improving the lives of everyone living with cancer. **Qualifications:** **Required****:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * High school diploma or GED. * 3\+ years of professional full\-stack software development experience. * Working proficiency in React and modern JavaScript; TypeScript preferred. * Strong Python skills, including building REST APIs with FastAPI — or with Flask or Django and a clear willingness to work in FastAPI. * Comfort with async/await in Python and with typed request and response models (Pydantic). * Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with analytical data models. * Experience deploying applications to a major cloud platform, Azure preferred. * Experience with REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD. * Ability to own a feature end to end with reasonable guidance, and comfort on a small team. **Preferred:** * Hands\-on experience embedding Power BI in a web application — embed tokens, the Power BI REST API, the JavaScript client library, and row\-level security. * Experience working against Databricks (SQL warehouses, Unity Catalog, Delta) or a comparable lakehouse platform. * Familiarity with Databricks Genie or other conversational or LLM\-backed analytics interfaces. * Healthcare exposure, particularly clinical, operational, or financial reporting. * Multi\-tenant application experience where data isolation between customers matters. * Experience with SQLAlchemy, Alembic, or comparable Python data access and migration tooling. * Azure DevOps, Docker, or containerized deployment experience. * Experience working in a HIPAA\-regulated or HITRUST\-certified environment. **Essential****Competencies:** * Ownership — takes a feature from ticket to production and follows through on what breaks. * Curiosity and growth — asks good questions, learns the domain, and levels up quickly. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical partners. * Generalist range and comfort operating on a small, fast\-moving engineering team. * Sound handling of protected health information and a security\-first mindset. * Attendance is an essential job function.

jobs.title: Robotics Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Pantograph** is building general purpose intelligent robots that can safely and autonomously accomplish useful work in the real world. We believe the path to capable robots runs through general intelligence rather than narrow, robot\-specific skills, and that there is an enormous amount of work worth doing in the physical world that would improve quality of life for people. As AI models make it easier to build software around our needs, we hope robots can empower people to shape the physical world. Across research, hardware, and software, we focus on finding simple ideas that work, executing them extremely well, and scaling them up. We value clear thinking, careful execution, and systems we can understand, trust, and improve. We're looking for a robotics ML engineer to design and build the systems that turn capable AI models into robots doing useful work. You'll bring a deep background in robotics and use it to decide how frontier models, learned policies, and classical controllers fit together. We see frontier models as an increasingly powerful foundation for general robot behavior, and want someone who can combine their capabilities with the methods robotics already does well. The work includes connecting models to robot observations and actions, building the tools, skills, and controllers they rely on, and developing evaluations in simulation and on our fleet. You'll investigate when a frontier model should act directly, when it should coordinate faster learned policies or classical controllers, and when it should write its own tools or control code. You'll weigh the tradeoffs in capability, reliability, latency, safety, and how easily we can understand and supervise the system, with real deployments guiding your decisions. You'll work closely with our research, robot software, and product teams, building a tight loop between experiments and experience on real hardware. We're looking for someone who combines excellent experimental judgment with a strong intuition for both robots and models, and enjoys building things to test their ideas. When something fails, you'll work out whether it calls for a better observation, a different tool, a change in orchestration, a better policy or controller, or a fix elsewhere in the system. You might be a good fit if you: * Have deep experience in robotics across areas such as control, perception, planning, and learned policies, and have made robots do useful work on real hardware * Use simulation to develop and test systems, and understand where it diverges from reality * Have designed and shipped robotic or AI systems that people use, with clear evidence of what made them better * Are excellent at designing experiments and interpreting results: separating competing explanations, identifying confounders, and knowing what the evidence does and doesn't establish * Have a strong intuition for how models behave: what they understand, what confuses them, and how their behavior changes with the tools, context, and feedback they receive * Enjoy digging into failures and understanding how systems behave beyond aggregate metrics * Are pragmatic about methods and care more about what works on real tasks than what's newest or most complex * Can build reliable software across the stack, from model APIs and inference to robot software and testing infrastructure * Communicate clearly and enjoy working across research and engineering * Use AI tools extremely effectively Bonus if you've worked with: * Agent harnesses, tool use, memory, or long\-horizon tasks * Systems where models write and execute code or develop their own tools * Fine\-tuning vision\-language\-action models or other large robot policies * Teleoperation, robot data collection, or learning from fleet data * Evaluation design, failure analysis, or safety testing * Inference optimization, including latency, throughput, and cost We care much more about what you've built and learned than credentials. We're a small, fast\-moving team working together in person in San Francisco. If this sounds exciting to you, we want to hear from you. Compensation Range: $150K \- $260K

jobs.description: ### **About Point** **✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals. **✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage. **✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers. **✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area. **✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week. **Local or 100% Remote** **About the role** Point helps homeowners unlock the equity in their homes without taking on a monthly payment. Our customer acquisition strategy leverages multiple touchpoints across direct mail, paid search and social, affiliates, CTV and a fast\-growing broker channel. We can say what each channel spent and what it reported. We cannot yet say, channel by channel, how much of the resulting funding would have happened anyway, and that is the job. You will be the first scientist dedicated to marketing measurement: incrementality and attribution across every channel, a universal holdout that no campaign touches, the controlled tests that check what our media mix model claims, and the power calculations that decide whether a test is worth running. You sit on the data science team next to the people who build our targeting models, and you work every week with the marketing analysts and channel owners who act on what you find. You will have real spend to test against, data already modeled in Snowflake and dbt, and a growth leadership team that you will closely partner with. **Your responsibilities** * Measure incrementality channel by channel: design and run holdout and controlled tests, keep a running read of incremental funding per channel, and reconcile it against the dollar attribution we report each month. * Own the universal control: define and operate a 5 to 10% holdout at the qualified stage that no campaign or channel touches, so tests stop contaminating each other, and make sure web and non\-web experiments both respect it. * Size every experiment before it runs: power calculations, minimum detectable effects and pre\-declared readouts for every test in the registry, web or sales\-side, so no test ends in a confidence interval too wide to act on. * Lead the media mix modeling work from our side: evaluate vendors with the marketing team, specify the feeds with the marketing analytics engineer, and own interpretation once the model is live, including the tests that check its claims. * Extend model\-based targeting beyond direct mail: with the data science team, build and refresh propensity and expected\-value models for paid search and other channels as volume allows, scored onto the audience table with suppressions applied. * Publish the measurement layer the company reads: incremental funding by channel with a confidence range, refreshed monthly and reviewed with channel owners. * Partner with marketing analysts and channel owners on test design week to week, and teach the methods so the team's own experiments get stronger. * Write up findings for leadership in plain language with the uncertainty attached, and recommend the next test. * Run retros on tests that did not answer their question, and turn what you learn into the standards in the experiment registry. **About you** * 5\+ years in a data science, marketing science or experimentation role, including measurement of real marketing spend. * Hands\-on experience designing and reading controlled experiments: randomization, holdouts, power analysis, and the judgment to know when a test cannot answer its question. * Incrementality and attribution methods (geo tests, holdout designs, synthetic controls or similar) and a clear view of what each can and cannot tell you. * Familiarity with media mix modeling: you have built, run or critically evaluated one and can explain where it over\- or under\-credits a channel. * Strong SQL and Python (or R) for analysis and modeling, and comfort working in a modern warehouse with dbt\-managed tables. * Statistical modeling and machine learning for targeting: propensity and expected\-value models, with experience refreshing and monitoring them in production. * Clear communicator who can explain a confidence interval to a channel owner and write a one\-page readout an executive will act on. * Comfortable embedded with a business team, setting the standard for how tests are run without owning the budget or the execution. **Nice to have** * Direct mail, affiliate or broker channel measurement, where attribution is messy, and response windows are long. * Consumer fintech or lending. * Causal inference and MMM tooling (CausalImpact, GeoLift, Robyn or similar) and Bayesian methods. * Experience standing up an experimentation program or registry from scratch. * AI\-assisted analysis workflows (Claude, Cursor or similar) in daily use. Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region \| Location \| Market Salary): * Tier 1 \| San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle \| $164,900 \- $203,700 * Tier 2 \| Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara \& Washington DC \| $149,600 \- $184,800 * Tier 3 \| All other US metro areas \| $140,300 \- $173,250 This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job\-related factors, to determine final compensation. Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point's states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI. ### **Our benefits** * **Generous health benefits:** We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (Health Care FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA). * **Unlimited paid time off:** Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays. * **Flexible remote and onsite work:** Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in\-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ. * **Fully paid parental leave:** Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay. * **Equity:** We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success. * **Financial wellness:** We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Extra work/life benefits:** We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one\-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor. Point is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. Each individual at Point brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them, and we believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides better services to customers, and helps us all grow and learn. jobs.title: AI Enablement & Infrastructure Engineer (Contract)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Help shape how AI works at sea, at one of the most unique communities on the planet.** We are a private residential community on a ship that never stops travelling. We're growing with AI, and what feels advanced today will look simple in a few years. We'd like you to be part of that journey: supporting our teams as they learn and build, and helping IT keep it all secure. Our teams already use AI every day, and we have a clear AI policy in place. Your job is to help them go further, faster and safely. * **Educate.** Run practical sessions for office and shipboard teams, share prompting best practices, and turn our AI Usage Policy into quick guides people actually use. * **Mature our AI products and services.** Help improve the AI tools, agents and automations we already have, so they become more reliable, useful and well supported over time. * **Support the business.** Work side by side with teams and department champions to turn good ideas into agents and apps on our approved platforms, and share the wins. * **Evaluate and manage risk.** Help teams register new agents and apps, assess their data, access and security risks, and keep safeguards in place as they grow. You'll support our Infrastructure \& Cybersecurity Manager across day\-to\-day operations and security, ashore and on board. * **Keep people productive.** Install and troubleshoot desktop apps (Microsoft 365, Teams, Adobe, browsers, AI tools) and hardware, from laptops and docks to printers, phones and meeting\-room AV. * **Run the Microsoft backbone.** Manage accounts, groups and device policies in Active Directory, Entra ID and Intune. Support SharePoint sites, permissions and sync, and Exchange Online mail flow, lists and filtering. * **Keep everyone connected.** Support wired and wireless networks, VPN, zero trust access, web security, remote desktop, and our Teams phone system and call queues. * **Onboard and offboard.** Set up laptops, accounts and apps for new joiners, and close access cleanly for leavers. * **Stay patched.** Track exploitable vulnerabilities and drive operating system and application updates and hardening, automating where possible. * **Protect and recover.** Monitor backups across cloud and on\-premises, run test restores, and help with recovery. * **Respond to threats.** Help contain and investigate incidents with our endpoint, SIEM and SOC tools, and handle phishing alerts. * **Support our cloud.** Provision, size and maintain virtual servers in Azure and AWS. * **Secure our AI.** Help assess agents and apps before go\-live, set up agent identities and approved connectors, and spot shadow AI. Who we think is the right candidate * **AI application development** — Has built and deployed an internal AI application, such as a knowledge assistant or workflow tool, using model APIs and approved company data. Can explain how the application enforces user permissions and how its outputs were tested. * **Autonomous agent development** — Has built and deployed an agent that can carry out a multi\-step business workflow and take authorized actions in connected systems. Can explain what triggers the agent, which actions it can take independently, and when it asks for human approval. * **Technical skills** — Proficient in Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, authentication, and Git. Has hands\-on experience integrating AI applications and agents with business systems such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or internal APIs. * **Security and governance** — Knows how to apply least\-privilege access, manage service identities and secrets, log agent actions, prevent duplicate actions during retries, and pause or disable an agent when needed. * **Evidence of experience** — Can walk through one AI application and one autonomous workflow they personally built, including how they tested failures, monitored quality and cost, and handed over ongoing operations to a named owner. **Bonus points:** Azure or AWS, Teams Phone, SIEM or EDR tools, vulnerability management, GitHub Enterprise, hospitality or maritime experience, a security certification. Pay: $76,800\.00 \- $92,600\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Have you worked in a corporate environment with formal AI governance policies or guidelines? If so, what was your role? * Have you helped establish procedures for monitoring AI performance, accuracy, or regulatory compliance? You'll decide how every API is authenticated, which operations are allowed, how abuse is detected and stopped, and how new APIs ship secure by default. You'll work hands\-on and lead through influence across platform, product, identity and security teams, with leadership backing and a clear mandate. **Top Reasons to Apply:** * A Key technical role on a high impact team. You'll shape its architecture, standards and hiring from day one. * Real scale: billions of API and GraphQL requests a month, and abuse that ranges from scraping to account takeover. * Direct business impact: your work protects consumer accounts, the quality of leads sent to agents, and the data that powers our business. * A modern stack, all managed as code: an API gateway, Apollo GraphQL Federation, Kubernetes and policy\-as\-code. * Room to apply automation and AI to detection and response. * Leadership that wants guardrails built into the platform, not more tickets. #### **What You'll Do:** * Own the API security architecture across the API gateway and the GraphQL platform, and set the multi\-quarter roadmap. * Define and enforce an authentication standard for every public API, and lead the migration of existing unauthenticated APIs to it, working with the owning teams. * Secure GraphQL end to end: approved\-operation lists and persisted queries, depth and cost limits, field\-level authorization, and safe schema change. * Protect high\-value flows such as sign\-in, registration, account and lead submission against credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and fake submissions. * Make "secure by default" real, using admission policies, CI checks and gateway policies that stop an unprotected API from reaching production. * Build detection and alerting on API abuse, so attacks surface in minutes, not in downstream business reports. * Lead response to API attacks and abuse, and turn every incident into a lasting fix. * Mentor engineers, set API security review standards, and help hire the rest of the team. #### **What You'll Bring:** * 8\+ years in security, platform or backend engineering, with 5\+ years focused on API or application security at large scale. You will be making it fast and intuitive for admins to govern and curate, for teachers to find and instruct, and for students to explore and grow their respective libraries. In addition, you will be the first team to adopt Renaissance's S3 model of software development. You will be expected to build **multi\-agent orchestration**, where specialized agents coordinate on complete features and engineers shift from managing individual tasks to designing the systems that produce the work. **In this role as a Software Engineer III, you will:** * Build features across the discovery layer and the products it connects — search and browse for teachers, curation and governance for admins, exploration for students. * Develop backend services that leverage relational databases, non\-relational datastores, message queuing, and cloud infrastructure, against typed contracts. * Build and test frontend experiences in TypeScript and React, contract\-tested against the backend, with accessibility treated as a requirement rather than a follow\-up. * Write the tests and the instrumentation with the feature — unit, component, and contract tests, plus the traces, metrics, and logs that make the system debuggable. **Qualifications** **For this role, you must have:** * Professional experience building and shipping production web applications or services. * Experience developing backend services against relational databases, and comfort with non\-relational datastores, message queuing, and/or cloud infrastructure. * Excitement to help craft a new, AI\-first software development lifecycle. The successful candidate will have strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent communication and time management skills, and the ability to build applications that meet business requirements and user needs. This individual will contribute to technical design decisions, troubleshoot issues across front\-end and backend components, and mentor junior developers. **Essential Functions:** ***Developing New Functionality, Maintaining and Enhancing Existing Systems*** – We develop and maintain multiple systems for internal use and for our customers and partners. Primary front\-end technologies include Angular, NgRx, RxJS, Server\-Side Events (SSE), Module Federation, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, and HTML. UI frameworks include Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS. jobs.title: Test Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Test Systems Software Engineer supports the development and validation of advanced power electronic systems by designing, automating, and maintaining test solutions used across engineering programs. This role blends software engineering, test automation, embedded development, and networked test infrastructure to ensure robust, repeatable, and high fidelity testing of power electronics hardware and control algorithms. The engineer will develop automated test applications, integrate instrumentation, manage data systems, and contribute embedded software used to validate system performance. This is a senior level individual contributor position requiring strong technical judgment, autonomy, and cross discipline collaboration. **Essential Functions** * Design, develop, and maintain automated test software used to control test instrumentation for power electronics development and qualification. * Create intuitive and reliable graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to support test operations, operator workflows, and automated execution. * Architect and integrate database systems for storage and retrieval of test results, test configurations, calibration data, and system metadata. * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN networks that support test stands, instrumentation, data servers, and test automation environments. * Develop and maintain CI/CD workflows to ensure consistent deployment, validation, and version control of test software and related toolchains. * Design and implement embedded software modules that support control algorithm development, hardware‑in‑the‑loop operation, and power electronics controller validation. * Collaborate with power electronics engineers, systems engineers, and test personnel to translate test requirements into robust automated solutions. * Provide technical leadership in defining software architecture, instrumentation strategies, and long\-term test infrastructure improvements. * Ensure test systems comply with internal standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering best practices. * Document designs, test procedures, and software release notes to support traceability, audits, and knowledge transfer. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related technical field. * 5\+ years of experience or 3\+ years with related Master’s degree * Proficiency in software development for test automation (examples: Python, C\#, LabVIEW, or similar languages/frameworks). * Experience designing GUIs for engineering tools or test platforms. * Working knowledge of database design, schema management, and interfacing with SQL or NoSQL systems. * Ability to work independently on complex engineering challenges and provide mentorship or technical guidance to junior engineers. **Preferred Additional Skills** * Experience developing automated test systems using instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, programmable loads, oscillators, DAQs, or similar equipment. * Experience configuring and maintaining LAN networks, including switches, VLANs, and device connectivity. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and automated deployment workflows. * Experience with embedded software development (C/C\+\+ or equivalent) for control systems or embedded processors. * Experience with power electronics testing, control algorithm development, or real\-time embedded systems. * Familiarity with hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) systems, real\-time simulation platforms, or automated power electronics test benches. * Knowledge of cyber security best practices for engineering networks and test environments. * Experience in aerospace, defense, or other regulated engineering environments.

jobs.title: Senior Telecommunication Engineer

As one of the largest **EMPLOYEE\-OWNED** electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. Travel: * Up to 25% local and regional travel to project sites, client offices, and industry events may be required. Working Conditions: * Work will be performed in a hybrid environment, splitting time between a professional office setting and various construction job sites. * Requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl, with or without accommodation. * May require occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds, such as test equipment or project documents. * Field conditions may include exposure to outdoor weather, varying temperatures, loud noises, and construction hazards; personal protective equipment (PPE) will be required. * Adherence to all company safety policies and procedures is mandatory at all times. * Rosendin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities. **YOU Matter \- Our Benefits*** ESOP \- Employee Stock Ownership * 401 K * Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement * 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays * 3 days of paid sick leave each year * 3 days of paid Bereavement leave each year * 3 days of paid Jury Duty * Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance * Bonding Leave * Term Life, AD\&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance * Disability Income Protection Insurance * Pre\-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care) * Charitable Giving Match with our Rosendin Foundation Our success is rooted in our people. Rosendin is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Reservoir Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Reservoir Engineer is SOGC’s technical authority on the oil and gas assets it owns. The role determines how much oil and gas the SOGC’s assets in North Dakota and the Midland Basin can produce and what they are worth. It owns the reserves reporting relied on by leadership, the Board, auditors, and the SEC, finds ways to increase production from existing wells, and provides the technical analysis behind acquisition and divestiture decisions. The role reports findings to executive leadership and turns reservoir data into decisions that drive the company’s growth and value. **Responsibilities** * Lead midyear and year\-end reserves evaluations in coordination with third\-party auditors. * Maintain and update the corporate reserves database. * Prepare and present reserves reports to executive leadership and the Board of Directors. * Ensure compliance with SEC and SPE\-PRMS standards. * Build and maintain reservoir simulation models (e.g., CMG, Eclipse, or similar). * Conduct decline curve analysis, volumetric assessments, and material balance calculations. * Integrate geological, petrophysical, and production data to characterize reservoir performance. * Forecast production and estimate ultimate recovery for development planning. * Analyze well performance and identify opportunities to enhance production. * Recommend and design workovers, stimulations, artificial lift changes, and other interventions. * Collaborate with operations and completions teams to implement optimization strategies. * Monitor post\-intervention performance and update models accordingly. * Lead technical evaluations of potential acquisition targets and divestiture candidates. * Perform reservoir due diligence, including reserves validation, production forecasting, and economic modeling. * Support data room preparation and review third\-party engineering reports. * Collaborate with land, finance, and executive teams to inform strategic decisions. * Build and maintain dashboards tracking relevant A\&D across the industry. * Serve as the company’s subject matter expert on reservoir engineering. * Develop and maintain internal workflows and best practices for reservoir analysis. * Support cross\-functional teams with technical insights and mentoring as needed. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering or related field. * 7\+ years of reservoir engineering experience, preferably in unconventional plays. * Proficiency in reservoir simulation software and reserves/economics tools (e.g., Aries, PHDWin). * Strong understanding of Bakken/Three Forks and Midland Basin geology and production trends. * Experience supporting A\&D transactions from a technical perspective. * Excellent communication skills and ability to present technical data to non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-starter with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. * Experience with Spotfire, Python, sql, database, machine learning, AI and other data analytics tools. * Familiarity with SEC reserves reporting and third\-party audit processes. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

The right person can preserve evidence, reconstruct attacker activity, establish defensible conclusions, direct containment and eradication recommendations, and communicate clearly under pressure.Key Responsibilities -------------------- **Digital Forensics \& Incident Investigation*** Lead investigations involving ransomware, endpoint compromise, credential abuse, unauthorized access, lateral movement, persistence, and suspected data exfiltration. * Acquire and analyze evidence from Windows and Linux hosts, endpoints, memory and disk images, network traffic, firewall logs, cloud audit sources, and identity telemetry. * Correlate EDR, SIEM, endpoint, network, authentication, and infrastructure data to build host\-centric and cross\-environment incident timelines. * Develop hypotheses, identify indicators and attacker techniques, assess confidence levels, and distinguish confirmed observations from investigative assumptions. **Threat Detection \& Compromise Analysis*** Investigate incidents across hybrid data\-center environments, including Linux and Windows servers, virtualization infrastructure, network controls, and high\-performance compute systems when within engagement scope. * Use Cortex XSIAM/XDR, SentinelOne, firewall and network telemetry, identity logs, and independent forensic tools to test hypotheses and validate the scope of compromise. * Preserve chain of custody, evidence integrity, analysis notes, and repeatable procedures appropriate to the engagement's legal and contractual requirements. **Incident Response \& Stakeholder Communication*** Advise customers and internal stakeholders on containment, credential rotation, recovery sequencing, monitoring, and remediation validation. * Produce technically rigorous reports, incident briefings, executive summaries, and prioritized lessons learned; lead customer\-facing readouts. **Process Improvement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Guide junior responders, improve forensic collection and analysis playbooks, and automate repetitive triage and evidence correlation tasks. * Partner with SOC, engineering, and security leadership on detection improvements, incident readiness assessments, and post\-incident hardening. Experience \& Qualifications ---------------------------- **Required*** 7\+ years in incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, or related security operations, including independent leadership of serious incidents. * Deep Windows and Linux forensic knowledge, endpoint artifact interpretation, and understanding of attacker persistence, privilege escalation, and lateral movement. * Strong analysis across SIEM/EDR telemetry, network logs, identity events, and cloud or virtualized environments; ability to handle large datasets. * Experience with forensic collection and analysis tooling, incident timelines, integrity verification, and structured evidence management. * Strong customer\-facing communication and judgment during evolving incidents, including the ability to document uncertainty clearly. * At least one recognized DFIR certification, such as GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GREM, CFCE, or a comparable current forensic/incident\-response credential. **Preferred*** Experience responding to ransomware or high\-impact Linux and virtualization incidents, including GPU/compute or data\-center infrastructure. * Familiarity with Cortex XDR/XSIAM, SentinelOne, firewall telemetry, and cloud investigation workflows. * Python/PowerShell tooling, forensic automation, memory analysis, and development of customer incident response playbooks. Compensation ------------ * Full\-Time, Exempt * $145,000\-$185,000/year, DOE Benefits -------- * Health Coverage – Medical, Dental \& Vision * FSA Health and Dependent Care available * 401(k) Plan * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Observed Holidays Paid * Cell Phone Allowance * Collaborative, growth\-driven culture Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US. jobs.title: Coastal Water Resources Engineer - Mid-Level
jobs.description: Responsibilities: As a valued member of our dynamic team, you’ll collaborate with project and technical leads to deliver water resources and coastal engineering analyses. You will contribute to hydrologic, hydraulic, and coastal flood\-hazard evaluations, including work that uses the ADCIRC model as a primary analytical tool. Your role will involve participating in multidisciplinary project teams and developing, applying, and interpreting numerical models and engineering analyses for power plant sites and other infrastructure projects. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Sentient** ------------------ Sentient is building the future of open\-source AI. Our mission is to ensure that the most powerful AI systems remain open, accessible, and beneficial to everyone. Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera Capital, Sentient brings together world\-class AI researchers, engineers, and builders to develop cutting\-edge open\-source AI technologies. Our work spans AI agents, model verification, AI benchmarking, and self\-improving AI systems. We're focused on turning frontier research into useful, widely adopted products that push the boundaries of what's possible with open\-source AI. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a highly technical, entrepreneurial Product Manager to help shape and build the next generation of AI products at Sentient. You'll work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI research and product development, identifying promising research breakthroughs and turning them into products that developers and businesses actually want to use. This is a hands\-on role that requires strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to take ideas from early exploration through launch and adoption. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable exploring new technologies, prototyping solutions, engaging with users, and working alongside researchers and engineers. You'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and leadership teams to determine what we should build, why it matters, and how to bring it to market. The role reports to the VP of Product and works alongside the team’s PM Lead, who will set overall product direction. **Location:** Remote. The team is spread across Singapore, Hong Kong, and UAE, so you'll need regular overlap with Asia/Middle East working hours, with flexibility across timezones as we are a global team. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Find product opportunities where our research, emerging technology, and market need meet, then set the vision, priorities, and roadmap. * Lead products from first concept through prototype, launch, and adoption, working with engineering, research, and go\-to\-market teams. * Work with AI researchers to spot promising breakthroughs and turn them into product requirements, user experiences, and technical specifications. * Evaluate technical approaches and make architectural trade\-offs alongside engineering. * Build prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, using code, APIs, and current AI tooling: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, and developer infrastructure. * Design experiments and evaluations to test product hypotheses, and move quickly from idea to working demo to user feedback. * Talk directly with developers, design partners, and customers. Define and track adoption, engagement, performance, and retention, and feed what you learn back into product and research priorities. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * You have taken a technical product from concept to launch, and you can show us the product and its usage numbers. * You have worked as a software or ML engineer, or have equivalent hands\-on technical depth. * You write Python well enough to build a working agent prototype against LLM APIs on your own. * You have designed and run evaluations for an LLM or agent system, and can explain why a given eval does or does not predict real\-world performance. * You can point to a time you killed or reshaped a technically promising idea because users did not need it. * You have driven an initiative from start to finish without a defined brief or someone else setting the scope. * You can explain a research result to a customer and a customer problem to a researcher, clearly and in writing. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience as a founder, founding product manager, early\-stage engineer, or technical product lead. * Experience building AI developer tools, AI agents, ML infrastructure, model evaluation systems, or open\-source products. * Familiarity with agent frameworks and modern AI development workflows. * Experience collaborating with research scientists or bringing emerging AI technologies to market. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or active involvement in developer communities. * Experience working with design partners to validate and refine new products. **Why Join Sentient?** ---------------------- ### **Why open source** At a closed lab, the product is access to a model. Here, the product is something developers can run, inspect, and build on themselves. That changes the job in three ways. * **Your work is public.** Most of what you ship lives in the open, where anyone can read it, fork it, and challenge it. Your track record is visible to the whole field, not locked inside one company. * **Your users are your collaborators.** Developers file issues, send pull requests, and tell you what is broken within days. You learn faster than any private beta allows. * **You build for adoption, not lock\-in.** A product wins here because developers choose it, not because they have no alternative. That is a harder bar and a more honest one. ### **What else you get** * **Work at the frontier of AI:** Collaborate with leading researchers and engineers on technologies shaping the future of artificial intelligence. * **Meaningful ownership:** Have a direct impact on product strategy, technical direction, and execution. * **Research meets real\-world impact:** Translate innovative AI research into practical products used by developers and organizations. * **Builder\-driven culture:** Work with an ambitious team that values experimentation, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results. If you're passionate about AI, enjoy building products from the ground up, and want to shape the future of open\-source AI, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Service Center Metals (SCM) manufactures aluminum extrusions and billet in Prince George, Virginia. Our facilities run 24/7, and our Controls team works directly with Maintenance and Operations to keep production equipment running safely and reliably. We name our equipment after rock\-and\-roll legends, and we take pride in a Can\-Do culture build on teamwork and getting the job done right the first time. As an Automation Controls Engineer, you’ll spend time on the production floor diagnosing equipment failures, troubleshooting electrical and automation systems, and programming PLCs. You’ll help get equipment back online during breakdowns, investigate recurring problems, and implement improvements that make our lines safer, more reliable and efficient. This is a salaried position. We are open to discussing regular work hours that fit your preferences and out production’s needs. Candidates who prefer a later start and finish, including afternoons and evening hours, are encouraged to apply. This role will participate in the Controls Teams’ one\-week on \-call rotation. **What You'll Be Doing** * Troubleshoot, program, maintain, and improve PLC\-controlled manufacturing equipment and automation systems. * Diagnose and resolve electrical, controls, instrumentation, and communication issues to minimize equipment downtime. * Work closely with Maintenance, Engineering, and Operations to improve equipment reliability, safety, and production efficiency. * Develop, modify, and support PLC programs, HMIs, drives, servo systems, and industrial control networks. * Support equipment upgrades, automation projects, new installations, and future plant expansions. * Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement practical, long\-term solutions. * Maintain electrical drawings, control system documentation, equipment settings, and program backups. * Assist Maintenance with preventive and predictive maintenance strategies for automated equipment. * Provide technical support during equipment breakdowns, including after\-hours or on\-call support as needed. * Participate in the rotating on\-call schedule with other Controls Team members, providing after\-hours technical support for one week at a time as scheduled. * Candidates who prefer a regular night\-shift schedule are encouraged to apply. Having a Controls Engineer on\-site overnight helps resolve issues sooner and reduces after\-hours calls for the team. **Experience \& Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, or a related technical field preferred. Minimum of 5–8 years of hands\-on industrial controls and automation experience required. Equivalent technical training and extensive relevant experience will be considered. * Strong hands\-on experience troubleshooting and programming industrial PLCs, particularly Allen\-Bradley and/or Siemens. * Experience with industrial automation, electrical controls, VFDs, servo systems, and HMIs. * Ability to read and use electrical schematics, control drawings, industrial wiring diagrams, and hydraulic schematics to diagnose equipment faults. * Solid understanding of industrial networking, instrumentation, hydraulics, pneumatics, and electromechanical systems used in automated manufacturing. * Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing complex equipment failures and developing effective solutions. * Takes initiative, works independently, and follows problems through to resolution. * Eager to learn new equipment, processes, and controls platforms. * Works with Maintenance and Operations to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **Additional Experience We'd Love to See** * Hands\-on industrial maintenance experience across multiple disciplines, especially electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, is strong preferred. * Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, and SEW Eurodrive systems. * HMI platforms such as FactoryTalk, WinCC, or Ignition. * FANUC robotics, including programming and troubleshooting. * Industrial communication networks such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet, and ControlNet. * PID control, instrumentation calibration, and process control. * AutoCAD, SQL databases, historians, and CMMS systems. * Experience in aluminum extrusion, continuous casting, robotic packaging, or other heavy industrial manufacturing environments. At SCM, we believe great employees deserve great benefits, opportunities to grow, and a company that values their contributions. * Competitive compensation based on experience * Bonus program * Paid vacation and sick time * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions * FREE on\-site health clinic for employees and eligible family members * Company\-paid life insurance * Gym membership discounts * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Career advancement and professional growth opportunities **Do You Have the SCM Can\-Do Attitude?** We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, thinks critically, solves problems, and doesn't hesitate to jump in when equipment needs attention. If you're an experienced Controls Engineer who enjoys hands\-on industrial automation and wants to make a real impact, we'd like to hear from you! Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

embedded engineering. * Proficient in English both written and verbal * Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. * Must reside within approximately 30 workforce capabilities. * Experience developing a technical organization through changes in technology, customer requirements, or business models. * Leadership or management of multiple technical Industrial Edge, virtualization, industrial data, AI, cybersecurity, digital twins, and software\-defined automation. * Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and make thoughtful investment jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
jobs.description: Siemens builds the systems the physical world runs on: factories, power grids, buildings, trains, hospitals. Industrial and physical AI is a major opportunity in applied AI, and one of the harder ones to get right. There is a generation of AI\-powered products to build. We are an applied science organization building the science behind them. The work sits at the intersection of machine learning research, real world data, and production systems running in industrial environments. As Senior Applied Scientist, you lead the science on a major capability area inside the pod. You take ambiguous problems through hypothesis, method selection, experimentation, and into models that run in production. You are hands on with the modeling, and you are accountable for the rigor and the outcome. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work in close partnership with engineers and product managers who turn your work into product. **Key responsibilities** * Contribute to one or more scientific capability areas end to end, for example perception, computer vision, language and agents, time series, control, planning, or evaluation * Take problems from ambiguous product or system requirements through clear research questions, hypotheses, and success metrics * Lead applied research projects: literature review, method selection, experimentation, ablation, error analysis, and productization * Build and run the evaluation pipelines for the work you own: offline metrics, online experiments, robustness testing in industrial conditions * Work with engineers to take models into production grade pipelines: data readiness, training infrastructure, inference, observability * Make scientific tradeoffs in front of engineers and product managers, with evidence, and translate them into decisions the team can act on * Identify and de\-risk scaling challenges in your area: data quality, model drift, latency, throughput, cost, safety * Raise the bar on experimentation rigor, reproducibility, and documentation across the team * Apply responsible AI practices in your work: bias detection, model risk management, human in the loop controls **Basic qualifications** * 6\+ years in applied machine learning, AI research, or data science, with models that shipped to production and made an impact * Strong foundation in machine learning theory and practice across training, evaluation, and deployment * Demonstrated experience taking research from a paper or prototype into a model that runs reliably in production * Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks and toolchains * Strong partnership track record with engineering teams on data, training infrastructure, and inference * Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, product managers, and senior leaders **Preferred qualifications** * Experience applying ML in industrial or physical domains: manufacturing, automation, robotics, energy, mobility, infrastructure, healthcare * Deep expertise in one of: multimodal ML, generative AI, retrieval augmented generation, agentic workflows, time series, control, or planning * Scientific ML for physical systems: surrogate modeling, operator learning, physics\-informed ML, geometry\-aware ML, differentiable simulation, AI for semiconductor/EDA * Hands\-on experience building evaluation pipelines, running online experiments, or instrumenting production monitoring for a model you owned * Publications, patents, open source contributions, or significant internal technology transfers * Experience mentoring more junior scientists and engineers * Experience working with globally distributed research, product, or engineering organizations **About the Team:** We are an early\-stage engineering team solving hard technical problems at the intersection of AI, systems, and real\-world interaction. We operate with high autonomy, collaborate closely across functions, and maintain high technical standards. Principal Engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. $167,443 $226,073 10%

jobs.title: AI Enablement & Delivery Lead (US)
jobs.description: **A Snapshot of Your Day** You are the person who brings AI into engineering – and makes it stick. One day you run a hands\-on session with a design team and spot a process step where AI can save hours. The next day you work with engineers, subject\-matter experts and our Data \& AI Architect to build that solution, so it delivers correct results the first time, every time. You measure what it saves, and you help leadership decide what to scale. **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Deliver complex AI use cases end\-to\-end in engineering workflows – from problem definition and baseline to a validated solution in live projects * Deliver the first complex case within 12 months on our lighthouse project, with a measured engineering\-hours baseline and verified savings * Run enablement sessions for engineering teams and managers so that they can identify, build and use AI solutions in their daily work * Identify and assess high\-impact opportunities across the engineering order process and prepare them for prioritization by the management team * Design solutions that are verifiable by design: traceable, auditable and reproducible results with subject\-matter\-expert validation, human approval and a maintenance concept for every agent * Measure impact in engineering hours, non\-conformance cost and lead time, and support process owners in making proven solutions standard work **What You Bring** * Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, data science, mechanical/process engineering or a related field * At least 5 years of hands\-on experience delivering AI/ML or generative\-AI solutions into productive use, ideally including LLM\-based agents and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). Those with more experience may be considered for a more senior level. * Engineering domain know\-how – ideally in rotating equipment, compressors, plant or product engineering – and the ability to talk to engineers in their language * A track record of moving from pilot to production, including validation, quality assurance and lifecycle maintenance of AI solutions * Strong facilitation and coaching skills; you enjoy enabling others and can explain AI clearly to engineers and managers alike * Results\-driven and pragmatic: you measure success in delivered impact, not in the number of pilots. Fluent English; German is a plus Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer\-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers. **About the Team** Our **Transformation of Industry** division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward. **Who is Siemens Energy?** At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo **Rewards** * Career growth and development opportunities * Supportive work culture * Company paid Health and wellness benefits * Paid Time Off and paid holidays * 401K savings plan with company match * Family building benefits * Parental leave https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs This job may be based in New York. Siemens Energy offers a variety of health and wellness benefits including paid time off and holiday pay. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://benefitsatenergy.com/thinking\-of\-joining.html. The base salary range for this position if based in New York is $150,510– $254,400 and the annual incentive target is 10\-25% of base salary. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, skills, certifications, and other business needs. Employees typically do not start at the top of the range, though compensation depends on each individual’s qualifications.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Lead** ----------------- ### **About SnapMagic** SnapMagic is building AI for PCB design. More than 2 million engineers use SnapMagic every year to discover electronic components and design products faster. Behind the scenes, we’re building the operating system for electronics design: one of the world’s largest electronics component databases, a platform the industry already trusts, and a new generation of AI tools, starting with our AI\-assisted design product, that take engineers from idea to working hardware faster than ever. We have strong revenue growth, proven product\-market fit, and backing from leading Silicon Valley investors including Y Combinator. The next chapter of how the world’s hardware gets designed is being written now, and we want you in the room for it. ### **The Opportunity** Millions of engineers use SnapMagic to build everything from fully electric aircraft to connected toys to life\-saving medical devices. We’re rebuilding how they find, evaluate, and design with components, and we’re doing it with a small team that ships fast and holds a very high bar. As our Software Lead, you’ll own the core platform and set how we build. We ship through an AI\-native software factory, where engineers and coding agents work together to ship faster than most teams can, without letting quality slip. You’ll work directly with the founders, Product, and Customer Success. No layers, no handoffs. You’ll decide what to build, build it, ship it, and see how customers respond the same week. ### **What You’ll Work On First** * **Core platform.** Own the foundation everything else runs on: search, data, performance, and reliability for millions of engineers. * **Recommendation engine.** Help engineers find the right component faster, with recommendations they trust. * **Analytics dashboard.** Give customers and our team a clear view of how components are found, evaluated, and used. ### **What You’ll Own** * **The software factory.** Run how we ship: coding agents, automated testing, CI/CD, and review, set up so we move fast and what we ship holds up. * **Code quality.** You build with AI every day, and you can write excellent code yourself. You hold a strict line in code review, whether a person or an agent wrote the code. * **Product end to end.** Take features from idea to production and keep improving them. You own the outcome, meaning whether people actually use what you ship, not just the ticket. * **Full\-stack delivery.** Postgres, Python, Django, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, in applications that perform reliably for millions of engineers. * **Product direction.** Talk to users, dig into the data, form opinions, and push on what we build next. This is a product engineer’s role: close to product management, from an engineer’s seat. ### **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years building full\-stack web applications, ideally with Django, with a track record on high\-throughput systems * AI\-pilled: you already ship with coding agents, and you know where they break * You can actually code. You have strong fundamentals, and you hold strict standards for code review and output quality * Ownership above everything. You treat the platform as yours and don’t wait to be told what to fix * Real product instinct. You care about adoption and engagement as much as the code, and you’ve built things people actually use * Obsessive attention to detail and reliable follow\-through. When you say it’s done, it’s done and it works * Experience leading technical decisions on a team, with or without the title * Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to solve problems independently ### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You** * Enjoy shipping as much as designing * Care about the craft but never lose sight of the customer * Want to be early on a product category that’s about to be rebuilt * Like to teach and learn from those around you * Thrive in small, high\-accountability teams ### **Perks and Benefits** * A role at the helm of growth, with vast opportunities for impact and innovation * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus dependent coverage * 401(k) plan * An innovative environment that encourages creative thinking Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: IT Analyst Principal (Principal Infrastructure Engineer)
jobs.description: Solano County Department of Information Technology (DoIT) provides customer\-oriented and convenient access to information and services through the use of technology; anytime \- anywhere. The County strives for cost\-effective use of technology, with interactive exchange and sharing of data within departments, with constituents, with other governments and business partners. The guiding principles of DoIT are: * Support and facilitate access to County information for the public and its employees and to help the County conduct its business in a fast and easy manner * Support the business goals of the County in an efficient, cost\-effective manner * Provide safe and secure systems and an integration mechanism to streamline business practices * Provide ongoing technology training for staff * Provide opportunities for constituents to utilize technology in their interaction with the County * Share and exchange information using multiple channels **THE POSITION** Manages and oversees a major information technology system, group, or program including staff and contract resources; plans, designs, and coordinates the maintenance of the most difficult and complex infrastructure system or computerized data processing and applications systems for large, multi departmental or county wide functions; acts as a project/team leader and technical expert in assigned area(s) of responsibility, and oversees major information technology initiatives. Positions in this class head a major information technology section, program or initiative and may supervise lower level information technology professionals. Positions in this classification have the highest subject matter expertise for the assigned area and are proficient in project management, system development and design, GIS, infrastructure design and planning, and emerging technology development and implementation. This class is distinguished from the: * Information Technology Analyst IV by responsibility for a major section, program or initiative with a high level of independence and responsibility for significant resources. The eligible list established from this recruitment will be used to fill full\-time and part\-time regular, limited\-term or extra\-help positions as vacancies occur or the need arises. **Position Requirements** ------------------------- **Education:** Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university, preferably in Information Technology or related field. **Experience:** Six (6\) years of information technology systems and/or application development and support experience including two (2\) years of project lead or supervisory responsibility. Note: Additional experience may substitute on a year for year basis for the educational requirement. **LICENSING, CERTIFICATION AND REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:** * Applicants may be required to possess a valid California Driver’s License, Class C. * Some positions in this class will require technical certifications demonstrating expertise in specific bodies of knowledge. Note: All licenses, certificates and registrations requisite to the position must be kept current while employed in this class. This may include the completion of continuing education units to maintain the required registration in good standing. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **SELECTION PROCESS** **OPEN UNTIL FILLED: First review date, December 11, 2026 at 5:00 PM**. Based on the information provided in the application documents, the qualified applicants may be invited for further examination and will either be pre\-scheduled by the Department of Human Resources or be invited to self\-schedule. All applicants meeting the minimum qualifications are not guaranteed advancement through any subsequent phase of the examination. Depending upon the number of applications received, the selection process may consist of an initial application screening, a mandatory information meeting, a supplemental questionnaire assessment, a written and/or practical exam, an oral board exam, or any combination listed. Responses to supplemental questions may be used as screening and testing mechanisms and will be used to assess an applicant’s ability to advance in the process; as such, responses to supplemental questions should be treated as test examination responses. Information contained herein does not constitute either an expressed or implied contract. All potential new hires and employees considered for promotion to management, confidential positions or unrepresented positions will be subject to a background and reference check after contingent job offer is accepted. These provisions are subject to change. RETIREES \- Solano County invites all to apply for positions; however pursuant to Government Code Section 21221(h) and 21224, hiring restrictions may apply to California Public Sector Pension Plan Retirees. **HOW TO APPLY** Applications must be submitted through the NeoGov system. Paper copies of applications are not accepted. All additional application materials as requested in the job announcement (e.g.: degree/transcripts, certificates, licenses, DD\-214, ADA Accommodation Request, etc.) must be submitted by the date indicated above. Resumes are not accepted in lieu of completing the application. **You will be evaluated based on the information provided on the application**. Please ensure any experience you believe qualifies you for the job is reflected in your application’s employment history. When completing employment details and/or responding to supplemental questions, do not write “see resume,” as resumes will not be reviewed and this will be considered an incomplete application. **In addition, submit a cover letter detailing how you best meet the Ideal Candidate profile, desirable qualifications and certifications, and complete the supplemental questions completely (Do Not Say, "See Resume/Application".)** **DOCUMENT SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS:** **A Bachelor’s degree is required for this position**. All candidates are strongly encouraged to submit a copy of their **college diploma** (verifying the degree, date earned and area of specialization) or **official/unofficial transcripts** (verifying institution, student, date, degree and area of specialization conferred) by the final filing deadline. Candidates who fail to submit their diploma or transcripts **by the final filing date** may be disqualified from the recruitment. PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING: Candidates who attended a college or university that is accredited by a foreign or non\-U.S. accrediting agency must have their educational units evaluated by an educational evaluation service. The result must be submitted to the Human Resources Department no later than the close of the recruitment. Please contact the local college or university to learn where this service can be obtained. **How to Submit Your Documents** In addition to uploading attachments when applying online, candidates may submit documents by fax to (707\) 784\-3424, or by email to recruitment@solanocounty.com. Be sure to include the recruitment title (Information Technology Analyst Principal (Principal Infrastructure Engineer)) and the recruitment number (26\-367070\-R2\) in your email or fax. **OTHER REQUIREMENTS:** * Background Checks: The County may conduct background, credit and reference checks on candidates prior to appointment to this class. The background check may include the State of California Department of Justice, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), the Child Abuse Central Index (CACI), and criminal checks in any state, city, and/or county where the applicant has lived, worked, or gone to school. * Independent Travel: The employee may be required to travel independently, for example, to perform work at other work sites, to attend meetings with other County employees, to attend meetings with community organizations, etc. * Work Hours: The employee may be required to work weekends, holidays, irregular hours, on\-call, and after normal business hours. **Americans with Disabilities Act** It is the policy of Solano County that all employment decisions and personnel policies will be applied equally to all County employees and applicants and be based upon the needs of County service, job related merit, and ability to perform the job. APPLICANTS WITH DISABILITIES:Qualified individuals with a disability, who are able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, and need an accommodation during any phase of the recruitment/testing/examination process (as detailed in the “Selection Process”) in the Human Resources Department by the application review deadline. Applicants will be contacted to discuss the specifics of the request.
