Our next Program begins Summer 2027\. **Position Location:** Miami, FL **What You Need to Know** Open the door to a groundbreaking tech career with an industry leader. Southern Glazer’s Wine \& Spirits is North America’s preeminent wine and spirits distributor, as well as a family\-owned, privately held company with roots that go back to 1933\. To create a new era in alcohol beverage sales and service, we’re heavily invested in the most transformative new technologies – and the most brilliant tech professionals. Southern Glazer’s was named by Newsweek as a Most Loved Workplace and is included on the Forbes lists for Largest Private Companies and Best Employers for Diversity. In 2024, Southern Glazer’s was recognized as one of Forbes America’s Best Employers for New Grads. Southern Glazer’s offers a competitive compensation package with a salary of $70000 / year plus bonuses. In determining a final offer, the company will evaluate a specific candidate's education, skills and experience and will make an offer appropriately. As a full\-time employee, you can choose from a full menu of our Top Shelf Benefits, including comprehensive medical and prescription drug coverage, dental and vision plans, tax\-saving Flexible Spending Accounts, disability coverage, life insurance plans, and a 401(k) plan. We also offer tuition reimbursement, a wellness program, parental leave, vacation accrual, paid sick leave, and more. We offer continuous learning and career growth in a fast\-paced environment where you are respected, your voice is heard, and technology is part of our strategy for success. If you’re looking to fill your glass with opportunity, come join our FAMILY. **About the Program** The NextGen OneTech Program is a 12\-month rotational development experience designed to build the next generation of technology talent. As a Program Associate, you will complete three four\-month rotations across OneTech, gaining hands\-on experience with different teams, projects, and areas of the technology organization. Rotations will vary based on business needs, available opportunities, and individual development, allowing Associates to broaden their skills while learning how technology supports Southern Glazer’s. Throughout the program, Associates will also participate in professional development and training, connect with senior leaders and key decision\-makers, and build a strong network across the organization. **Qualifications** * Must be a graduating senior (December 2026 or May 2027\) pursuing a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), Data Analytics/Data Science, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, and/or a comparable field from an accredited university * Strong team player with ability to demonstrate Agile delivery values working both within a team and working independently * Ability to collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to understand needs and help prioritize work by business value and urgency * Commitment to contributing to an inclusive, collaborative team environment * Ability to gather, interpret, and analyze data, with a willingness to learn how to report on metrics and KPIs * documentation * Strong planning and organizational skills to work comfortably in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities * Clear oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences * Foundational knowledge of application and software development, including software design and programming principles (e.g., SDLC, Agile) * Familiarity with coding and data fundamentals, such as a programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, R), databases and SQL, version control (e.g., Git), and testing/debugging * Familiarity with, or interest in learning, the tools used across OneTech, such as SAP, Power BI, and Jira * Interest in AI and generative AI, with a commitment to using these tools responsibly (e.g., jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (HR Title: Applications Developer III)
jobs.description: Full Stack Developer (HR Title: Applications Developer III) \- (INF00000209\)**Description** --------------- **Salary Range:** Salary commensurate with experience and qualifications **About SMU** SMU’s more than 12,000 diverse, high\-achieving students come from all 50 states and over 80 countries to take advantage of the University’s small classes, meaningful research opportunities, leadership development, community service, international study and innovative programs. SMU serves approximately 7,000 undergraduates and 5,000 graduate students through eight degree\-granting schools: Dedman College of Humanities and Sciences, Cox School of Business, Lyle School of Engineering, Meadows School of the Arts, Simmons School of Education and Human Development, Dedman School of Law, Perkins School of Theology and Moody School of Graduate and Advanced Studies. SMU is data driven, and its powerful supercomputing ecosystem – paired with entrepreneurial drive – creates an unrivaled environment for the University to deliver research excellence. Now in its second century of achievement, SMU is recognized for the ways it supports students, faculty and alumni as they become ethical, enterprising leaders in their professions and communities. SMU’s relationship with Dallas – the dynamic center of one of the nation’s fastest\-growing regions – offers unique learning, research, social and career opportunities that provide a launch pad for global impact. SMU is nonsectarian in its teaching and committed to academic freedom and open inquiry. **About the Position:** This role is an on\-campus, in\-person position. The full\-stack developer is part of the Web Application Services team in SMU’s Office of Information Technology. The full\-stack developer builds and supports web applications as SMU transitions from Sitecore to a modern headless CMS. The role combines front\-end and back\-end development with contributions to solution design and the delivery of secure, accessible, and maintainable applications. The developer is a collaborative team member who will work with colleagues, stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to deliver and troubleshoot CMS\-integrated features across the full application lifecycle. This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to architectural decisions while remaining hands\-on in development. **Essential Functions:** * Design, develop, and maintain web applications using traditional and headless Content Management Systems (CMS) platforms. Build responsive, accessible, and high\-performing using React, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Participate in architecture discussions, code review, testing, and deployment activities. Assist with application architecture and technology decisions for new and existing systems. * Develop and support back\-end applications, microservices, APIs, and integrations using appropriate modern technologies. Design and implement secure, maintainable API integrations with enterprise and third party platforms using REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI specifications, versioning, and integration best practices. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automations. * Troubleshoot application issues across front\-end, back\-end, on\-premises and cloud environments by collaborating with teammates and infrastructure teams. Optimize application performance, accessibility, security, and reliability. * Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Participate in department and enterprise projects. Provide project management and coordination as necessary to support successful project delivery. * This position requires participation in a scheduled on\-call rotation and night/weekend deployments as necessary. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Education and Experience:** A Bachelor’s degree is required. A Master's degree is preferred. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or Software Engineering is desired. A minimum of five (5\) years of experience developing enterprise web applications is required. The following experience is also required: * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks including React and Next.jS * Experience integrating applications with a headless or composable CMS, or comparable experience working with content APIs and modern web platforms * Experience developing back\-end services, APIs, and system integrations, including API contract design and documentation * Experience with cloud hosting environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud * Experience working within agile development environments * Experience building applications that meet WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA accessibility standards Experience in higher education, public sector, or large enterprise environments is preferred. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** Candidate must demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate broadly across the University and develop and maintain effective relationships with a wide range of constituencies. Must also demonstrate strong written communication skills. A strong customer service orientation is essential. Candidate must possess strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify and analyze problems, as well as devise solutions. Must also have strong organizational, planning, and time management skills. Strong project management skills and a focus on attention to detail are essential. Candidate must have an understanding of modern authentication and security concepts including OAuth and OpenID Connect. The following are preferred: * Experience developing back\-end applications, microservices, APIs, and system integrations using one or more modern server\-side technologies, such as TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java/Spring Boot, and/or C\#/.NET, or comparable experience with other modern back\-end technologies * Familiarity with REST, GraphQL, or OpenAPI * Familiarity with containerized application deployment technologies such as Docker * Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools * Familiarity with platform engineering concepts and developer enablement practices is a plus * Previous Sitecore experience to support SMU’s transition from Sitecore to a modern headless CMS * Experience supporting applications running in Kubernetes\-based environments **Physical and Environmental Demands:** * Sit for long periods of time **Deadline to Apply:** The position is open until filled. Priority consideration may be given to submissions received by December 4, 2026\. **EEO Statement** SMU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or other characteristics protected by state and federal law. **Benefits:** SMU offers staff a broad, competitive array of health and related benefits. In addition to traditional benefits such as health, dental, and vision plans, SMU offers a wide range of wellness programs to help attract, support, and retain our employees whose work continues to make SMU an outstanding education and research institution. SMU is committed to providing an array of retirement programs that benefit and protect you and your family throughout your working years at SMU and, if you meet SMU's retirement eligibility criteria, during your retirement years after you leave SMU. The value of learning at SMU isn't just about preparing our students for the future. jobs.title: Senior GTM Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.** ------------------------------------------------------------ Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage. Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners. As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission. Spring Health is actively seeking a Senior GTM Data Engineer to join our Revenue Operations team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales Systems \& Data and partnering closely with Marketing Operations, Sales, Data \& Analytics, and AI/Agent teams, the Senior GTM Data Engineer will architect and maintain the integrated data infrastructure that powers analytics, AI agents, and go\-to\-market automation. We're looking for a data architect and engineer who can do three things equally well: build analytics data models, design data pipelines for AI/ML agents and skills, and bridge disconnected systems to ensure data flows where it's needed. You'll own data quality and governance across the entire GTM stack, working at the intersection of analytics, AI enablement, and system integration. This is a full\-time, remote position, with occasional travel required for team offsites and company events. **What you'll do:** ------------------- * Build and maintain well\-documented, tested data models in Snowflake and dbt that unify CRM, marketing automation, campaign, engagement, and enrichment data. * Design and govern a consistent semantic layer with reusable business logic and metric definitions across accounts, buying groups, campaigns, and opportunities. * Partner with GTM and business stakeholders to turn operating questions into durable data products, including funnel, account engagement, lead scoring, and multi\-touch attribution reporting. * Create analytics\-ready datasets and actionable dashboards in tools such as Hex, Looker, or Tableau, explaining data logic and limitations clearly to non\-technical partners. * Enable self\-service analytics across GTM teams by publishing curated models, metric guides, and practical usage documentation. * Design and implement data pipelines that consolidate data from disparate systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack, Marketo, 6sense, etc.) into Snowflake, using orchestration tools like Fivetran, custom connectors, or APIs. * Build custom data connectors and integrations (e.g., Zendesk Salesforce) to bridge data gaps where commercial connectors don't exist, using APIs and event\-driven architecture. * Manage D360 and other third\-party data enrichment services, ensuring data quality, deduplication, and proper mapping into core tables. * Implement automated reconciliation checks and lineage tracking to ensure jobs.title: Software Engineer (Kubernetes/Cloud Platform Engineering and Automation)
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. In this role, you'll help engineer and automate Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine (OKE) environments, leveraging Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (ACM) to deliver consistent management and governance across multiple clusters. You'll collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, and cloud engineering teams to support Kubernetes capabilities across on\-premises environments and Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA). **What You'll Do:** * **Engineer and Automate:** Design, develop, and maintain reusable platform automation using Ansible, Kubernetes/OpenShift APIs, and declarative configuration. * **Support Platform Modernization:** Automate cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, patching, certificate management, health checks, and ongoing operations. * **Drive Consistency and Reliability:** Leverage ACM, GitOps, and Argo CD to manage Kubernetes environments, maintain desired state, and improve operational efficiency across multiple clusters. * **Develop Scalable Solutions:** Write scripts, integrations, APIs, and supporting code to eliminate manual processes and create reliable, repeatable automation. * **Strengthen CI/CD Practices:** Integrate automation with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code reviews to support safe, consistent platform changes. * **Champion Security and Stability:** Apply secure authentication, secrets management, least\-privilege access, and robust error handling to protect enterprise infrastructure. * **Collaborate and Innovate:** Partner across engineering teams to troubleshoot complex challenges, improve platform reliability, share knowledge, and establish effective engineering standards. Qualifications: **What You'll Bring:** We're looking for an engineer with approximately **five years of relevant experience** in software development, infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or platform automation. We value hands\-on technical skills, strong problem\-solving abilities, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. * Approximately five years of professional experience in software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, SRE, or platform automation. * Hands\-on experience developing reusable automation using **Ansible** or similar infrastructure automation tools. * Working knowledge of **Kubernetes**, including APIs, resources, cluster operations, and declarative configuration. * Experience with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code reviews**. * Proficiency with **Linux, scripting (Python or Bash), REST APIs**, and technical troubleshooting. * Understanding of automation reliability, idempotency, error handling, authentication, access controls, and TLS/certificate management. * Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with **Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine (OKE), Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), or Ansible Automation Platform**. * Familiarity with **GitOps, Argo CD, Kubernetes Resource Model (KRM)**, multi\-cluster management, or policy\-based governance. * Software development experience using **Go, Python**, or another general\-purpose programming language. * Experience with **GitHub CI/CD**, automation testing, observability, or platform validation. * Knowledge of **AWS, ROSA, AWS IAM**, hybrid\-cloud infrastructure, or enterprise networking. * Familiarity with **Microsoft Entra ID, OIDC/OAuth 2\.0**, workload identity, secrets management, or SPIFFE/SPIRE. * Experience with **Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)** or Red Hat Enterprise Linux CoreOS (RHCOS). * Experience contributing to engineering standards, technical documentation, knowledge sharing, or mentoring. **Why Join Us?** Great platform engineers come from a variety of technical backgrounds. You don't need to be a senior architect or have experience with every technology listed to succeed in this role. If you have a strong foundation in automation, software development, or infrastructure engineering and are excited to help shape an enterprise hybrid\-cloud platform, we encourage you to apply. **Work Locations**: Bloomington, IL\-Corporate, Dunwoody, GA\-Park Center Hub or Tempe, AZ\-Marina Heights Hub locations. **Hybrid Work Arrangement:** A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **SPONSORSHIP**: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week! * Potential starting salary range: $95,000 \- $115,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.description: \*\*\*THIS RECRUITMENT MAY CLOSE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE DEPENDING ON THE NUMBER OF APPLICATIONS RECEIVED. APPLICANTS ARE ENCOURAGED TO APPLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE\*\*\* **Job Summary** --------------- The Nevada Department of Transportation (NDOT) Structures Division, Design Section, is hiring for a Professional Engineering Specialist in Carson City, NV. The incumbent will develop structural design documents and provide construction support services for highway construction projects; perform structural engineering analysis and design of reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, and structural steel structures; perform structural analysis and design of transportation structures using the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) Bridge Design Specifications. The role requires strong technical expertise, independent judgment, and the ability to coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Incumbents possess a degree of knowledge and proficiency sufficient to perform work independently with little or not additional training. \*\*\*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. Please note that this position is on\-site and does not offer remote work options. The Job Duties section listed in this announcement reflects the Statewide Class Specifications for all positions and do not fully correlate with the specific duties of this position.\*\*\* Professional Engineering Specialists are experienced Professional Engineers (P.E.) who have detailed and in\-depth knowledge and expertise that enables them to develop solutions to complex atypical design and/or construction challenges; advise management, engineering professionals and technical staff division/departmentwide on contract interpretation, conceptual design alternatives analyses, code interpretation, and specialized research and analysis related to best methods, materials and practices. The preponderance of duties and responsibilities of positions in this class is providing technical expertise for project development, specialized systems and/or functions and advanced research, analysis and problem solving in specialized areas of highway maintenance and construction. **Essential Qualifications** ---------------------------- Master's degree from an accredited college or university in a civil engineering field such as geotechnical, structural, water resources, transportation or construction engineering, and licensure as a Professional Engineer which included practical experience relevant to the assignment; OR Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in civil engineering, completion of 12 units of graduate level coursework relevant to the assignment, licensure as a Professional Engineer, and one year of professional post\-licensure civil engineering experience; OR five years of professional experience as a Licensed Professional Engineer performing engineering work relevant to the assignment. **Additional Position Requirements:** * Current licensure as a Professional Engineer (P.E.) in Nevada * Experience in the analysis and design of reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, and structural steel transportation structures. **Job Duties** -------------- Professional Engineering Specialists are experienced Professional Engineers (P.E.) who have detailed and in\-depth knowledge and expertise that enables them to develop solutions to complex atypical design and/or construction challenges; advise management, engineering professionals and technical staff division/departmentwide on contract interpretation, conceptual design alternatives analyses, code interpretation, and specialized research and analysis related to best methods, materials and practices. The preponderance of duties and responsibilities of positions in this class is providing technical expertise for project development, specialized systems and/or functions and advanced research, analysis and problem solving in specialized areas of highway maintenance and construction. Consult with management regarding solutions and alternatives in specialized areas and on special projects; provide technical expertise in the application of advanced theories, concepts, and processes; research new technologies and processes to solve existing problems; develop innovative approaches to the application and utilization of new and advanced technology; and support management and staff department\-wide by providing expertise, research, and analysis in specialized engineering areas. Evaluate specific elements of research conducted by others and determine the applicability to specific design, construction, or maintenance projects in Nevada; prepare reports for management defining the issues, evaluation, possible solutions, costs, risks, and alternatives on projects that significantly impact the department’s mission. Research and analyze design proposals, specifications, manuals, new technology and new products, and other data to evaluate the feasibility, cost and maintenance requirements of designs or applications; conduct risk analysis based on cost benefit and probability of success or failure to quantify the risk associated with each recommended alternative. Evaluate and interpret code requirements in relation to specific projects and recommend deviations as appropriate to the circumstances; provide technical direction to Professional Engineers and administration on the interpretation of the American Association of State \& Highway Transportation Officials (AASHTO) policy and applicable codes; review and make recommendations regarding the AASHTO policies; and develop and recommend design policies and procedures when there are no standard practices. jobs.title: Senior IT Application Developer (DPS #59936)

DPS houses many in\-house and vendor supported applications with back\-end Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases that support DPS's mission. Assist in the development of disaster recovery plans with service providers * Develop reports and presentations, as needed, engage in long\-term strategic planning * Propose, conceptualize, design, implement, and develop solutions for difficult and complex applications independently. Work on projects that may span a broad range of applications and/or require expertise in multiple technical environments and business areas. * Accountable for application security, validation, evaluation, and implementation. * Develops, executes, and documents test plans. * Sets up and maintains the test environments. * Writes and communicates business requirements and functional specifications for the implementation of client solutions. * Reviews technical design specifications developed by junior analysts/developers. * Document function and changes to new or modify modules, test activities/results, and other areas. * Provide data from repositories that can be used by customers for reports and presentations Who are the customers? DPS including NMSP and all Law Enforcement and criminal justice agencies within the state of New Mexico. Ideal Candidate DPS including NMSP and all Law Enforcement and criminal justice agencies within the state of New Mexico. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- $227K – $284K • Offers Equity *Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role, requiring 3 days per week in our SF Hub. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who takes real ownership and does well in a fast\-moving, ambitious, and problem\-oriented environment. You’ll work hands\-on with improving our LLMs, and using them to solve for high\-impact product opportunities. You’ll own part of the direction of our AI work: framing the right problems, finding their most effective solution, and helping shape the roadmap. This role is a bit of a hybrid of machine learning/engineering with product. It would suit someone already in an AI Engineering role, as well as software engineers or data scientists that have gone deep into shaping models (themselves) to propel them forward. What you’ll do * Lead entire AI/ML initiatives from problem definition through delivery. * Influence technical direction and roadmap decisions by framing problems clearly and backing choices with evidence. * Partner with product, engineering, and design to deliver high\-impact models. * Strengthen our ML practices and infrastructure, including evals, training pipelines, and model serving. * Mentor teammates and share knowledge to raise the bar across the team. By 30 days, you will have: * Upgraded an existing feature to be meaningfully smarter and/or faster, and shared what you learned with the team. * Reviewed our evaluation approach and improved or built evals for our core features. * Found the highest\-leverage opportunities in our AI stack and started shaping priorities with the team. By 90 days, you will have: * Led the delivery of AI features that address valuable customer use cases. * Fine\-tuned models for our specific needs and set repeatable practices others can build on. * Developed new processes to speed up how we utilize new AI models. **Qualifications** ------------------ * A track record of owning and shipping production AI/ML systems end\-to\-end, with the independence and judgment expected of a senior engineer. * A blend of modern LLM expertise and structured problem\-solving. You can work backward from a user problem, frame the right technical question, and define how to evaluate success. That structured problem\-solving might come from product engineering, technical consulting, or comparable experience. * Deep hands\-on experience in LLM post\-training and/or inference optimization, with evidence of exceptional results in a specific problem area. For example: + Building a model that outperforms strong alternatives on a specialized task through thoughtful dataset development, supervised fine\-tuning, preference tuning, or reinforcement learning. * Making LLMs substantially faster or more efficient through tailored quantization, speculative decoding, or other inference techniques.The ability to go beyond established recipes: diagnosing failure modes, designing experiments, and adapting methods to the problem at hand.Strong evaluation judgment. You design evals grounded in user needs, distinguish meaningful improvements from benchmark gains, and establish practices that catch regressions before users do. * Experience serving and optimizing models at scale, with a practical understanding of the trade\-offs between latency, throughput, uptime, and cost. * Strong production Python and fluency with data, including building and cleaning datasets, analyzing results in Python or SQL, and working comfortably with modern training and serving stacks. * Experience influencing technical direction and helping other engineers succeed through clear reasoning, collaboration, and mentoring. Nice to have * Experience spanning both LLM post\-training and inference optimization. * Successful application of preference tuning or reinforcement learning to improve real\-world model performance. * Speech or long\-context experience, especially with noisy, lengthy transcripts. * Experience establishing ML infrastructure, evaluation practices, or model development workflows at a startup or growth\-stage company. How you work * Ownership: You take ambiguous problems and drive them to clear outcomes without waiting for perfect specs. * High standards: You care about quality and detail, you’re tenacious, and you raise the bar for everyone around you. * Pragmatic and results\-driven: You pick the right hills to climb and find the fastest way up. * A generalist who dives deep: You might work on data one day and training methods or infrastructure the next. * Clear communicator: You explain technical results and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Multiplier: You make the people around you better through mentorship, reviews, and knowledge\-sharing. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) and RRSP matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E\-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada). Compensation Range: $227K \- $284K

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description: Overview: TISTA is seeking an experienced **Scrum Master** to support Agile Operations within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program. This position supports Shared Services and provides flexible Scrum Master coverage across multiple Agile teams and initiatives based on evolving program priorities. The Scrum Master will support Agile delivery across various program areas, which may include:* Healthcare Technology and Asset Management (HTAM) * Shared Services * VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP) * Prosthetics * Other Healthcare Enterprise Logistics Management (HELM) initiatives The position may also support modernization initiatives such as SEPG\-EER Cloud within HTAM. Working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, the Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, remove impediments, and support successful execution of sprint and Planning Interval (PI) commitments. This role requires adaptability, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively across multiple technical teams and changing program priorities. At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do. **TISTA** associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account \& Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short\-term \& Long\-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more! Responsibilities: * Facilitate daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives for your assigned teams. * Line up sprint and PI plans across teams that depend on each other, so that dependencies are planned, not discovered. * Back up the other Scrum Master during leave and PI Planning. * Position 2 (Agile Operations): support teams in more than one sub\-product line at a time when assigned, learn each backlog and cadence quickly, and hand teams back cleanly when an assignment ends. * Prepare the team for quarterly PI Planning: capacity, draft features, dependencies and risks. Attend Scrum of Scrums and ART syncs with the Release Train Engineer. * Track interface work with the teams and VA offices that own connected systems and raise dependency risks before they block a sprint. * Keep data migration and cutover tasks from Maximo EAWM and AEMS/MERS on the board, with owners and dates, so progress toward retiring those systems is visible. * Coordinate with Nuvolo and VA's ServiceNow platform owners when their upgrades or fixes affect the team's work. * Keep Jira boards, sprints and story points current so the team's status is accurate without a separate report. * Track velocity, say/do ratio, cycle time and carryover. Use the numbers with the team to find where work gets stuck. * Log impediments, raise them to the right person, and follow through until they are closed. Escalate cross\-team blockers at the ART sync. * Work with the Product Owner and HTAM business stakeholders to keep the top of the backlog refined, sized and ready two sprints ahead. * Coach team members, Product Owners and VA stakeholders on Scrum and SAFe practices. Protect the sprint from unplanned work and route urgent requests through the agreed intake process. * Help the team meet the definition of done before each release: Section 508 checks, security scans, test sign\-off and change control board approval. Qualifications: * 5\+ years as a Scrum Master on software development teams. * Experience running all Scrum events for at least one team, sprint after sprint. * Experience working inside a SAFe Agile Release Train, including at least one PI Planning event. * Hands\-on Jira experience: boards, sprints, filters, dashboards and Agile reports. * Experience with Confluence or a similar team wiki. * Experience supporting distributed teams that work fully remote, using Microsoft Teams or a similar tool. * Clear written and spoken communication with developers, testers, Product Owners and customer leaders. * Ability to obtain and keep a VA Public Trust (Tier 2 / Moderate Risk) background investigation. **Desired skills:** ------------------- * Position 2: experience moving between teams on different kinds of products, such as integration platforms, data platforms and VistA\-based applications. * Scrum Master experience on a ServiceNow team, or on another configurable platform such as Salesforce. * Experience with enterprise asset management or maintenance systems such as Nuvolo, IBM Maximo or ServiceNow EAM. * Experience on projects that move records from legacy systems to a new platform, including cutover planning. * Experience with teams that build and test system interfaces against formal interface control documents. * Exposure to healthcare technology management, clinical engineering or biomedical equipment programs. * Federal health IT experience, especially VA, DHA, CMS or HHS programs. * Facilitation with Mural or Miro for remote PI Planning and retrospectives. * Familiarity with Smartsheet or Jira Align. **Required certification:** * SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM). Professional Scrum Master (PSM I) is accepted as equivalent. **Preferred certifications:*** SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM) * SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Practitioner (SP) * ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching (ICP\-ACC) * PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP) **Education:** -------------- * Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, engineering, computer science or a related field. Four additional years of Scrum Master or Agile delivery experience may substitute for the degree. **Clearance:*** Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Background Investigation (VA Handbook 0710\); ability to obtain VA PIV credential. **Location:*** Work location and schedule (remote) to be specified upon hire. **Pay Range:*** The suggested pay for this position ranges from $90,546 to $125,875\. * The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. * Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses. * TISTA associates are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits plan! More information can be found here: https://tistatech.com/working\-at\-tista/

jobs.title: Lead Engineer - Cloud Security Platform & CSPM (Hybrid)
jobs.description: The pay range is $132,000\.00 \- $238,000\.00 Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well\-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits. **About Us** Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. Target is one of the world's most recognized brands and one of America's leading retailers. But behind the brand our guests love, is a culture of continual innovation and right now, we are up to big things! Target's security team is a place where innovation happens daily. Interested in a culture that combines ongoing learning, engineering excellence, and stellar outcomes? We are too – that's why we work here. Join our team to improve Target's security and move the business forward. As a **Lead Engineer on the Cloud Security** team, you'll be the senior technical owner of Target's **Cloud Security Platform and CSPM capability** across our public and private cloud environments. You'll be the person the team, our partners, and leadership look to for how CSPM and the broader CNAPP surface should be designed, deployed, operated, and evolved at Target scale — turning posture signal into action, and controls into paved roads that developers can actually use. Beyond deep technical expertise, you have a strong bias for action and a builder's mindset. The Cloud Security Platform sits between architecture and the engineering teams who consume it, and you are comfortable operating in that realm – translating security requirements into reliable, automated, developer\-friendly controls; owning the day\-to\-day operation and continuous improvement of the CSPM/CNAPP platform; coordinating exceptions and developer\-experience tradeoffs and partnering with peers so that cloud security findings flow into the enterprise remediation lifecycle. You have the engineering credibility to set technical direction for a team of engineers as a hands\-on IC, and the communication and partnership skills to make the controls land well across Target. **Expect to:** * Serve as the senior technical lead and hands\-on owner of Target's Cloud Security Platform and CSPM capability — setting the technical direction, standards, and roadmap that other engineers execute against. * Own the end\-to\-end engineering, deployment, configuration, tuning, and ongoing operation of the CSPM/CNAPP platform across Target's public and private cloud environments, including onboarding of new cloud accounts, projects, and workloads, leading the implementation and operation of core functional controls, and managing operations such as RBAC and SSO. * Operate the platform as a production system: own its availability, performance, observability, capacity, upgrade cadence, and outage response, with clear SLOs and on\-call participation. * Own the CSPM policy set end\-to\-end: which rules are on, which are tuned, which are suppressed and why — grounded in Target's reference architecture, secure configuration benchmarks, and the realities of our environment. * Peer with Cloud Security software developers on design of the findings pipeline for CSPM and adjacent CNAPP signal. The pipeline will aggregate posture findings, deduplicate and enrich them with ownership attribution, and ship them into Target's enterprise remediation dashboards with SLAs so product and platform teams can act. * Drive continuous reduction of noise and false positives so every finding that reaches an engineer is worth their time. * Extend ownership into adjacent CNAPP capabilities delivered by the same platform — cloud workload posture, container/image posture, cloud identity/entitlement (CIEM) findings, and IaC posture signal — coordinating with the engineers who own the deeper IaC scanning, admission control, and SSPM controls. * Partner with Detection \& Response to turn high\-signal posture and runtime findings into detections, and to support cloud incident response with the context the platform can provide. * Drive multi\-quarter initiatives end\-to\-end: from problem framing and scoping, through design, build, rollout, adoption, and steady\-state operation. * Make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy calls within the platform's ecosystem, and own t CP preferred; AWS/Azure experience also valued) and private cloud / Kubernetes environments at enterprise scale * Working knowledge of Kubernetes and admission controller frameworks — enough to partner effectively with the engineers who own those controls and to integrate posture signal across them * Strong working knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform and equivalent) and policy\-as\-code (e.g., Rego), and familiarity with integrating policy and posture signal into CI/CD * Experience building and operating findings pipelines that integrate cloud security signal into enterprise remediation/governance platforms (shipping CSPM and adjacent CNAPP findings to centralized dashboards with ownership attribution \& SLAs) * Experience integrating cloud telemetry into enterprise SIEM/SOAR pipelines * Proven history of effectively utilizing a variety of security tools and technologies across diverse environments. The ideal candidate will not be limited to specific vendors or solutions but will possess the technical depth to comprehend and implement end\-to\-end solutions that align with the reference security architecture's requirements * Hands\-on experience integrating security tooling with developer workflows (CI/CD, source control, ticketing) in a way that scales with a large engineering organization * Strong understanding of secure software development practices, network security fundamentals, and modern cloud\-native architectures * Solid understanding of AI/ML and the emerging security considerations associated with it, including how to surface and enforce them through cloud security tooling * Automation\-first engineering mindset, with hands\-on fluency in at least one general\-purpose language (e.g., Python, Go) and a track record of building reusable platforms and paved roads instead of one\-off scripts * Strong cross\-functional partner: comfortable working closely with a variety of security and product engineering teams to align requirements, rollout plans, and operational ownership * Effective at representing your work, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership, and equally effective explaining the same content to staff engineers in detail * Good understanding of security management workflows in large enterprise organizations and complex environments, and of the current threat landscape and the challenges most organizations are facing * Working knowledge of security frameworks, standards, the cloud threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., NIST, CIS Benchmarks, ISO/IEC 27001\) — enough to align the platform's controls to them, without being the policy author * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong presentation abilities * Demonstrated curiosity, bias for action, and a genuine builder's mindset — you want to ship the platform, not just describe it This position will operate as a **Hybrid**/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Scientist / Engineer – Oncology Foundation Models & Agentic Platforms
jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. We are seeking an exceptional AI Scientist/Engineer to bridge two cutting\-edge domains in medical AI: **Oncology Foundation Models** and **Agentic Systems**. In this role, you will design and train domain\-specific foundation models on complex, multimodal cancer datasets (genomics, histopathology, longitudinal EHRs, and clinical imaging) while simultaneously building agentic workflows that orchestrate these models. By integrating foundation models with agentic frameworks, you will help create intelligent clinical tools capable of dynamic reasoning, multi\-step evidence synthesis, and complex decision support in oncology. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- 1\. Oncology Foundation Model Development * Design, train, and fine\-tune large\-scale multimodal foundation models specialized in oncology (e.g., integrating spatial transcriptomics, whole\-slide images, and clinical histories). * Implement pre\-training strategies tailored to bio\-medical domains, including self\-supervised learning (SSL), contrastive learning, and masked token prediction. * Evaluate model robustness, generalization, and domain shift across diverse patient cohorts, tumor types, and sequencing platforms. 2\. Agentic Platform Engineering * Architect scalable agentic frameworks (e.g., tool\-use, multi\-agent communication, autonomous planning, and retrieval\-augmented generation) tailored for clinical workflows. * Design safety guards, reasoning trace verification, and human\-in\-the\-loop interventions for AI agents operating in high\-stakes medical settings. * Integrate agentic systems with external biological knowledge bases, literature databases (PubMed, clinical trials), and EHR interfaces. 3\. Connecting Models \& Agents (The Synergy) * Expose specialized oncology foundation models as core tools/capabilities within the agentic platform, enabling agents to dynamically invoke multi\-omic analysis tools. * Develop agent\-driven workflows that use foundation models to summarize complex patient trajectories, propose biomarker\-driven treatment hypotheses, or query trial eligibility. * Optimize end\-to\-end latency, reasoning chains, and output interpretability for clinical and scientific research end\-users. The successful candidate will play a central role in modernizing and expanding the NetZoo software ecosystem—one of the world’s leading open\-source platforms for gene regulatory network analysis—and in developing intelligent software systems that fundamentally change how scientific software is created, maintained, and used. **Job Summary** We are undertaking a major redesign of the NetZoo software ecosystem that will make our tools more robust and sustainable. The successful candidate will lead software engineering efforts that include: Refactoring the NetZoo codebase into a modular, extensible, and maintainable software architecture. Designing and implementing modern software engineering practices across the entire project. Developing the next generation of NetBooks, an interactive educational and analytical environment that combines executable tutorials, reproducible workflows, and best practices for computational biology. Building AI\-assisted and agentic software systems that automate testing, documentation, software maintenance, code review, dependency management, issue triage, and developer support. Developing intelligent agents that help scientists construct, execute, and interpret complex network analyses. Building scalable cloud\-native and high\-performance computing workflows for large biological datasets. Working closely with computational biologists to translate cutting\-edge algorithms into robust, production\-quality software. The position provides substantial opportunity for innovation. We are particularly interested in exploring how large language models, autonomous software agents, and modern AI development tools can improve both scientific software engineering and the user experience for computational biology. We value clean architecture, thoughtful design, careful documentation, reproducibility, and maintainability as essential components of scientific excellence. Equally important is our collaborative culture. We function as an integrated research team in which software engineers, computational biologists, statisticians, postdoctoral fellows, students, and faculty work closely together. Every member of the laboratory is expected to contribute to a shared scientific mission by participating in collaborative software design, code reviews, scientific discussions, manuscript preparation, mentoring, and the continuous improvement of our research ecosystem. Research software engineers are valued as intellectual partners in our scientific mission. We value demonstrated delivery and judgment over expertise in a particular language * Strong SQL and relational data modeling skills, with the ability to investigate query performance and reconcile results * Experience translating business definitions into reusable data models and tested metrics; semantic\-layer experience is valuable * Strong software engineering fundamentals: service and API design, debugging, testing, and the ability to work across languages and unfamiliar codebases * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications with tool use and structured data access, and evaluating their reliability and output quality * Testing discipline across software and data, including automated regression tests in CI * Able to work directly with business leaders, turn ambiguous questions into precise definitions, and explain results clearly * Independent and self\-motivated, with the ability to take a tool from an unclear need through rollout and ongoing support * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Semantic platforms such as Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, or LookML, and Power BI data models or DAX * Retrieval\-augmented generation, enterprise search, knowledge graphs, or knowledge\-base systems * Docker and AWS * E\-commerce, retail, supply chain, or pricing background **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(El Segundo, CA)

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Trailhead Biosystems merges developmental biology with computerized experimental design to develop novel iPSC research products. Trailhead Biosystems is the pioneer of High\-Dimensional Design\-of\-Experiment (HD\-DoE®), a powerful platform that differentiates human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) into virtually any desired cell type with unparalleled precision and efficiency. We are moving beyond traditional trial\-and\-error methods by implementing Quality by Design (QbD) principles and utilizing DoE combined with Multivariate Data Analysis (MVDA). We are seeking a forward\-thinking AI Engineer to join our R\&D team and help build the intelligent systems that drive our cellular engineering workflows. **Why Join Us?** As an AI Engineer at Trailhead, you will not just be managing data; you will be part of a team that is revolutionizing how we explore cell biology, using intelligent systems to direct human iPSC differentiation with unprecedented reproducibility and accuracy * Generate Computer\-Based Experimental Designs: Drive advanced cell culture workflows through AI\-supported design, drastically reducing the time and number of experiments needed for optimization. * Model Biological Complexity: Mathematically model the effector/response space to perform virtual experiments, allowing us to predict how specific additives will create desirable cell culture fates before physical testing. * Decipher Gene Expression: Gain deep knowledge into how culture conditions affect gene expression, addressing complex optimization challenges regarding cell purity and potency. * Master Manufacturing Variance: Use data\-driven insights to understand and control variance in cell manufacturing methods, ensuring consistent, high\-quality outcomes. **The Role** As an AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in deploying Agentic AI frameworks that can reason, plan, and execute complex scientific tasks. You will build autonomous multi\-agent systems capable of analyzing proprietary biological data, managing knowledge graphs, and optimizing experiments. Working within a robust Azure cloud architecture, you will turn research concepts into production\-grade tools that empower our scientists to work faster and smarter. **Responsibilities** * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with research scientists, biologists, and product managers to translate complex scientific challenges into actionable technical requirements and scalable AI solutions. * Develop Agentic AI Solutions: Design and build autonomous AI agents that leverage our proprietary biological datasets to automate complex analytical workflows, from experimental design to data interpretation. * Fine\-Tune Domain\-Specific Models: Fine\-tune open\-weights models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) on our proprietary biological datasets to create specialized models capable of understanding cell differentiation pathways and effector\-response relationships. * Proprietary Data Architecture \& UI: Architect, build and maintain a secure proprietary database and automated data ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT), while developing intuitive user\-friendly interfaces and APIs that help scientists to easily query, visualize, and interact with our proprietary data. * Build \& Maintain Knowledge Graphs: Integrate GenAI models with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) to map complex relationships between cell lines, reagents, and genetic markers, enabling the AI to perform deep reasoning over structured biological data. * Orchestrate Multi\-Agent Systems: Design and implement sophisticated multi\-model, multi\-agent architectures using state\-of\-the\-art frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI. Your systems will coordinate multiple specialized agents to solve multi\-step problems collaboratively. * Production Deployment on Azure: Lead the deployment of AI solutions into a secure Azure cloud environment. You will be responsible for setting up monitoring, ensuring observability (logging, tracing), and managing the lifecycle of models using MLOps best practices (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, MLflow). * RAG \& Information Retrieval: Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in our internal scientific corpus, ensuring high accuracy and reduced hallucinations in technical outputs. * Evaluation \& Benchmarking: Design, implement, and own automated LLM evaluation frameworks and benchmarking suites to quantify model accuracy, reliability, and business impact. * Guardrails \& Quality Assurance \& Policy Making: Establish and maintain robust guardrails, observability, and quality gates to mitigate hallucinations, ensure AI safety, and prevent jailbreaking. Help build policies, governance, and procedures. * Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks to ensure system reproducibility and facilitate team knowledge sharing. * Ownership: Own end\-to\-end model performance and reliability across different systems, including continuous monitoring, logging, and regression testing. **Qualifications \& Requirements** Education: * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Biology or a related quantitative field. Experience: * 3\-5 years of professional experience in software engineering with a dedicated focus on AI/ML. * 2\+ years of experience developing agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines using large language models, bringing prototypes through to scalable production. Technical Skills: * Agentic Frameworks: Strong proficiency with orchestration frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen. Experience building agents that utilize tool calling and function execution is essential. * Programming: Expert\-level fluency in Python and familiarity with modern software development practices (CI/CD, Git, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes). * Cloud Architecture: Demonstrated experience deploying scalable applications on Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure Functions is highly preferred. * Data Engineering \& Knowledge Graphs: Experience designing schemas and querying graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL) and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus). * MLOps: Practical knowledge of model monitoring, evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, LangSmith), and deploying models via REST APIs (FastAPI). Soft Skills: * Ability to translate complex technical concepts for cross\-functional teams, including biologists and lab scientists. * Strong problem\-solving skills with a "builder" mindset, you enjoy taking projects from prototype to production. * Collaborative spirit with a desire to work in a fast\-paced, research\-driven environment. Nice to Have: * Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sectors. * Familiarity with biological data standards or bioinformatics workflows. Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

This includes travel domestically and internationally. **What You'll Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems, Telecommunications, or related technical field and/or related experience with 5\+ years of experience. * Experience or training with CCaaS and UCaaS platforms is preferred. Experience with NICE Neva solutions is a plus. * NICE CXone administration and development experience is required. NICE CXone Certified Professional, NICE CXone Studio Certification, and NICE CXone Admin Certification are entations. * Knowledge of WAN/LAN technologies and VoIP/SIP call routing technologies and protocols, including working knowledge of TCP/IP routers, SBC’s, servers, switches, firewalls, DNS, DHCP and Citrix Desktop deployments. * Experience leading projects, coordinating cross\-functional teams, or providing technical guidance to peers, contractors, or vendors. * Experience working closely with our engineers, analysts, IT peers, outside vendors, outside expert resources third party vendors, carriers, internal technical and business resources to evaluate, develop, and propose innovative new technologies including CCaaS and UCaaS options, financials and risks, methodologies, processes, and other improvements aimed at improving the effectiveness of the organization. * Experience creating call flow diagrams using Visio to document and visualize scripting logic. * Proven experience designing, developing, configuring, testing, implementing, and supporting NICE CXone Studio scripting solutions using industry best practices and established development standards. * Proven ability to coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and contractors to troubleshoot, isolate, and resolve complex telecommunications and contact center issues. * Experience administering and supporting NICE CXone contact center environments, including routing, workflows, agent configuration, reporting, and platform integrations. * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting AI\-enabled customer experience solutions within NICE CXone, including intelligent routing, virtual assistants, automation, analytics, and conversational AI capabilities. * Expert\-level technical expertise supporting NICE CXone contact center solutions and complex telecommunications environments. Experience with VoIP/SIP technologies, contact center integrations, and Cisco telecommunications systems is preferred. * Five or more years of experience in the support and development of solutions within complex telecommunications environments. *Experience equivalent to the education requirement may be accepted in lieu of the education requirement.* **How You'll Be Rewarded:** We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. jobs.title: AI Engineer - Agent Infrastructure & AI Workflow
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a talented and driven developer to join a client of TribalScale's team and build the shared, cloud native agent infrastructure on AWS that our AI\-assisted modeling pipeline and our internal AI\-enabled development workflow run on. A client of TribalScale, builds virtual Arm devices: phones, IoT boards and automotive controllers that run real, unmodified firmware on a client of TribalScale's CHARM hypervisor. Atlas is our product for virtual IoT, automotive and embedded hardware. Today each new device model takes a team of modeling engineers weeks of reading reference manuals and hand\-writing peripheral models. We are building an AI\-assisted modeling pipeline that collects vendor documentation, extracts per\-peripheral specifications, generates register and system definitions, synthesizes behavioral C code, and validates the result by booting vendor firmware. We use it on our own bring\-ups first, then hand it to Atlas partners so they can build and validate their own models. This role sits on our AI \& SDLC Platform team, which supplies agent infrastructure and AI platform support to the delivery teams. Model Delivery owns the modeling backlog and its outcomes. You own the substrate that pipeline runs on: job orchestration, multi\-model inference, evaluation hooks, observability and secure deployment. Your work takes the pipeline from an engineer\-run prototype to a reliable, measured service. You apply the same infrastructure to replace parts of our internal software development process with AI\-enabled workflows. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design and implement orchestration for long\-running agent pipelines on AWS: job orchestration, artifact and manifest generation, checkpointing, retries, and prompt and model versioning. * Run multi\-model inference across Amazon Bedrock and self\-hosted models, with routing, an independent judge model, semantic caching and token\-cost and latency controls. * Provide shared evaluation and tracing hooks so Model Delivery can measure each pipeline stage and compare models, prompts and pipeline versions. * Build and operate the internal AI gateway, agent runtime and tool integrations that engineers use in the AI enabled SDLC: code review, ticket\-to\-merge\-request workflows and knowledge retrieval. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) with secure secrets management and least\-privilege access. * Instrument agents and pipelines (success rate, cost, latency, failure modes) and maintain dashboards, alerts and runbooks. * Work with the product teams that own customer\-facing MCP and API surfaces so internal agent tools and product interfaces stay consistent. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Hands\-on experience with AWS services including Bedrock, Lambda, ECS or EKS, S3 and Step Functions. * Experience with GenAI infrastructure: LLM integration, agent frameworks, MCP, semantic caching and LLM evaluation. * Familiarity with Amazon EKS and Kubernetes\-based deployments. * Familiarity with GitHub/GitLab workflows, secrets management and secure deployment practices. • * Knowledge of observability tools like Datadog and log aggregation strategies. * Ability to write clean, maintainable code and contribute to shared documentation and best practices. * Experience collaborating directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross\-functional delivery teams. * Excellent wr  with tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar platforms for monitoring and evaluating AI systems. * **Embedded Systems \& Virtualization:** Exposure to Arm architectures, firmware development, IoT devices, hypervisors, or hardware virtualization. * **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Experience building MCP servers, integrating external tools, or developing reusable agent tooling. * **Infrastructure Scalability:** Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and scaling production AI workloads. * **AI Workflow Automation:** Experience automating software development processes, including code generation, automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows. * **Open\-Source Contributions:** Contributions to open\-source AI frameworks, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure projects. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. As you grow in the role, you will: * Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans. * Deliver AI\-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations. * Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible. * Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models. * Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly. * Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements. * Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production. **Why TribalScale** ------------------- * Work on high\-impact challenges across industries and technology domains. * Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations. * Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions. * Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning. * Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale's evolving technical practices. * Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged. **Why Choose TribalScale** At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI\-driven innovation. We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation. **Diversity: Our Collective Strength** TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able\-bodiedness, or gender identity. We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. Your unique perspective is the key to our collective innovation. Should you require any accommodations, we implore you to inform us. Our commitment to inclusivity knows no bounds, and we stand ready to adapt our processes to ensure your comfort and success.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location within the state. Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until December 21st, but may change based on business needs. . **Twilio thinks big.
