jobs.title: URBN Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Role Summary: URBN is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud\-native services that power our digital ecosystem. We're looking for a hands\-on technical leader who has taken complex systems from concept through production, architected the solution, rallied a team around it, and seen it through to a reliable, measurable outcome. You will own outcomes and be accountable for delivery timelines as much as the technology. You will collaborate with a cross\-functional team of designers, data scientists, product managers, and domain experts to deliver significant business impact. Role Responsibilities: * Design and own RESTful web services and APIs using frameworks such as Tornado, or similar technologies, including GraphQL where appropriate. * Architect asynchronous, event\-driven systems and data pipelines, including consumer/producer patterns, batching strategies, error handling, and dead\-letter/failure recovery flows. * Design, build, and deploy containerized and serverless workloads on public cloud platforms, using cloud\-native services where they fit. * Define and manage infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) to keep environments reproducible, version\-controlled, and auditable. * Design data storage schemas, indexing strategies, and query optimization for high\-throughput transactional workloads, and design caching layers where low\-latency reads are required. * Integrate AI/ML services and agentic workflows into backend systems using modern orchestration frameworks and event\-driven patterns, including agentic harnesses (orchestration, tool access, context management, guardrails, and evaluation loops) and AI telemetry (model and tool call traces, token usage and cost, latency, and output quality) to run and improve them reliably in production. * Own a comprehensive test strategy across unit, integration, behavior\-driven, and performance/load testing; practice TDD and maintain high coverage standards. * Own performance and resiliency: define and meet targets for latency, throughput, and availability; build in redundancy and graceful degradation. * Apply SRE practices: observability (structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health checks), alerting, capacity planning, and deployment/release engineering through CI/CD pipelines. * Establish engineering standards: static analysis, type checking, automated quality gates, and code review practices. * Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (design, coding, testing, code review, documentation, deployment, and incident analysis), and define team practices for it, such as context management, reusable agent instructions and skills, and human review of AI\-generated code, while measuring its impact on quality and delivery speed. * Own the technical roadmap for your area end\-to\-end: scope, sequence, and deliver major initiatives from design through production rollout, balancing technical debt against feature velocity. * Participate in cross\-functional planning with product, operations, and other engineering teams to align technical work with business priorities and deadlines. * Conduct exploratory proof\-of\-concept studies to evaluate new architectures and technologies. * Mentor engineering team members and champion engineering best practices. * Participate in on\-call support and incident response; diagnose issues across API, database, and cloud infrastructure layers, and drive post\-incident follow\-through. Role Qualifications: * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a role with direct ownership of project delivery (technical lead, engineering manager, or senior IC accountable for outcomes, not just code). * Demonstrated track record of taking at least one significant system or platform from design through production launch, including the tradeoffs, setbacks, and cross\-team coordination involved. * Expert\-level backend engineering in a modern, high\-performance language/framework ecosystem, with strong command of asynchronous programming patterns. * RESTful APIs \& Distributed Systems: Strong background in designing and building scalable RESTful APIs and distributed systems, including microservices architecture and high availability. * Containerization \& Cloud: Proficiency with Docker and experience deploying and operating applications on major public cloud platforms. Experience with serverless workloads, container orchestration (deployments, configuration/secrets management, autoscaling, resource tuning), and cloud\-native services. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands\-on experience defining and managing infrastructure using Terraform or similar tools. * Database Management: Deep experience with production\-grade relational data stores, including schema/data modeling, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, replication, and query optimization at scale. * Messaging \& Event\-Driven Systems: Experience with distributed messaging/event\-streaming systems, including consumer group management, batch processing, error handling, and partition/scaling management. * Quality \& Automation: Dedication to modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), comprehensive testing (unit, integration, behavior\-driven, performance/load), and automated code quality standards. * AI\-Augmented Development: Proficient in using AI\-powered development tools (e.g., Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Claude Code, or Gemini) across the development lifecycle, from coding and testing to design documentation and code review, with sound judgment in validating AI\-generated output for correctness, security, and protection of proprietary code and data. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, PTO, generous employee discounts, retirement savings and much more! jobs.description: **About the Role** As a Staff Security Technologist, Incident Command, you are accountable for leading Uber’s most critical, complex, and high\-impact security incidents end\-to\-end \- from escalation to containment, recovery, and systemic remediation \- and owning the operational and technical effectiveness of the incident\-command function. This role will sit in either our Seattle, San Francisco, or Sunnyvale office. You operate at the intersection of Fire Captain, NTSB Investigator, and hands\-on technical practitioner. In the moment, you take command \- setting strategy, assigning resources, and making high\-consequence decisions under pressure. After the smoke clears, you drive deep technical investigation and post\-incident analysis to ensure we understand not just what happened, but why it happened, and that meaningful, durable fixes are made. This is not a passive coordination role. You are expected to be technically credible, decisive in ambiguity, and comfortable owning outcomes when there is no playbook. As a technical domain and cultural leader, you drive the priorities, goals, and delivery of a significant incident response program spanning multiple high\-complexity projects. You align Security Technologists and partner teams across Engineering Security and adjacent functions \- raising the technical bar, establishing reusable frameworks and best practices, and modernizing tooling and workflows to reduce risk across Uber. **What the Candidate Will Do** * Command the highest severity and most complex security incidents across Uber and its subsidiaries, serving as the single accountable leader during active response. * Participate in an on\-call rotation where you are expected to make real\-time decisions with incomplete information, balancing speed, risk, and impact, and model decisive, responsible action that keeps responders and stakeholders moving. * Act as the incident authority, not just a facilitator \- forming hypotheses, setting strategy, and directing investigative focus while providing technical oversight to engineers and Security Technologists working across parallel response and remediation efforts. * Transition seamlessly between executive\-level incident leadership and hands\-on technical investigation, including log analysis, system interrogation, and root cause validation across complex systems and security domains. * Serve as the primary interface to senior leadership during critical incidents, translating evolving technical realities into concise, audience\-aware updates with clear knowns, unknowns, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed. Align stakeholders and seek guidance from senior leaders as appropriate. * Build and maintain strong working relationships with global engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy, and operations teams to enable fast, coordinated response, aligning competing goals and translating business needs, risks, and threats into actionable response requirements. * Conduct rigorous post\-incident analysis in the spirit of an NTSB investigation \- focused on systemic causes, contributing factors, and concrete prevention. Drive cross\-team remediation with accountable owners, timelines, and validation of durable risk reduction. * Serve as a cultural and technical leader, actively mentoring responders, incident leaders, and promising engineers and architects. Share domain expertise and coach effective communication, sound decisions under uncertainty, and greater cross\-organizational impact. * Own the priorities, goals, and delivery of a significant incident response program with multiple high\-complexity projects, in partnership with Senior Manager and Director\+ stakeholders. Align Security Technologists across related and adjacent efforts, provide technical and architectural direction, and proactively deliver improvements, including: * High\-fidelity incident simulations and technical tabletop exercises that develop responders, expose readiness gaps, and turn incident learnings into validated improvements * Threat\-informed response planning and scenario development, supported by reusable frameworks, playbooks, documentation, and tutorials that enable other teams to leverage your work independently * ‘Left of boom’ threat modeling and pre\-mortems to prevent incidents before they occur, translating attack paths and business risk into preventive controls and measurable risk reduction * Improvements to detection, containment, and response automation that solve classes of recurring problems and create broadly reusable solutions adopted by multiple teams * Adoption of new investigative techniques and tooling, including AI\-assisted workflows, with source validation, data protection, and human decision gates. Establish and promote response best practices across the group **Basic Qualifications** * 8\+ years in security operations, detection, or incident response roles at scale, with demonstrated ownership of ambiguous, large, complex, high\-impact incidents a tions. Ability to translate business problems, risk, and threats into security requirements and effective response solutions. * Strong technical investigation skills \- comfortable working directly with logs, telemetry, and raw system data to validate hypotheses and determine root cause, with the technical depth and breadth to resolve undefined, high\-risk problems with little existing structure. * Experience briefing executives during active incidents and aligning technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels, with concise, informative, audience\-appropriate communication of tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and recommended actions. * Experience designing or running technical incident simulations (tabletops, purple team exercises, or similar) that stress real\-world response enabling peers and stakeholders to make sound decisions under uncertainty, responding promptly, and following through on commitments. * Experience responding to incidents in highly distributed, cloud\-scale environments where blast radius and coordination complexity are significant, and driving improvements across multiple teams and adjacent functions. * Broad security domain knowledge jobs.title: Research Scientist - Agentic AI and Knowledge Extraction
jobs.description: At **Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED)** (UDC), we’re changing the way people see the world. If you’re reading this on a smartphone, there’s a good chance UDC’s materials are producing the light and color shining from your screen right now. UDC’s OLED ingredients are key parts of stunning, energy\-efficient displays used in everything from smartwatches to phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs and automobiles. Virtually every OLED consumer electronics product around the world uses UDC’s phosphorescent OLED materials and technologies. UDC is a publicly traded company and pioneer in the OLED industry. When you join our global team, you are embarking on a journey at the forefront of display technology and organic electronics that impacts the daily lives of people around the world. From engineers to chemists, Ph.D. scientists, technicians, lawyers and more, our UDC team is continuously advancing our field. With a focus on energy efficiency, UDC’s team is contributing to making a better, more sustainable planet. Please visit us at www.oled.com. **Job Summary:** Universal Display Corporation is seeking a Research Scientist to develop and deploy agentic AI systems and scientific knowledge\-extraction workflows that accelerate molecular discovery and materials research. This role will build multi\-agent systems that explore chemical space and propose candidate materials, while developing pipelines that convert patents, scientific literature, and chemical structure images into machine\-readable knowledge that these systems can use. The position will contribute to a broader AI/ML and synthetic chemistry team advancing OLED chemistry across the discovery process, from ideation through synthesis and testing. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agents or scientific information\-extraction systems, sufficient chemistry knowledge to evaluate their outputs, and the ability to collaborate with ML scientists, computational chemists, and synthetic chemists to move new materials from concept toward experimental validation. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, and evaluate multi\-agent AI systems for molecular discovery, including database\-driven exploration and open\-ended, chemistry\-guided search. * Develop workflows that extract molecular structures, properties, and design knowledge from patents, scientific literature, and chemical structure images, including generic and Markush structures. * Build retrieval and knowledge\-management systems, including vector, graph, and relational databases, that allow agents to search curated scientific corpora. * Develop tools, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect agents to predictive models and computational chemistry workflows. * Design persistent and shared\-memory approaches that enable agentic systems to build on prior discovery efforts. * Evaluate agent performance against expert review and incorporate feedback from synthetic chemists into the continuous improvement of agentic workflows. * Contribute to secure, reproducible AI infrastructure for deploying agentic systems in isolated cloud and on\-premises environments. **Required** **Qualifications:** * Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience applying large language models or agentic AI to scientific problems. * Proven experience developing agentic AI workflows, LLM tool harnesses, or AI\-enabled scientific applications that connect models, tools, data, and user workflows. * Experience extracting structured information from scientific text, patents, or chemical structure images. * Proficiency in Python for scientific programming, including hands\-on experience with RDKit and working knowledge of SMILES and SMARTS. * Experience with retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or databases, including vector, graph, or SQL databases. * Strong working knowledge of molecular chemistry sufficient to assess the validity of proposed molecules and extracted structures. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building MCP servers or custom APIs for agent tool use. * Experience with optical chemical structure recognition (image\-to\-SMILES) or Markush structure handling. * Experience with agent memory, multi\-agent coordination, or agent\-evaluation methods. * Experience fine\-tuning or distilling language models, including small models for domain\-specific tasks. * Experience with chemistry\-specific language models or generative molecular design. * Background in molecular chemistry, organic electronics, OLED materials, or organic semiconductors. * Experience with patent\-literature analysis or prior\-art search. * Experience deploying AI systems in secure or isolated computing environments. **Current Benefits at UDC:** * Competitive base salary and annual bonus program * Medical/Prescription Drug coverage, Dental, and Vision for employees and family * Option of Health and Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) * Option of Health Savings Account (HSA) * Group Term Life insurance, short term disability, and long\-term disability benefits for employees * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * 401(k) company contribution * Ewing Worldwide Headquarters (HQ) cafeteria provides breakfast and lunch to employees at no cost to them * Annual charitable matching gift * Generous Paid Time Off **Annual compensation range: $115k\-140k** At Universal Display Corporation, base pay is one part of our total compensation package. Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the annual salary range only, and does not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable.

jobs.description: **Open Source Research Software Engineer:** Computational Infrastructure (0652\) Job \#87957 \- Berkeley In About Berkeley At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world. At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups. We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence. Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride. Departmental Overview Since its launch in 2013, BIDS has been dedicated to accelerating data\-driven discovery by fostering an environment of open inquiry and cross\-disciplinary collaboration. We have successfully broken down traditional academic silos, uniting domain experts from the life, physical, and social sciences, as well as the arts and humanities, with methodological leaders in computer science, statistics, and applied mathematics. BIDS is expertly positioned as the central hub for advancing interdisciplinary data science research, academic training, and software development within the UC Berkeley College of Computing, Data Science, and Society. BIDS houses UC Berkeley's Open Source Program Office and champions open science, open source software, and open scholarship. We serve as a discipline\-agnostic space to rally Berkeley's unique ecosystem, driving forward innovative collaborations that explore the profound impacts of Artificial Intelligence on both science and society. UC Berkeley and UCSF have launched a joint program called the Bakar Computational Biomedicine Initiative to develop the frontier of AI and biomedicine, tremendously accelerating advances in clinical care. The new partnership brings together world\-class faculty expertise in computing, AI, statistics, biology, and medicine, to speed discovery in everything from disease prevention, to early detection and new therapeutics in healthcare. As part of this effort, at BIDS our team of open source research software engineers (OS\-RSEs), product managers, and computational postdoctoral researchers will build the BioJupyter platform. Based on the widely adopted architecture of Project Jupyter and developed as part of the existing Jupyter ecosystem, with advancements and contributions to existing Jupyter components as well as the development of new tools, BioJupyter will bring next\-generation features to facilitate collaboration in data\-intensive, AI\-powered biomedical research. These will include, but not be limited to, advances in core Jupyter components for collaboration and data sharing across deployments in separate hosting environments (ranging from local clusters and HPC facilities to the cloud), integration of AI agents and tools into the research workflow, sharing of intermediate results, code and pre\-publication outputs with fine\-grained access control, and fluid integration of these Jupyter deployments alongside existing research tools and environments that are independent of Jupyter. OS\-RSEs bring software engineering expertise and open source development practices to interdisciplinary projects. They play the role of an "expert collaborator" who solves problems at the intersection of research, software, and modern computing infrastructure. They regularly investigate \-\- and propose solutions to \-\- open\-ended, unstructured challenges that arise from the computational needs of researchers. They scope, and deliver on technical requirements that require an in\-depth evaluation of cutting\-edge data science and AI applications. They are integral members of a diverse team, co\-creating the BioJupyter platform to solve real\-world challenges in the biomedical sciences. OS\-RSEs work closely with senior researchers, industry partners, and stakeholders across global scientific open source projects in the Jupyter ecosystem, as well as those of the computational tools used by our researchers today, including Scientific Python, R, and beyond. They create, improve, and maintain parts of the open source software ecosystem that underpins global innovation in data science and AI. jobs.description: **Programmer Analyst 3** ------------------------ **Requisition ID** req38568 **Working Title** Programmer Analyst 3 **Position Grade** 14 **Position Summary** **Position Summary:** UNM Information Technologies is seeking a Programmer Analyst 3 (AI Engineer) to build AI agents and AI enabled automation on nebulaONE, the university’s general purpose AI platform built on Microsoft Azure AI Foundry. Under limited supervision, the AI Engineer will apply advanced system analysis and design techniques to produce innovative solutions addressing complex business objectives: analyzing existing university processes, identifying where AI can add value and where it cannot, and designing, developing, testing, and supporting agents and automation that improve services for students, faculty, and staff. This role builds solutions on existing foundation models, such as OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude models, rather than training models, using retrieval augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and multi\-step workflows with human review where appropriate. The AI Engineer will help define how AI solutions are built at UNM by developing engineering standards, guidelines, reference architectures, and reusable templates for agent development. These will cover evaluation and regression testing, prompt and version control, security guardrails such as least\-privilege access and prompt\-injection defenses, protection of university data, accessibility, and monitoring. The position will review code and agent designs written by other developers and provide documentation, training, and technical guidance to IT staff and campus agent developers. The role will connect agents to enterprise systems including ServiceNow, Ellucian Banner, Salesforce, and Microsoft 365 using APIs, MCP servers, and the Boomi Integration Platform, and will implement monitoring and usage and cost reporting using Azure Monitor and Application Insights. The position participates in modern DevSecOps practices including pipelines, version control, code review, and automated testing, and uses AI assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex. The successful applicant will be a software engineer who has built and deployed applications using large language models, with specialized skills in Python or a similar language, sound judgment about where AI does and does not belong, a commitment to responsible and secure use of AI, and strong communication skills for working with technical and non\-technical partners in a higher education environment. Completed degree(s) from an accredited institution and/or experience that is directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified may be interchangeable on a year\-for\-year basis. large language models (LLMs) through provider APIs such as Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI, including at least one solution used in production. * Experience with retrieval augmented generation (RAG), including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and vector or hybrid search such as Azure AI Search. * Experience building AI agents that use tool or function calling and multi\-step workflows, and knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including developing MCP servers. * Experience evaluating AI solutions, including building test sets, automated evaluations, and regression tests that measure accuracy, grounding, and safety before and after changes. * Knowledge of AI security and responsible AI practices, including prompt\-injection and data\-leakage defenses, least\-privilege access, human review of AI outputs, and frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. * Experience analyzing business processes and automating them using AI and workflow tools, including determining when AI is and is not the appropriate solution. * Specialized skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, including writing, testing, and troubleshooting code of advanced complexity and developing APIs. * Knowledge and/or experience with agent frameworks or SDKs such as Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or the Claude Agent SDK. * Knowledge and/or experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault, API Management, ping technical standards, reference architectures, reusable templates, or developer documentation, and performing code reviews. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Ellucian Banner, Salesforce, or Microsoft 365 using REST APIs and middleware platforms such as Boomi. * Experience with DevSecOps and the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including version control, CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, automated testing, and containerized deployment. * Experience using AI assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, including verifying and testing AI generated code. * Knowledge of data privacy, security, and accessibility requirements relevant to higher education, such as FERPA, HIPAA, institutional data classification, and WCAG 2\.1 AA. * Ability to obtain results and add value to the organization by being accessible to and supportive of others, setting clear goals and monitoring progress, making timely and sound decisions, and collaborating effectively across teams. * Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills including the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences and to develop documentation and training for end users. **Additional Requirements** Applications need to include a complete jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Industrial Engineering, Tenure Stream
jobs.description: Assistant Professor of Industrial Engineering, Tenure Stream Industrial Engineering \- Pennsylvania\-Pittsburgh \- (26007004\) The Department of Industrial Engineering at the University of Pittsburgh invites applications for a tenure/tenure\-track faculty position at the Assistant Professor rank, with an expected start date of Fall 2027\. We are seeking candidates in all areas of industrial engineering, including, but not limited to, data analytics, simulation, AI/ML, human factors, and operations research applied to address challenges in health systems, manufacturing, materials, robotics, quality/reliability, and other emerging areas. Applicants must hold a PhD in Industrial Engineering or a closely related field. Preference given to candidates with one or more degrees in industrial engineering. Applicants should also have a strong methodological background and an ability to conduct impactful, cutting\-edge, interdisciplinary research. Our primary search criterion is the potential to build and sustain a successful research program. Candidates should also have evidence of, or potential for, teaching excellence. Applicants should submit (1\) a cover letter, (2\) a detailed curriculum vitae, (3\) a statement of research plans/vision, (4\) a statement of teaching plans/vision, (5\) up to three representative publications, and (6\) a list of three or more professional references. They are also expected to maintain a research program; serve on assigned department committees, advise undergraduate and graduate students; serve as a Senior Design mentor as needed; and attend department meetings and events The Department of Industrial Engineering has established an outstanding reputation in a wide variety of research areas. The department maintains vibrant programs at the undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral levels; offers excellent laboratory facilities; and benefits from many contacts with regional and national corporations. Additional information about the department can be found at www.engineering.pitt.edu/industrial/. Applications will be reviewed until the position is filled. Please direct any inquiries (but not applications), to the search committee chair, Bopaya Bidanda at bidanda@pitt.edu. Applicants should submit (1\) a cover letter, (2\) a detailed curriculum vitae, (3\) a statement of research plans/vision, (4\) a statement of teaching plans/vision, (5\) up to three representative publications, and (6\) a list of three or more professional references. *The University of Pittsburgh is an equal opportunity employer / disability / veteran.* Assignment Category: Full\-time regular Bargaining Unit Eligibility: This position may be bargaining unit eligible Campus: Pittsburgh Child Protection Clearances: Not Applicable Required Attachments: Cover Letter, Curriculum Vitae, Teaching Statement, Other (see posting for additional details)

jobs.title: Manager, Tooling
jobs.description: Vast is developing next\-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware\-rich, and capital\-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven\-1 is targeted to become the world's first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high\-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long\-term space economy. Vast is looking for a **Manager, Tooling** reporting to the **Director of Mechanical Subassemblies,** to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of artificial\-gravity, human\-rated space stations, and extending to follow\-on Haven satellites and lunar programs. You will lead an engineering team with end\-to\-end ownership of tooling design, analysis, fabrication, activation and validation. You will set the standards for how Vast designs and releases tooling, define the vehicle integration flow and its tooling interfaces, and work side by side with vehicle engineering, production, and technicians to get flight hardware built safely, on schedule, and to tolerance. This will be a **full\-time**, **exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location. **Responsibilities:** * Own and grow the engineering team responsible for tooling at Vast, covering design, analysis, and fabrication * Set priorities, manage schedules, and track critical next steps, deadlines, and outcomes across assigned projects * Mentor engineers and build a culture of first\-principles design, rigor, and a safety\-first mindset * Own design and fabrication of fixtures and tooling for Haven\-1 production, lifting, handling, fabrication and transport and extend to Haven satellites and lunar programs * Develop critical lifting hardware, break\-over fixtures, and integration tooling for large, complex assemblies, including welded and fastened structures * Perform mechanical analysis (FEA and hand calculations) to qualify spacecraft fixtures, lifting equipment, and handling systems * Develop, test, and implement tool improvements that yield time savings or tolerance improvements * Coordinate tooling modifications driven by part, production, or design changes * Define the vehicle integration flow, concepts, and tooling interfaces * Collaborate with vehicle engineering and production to define fixture and tooling requirements and qualification plans, and to introduce tooling to production * Work closely with engineering stakeholders and technicians to solve production\-related issues quickly * Support work orders and assembly instructions for tooling use and vehicle build * Develop operation and maintenance plans for all test fixtures and tooling, including inspection, proof\-load, and recertification cycles * Assist facilities manager(s) in all aspects of project implementation as needed * Manage vendor relationships and coordinate meetings to identify new technologies and how they can be applied to Vast's cutting\-edge applications * Provide input on factory layout/design and capital asset sourcing, and regularly present progress and solutions to company and customer leadership **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering, or similar engineering discipline * 5\+ years of experience in aerospace or automotive tooling * 5\+ years of experience in NX or other 3D CAD packages * 4\+ years of stress analysis (FEA/Hand Calc) experience * 3\+ Structural Analysis experience using ANSYS/FEMAP * 4\+ years of experience applying industry standards (AWS, AISC and ASME) * Experience with GD\&T * Experience with work orders and assembly instructions * Experience architecting good designs based on first principles * Hands\-on experience with handling, lifting, or building large, complex assemblies **Preferred Skills \& Experience:** * Experience with managing engineers * Design of pneumatic, electrical, or hydraulic motion systems * Integration tooling design * Experience designing and producing large welded or fastened assemblies * Prior experience designing tooling for welded products * A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast\-paced environment and hands\-on design and development * Strong communication skills **Additional Requirements:** * Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones * Ability to lift up to 25lbs unassisted *We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.* **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** Base salary will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full\-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20\+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10\+ days of vacation for non\-exempt staff with the ability to cash\-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee \& onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast's ongoing commitment to providing high\-quality meals for employees. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Front End
jobs.description: **Company Description** System High is a wholly owned subsidiary of Veilant, delivering advanced protection and secrecy solutions that secure and strengthen critical missions, programs, and intelligence activities. We support some of the nation’s most sensitive efforts, and our team plays a direct role in protecting what matters most. As part of Veilant, System High combines deep mission expertise with the resources and capabilities of a broader organization focused on protecting and advancing critical national security missions. **Job Description** **Want to build instead of inherit?** System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user\-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up. This is a true greenfield opportunity. You won’t be inheriting years of legacy frontend code or simply working through an established backlog. You’ll have the opportunity to help establish the frontend architecture, component patterns, development workflows, and technical standards that shape the application as it grows. We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend development skills with broader software engineering fundamentals. You should be comfortable building modern web applications, integrating with APIs, working within GitHub and CI/CD workflows, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and other technical specialists. React is our preferred direction, but because the application is still being built, we value strong engineering fundamentals and experience with modern frontend frameworks over expertise in one narrowly defined stack. We also want someone who knows how to use modern AI\-assisted development tools effectively. AI should make you faster at tasks like documentation, testing, scaffolding, debugging, and repetitive development but it shouldn't replace your ability to understand the code, challenge the output, and make sound engineering decisions. If you're energized by a blank canvas, enjoy solving problems without having every step prescribed, and want to see your technical decisions directly influence a new product, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. **What You’ll Do** * **Own the Frontend Application Layer:** Help design and build the frontend from the ground up, establishing scalable patterns for components, routing, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability. * **Build Production\-Ready Experiences:** Translate product requirements and UI/UX concepts into responsive, intuitive, high\-quality application features. * **Integrate with APIs:** Build reliable integrations between the frontend and backend services, confidently working with API contracts, data structures, payloads, application state, error handling, and asynchronous workflows. * **Shape Frontend Architecture:** Participate in technical decisions around frameworks, libraries, application structure, reusable components, testing strategies, and development standards. * **Work Across Engineering Boundaries:** Collaborate with backend development, AI/technical specialists, QA, and product leadership to solve problems that span multiple parts of the application. * **Build Efficient Development Workflows:** Work within GitHub, AWS/GIT\-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, integration, and deployment. * **Use AI to Increase Engineering Velocity:** Apply AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate documentation, testing, debugging, code scaffolding, and repetitive engineering tasks while independently reviewing, validating, and improving generated output. * **Automate Where It Makes Sense:** Write lightweight scripts or utilities to eliminate repetitive tasks, manipulate data, support development environments, or improve engineering workflows. * **Deliver Iteratively:** Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and deliver working software through an Agile/Scrum development process. * **Contribute Beyond Your Code:** Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices. **What Success Looks Like** **Within your first six months, you will have:** * Helped establish the technical foundation and architecture of a new frontend application. * Built and delivered production\-ready features that turn product requirements into an intuitive user experience. * Established reliable integrations between the frontend and backend APIs. * Contributed reusable components, patterns, and development standards that make the application easier to extend and maintain. * Demonstrated the ability to independently troubleshoot issues across the frontend, API, data, and development workflow layers. * Integrated AI\-assisted development into your workflow in ways that measurably improve speed and efficiency without compromising engineering quality. * Become a trusted techni t. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. **Nice to Haves** * Experience helping build a new application, product, or significant feature from the ground up. * Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Familiarity with GIT/AWS development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud\-based application delivery. * Experience working across frontend/backend boundaries or collaborating closely with backend engineering teams. * Familiarity with scripting or automation using Node.js, Python, Bash, or similar technologies. * Experience establishing frontend architecture, component libraries, design systems, or engineering standards. * Experience with automated frontend or unit testing. * Exposure to applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities or other intelligent application services. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** You’re likely to enjoy this role if you like building more than maintaining. You don’t need someone else to define every implementation detail before you can get started. You’re comfortable taking a requirement, asking the right questions, evaluating different approaches, making a recommendation, and turning that recommendation into working software. You also recognize that modern engineering is changing. You’re interested in using AI and automation to remove repetitive work and increase your output, but you understand that engineering judgment still matters. You can explain your code, defend your technical decisions, identify when generated code is wrong, and improve a solution rather than accepting the first answer a tool provides. Most importantly, you want ownership. This is an opportunity to help establish something new rather than simply inherit what someone else already built. **Additional Information** **What is the Compensation Range for this role?** The salary range for this position is $100,000 \- $145,000 annually for full\-time status. Actual compensation within this range at Veilant is determined by numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, including experience, education, certifications, technical skills, as well as contract\-specific affordability and labor categories, the scope and responsibilities of the role, market and business considerations, and geographic location. **Here are some Perks at System High!** **Benefits That Support Your Life and Career** * Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage options. * Paid time off that grows with tenure, plus 11 paid holidays annually. * A 401(k) retirement savings plan and financial planning guidance. * Up to $5,250 annually in tuition assistance for approved coursework. * Support for professional training and certifications. * Company HSA contributions of $600 for individual coverage or $1,200 for family coverage, prorated. * Company paid life insurance, plus short term and long term disability coverage. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office * Constantly work with computers and other information technology equipment * The ability to communicate information and ideas in a classroom style format, may stand at a podium for long periods of time *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with Veilant through its online applicant system, please contact Veilant's Talent Management Department at (703\) 544\-2424 or contact us through e\-mail at* *contact\_us@**veilant.com*

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** *Vertex Service Partners is a home improvement services company focused on residential roofing and other exterior services across the United States. Backed by Alpine Investors, a top\-decile private equity fund with $4\.0 billion of committed capital, Vertex is building a best\-in\-class national platform.* *Our company is built on our core values—****servant leadership, unwavering character, a growth mindset, persistence, empowerment, pace, and fun****—and guided by three pillars: being the* ***Employer of Choice****,* ***Partner of Choice****, and* ***Contractor of Choice****. We offer transformative support in operations, marketing, training, talent, finance, and technology, all while preserving the autonomy of local brands.* **Mission of the role** *As a Junior AI Engineer on the AI Engineering team, you help build the AI\-powered applications, automations, and models our brands use every day: tools that route leads to sales reps, calculate commissions, staff call centers, onboard and offboard field employees, and deliver the morning reports leadership relies on. Working alongside the Senior Manager of AI Engineering, you take features from request to production. You gather context from the business, build with AI\-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code), connect to our business systems and data warehouse, and prove your work with tests before it ships. You start on well\-scoped pieces of live applications and grow into owning features, LLM capabilities, and machine learning models end\-to\-end.* **Where** **you'll** **make an impact** * **Internal applications** — Build and improve full\-stack web applications in TypeScript, React, and Node on Postgres using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code), working in GitHub with pull requests, code review, and CI/CD. * **LLM\-powered features** — Ship features built on large language models (e.g., the Claude API and Snowflake Cortex), such as plain\-English summaries in automated reports, in\-app assistants that answer "how do I…" questions, and routing requests to the right team. Evaluate the output so quality is measured, not assumed. * **Machine learning** — Help train, deploy, and monitor predictive models in our data warehouse, such as lead\-to\-rep matching scores and revenue predictions, including scheduled scoring and retraining. * **System integrations** — Connect our applications to the platforms the business runs on, including field\-service management, HR and payroll, recruiting, sales/CRM, SMS, and email. Make those integrations safe to re\-run, resilient to failure, and easy to audit. * **Data modeling in dbt** — Write dbt models in SQL with the help of AI coding assistants while understanding the dbt methodology yourself: declaring sources, layering staging, intermediate, and mart models, building the DAG with ref(), choosing materializations (view, table, incremental), and adding tests and documentation in YAML. Know how data flows from raw source to the mart an app or report reads, and what breaks downstream when a model changes. * **Reporting \& alerting automation** — Build scheduled reports, data\-quality checks, and watchdogs (Python, serverless functions) that tell the right people when something has gone wrong in the business or in one of our own services. * **Cloud deployment \& operations** — Deploy and run services on Azure (App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID sign\-in, Application Insights) and help keep them healthy once they are live. * **Business partnership** — Work directly with sales, operations, recruiting, and finance users to understand what they need, demo what you built, and document it so others can support it. **Key outcomes** * **Ships to production early** — Delivers small, reviewed changes to live applications in the first month and owns a feature end\-to\-end by the end of the first quarter. * **Capacity multiplier** — Takes well\-defined features, fixes, and enhancements off senior engineering's plate so senior time goes to architecture and the hardest problems. * **Reliable, tested work** — Changes ship with tests and documentation; integrations don't double\-send, double\-pay, or fail silently. * **Measured AI** — LLM and ML features have an evaluation set or a before/after measurement, so we know they work. * **Trusted by users** — The business teams who use our tools see their requests understood, delivered, and followed up on. **This role allows you to** * Put AI into production. Sales reps, managers, and executives use your work every day; it doesn't sit in a demo. * Learn full\-stack, data, and applied\-AI engineering at the same time, with direct mentorship from a senior AI engineering leader. * Build with modern AI\-assisted tooling and learn how to direct it, review it, and ship it responsibly. * Grow quickly in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, fast\-growing company. **Who you are** * You have 0–2 years of professional software, data, or AI engineering experience, or a CS/engineering degree, bootcamp, or equivalent portfolio. * You write working Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, and solid SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions, CASE statements). * You have built and deployed at least one project that someone other than you has used. * You have called an LLM API from code (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) and understand prompts, tool use, and the limits of model output. * You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) daily, and you review, test, and question what they produce rather than accepting it as\-is. * You're comfortable with Git/GitHub: small commits, clear pull requests, and having your code reviewed and iterating on feedback. * You understand, or can quickly learn, how data moves from source systems through modeled layers in a data warehouse. * You're a clear communicator who can explain a technical fix to a non\-technical manager in a couple of sentences. * You're curious about how the business runs and enjoy turning a vague request into something that works. **Nice to have** * dbt, Snowflake, or a modern data stack. * React (Tailwind, TanStack Query) and Postgres with an ORM. * Azure or another major cloud (serverless functions, app hosting, identity). * ML fundamentals: training, evaluating, and serving a classification or regression model. * RAG, agent, or tool\-use patterns with LLMs, and evaluating LLM output. * Automated testing (Vitest/Jest, pytest, Playwright). * Field\-service, home services, or multi\-site experience. **Personal characteristics** * **Data\-driven decision\-maker** — Skilled at working with data and finding meaning and action in numbers. * **Flexible \& adaptable** — Willing to take on new projects and challenges to support the evolving needs of a high\-growth company. * **Get\-it\-done attitude** — Problem\-solves on the fly and completes time\-sensitive work to drive the business forward. * **Service\-oriented** — Builds strong relationships with peers across the corporate team and operating companies. * **Resourceful** — Drives action and achieves results creatively with finite resources. * **Critical thinker and learner** — Picks things up quickly and asks "why" rather than taking "yes" for an answer. * **Culture carrier** — A humble servant leader with unyielding integrity who is self\-aware, open to feedback, and respectful of others. **Benefits:** Full\-time employees are eligible to participate in the following benefits: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) with company match * Company sponsored Life and AD\&D coverage * Paid Time Off * Opportunities for growth and on\-the\-job training **Why Join Us?** * **Build Something Big** – Shape processes for a rapidly growing organization. * **Growth\-Oriented Culture** – Work in a dynamic, people\-first environment. * **Make an Impact Across Regions** – Partner with business leaders to drive meaningful change. **Apply Today!** *Vertex Service Partners is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, military service, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability, please contact Human Resources with your request and contact information.* *Applicant Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About us:** At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. **What you'll do:** The System Software team owns the foundational OS layer — AlmaLinux\-based embedded servers called Mobility Access Servers (MAS) — that powers inflight WiFi and streaming content on the world's leading airlines. You'll work on the software stack from bootloader to application services: storage health, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, security hardening, and field incident investigation. When something goes wrong on a production aircraft, your team is the one that figures out why and ships the fix. This is a site\-based role; employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five\-day workweek. **The day\-to\-day:** * Software engineering as part of an agile development team * Actively design and drive software architecture involving a Linux\-based operating system with custom support applications involving REST, HW interfaces, ARINC controllers, cellular device controllers, and other low\-level driver support * Participate in the design, development, and testing of software products we support * Maintain and improve our current setup for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, with a focus on applying GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Vault, and GitHub * Improve and implement testing, both virtual and on bare metal hardware, to improve software quality by catching issues before they reach production * Debug and investigate production system failures using log analysis tools (syslog\-ng, fluent\-bit, journalctl) and field data from live aircraft deployments * Manage and maintain ZFS storage pools, disk health monitoring, and storage subsystem reliability * Develop, deploy, and maintain containerized services using Docker and k3s (lightweight Kubernetes) on embedded hardware * Drive security posture improvements including secret/key rotation, file integrity monitoring, and remediation of penetration test findings * Participate in code reviews with a view to deliver quality products in the short and long term * Travel up to 10% **What you'll need:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering * Hands\-on proficiency in C/C\+\+/Rust/Go/Bash/Python in embedded environments, independently designing, implementing, testing, and debugging solutions for well\-defined subsystems or features, with a track record of delivering that scope reliably to schedule and quality goals. * Hands\-on experience with Object Oriented methodology and development * Proficiency with Linux system administration: systemd service lifecycle, boot process debugging, and log\-based forensics (journalctl, syslog) * Experience with container technologies (Docker) and/or container orchestration (Kubernetes/k3s) * Experience investigating and debugging field incidents and production system failures, including reading system logs, correlating events across services, and driving to root cause * Experience with developing and delivering software using CI/CD and DevOps practices * Familiarity with common development and infrastructure tools including Git, GitHub, Docker, HashiCorp Vault, and artifact management platforms (e.g. Artifactory) * Ability to champion modern software practices and uphold software quality standards in all phases of development * Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate software architecture \& design, including existing codebases * Performing tests following a requirement\-based testing approach * Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development **What will help you on the job:** * Experience working with Linux distributions and embedded optimized frameworks (e.g. AlmaLinux, OpenWRT, Yocto, Buildroot) * Deep understanding of the bootloader and application bring\-up process * Experience orchestrating and optimizing resources (CPU, memory, disk) using tools such as cgroups and MGLRU * Deep familiarity with ZFS storage management — pool creation and recovery, persistent device naming (udev/wwn), disk failure mode analysis, and systemd unit integration for storage subsystem services * Kubernetes/Helm chart authoring for containerized service deployment on embedded hardware * Familiarity with infrastructure and security tooling such as HashiCorp Vault, Jenkins, Artifactory, Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions **Salary range:** $140,500\.00 \- $221,500\.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $174,000\.00\- $261,000\.00/ annually : At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Vital Services is seeking a talented and experienced Mid\-Level Software Engineer to join our growing Application Engineering department. This is an extraordinary opportunity to be a part of, and play an integral role in, the expansion of our Information Technology team. The core focus of this role is to write clean, secure, and highly efficient code that successfully implements functional requirements, ensuring rapid features delivery and high system reliability across active product and T\&M client queues. **Roles \& Responsibilities of the Software Engineer** ====================================================== * **Feature Implementation \& Delivery:** Writing well\-structured, testable, and maintainable application code that fulfills documented user stories and technical design specs. * **Defect Resolution \& Support Execution:** Investigating, triaging, and patching software bugs and performance issues efficiently across SaaS platforms and custom client applications. * **API \& Data Flow Execution:** Building and consuming secure web services, endpoints, and third\-party API extractions based on the patterns outlined by the Architect. * **Code Quality \& Testing Discipline:** Participating actively in peer code reviews, adhering to organizational standards, and writing comprehensive unit and integration tests. * **Sprint Hygiene \& Operational Visibility:** Estimating assigned tasks accurately, updating Jira tickets daily, and actively raising dependencies during sprint ceremonies to protect velocity. **Skills \& Experience of the Software Engineer** ================================================= * **Professional Core Experience:** 3\-6 years of verified full\-stack or backend software engineering experience operating within an agile team ecosystem (experience in multi\-client agency or SaaS environments is a plus). * **Technical Stack Proficiency:** Solid proficiency in C\# languages and core object\-oriented programming methodologies in a Microsoft tech stack environment. * **Database Conversance:** Clear comfort writing optimized queries and interacting with relational or non\-relational database engines (e.g., SQL/MySQL). * **Version Control Mastery:** Complete fluency with Git workflow mechanics, branching strategies, and handling merge conflicts cleanly. * **Implementation Mindset:** A strong track record of taking well\-defined, abstract functional requirements and successfully transforming them into live, working software capabilities without needing extensive architectural oversight. **Success Metrics of the Software Engineer** ============================================ * **Individual Sprint Say/Do Ratio:** \>\= 80% predictability on completing committed sprint tasks and feature points. * **Code Review Turnaround Time:** Review and provide actionable feedback on peer pull requests within an average of \< 24 hours to prevent pipeline blockages. * **Post\-Deployment Defect Leaks:** Maintain a threshold of \< 2 critical execution defects or breaking bugs introduced to production environments per quarter. * **Jira \& Time\-Tracking Accuracy:** 100% weekly compliance on task logging, feature estimations, and accurate time log entries. **Compensation \& Culture** =========================== * Salary Range: $95,000 – $115,000 (Mid\-Level) \- *Final offer will be commensurate with experience and technical assessment results.* * Hybrid Flexibility: We value our culture in our offices in Allen, TX and Oak Ridge, TN, but offer a flexible hybrid or remote schedule based on team project needs rather than a rigid clock\-in / in\-office requirement. * Growth Path: This position was created by a team member's promotion. We actively invest in our engineers' career trajectories into senior engineering or architecture roles.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Healthcare AI
jobs.description: About the Opportunity Our client is a fast\-growing healthcare AI startup that achieved **30x revenue growth over the past year**. The company develops and deploys AI agents directly within leading healthcare systems, working with organizations such as Mayo Clinic and Cleveland Clinic to improve clinical workflows and operational efficiency. We're looking for **Forward Deployed Engineers** who combine strong software engineering skills with hands\-on customer collaboration. This is a founding\-level, high\-ownership opportunity where you'll work directly with healthcare professionals to transform complex clinical challenges into reliable, production\-ready AI solutions. **Location:** San Francisco, CA — On\-site **Experience:** 1–6 years What You'll Do * Work directly with physicians, hospital IT teams, and clinical stakeholders to understand workflows, challenges, and technical needs. * Translate loosely defined clinical problems into production\-ready AI agents. * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents end\-to\-end. * Develop evaluations (evals) to validate agent reliability and performance. * Continuously improve deployed solutions based on clinical guidelines, user feedback, and operational requirements. * Troubleshoot technical issues and ship improvements quickly. * Take ownership of the entire engineering lifecycle, from identifying a customer problem to delivering a working solution. * Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and customer teams in a fast\-paced startup environment. What We're Looking For * **1–6 years of professional experience** in full\-stack software engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or related roles. * **Strong Python skills** for backend development. * Experience with **React and TypeScript** for frontend development. * Experience with **Rust, Kubernetes, and AWS**. * Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production software. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments. * Excellent communication skills and confidence collaborating directly with customers and nontechnical stakeholders. * Demonstrated technical ownership, exceptional performance, rapid career progression, or meaningful contributions to demanding engineering teams. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field. * Availability to work on\-site in San Francisco. Backgrounds We're Especially Interested In **Early\-Career Engineers (1–2 Years of Experience)** Candidates with experience at high\-growth technology startups, forward\-deployed engineering organizations, or strong computer science programs. **Experienced Engineers (3–6 Years of Experience)** Candidates with experience at high\-performing engineering organizations who have also worked in high\-growth, venture\-backed startups, founding engineering roles, or customer\-facing deployment environments. We're particularly interested in engineers who have demonstrated exceptional technical ability, strong ownership, and the capacity to deliver production\-ready solutions in demanding environments. Additional Advantages * Experience in healthcare or health technology. * Experience building AI agents or working with production AI applications. * Familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare systems, or regulated environments. * Experience with infrastructure tooling such as Helm. * Experience as a founding engineer or early employee at a venture\-backed startup. Compensation and Support * **Annual base salary:** $180,000–$285,000 USD, depending on experience and seniority. * **Equity:** Included in the compensation package. * **Relocation support:** Available. * **Visa sponsorship:** Available, including eligible H\-1B and TN sponsorships and visa transfers. Why Join? Join a rapidly growing healthcare AI startup where your work will directly impact real clinical environments. You'll collaborate with healthcare professionals, tackle complex technical challenges, and take significant ownership of solutions from development through deployment. This is an opportunity to help shape a company at an early stage while building AI technology that improves healthcare operations. **Work Location:** In person — San Francisco, California. Pay: $180,000\.00 \- $285,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description: **About WEG Electric Corp.** WEG Electric Corp. is the largest industrial electric motor manufacturer in the Americas and one of the world's largest, producing more than 21 million units annually. Founded in 1961, WEG Electric Corp. operates mainly in the capital goods sector, with five main businesses: Motors, Energy, Automation, Coatings, and Transmission \& Distribution, providing global solutions for electric motors, variable frequency drives, soft starters, controls, panels, transformers, and generators. The US corporate office is in Duluth, GA, with manufacturing units in Minnesota, Indiana, and Missouri, and over 30,000 employees worldwide. **About the Role** The **Mechanical Design Engineer** supports the design, development, and documentation of control panel enclosures, sub\-panels, and related mechanical assemblies. This role creates detailed layouts, 3D models, manufacturing drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and engineering documentation to support new product development and production. Working closely with Engineering, Sales, Purchasing, Quality, Production, and external vendors, the Mechanical Design Engineer helps ensure designs meet customer requirements, manufacturing standards, quality expectations, and cost objectives. **Primary Responsibilities** * Create detailed mechanical layouts, models, and fabrication drawings for control panels, enclosures, sub\-panels, and related assemblies using SolidWorks and AutoCAD. * Collaborate with engineers and project leaders to develop, refine, and document mechanical designs from concept through production. * Generate, maintain, and revise structured Bills of Materials (BOMs) and associated engineering documentation. * Create and maintain enclosure drawings, manufacturing documentation, and engineering records while ensuring proper revision control. * Perform basic engineering calculations and analyses to validate design performance, fit, and functionality. * Support production teams during fabrication, assembly, testing, and startup activities by resolving design\-related issues. * Work closely with Quality and Manufacturing teams to investigate and resolve design conflicts, nonconformances, and corrective actions. * Assist in selecting and specifying mechanical components and materials by coordinating with vendors and suppliers. * Prepare technical documentation, engineering reports, presentations, and design review materials. * Support Sales and Applications Engineering by developing conceptual designs and providing technical input for proposals and customer requests. * Coordinate with external vendors throughout the design, fabrication, and revision process for outsourced components and assemblies. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving SolidWorks infrastructure, engineering processes, and BOM management procedures. * Ensure designs comply with applicable standards, customer requirements, and internal engineering practices. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned. ### **Eduction** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Mechanical Design, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education and directly related experience. **Experience \& Knowlege** * Minimum 1 year of experience developing mechanical drawings, assemblies, or engineering documentation in a manufacturing or industrial environment; internships and co\-op experience considered. * Minimum 1 year of experience using 3D CAD software, preferably SolidWorks. * Minimum 1 year of experience creating and maintaining Bills of Materials (BOMs) and engineering documentation. * Working knowledge of AutoCAD and engineering drawing practices. * Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, fabrication techniques, and assembly methods. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Up to 2 years of experience in mechanical design, product development, or industrial equipment manufacturing environments. * Knowledge of industrial standards and codes, including UL 50, NEMA, and UL 508A. * Experience designing sheet metal, weldments, machined components, or enclosure systems. * Understanding of BOM systems, material management processes, and engineering change control. * Knowledge of manufacturing and assembly processes for industrial enclosures and control panels. * Familiarity with drawing exchange between CAD platforms and dimension scaling requirements. * Experience supporting production, quality, and vendor\-related engineering activities. * Knowledge of WEG products and industrial power or automation equipment is a plus. We offer a pleasant work environment, competitive compensation, and a full benefits package. Benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, Employee Assistance Program, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, 401K, Paid Time Off, Eleven Paid Holidays, and one floating holiday. **To Apply:** All candidates must submit an updated resume and complete our application in order to be considered for this position. Must be authorized to work in the United States. WEG Electric Corp. does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran status, or other protected status. Visit our website to learn more: **www.weg.net.**

or application environments through professional or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Experience with Azure (preferred) or another major cloud provider (AWS, GCP), with familiarity in cloud security and monitoring tools. * Basic understanding of identity and access management concepts; familiarity with Azure and Entra ID is preferred. * Familiarity with source control and automated deployments;
