jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Would you like to put AI to work on real client problems, helping rebuild how a global risk consulting business delivers its advice, inside a company that works with 91% of the Fortune Global 500? We are looking for hands\-on AI Solutions Engineers to join our Willis Neuron Technology team in London or New York on a 2\-year fixed term, working directly with the consulting practices of Risk \& Analytics (R\&A), part of Willis, a WTW business, to redesign workflows, build working solutions and modernise how they deliver for clients. R\&A's consulting practices are already prioritising this work: automating recurring reporting, standardising outputs and putting AI to work on routine analysis. You will give that effort dedicated engineering capability and structure, working closely with the practices and linking them into our technology delivery teams. The aim is not efficiency for its own sake: clients should get insight faster and more consistently, with more of our experts' attention on the decisions that matter most. Alignment across practices is a core part of the role. Common workflows, formats and data help practices share insight, bring clients the full breadth of R\&A and create cross\-selling opportunities. This is how R\&A digitalises its business, moving from manual, practice\-by\-practice delivery to digital, data\-driven services: a broader, connected view of a client's risks, analysis that keeps pace with their business, and advice grounded in data that has never been brought together before. The role offers hybrid working with travel to office expected on a regular cadence for meetings and workshops. Some occasional travel may be required as part of the engagement with business and technology stakeholders. **The Role** * Redesign workflows rather than just automating them: work with practice leaders and subject\-matter experts to map how work gets done today and rebuild it for real efficiency gains. * Shape the problem and the solution: identify where AI changes what we can deliver to clients, agree priorities with practice leadership, and agree success measures (time saved, turnaround to clients, quality and consistency) up front. * Build working solutions fast: prototype and build automation and agents in short cycles, often embedded with the practice team, and take each workflow from problem definition to a measurable gain. * Work closely with the practices: learn how each practice works, build trust with its experts, translate between business and technical teams, and help integrate solutions into existing workflows. * Align practices on common workflows, shared components and agents, so a client working with one practice can draw on all of them, and use that digital foundation to test new ideas and bring new capabilities to clients. * Build agents and pipelines that write to a single, governed data layer, so storage is no longer a per\-team choice and outputs are reusable across R\&A. * Link with technology delivery: work with architects, Delivery Leads and Product Leads, identify the infrastructure each solution needs and raise it early, and take solutions into production through our architecture, security and deployment standards. * Build trust in AI\-enabled processes: evaluate outputs rigorously, keep a human in the loop, and handle sensitive client data in line with security and governance requirements. * Document what you build, help practices adopt and sustain the change, and influence how R\&A colleagues think about their processes and use technology. **Qualifications** ------------------ **What you’ll bring** Essential * Proven experience shipping production software, ideally in data\- or automation\-heavy environments. * Strong TypeScript and Python engineering, with hands\-on experience of LLMs applied to real workflows, including prompting, tool use, document extraction, RAG and rigorous evaluation. * Experience building agents and agentic workflows. * Data engineering fundamentals: pipelines, data modelling, structured storage, and reconciling messy or unstructured inputs such as reports and documents. * Experience using AI coding assistants, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and Azure, to build solutions that can be deployed, run and supported in production. * A process mindset: comfortable mapping and challenging a workflow, and working directly with non\-technical subject\-matter experts. * Curiosity about the client problem: you want to understand how consultants help clients, not just the workflow they follow. * Clear communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. * Awareness of security, access control and data governance for sensitive commercial data. Desirable: * Insurance, risk management or consulting domain experience. * Prior embedded or solutions engineering roles. * A process improvement or automation background. **What we offer** Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company. We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle\-to\-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you. **Equal Opportunity Employer** We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Enables dependable software capabilities that support business operations and digital experiences. Provides direction for defined application and service priorities. Contributes to the long\-term reliability of software within assigned delivery objectives. Cart \& Checkout owns the part of walgreens.com where a customer turns a cart into a paid order. That covers cart, checkout, payments and post\-order flows for one of the largest retail pharmacy sites in the US. We're a team of about 10 engineers, leads and QA. We own around 10 microservices, mostly Java and Spring Boot with some Node.js and ReactJS, running on Azure Kubernetes Service. The work is high\-traffic and directly tied to revenue. It includes payment integrations such as card processing and digital wallets, so reliability, security and PCI\-aware engineering matter every day. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build and maintain Java/Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs for cart, checkout and payments. * Take features from design through production: technical design, code, tests, deployment and support. * Deploy and run services on Azure, including containerized workloads on Kubernetes (AKS). * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Write solid automated tests (unit, integration and API) and keep quality high in code reviews. * Troubleshoot production issues across services, using logs, metrics and traces to find root causes. * Work with product, QA, UX and partner teams (payments, pharmacy, orders) to deliver features end to end. * Contribute to ReactJS front\-end work when needed. * Mentor other engineers and help set team engineering standards. * Use AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot) as part of daily engineering work. **About Walgreens** Founded in 1901, Walgreens (www.walgreens.com) proudly serves nearly 9 million customers and patients each day across its approximately 8,500 stores throughout the U.S. and Puerto Rico. Walgreens has approximately 220,000 team members, including nearly 90,000 healthcare service providers, and is committed to being the first choice for pharmacy, retail and health services, building trusted relationships that create healthier futures for customers, patients, team members and communities. The salary for this role is being provided to promote pay transparency and equal employment opportunities at Walgreens. The actual compensation and performance\-based bonus that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including experience, geographic location, and other factors permitted by law. This job posting will remain open for a minimum of 5 days and may remain open until the position is filled. To review benefits, please click here jobs.walgreens.com/benefits. If you are applying on a job board or unable to click on the link, please copy and paste this URL into your browser jobs.walgreens.com/benefits **Basic Qualifications** * Requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent and at least 4 years of related experience. * At least 2 years of experience in Software Engineering, technology, or a closely related field. * At least 2 years of experience applying software engineering principles to complex application development. * At least 2 years of experience considering the primary business and financial drivers relevant to the area of responsibility and their impact on decisions and recommendations. * At least 2 years of experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. * Travel may be required up to 10%. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Preferred Skills:** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * **Java 17 or later:** strong hands\-on experience with modern Java, including streams, records, concurrency basics and JVM fundamentals. * **Spring Boot:** building production microservices with Spring Boot, including REST API design, Spring Data, Spring Security, configuration and error handling. * **Cloud:** hands\-on experience deploying and running applications in a public cloud. Azure is strongly preferred; AWS or GCP experience is acceptable. * **DevOps basics:** working experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (ADO) or GitHub Actions, plus Git branching and pull request workflows. * Working knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases. * Experience writing automated tests (for example, JUnit and Mockito). * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Clear written and spoken communication, and comfort working with distributed teams. * **ReactJS:** building or maintaining React front ends (hooks, state management, calling REST APIs). * Docker and Kubernetes, ideally Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). * Azure services such as Key Vault, Service Bus, Azure Front Door or API Management. * Event\-driven or messaging systems (Kafka, Azure Service Bus). * Observability tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk or Azure Monitor. * E\-commerce, payments, digital wallets or PCI DSS experience. * Node.js services. We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Salary Range:** $100000 \- $175000 / Salaried **Benefits** ------------ * ### **Health, dental and vision\*** * ### **Retirement Savings Plan (401(k))** * ### **Paid time off benefits** * ### **Onsite fitness center and health center** * ### **Work \& life resources** * ### **Employee discount** * with a 30\-hour work week

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description: Waste Connections is seeking a Full Stack Software Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise applications that drive business operations across North America. This role will focus on backend services, APIs, system integrations, and modern web applications while partnering closely with business and technology teams to deliver innovative, scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support full\-stack business applications using .NET and C\#. * Build and maintain APIs, integrations, and backend services connecting enterprise systems. * Develop responsive web applications using React and/or Angular. * Design and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, and data\-access solutions. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues across application, API, integration, and database layers. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. * Participate in code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD processes. * Ensure application security, compliance, and protection of sensitive data. * Create and maintain technical documentation and support materials. * Continuously improve application performance, reliability, and maintainability. Qualifications Required * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 3\+ years of software development experience using .NET and C\#. * Experience developing and supporting web applications across frontend and backend technologies. * Strong knowledge of REST APIs, integrations, and software architecture principles. * Experience with SQL Server, database design, and query optimization. * Experience with React and/or Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Experience with Git\-based source control and CI/CD tools. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Ability to independently deliver solutions from design through production support. Preferred * Experience with Azure cloud technologies. * Experience with microservices and event\-driven architectures. * Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or other AI\-assisted development tools. * Exposure to containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with Salesforce development is a plus. Why Waste Connections? At Waste Connections, we empower our employees to think entrepreneurially, solve complex business challenges, and make a meaningful impact. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, career growth opportunities, and the chance to work on technology solutions that support one of North America's leading environmental services companies. Waste Connections is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **Soar with us at Wawa.**We believe we can make life a little better every day – one smile, hoagie, or experience at a time. And there’s one secret ingredient that truly sets Wawa apart: Our Associates. At Wawa, you’ll be part of a caring team that’s dedicated to helping all of us fly high – together. We’re team players, day\-brighteners, and go\-getters: and we know that Wawa is a place where we can build skills to thrive and open doors to new career opportunities. We’re proud to be a part of a winning team of Associate owners who shape our success. We’re committed to helping our communities and one another at every turn, because we know that when we fly together, there’s no limit to how far we can go. **Ready to be part of a team that helps you reach new heights? Join our flock and get ready to soar.** **Job Description** Position Summary: The Operations Engineer is responsible for supporting various Wawa departments with development of efficient processes, evaluation of equipment, study and analysis of key systems, and design of critical work cells and store layout concepts. The Operations Engineer uses a process engineering and data\-driven approach to drive improvements which reduce complexity, lower operating costs, improve labor productivity, maximize throughput capacity, and enhance customer speed of service. Principal Duties * Assist in the development of processes and store\-level procedures that will improve productivity, profitability, and customer satisfaction. * Champion process improvements and is responsible for the application and evaluation of the latest technologies to enhance store operating systems, work cell layouts, and equipment. * Support Merchandising, Store Operations, Product Development, Strategic Sourcing, and Store Design initiatives through participation in cross\-functional team projects. Specifically, Operations Engineering will: * study and analyze impact of labor and efficiency utilizing time study methodology * develop engineered time standards and analyze task frequencies to support the store labor model * test new products and define proper cooking methods to meet product quality standards * test and evaluate new equipment for feasibility, durability, energy consumption, and product quality * test and evaluate critical supplies for Food Service and Beverages * design efficient work cells to maximize productivity * optimize backroom and storage needs * conduct capacity analyses for Store Operations to ensure customer demand is met * develop layout concepts for new store design * build simulation models to assess process efficiency and throughput * define and measure key operating metrics * support operational problem solving * identify and alleviate customer bottlenecks * streamline complex functions * benchmark for excellence * Develop and maintain databases and analytical tools used to collect, organize, and analyze large operational, labor, time standard and capacity\-related data sets. * Query, manipulate, and analyze complex datasets using Snowflake and other analytical tools to identify trends, support operational modeling, conduct capacity analyses, and support data\-driven decision making. * Convert complex data sets and analyses into actionable insights. Report results to cross\-functional teams and members of management through Engineering reports or formal presentations. * Ensure that Operations Engineering functions are conducted on a timely basis through the creation of action plans to deliver targeted goal to internal customers. Ensure that resources are used to produce accurate, practical, and actionable results. * Travel to stores to study processes, support roll\-out of key programs, and drive change. Essential Functions: * Highly observant of operating techniques, situations, and conditions * Strong analytical skills with the ability to organize, manipulate, and interpret large datasets * Ability to work well individually as well as in a team environment * Detail oriented and excellent organizational skills * Excellent oral and written communication skills * Excellent customer service skills * Strong problem\-solving capability * Ability to work with little or no supervision * Ability to interact with all levels of management and cross\-functional teams * Self\-motivated, proven self\-starter with demonstrated ability to make decisions * Performs the following physical behavior frequently throughout their shift: standing, walking. * Performs the following physical behaviors occasionally during their shift: bending, stooping, squatting, crouching, kneeling, pushing, reaching below the waist, reaching horizontally, reaching above the shoulder, grasping firmly and pushing buttons. * Ability to travel locally 20% of the time Basic Requirements: * Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering preferred, or 1 – 3 years of experience in a technical related field * Highly proficient with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access and data analysis techniques * Experience querying and analyzing large datasets using Snowflake or similar data warehouse platforms * Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence and data visualization tools preferred * Experience with AutoCAD and/or Mechanical Drafting * Experience with Simulation Modeling (Simio) preferred * Demonstrated understanding of process design and time study methods Wawa will provide reasonable accommodation to complete an application upon request, consistent with applicable law. If you require an accommodation, please contact our Associate Service Center at asc@wawa.com. Wawa, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Wawa maintains a work environment in which Associates are treated fairly and with respect and in which discrimination of any kind will not be tolerated. In accordance with federal, state and local laws, we recruit, hire, promote and evaluate all applicants and Associates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, familial status, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity or expression, citizenship status, disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Unlawful discrimination will not be a factor in any employment decision.

jobs.title: Sr. System Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Sr. System Software Engineer** ================================ Wayne State University is searching for an experienced **Sr. System Software Engineer** at its Detroit campus location. Wayne State is a premier, public, urban research university located in the heart of Detroit, Michigan where students from all backgrounds are offered a rich, high\-quality education. Our deep\-rooted commitment to excellence, collaboration, integrity, diversity and inclusion creates exceptional educational opportunities which prepare students for success in a global society. **Essential functions (job duties):** ------------------------------------- **Basic Purpose:** Positions in the Systems Software Engineer job family are responsible for evaluating, selecting, installing, and maintaining enterprise operating systems and technical applications for assigned platforms including enterprise servers and networks and for serving as a technical resource on enterprise hardware issues. Incumbents interact with technical and business customers to provide training and expertise in the design of specific applications to ensure the optimization of the platforms or technologies involved. The focus of work is on the efficient operation of enterprise operating platforms to support customer applications and the effective use of hardware and operating software in new or enhanced applications. **Essential Functions:** The functions within the job family will vary by level and specific assignment but will include the following: * Evaluate, install, customize, configure, and maintain enterprise operating systems including installing and testing new releases; * Evaluate operating efficiency, analyze performance and tuning, and assist in capacity planning and DASD management; * Analyze and troubleshoot operating problems to find problem areas and make fixes or work with the vendor for correction; * Advise technical staff in complex applications development to assist in avoiding problems of incompatibility with software capabilities; * Document changes to system functions and/or configurations for technical and customer reference; and * Review and evaluate new or upgraded systems software packages and related hardware and make recommendations based on established standards. Comments (Level Descriptions): The Systems Software Engineer family has four levels: **Systems Software Engineer I** This is the proficiency level where incumbents apply their basic skills and expertise, typically with a specific operating system and platform. They perform routine assignments to complete system change and modification requests and assist higher level staff in all aspects of maintaining, updating, documenting, and monitoring the operating systems. Incumbents also provide continuing support for their assigned operating system, trouble\-shooting and resolving common immediate problems. Work is assigned to provide a broader knowledge of the technology supported and to develop a high level of creative problem\-solving in preparation for qualification at the next level of the family. **Systems Software Engineer II** This is the career level where incumbents are fully knowledgeable in the operating system and platform supported and work as a part of a team to develop or install new systems software or supporting applications. The emphasis at this level is the incumbent’s ability to identify and resolve all but the most unusual operating systems problems quickly and with dispatch. While at this level, incumbents are increasing their knowledge and expertise in a complex operating system and platform or are expanding their capabilities in a second technology. They may also have specific assignments in areas such as performance tuning, security, disaster recovery, and the like to broaden their overall knowledge of their assigned technology. **Senior Systems Software Engineer** This is the specialist level where incumbents have full and specialized knowledge in their assigned operating system(s). This may be a single, highly complex system or multiple, less complex systems. Incumbents have primary accountability for the installation, maintenance, and operating efficiency of their assigned systems. They work with a high degree of independence, providing technical leadership and work review for less experienced staff. Individuals at this level are able to identify and resolve the most complex system\-related problems and deal directly with key vendor service representatives. Their work is characterized by the rapid application of technical knowledge to increase the efficiency and operation of the platform(s) supported. Incumbents may also be a Subject Matter Expert for their assigned system serving as third\-tier support for operating problems and technical consultant on complex applications development projects. They are key members of project teams for enterprise applications involving their assigned system. **Lead Systems Software Engineer** This is the leadership level where incumbents are recognized experts in a complex operating system and related areas such as network or database applications. Incumbents lead projects for major upgrades or installations, providing technical guidance and work direction to technical staff and ensuring that projects are completed smoothly and on time. Incumbents may also be a Subject Matter Expert for an enterprise\-wide system, assisting in technology planning and serving as a technical consultant on enterprise applications development project teams. They may also have formal leadership responsibilities for enterprise\-wide functions such as security, disaster recovery, and the like. ### **Unique duties:** **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Minimum Qualifications:** Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: * Knowledge of the specific operating systems, networks, and/or platforms supported; * Understanding of the hardware supported including mainframe, servers, workstations, peripheraldevices, and the like; * Skill in the use of operating system software, companion software, utilities, and the like; * High level skill in identifying and resolving technical problems and/or effectively communicating the problems to vendor representatives; and * Ability to analyze complex operating problems, working independently until the problem is resolved. * Knowledge of operating systems software, platforms, and computer operations typically acquired through an undergraduate program in Computer Science with an emphasis on systems software or the equivalent and one to two years of related experience; jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Wellington Management** offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long\-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients. **About the Role** ================== **Lead AI Engineer, Enterprise AI Platform** ============================================ **Location:** Boston, MA / Hybrid **Level:** Lead / Senior Individual Contributor **Organization:** Enterprise AI **Role Summary** ---------------- The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and operationalize the shared enterprise platform used to develop, deploy, and operate production AI applications and agents safely at scale. This is a senior, hands\-on role at the intersection of software and platform engineering, agentic AI development, cloud infrastructure, security, and developer experience. The role will turn enterprise architecture into reusable services, APIs, SDKs, infrastructure automation, and engineering standards. The platform is anchored on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Foundry, including Foundry Agent Service and hosted agents, and operates within a pragmatic multi\-cloud and multi\-model environment. The emphasis is on building durable engineering capabilities rather than relying on any single product. Success means making the governed path the fastest path for product and engineering teams. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Enterprise AI Platform Engineering** * Design and implement shared platform capabilities, including model access, agent runtimes, orchestration, gateways, MCP and tool integration, retrieval services, agent and tool registries, observability, evaluations, guardrails, and FinOps controls. * Build reusable platform capabilities that enable application and business teams to deliver secure, observable, and resilient production solutions through streamlined self\-service. ### **Agentic Application Development** * Establish patterns, frameworks, and reference implementations for building single\-agent and multi\-agent applications using technologies such as Microsoft Agent Framework or LangGraph. * Develop standards for agent\-to\-agent interoperability, prompts, context, state, memory, human approvals, kill switches, retries, fallback, versioning, service\-level objectives, and controlled promotion to production. ### **AI Gateway and Model Access** * Create a governed, model\-agnostic access layer with authentication, identity propagation, routing, quotas, rate limits, failover, usage attribution, policy enforcement, and provider abstraction. * Support model access across Azure, AWS, and approved on\-premises services, including patterns such as Azure API Management in front of Foundry model deployments. ### **MCP and Enterprise Tools** * Build secure MCP servers and gateways. * Define patterns for hosting, OAuth, delegated authorization, on\-behalf\-of identity, token exchange, tool discovery, registration, and allowlisting. ### **Identity, Security, and Entitlements** * Partner with Identity, Cybersecurity, and Cloud Engineering teams to implement enterprise identity controls. * Develop workload and per\-agent identity with lifecycle management and Conditional Access using Microsoft Entra ID and Entra Agent ID. * Implement role\-based access control, least privilege, app\-registration automation, secrets elimination, cross\-cloud federation, and entitlement\-aware data access. ### **Agent Evaluation and Observability** * Design and operate agent evaluation frameworks and regression pipelines that measure task success, tool\-use correctness, groundedness, safety, and use\-case\-specific outcomes. * Use evaluations as automated quality gates for production promotion. * Instrument agent runs, LLM requests, retrieval, tool calls, latency, errors, quality, policy events, token usage, and cost using OpenTelemetry\-based standards where possible. ### **AI Safety, Risk, and Compliance** * Implement guardrails, content\-safety controls, prompt\-injection defenses, data\-loss protections, red\-team testing, audit trails, and agent and model inventories. * Align platform capabilities with applicable regulatory and model\-risk requirements, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, SR 11\-7, and the EU AI Act where relevant. ### **Automation and Developer Experience** * Treat the platform as a product through Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated test\-to\-stage\-to\-production promotion, policy as code, SDKs, templates, reference implementations, documentation, and self\-service onboarding. **Technical Leadership Responsibilities** ----------------------------------- r:** Designs for security, resilience, scale, traceability, operability, and lifecycle management from the beginning. * **AI technologist:** Demonstrates a deep understanding of agent behavior, context, tools, retrieval, evaluation, and model trade\-offs, not solely cloud infrastructure. * **Enterprise integrator:** Navigates identity, entitlements, cross\-cloud connectivity, internal APIs, and regulated\-data controls. * **Technical leader:** Sets direction through working software, clear standards, strong reviews, mentorship, and credible decision\-making. The strongest candidates will bring senior\-level engineering experience and a demonstrated ability to create durable platform capabilities that enable multiple product and engineering teams to succeed. We are seeking expertise across AI and agent engineering, cloud and platform engineering, security and identity, technical leadership, and enablement. Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds. *As an equal opportunity employer, Wellington Management ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to* *r**ace, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, religion, creed, national origin, age, ancestry, disability (physical or mental), medical condition, citizenship, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information or any other characteristic* *protected by applicable law**.* *If you are a candidate with a disability, or are assisting a candidate with a disability, and require an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please email us at* *GMWTalentOperations@wellington.com**.* At Wellington Management, our approach to compensation is designed to help us attract, inspire and retain the best talent in our industry. We strive to pay employees fairly and competitively across all levels and roles. Our approach to compensation considers all aspects of total compensation; all employees are eligible to receive salary, variable compensation, and benefits. The base salary range for this position is: USD 90,000 \- 180,000 This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered when making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; role; skills and experience; certifications; and education. This range is an estimate, and further details on salary and total compensation aspects will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process. Base salary is only one component of Wellington’s total compensation approach. Other rewards may include a discretionary Corporate Bonus and/ or Incentives, if eligible. In addition, we offer a comprehensive and high value benefit package to meet the unique needs of our employees and their families, and we are committed to fostering a flexible work environment that enables employees to thrive personally and professionally. Examples of our benefits include retirement plan, health and wellbeing, dental, vision, and pharmacy coverage, health savings account, flexible spending accounts and commuter program, employee assistance program, life and disability insurance, adoption assistance, back\-up childcare, tuition/CFA reimbursement and paid time off (leave of absence, paid holidays, volunteer, sick and vacation time) We believe that in person interactions inspire and energize our community and are essential to our culture. We believe that this approach ultimately supports our mission to deliver investment excellence to our clients and their beneficiaries over the long term.

jobs.title: AI Platform Product Manager
jobs.description: Workiva is seeking a technically strong **AI Platform Product Manager** to own one or more of the shared AI primitives that every Workiva AI product is built on. You will define how engineers and product teams across Workiva build, ship, evaluate and govern AI agents, and you will do it with a working understanding of how these primitives behave under the hood. Your first customers are the internal builders who compose these primitives. Your end customers are the finance, audit and sustainability teams at the large companies, including most of the Fortune 1000, that rely on Workiva. They answer to regulators and auditors, so the platform has to make AI trustworthy by default. **The AI platform primitives you'll work with** ----------------------------------------------- You will own the roadmap for multiple AI primitive families and be fluent in the rest. * **Search \& Retrieval:** ingestion, parsing, extraction, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid and graph retrieval, relevance and ranking. * **Context:** agent memory and graph memory. * **Agent Harness \& Orchestration:** declarative agent definition, validation, versioning and publishing; agent runtime and agent loop; orchestration; worker lifecycle; agent and workflow debugging. * **Model Services:** ML and LLM operations, LLM gateway (routing, failover, quotas, caching, version pinning, usage metering, policy enforcement), model serving, model routing and lifecycle. * **Tools \& Integrations:** tool registry, connections, connectors, MCP client and MCP publishing, tool review and approval, approval and autonomy gating, agent identity and access management. * **AI Client:** design components for AI experiences and application context. * **Observability \& Telemetry:** logging and tracing, usage and cost analytics, performance and availability measurement, debugging. * **Evaluations:** online and offline evaluations, standardized graders and templates, golden\-dataset regression evaluation, evaluation SDK and CLI. * **Audit \& Governance (AI Trust):** AI inventory and registry, tamper\-evident audit trail, customer AI controls, evidence packages, retention and legal hold, detection and monitoring, policy management and enforcement. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Platform Strategy \& Vision** * Own the vision, roadmap and success metrics for your assigned primitives, and decide what belongs in a shared primitive versus a single product. * Break long\-term platform vision and goals into a clear MVP and a sequence of incremental releases that deliver value early. * Treat internal engineering and product teams as customers: run discovery, measure adoption, and invest in developer experience, including SDKs, CLIs, documentation and declarative definitions. * Define clear boundaries, contracts and APIs between primitives so teams compose them instead of rebuilding them. ### **Technical Product Leadership** * Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch: user research, requirements, prioritization, and go\-to\-market. * Write requirements at the level of system behavior: interfaces, schemas, and targets for latency, cost and availability. * Make principled tradeoffs, such as retrieval quality versus latency, autonomy versus approval gates, model capability versus cost, and build versus buy. * Take part in architecture reviews, and challenge and be challenged by engineers on design decisions. ### **Trust, Evaluation \& Governance** * Make evaluation, observability and audit built\-in parts of every primitive: golden datasets, graders, traces and audit events from day one. * Partner with Security, Legal and Compliance to turn policy into enforceable controls, including agent identity and access, policy enforcement, customer AI controls and audit evidence packages. ### **Adoption \& Go\-to\-Market** * Drive adoption across Workiva product teams with migration paths, reference implementations and enablement. * Use usage and cost measurement to inform how AI capabilities are packaged and priced for customers. Present platform strategy, roadmaps and results to executive leadership, customers and other stakeholders. * **What You'll Need** -------------------- ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience in product management or a closely related technical product\-building role with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; OR 5\+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree * 3\+ years on platform, infrastructure, developer or AI/ML products. * A track record of shipping platform or API\-first products that other engineering teams adopted, with measurable results. Hands\-on working knowledge of how LLM\-based agents are built: prompts and context, tool calling, retrieval, memory and evaluation. You can read a trace and explain why an agent failed. * ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior software or ML engineering experience, or a history of contributing code. * Experience with multi\-tenant enterprise SaaS, microservices and API\-first design. * Experience building for regulated customers, such as finance, audit, risk, compliance or sustainability reporting. * Experience with product analytics and structured prioritization methods. Ability to explain technical constraints and tradeoffs clearly to executives and non\-technical leaders. * ### **Technical Depth** We expect depth in at least three of these areas and working fluency in the others: * **Retrieval:** chunking, embeddings, hybrid and graph retrieval, ranking, and quality metrics such as precision and recall. * **Agent runtime:** agent loops, orchestration, state, long\-running work and failure handling. * **Model services:** gateways, routing, failover, caching, versioning, and the cost and latency tradeoffs behind them. * **Tools and protocols:** MCP, tool registries, authentication and scopes, approval gating and agent identity (OAuth, SAML, RBAC/ABAC). * **Evaluation:** golden datasets, graders and LLM\-as\-judge, online versus offline evaluation, regression gating. * **Observability:** tracing, usage and cost analytics, debugging production agents. * **Governance:** audit trails, policy enforcement, retention and legal hold, evidence for auditors. **Working Conditions \& Travel Requirements** --------------------------------------------- * Ability to travel up to 20% to meet with customers, stakeholders and product teams at other Workiva locations. Reliable internet connection required during remote work periods. * **How You’ll Be Rewarded** ✅ Salary range in the US: $163,000\.00 \- $290,000\.00 ✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually ✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire ✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors. **Why Join Workiva** Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI\-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world. At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic. Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email talentacquisition@workiva.com . Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards. *Workiva supports employees in working where they work best \- either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.* \#LI\-KP1

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role:** We are looking for an engineer who builds real solutions to real business problems. You will sit with teams across YA Group, learn how their work gets done, find where AI and automation can make it faster, more accurate or less manual, and then build those solutions yourself. This is an internal, hands\-on role. You are not selling products or running demos for customers. You will design, build and ship working tools that our people use every day, using modern AI development tools such as Claude Code alongside solid engineering practice. You will be the first dedicated AI and automation hire on the team, reporting directly to the Head of Technology \& Transformation. You will help shape how YA Group uses AI from the ground up. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. **In This Role, You Will:** Understand the business * Spend time with the business to map how work flows today, including the manual steps, handoffs and workarounds. * Identify and size opportunities for AI and automation, and help prioritize them by business value and effort. * Translate business needs into clear, practical solution designs that non\-technical stakeholders can understand and approve. Build and ship * Design, build, test and deploy AI\-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations and integrations. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code and similar) to move fast, while owning the quality, security and maintainability of what ships. * Integrate with our core business systems, including Microsoft 365, Salesforce, NetSuite and Dayforce, through APIs and connectors. * Work with our data platform and data owners to get the data your solutions need, in a governed way. Architecture and enablement * Contribute to reference architectures and reusable patterns for AI solutions: approved tools, connectors, environments, and how solutions access data. * Support builders outside IT, including AI specialists in other departments, with standards, code review and guidance so their work is secure and maintainable. * Maintain an inventory of AI solutions across the company: what exists, who owns it and what data it uses. Run and improve * Support what you build after launch: monitoring, fixes, documentation and handoff where appropriate. * Measure outcomes such as hours saved, error reduction and cycle time, and report them in plain terms. * Help triage and manage the queue of AI requests from across the business. * Partner with Information Security to put our AI governance framework into practice: tool and vendor evaluation, data access controls, review before production, and lifecycle ownership. **What You Bring:** Required * Hands\-on development experience: 3\+ years building and shipping software that real users depended on, not only prototypes or personal projects. * Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, with experience in REST APIs, JSON and SQL. * Integration experience: connecting business systems through APIs, webhooks or integration platforms. * Engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing, deployment, logging and error handling. * Security awareness: sound handling of credentials, access permissions and sensitive data. * Practical AI experience: has built real solutions with large language models (prompting, tool use, retrieval or agents) and uses AI coding tools in daily work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when to step in. * Solution design: experience designing the architecture of the solutions you build, not only building to someone else's design. * AI risk awareness: working knowledge of risks such as data leakage, prompt injection and model limitations, and the governance practices that address them. * Business process skills: able to sit with business users, ask good questions, map a workflow and explain technical options in plain language. * Ownership: comfortable working independently, managing your own priorities and seeing work through to adoption. Preferred * Experience with Microsoft 365 / Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, NetSuite or Dayforce. * Experience with the Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks. * Cloud experience (Azure preferred) and familiarity with data warehouses and pipelines. * Background in professional services, engineering or another field\-based business. * Experience working in a SOC 2 or similarly controlled environment. **Why Join:** * Build a new capability at a company that is serious about using AI to improve how work gets done. * Direct access to leadership and a wide view across the business. * Visible impact: your work will be used across the company, not shelved. * Remote role with a modern toolset. **Who We Are:** YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. **What We Offer:** * Employee\-focused culture * Strong commitment to work\-life balance * Remote work * Flexible vacation \& Paid holidays * Paid family care and sick leave * Parental leave * Comprehensive benefits * 401k with company match **Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:** Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information, such as bank account numbers or identification numbers, via social media or chat\-based apps. YA also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist, or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding applications will come from notify@dayforce.com or directly from a member of YA’s talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If fraudulent activity is suspected, please contact careers@yagroup.com. **Disclosures:** As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI\-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist, rather than replace, human decision\-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.

outcome\-focused deliverables. * Minimum 5 years of substantial hands\-on experience designing, implementing, operating, troubleshooting, or modernizing enterprise IAM. * Or equivalent combination of education and experience * Demonstrated experience leading complex Identity architecture, migration, or platform transformation across multiple systems or teams. * Strong experience with SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth, SCIM, federation, authentication, provisioning, lifecycle management, APIs, directories, attributes, groups, and automation. * Demonstrated ability to move personally between architecture and implementation. * Experience evaluating IAM platforms and vendors against technical, operational, migration, and business requirements. * Demonstrated ability to understand legacy or homegrown systems, identify important dependencies, and create practical modernization and migration paths. **Job Specific Working Conditions:** The anticipated salary rate for this position can range from $91,750\.00 \- $118,250\.00 depending on relevant experience and education, working location, and scheduled weekly hours.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, YouTube Live Discovery
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience developing recommender/ranking/prediction systems for personalized content delivery. * Experience in building and architecting ML systems and infrastructure (e.g., for model training, evaluation, deployment, serving). * Experience working with consumer\-facing video, audio or streaming platforms. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, personalization, search quality, embedding) in production. * Experience in distributed Machine Learning and Machine Learning infrastructure, distributed systems and with Machine Learning algorithms at scale. * Experience in designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience in Machine Learning model development and deployment frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Tensorflow, Jax, Ray), AI accelerators (e.g., TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (e.g., encoders, decoders, transformers), or APIs. * Experience in search and information retrieval. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a (TL) Technical Lead, you will work on improving Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and end\-to\-end solutions to empower live recommendations and grow live ecosystems responsibly. You will set up growth metrics and goals, conduct analysis and research to identify growth areas, and lead a team of engineers to iterate experiments toward launch. Additionally, you will communicate across YouTube engineering teams and leads, to align with the design direction and future plans of your projects. In this position, you will work with YouTube Discovery teams (e.g., Home, Shorts, WatchNext, Notifications, Living Room), Live Infrastructure, and Live Experience teams, and collaborate with Google DeepMind, YouTube Knowledge, and YouTube Trust and Safety (TnS) teams. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the technical goal and architecture for YouTube Live discovery and recommendation ML systems. * Develop state\-of\-the\-art deep learning models to improve real\-time engagement and viewer retention on live streams. * Scale high\-throughput, low\-latency machine learning pipelines to handle massive real\-time streaming data concurrent traffic. * Mentor junior and senior engineers, fostering technical growth and engineering excellence across the ML organization. * Design ranking, retrieval, and candidate generation algorithms tailored for live and real\-time content. jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering, Big Data
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ At Zillow, the top real estate website in the U.S., we’re on a mission to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. We’re creating innovative, connected, and equitable solutions to help people move from dreaming to transacting. The Analytics Data Engineering (ADE) organization sits within Zillow’s Data Engineering, Science \& Analytics organization and builds the data foundation for Zillow’s consumer business. Across three teams, ADE owns the data that measures the full customer journey: how buyers discover and engage with Zillow, connect with Preferred agents, finance with Zillow Home Loans, and transact. Our data products cover top\-of\-funnel engagement, leads, connections and transactions, the Zillow Home Loans funnel, marketing attribution and measurement, and Customer 360\. Partners in Data Science, AI/ML, Business Operations, Marketing, Experimentation, Finance and Product use them every day to set targets, size investments, run experiments, and build better customer experiences. **About the role** ------------------ \- Define and execute the long\-term strategy for big data engineering, ensuring platforms, pipelines, and services are scalable, reliable, and aligned with Zillow’s product and AI objectives. \- Lead and develop multiple engineering teams responsible for building high\-volume data ingestion, transformation, and serving systems supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning. \- Establish technical standards, architecture patterns, and best practices for big data processing, storage, and governance in cloud environments. \- Collaborate with product management, data science, and business stakeholders to prioritize data capabilities, translate requirements into engineering roadmaps, and deliver impactful data products. \- Build, mentor, and retain a diverse, high\-performing organization of managers and senior engineers through coaching, feedback, and clear career paths. \- Use data and engineering metrics to monitor platform health and drive continuous improvement in reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and developer productivity. \- Champion secure, compliant, and privacy\-aware data practices, partnering with security, legal, and compliance teams as needed. \- Influence technical strategy and modernization initiatives across the broader engineering ecosystem, advocating for best practices in big data architecture and tooling. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $251,400\.00 \- $401,600\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $238,900\.00 \- $381,500\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. \- 12\+ years of experience in software engineering with significant hands\-on exposure to large\-scale data systems, including 5\+ years in people leadership roles managing managers and/or senior engineers. \- Proven experience leading the design and operation of big data platforms, distributed data processing, or large\-scale data pipelines in a cloud environment. \- Demonstrated success partnering with product and data science teams to deliver data capabilities that support analytics, experimentation, and machine learning solutions. \- Track record of building and scaling high\-performing engineering organizations, including hiring, developing, and retaining diverse talent. \- Experience driving cross\-functional initiatives that improve data quality, reliability, governance, and developer experience. \- Or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role for Santa Clara, CA, reporting to the Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department. As an engineer on the Data \& APIs team, you will build large\-scale data pipelines and real\-time streaming systems that process Zscaler's security telemetry at scale, along with the APIs that expose it to internal and external consumers. You will own features end\-to\-end across the streaming pipeline and API surface—writing production code, contributing to distributed\-systems design, and operating what you build. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Build and maintain backend services and APIs (REST/gRPC) that expose Zscaler's security data to internal teams and customers, writing production\-quality code across the request path * Contribute to large\-scale streaming and batch data pipelines (Kafka, Spark/Flink) and the storage layer (SQL, NoSQL, columnar) that feed those APIs — writing processing logic, tuning performance, and helping triangulate bottlenecks in production * Participate in design discussions, write and review design docs for features you own, and contribute to AI/ML enabled jobs.title: AI Engineer

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description: eGain is the leader in AI knowledge management solutions for enterprises. This foundation enables scalable and effective AI automation of business operations, with customer service as the primary point of ROI. Our solutions power leading companies including JP Morgan, Liberty Mutual, Florida Blue, and Bosch. ### **The Opportunity** Join us in reimagining knowledge management as mission\-critical infrastructure for the AI\-powered enterprise. We’re seeking talented, hungry, and bold leaders to shape the future of how enterprises leverage AI and knowledge at scale. ### **Position Overview** As Director of Engineering, you will lead the development of customer\-facing applications that bring eGain’s AI knowledge management capabilities to life. You’ll oversee the creation of intuitive, powerful interfaces and applications that enable customer service agents, knowledge managers, and business users to harness the full power of enterprise knowledge and AI. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the engineering teams responsible for eGain’s core applications including knowledge authoring, search and discovery, agent desktop, and analytics * Drive the application architecture strategy, ensuring modern, maintainable, and performant user experiences * Build and inspire engineering teams that are passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and solving real business problems * Own the technical execution from concept through delivery, ensuring applications meet the highest standards of quality and usability * Collaborate closely with product management, UX design, and customer success to deliver applications that delight users and drive business value * Champion modern application development practices including agile methodologies, CI/CD, and automated testing * Foster innovation in AI\-powered user experiences, including conversational interfaces, intelligent recommendations, and proactive insights * Ensure application security, accessibility, and compliance with enterprise standards ### **What We’re Looking For** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with 5\+ years leading engineering teams * Strong expertise in modern web application frameworks and technologies (React, Angular, or similar) * Experience building enterprise SaaS applications with complex workflows and rich user interfaces * Deep understanding of application architecture patterns, API design, and front\-end/back\-end integration * Proven ability to balance user experience excellence with technical excellence * Track record of delivering high\-quality applications on schedule in fast\-paced environments * Strong product sensibility and user empathy * Excellent collaboration skills and experience working cross\-functionally with product and design teams * Passion for leveraging AI and machine learning to create intelligent application experiences * Bold creative vision combined with disciplined execution ### **Why eGain** * Build applications used by thousands of customer service professionals at leading enterprises * Shape how organizations interact with AI\-powered knowledge systems * Work $250,000 per year. * Stock options. jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. ### **About the role** Our database layer sits under everything Mecka ships, and it's growing quickly. We're looking for someone to own it: learn what we've built, set the plan for where it goes next, and help us scale. As part of our Platform Engineering \& Infrastructure team, you'll work hands\-on with MongoDB and ClickHouse at scale and take on challenges no one has solved for us yet. We need someone who brings both speed and quality, and who wants real ownership. ### **What you'll do** * Own the database layer: Take full ownership of Mecka's MongoDB and ClickHouse, and make the decisions that keep them healthy. * Learn it, then own it: Get a real grasp of the current setup in your first months, including a short overlap with a MongoDB engineer on contract, and take it from there. * Design the schema path: Come in with a medium\- and long\-term plan for schema and database design. * Plan the scale\-up: Map out what 2x to 10x data growth looks like, and how we avoid outages without a ton of compute and cost. * Solve what's new: Take on the unique problems that come with scaling, and find the path forward quickly without cutting corners. ### **What you'll need** * 3\+ years owning databases in a growing, fast\-paced environment. * Expert in MongoDB and ClickHouse, including advanced features at scale. * You've scaled databases through rapid growth before, and you bring those lessons with you. * You can ramp up, and you're ready to own the database layer. * You move quickly, and you have a point of view on how we should scale, avoid outages and keep this sustainable. This posting is for an existing vacancy (a newly created role). If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.
